#### **Introduction**

Rain of Fear is EverQuest's 19th expansion. It was announced on September 6, 2012, and had an official launch date of November 28, 2012.

- For the original announcement, see [this news story](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/story.html?story=30490).
- For all announcements and news postings surrounding the expansion, see [this link](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/news/tags/RainOfFear).
- For the expansion release patch message, see [this news story](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/story.html?story=31194).

In February 2013, it was [announced](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/story.html?story=31945) that an extension to the Rain of Fear expansion would be arriving in Spring: "Shadow of Fear" would bring on two additional zones, the Plane of Shadow and Chelsith Reborn. These zones were [introduced on April 17, 2013](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/story.html?story=32216).

In June 2013, a second extension was [announced](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/story.html?story=32631). "Heart of Fear" went live with three new zones on [July 16, 2013](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/story.html?story=32726)..

#### **Features**

- Level cap increase from 95 to 100 â€“ Achieve a new max level of 100 and set a new standard of gameplay.

- Hunter System â€“ Gain special rewards and titles for defeating large numbers of foes.

  - The Hunter System is found in the achievement window ("/ach" to track your kills).

- Aggro Meter â€“ A brand new tool to help better manage your aggro. You can now see your aggro level relative to your group.

  - Appears automatically in target windows.

- Collection System â€“ Discover items throughout Norrath and collect sets for exciting rewards and titles.

  - Like the Hunter System, this is found in and tracked through the achievement window.

- Improved Brokering System â€“ Sell items in the Bazaar while being offline! More flexibility as a buyer to search and purchase from anywhere in the world.

  - See [this news story](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/story.html?story=31054) for details about the offline Bazaar system.

- New Linear Item Progression â€“ Stats on armor collected will increase as you move up from one tier to another.

  - New itemization eliminates the issue where some classes would actually be downgrading by replacing a particular lower tier item with a higher tier item.

- Customization with non-visible armor â€“ All non-visible armor in Rain of Fear can be worn by all. You'll be able to customize your stats for every encounter.

  - Many earrings, rings, neck items, belts, etc. are designated ALL/ALL.

- Class-specific stat distribution â€“ Collect items that are designed specifically for each classes' abilities.

  - This is tied to the new itemization and all/all items.

- More than 1800 New Spells (Ranks 1, 2 & 3) â€“ Exponentially add to your spell arsenal.

- More than 550 AAs â€“ Elevate your power and abilities like never before.

- More than 3500 New Items â€“ Create your own identity with thousands of new items.

- More than 3000 New Tradeskill recipes â€“ Increase your value across Norrath by creating items only available by your craftsmanship.

- More than 110 Quests â€“ Challenge your skills and gather useful loot.

- 13 Raids â€“ Collect valuable rewards from all new adventures.

- 9 Zones â€“ Be the first to discover untouched lands of Norrath.

  - (10 zones if you count the new raid instance of North Temple of Veeshan.)

- 19 Missions â€“ Experience intriguing lore and immersive Missions.

- Continued opportunity to kill off Halflings.

- Legends of Norrathâ„¢ â€“ 5 Digital Booster Packs.

#### **What's Going On**

After the [defeat of The Triune God](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5538), the power of fear shot up into the sky and has now fallen back to Norrath in the form of crystalline shards... On the heels of the [incident at the Tower of Frozen Shadow](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=5702), some other old faces (along with some new faces) have gotten their hands on some of these shards...

For more lore surrounding Rain of Fear, check out [this wiki article](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/wiki/eq:Rain_of_Fear_Lore).

#### **Getting There**

- How to get to Rain of Fear zones:

  - Via the passage in the far northeastern corner of Erillion, the City of Bronze (to zone into Shard's Landing)
  - Via Druid/Wizard ports (to zone into Shard's Landing)
  - Via the Guild Hall portal (to zone into Shard's Landing)
  - Via the various portals found in older content (see the next section)
  - By clicking on the shard in the middle of the Shard's Landing crater (to zone into the Heart of Fear)

* * *

#### **Older Content Portals**

- Zone connections to Rain of Fear zones are found in six other older content zones:

- Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening (entered through the Eastern Wastes -- shard click in the far southeastern corner of the zone)
- Breeding Grounds (entered through Dragon Necropolis -- shard click in the far eastern part of the zone's upper level)
- Grelleth's Palace (entered through the Resplendent Temple -- shard click next to Udgar the Brave in the underground cave system)
- Evantil, the Vile Oak (entered by climbing a giant root near the Sarith zone-in; it extends into the southern boundary of the zone)
- Chapterhouse of the Fallen (entered through the Commonlands -- shard click next to the Befallen entrance)
- Valley of King Xorbb (entered through Beholder's Maze -- shard click in the north-central part of the zone)
- Chelsith Reborn (entered through The Grey -- shard click in the revenant lake, northwestern corner of the zone)
- Plane of Shadow (entered through Vex Thal -- shard click just outside the entrance hallway from the Umbral Plains)

- Map Locations (copy & paste into map files):

- eastwastes.txt map

  - P 4191.0000, 9091.0000, 143.0967, 0, 0, 240, 2, Zeixshi-Kar's\_Awakening

- necropolis.txt map

  - P 2732.6785, 36.3181, 18.1900, 0, 0, 240, 2, Breeding\_Grounds

- resplendent.txt map

  - P -97.8480, -2895.9031, -333.5678, 0, 0, 240, 2, Grelleth's\_Palace

- beastdomain.txt map

  - P -3345.0874, 6106.0879, 40.8294, 0, 0, 240, 2, Evantil,\_the\_Vile\_Oak

- commonlands.txt map

  - P -975.0684, 1054.1019, 41.6716, 0, 0, 240, 2, Chapterhouse\_of\_the\_Fallen

- beholder.txt map

  - P 543.4254, -1272.5778, 3.5822, 0, 0, 240, 2, Valley\_of\_King\_Xorbb

- thegrey.txt map

- vexthal.txt map

- Before going to these older zones, be sure to first pick up all the [portal attuning tasks](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/search.html?q=portal+activation) (note: this search output includes four older content tasks as well). Once you have those six tasks (or can do one at a time if you prefer), you can enter the new zones through the above portals and click an item to update your task. Once your task is updated for the particular zone, you can use the portals found in Shard's Landing to go to the new zones (this, instead of having to run around older zones every time).

* * *

#### **Progression**

- In the group game, there are no locked zones in this expansion. All zones are open.

- None of the mercenary tasks (meaning the kill tasks and non-story arc tasks) have any pre-requisites for requesting.

- Each zone has a central story arc (a zone's partisan tasks and missions). While partisan tasks for a particular zone have to be completed in a certain order, there are no other pre-requisites (meaning you can "start" in whichever zone you want; you are not forced to start in Tier 1).

- For a list of tasks in Rain of Fear, see our main progression article: [Progression Through the Rain of Fear Expansion](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/wiki/eq:Progression_Through_Rain_of_Fear)

* * *

#### **Raids**

- Unlike the group game, there is an element of raid progression in place.

- Like Veil of Alaris, raid currencies (and vendors) are back. Currencies work the same way as in Veil of Alaris.

- Fore more details, see our main raiding article: [Raiding in Rain of Fear](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/wiki/eq:Raiding_in_Rain_of_Fear)

* * *

#### **Armor**

- Armor is produced in a similar manner as previous expansions, except there is no template to buy, and the adorning agent is ALL/ALL.

  - For more details, see our main armor article: [Rain of Fear Armor Guide](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/wiki/eq:Rain_of_Fear_Armor_Guide)

* * *

#### **Class Weapons**

- With the "Heart of Fear" extension, class weapons were added (one group weapon and one raid weapon for each class).

  - For more details about how to obtain these weapons, see [this quest entry](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=6924).

* * *

#### **AAs**

- There are no locked AAs. All AAs are immediately available.

* * *

#### **Spells**

- Spells are obtained in the same manner as previous expansions (Rk. I vendorbought; Rk. II result from droppable turn-ins; Rk. III result from no-trade raid drops).

- Rank I spells are open to purchase without any pre-requisites.

- Rank I Spells

  - These spells are bought from vendors in the crater of Shard's Landing (in and around tents at around /location 400, 50, 2 -- this is the southwestern part of the crater where all the Shard's Landing task NPCs are found):

    - Bards and Enchanters: [Gilbert Songcryer](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=41127)
    - Clerics and Paladins: [Olivia Dawnlight](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=41129)
    - Druids and Rangers: [Noel Gladestrider](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=41130)
    - Necromancers and Shadow Knights: [Lirit T\`Prakk](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=41140)
    - Shamans and Beastlords: [Varille Alyrinshar](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=41131)
    - Wizards and Magicians: [Gilab Flamesphere](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=41128)
    - Melee Tomes: [Went Steelhaft](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=41132)

- Rank II Spells

  - Tradeable Dreadmotes are dropped by named mobs throughout the expansion.
  - Say "dreadmote" to [Tomekeeper Kerkaz](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=41133) in Shard's Landing (435, 25, 0 -- in a tent in the southwestern portion of the crater, slightly north of the quest NPC camp).

    - [Minor Dreadmote](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=106533) results in a [Level 96 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=6004)
    - [Lesser Dreadmote](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=106476) results in a [Level 97 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=6005)
    - [Median Dreadmote](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=106509) results in a [Level 98 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=6006)
    - [Greater Dreadmote](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=106464) results in a [Level 99 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=6007)
    - [Glowing Dreadmote](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=106497) results in a [Level 100 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=6008)

- Rank III Spells

  - NO TRADE Terrormotes are found in raid chests.
  - Say "terrormote" to [Tomekeeper Kerkaz](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=41133) in Shard's Landing (435, 25, 0 -- in a tent in the southwestern portion of the crater, slightly north of the quest NPC camp).

    - [Minor Terrormote](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=106901) results in a [Level 96 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=6009)
    - [Lesser Terrormote](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=106932) results in a [Level 97 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=6010)
    - [Median Terrormote](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=106902) results in a [Level 98 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=6011)
    - [Greater Terrormote](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=106844) results in a [Level 99 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=6012)
    - [Glowing Terrormote](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/item.html?item=106845) results in a [Level 100 spell/disc](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=6013)

- Portal Spells

  - Wizard and Druid portal spells are bought from [Magus Burlshin](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=41139) in Shard's Landing. He's found at the crystal druid ring a short distance from the zone-in in the southeastern valley. You need ally faction with "Crystal Circle Builders" to see them.

- Faycite Shards

  - Faycite spell shard augmentations are bought from Tomekeeper Kerkaz in the spell vendor camp of Shard's Landing (435, 25, 0 -- in a tent in the southwestern portion of the crater, slightly north of the quest NPC camp).

    - [Tomekeeper Kerkaz](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/npc.html?id=41133)

## Overview

Note: This write-up outlines group tasks and progression. For details about raid progression, see this article: **[Raiding in Rain of Fear](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/wiki/eq:Raiding_in_Rain_of_Fear)**.

There are no locked zones in this expansion. All zones are open.

There are 14 static zones:

- Tier 1:

  - [Shard's Landing](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=867)
  - [Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=868)
  - [Crystal Caverns: Fragment of Fear](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=870)
  - [Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=869)

- Tier 2:

  - [Breeding Grounds](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=871)
  - [Grelleth's Palace, Chateau of Filth](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=872)
  - [Evantil, the Vile Oak](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=873)
  - [Chapterhouse of the Fallen](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=874)
  - [Valley of King Xorbb](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=875)

- Tier 3 (introduced to live servers on April 17, 2013):

  - [Chelsith Reborn](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=914)
  - [Plane of Shadow](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=915)

- Tier 4 (introduced to live servers on July 16, 2013):

  - [Heart of Fear: The Threshold](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=924)
  - [Heart of Fear: The Rebirth](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=925)
  - [Heart of Fear: The Epicenter](https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/zone.html?zstrat=926)

In the group game, the Rain of Fear expansion is mostly non-linear. The only task pre-requisites you will encounter are those involved in a zone's individual central task arc. As far as overall zone progression, you can do anything in any order.

* * *

## List of Tasks

Listed here are all tasks and group missions.

- **Bolded** tasks represent that zone's central task arc.

  - These tasks make up a linear series to be completed in the order they're listed below.

- Unbolded tasks are stand-alone, generally with no pre-requisites other than a minimum level of 85.

**Note: Most or all starting task NPCs are findable with the CTRL+F (Find) option.**

**Note: This write-up will in with links to quest and NPC entries as they are entered into the database.**

---

_This is a raid introduced with EverQuest's 13th anniversary. It is only available during anniversary season (was available in 2012 from mid-March to mid-June)._
_It begins with Sam Napth, a Halfling in the Plane of Knowledge at about -215, -90, -155 (next to the Soulbinder)._
_Pre-requisites for requesting the raid:_
\- All of Sam Napth's previous tasks
_Pre-requisites for participating in the raid:_
\- None
_NOTE: There is a one-time reward window granted for completing this entire raid expedition. It allows you to choose from the two augmentations as well as a host of faction boosts and experience options._
_NOTE: Most mobs in this zone drop an item called "Fitting Wedding Garb". This item negates the zonewide snare/stat reduction effect. (If you die, you lose the item.)_

---

**Summary**
\- Say "stop to Mayong" to Sam Napth to trigger the raid.
\- Say "ready" to zone into Iceclad.
\- Click on the door to zone into the tower.
\- Say "fitting garb" to Tserrina to trigger the Warlord Ykesha event:
\-\-\-\-\-\- Kill adds as they spawn; don't let Ykesha die; heal him to 100% health.
\- Click the right-side mirror to port up to the second floor.
\- Clear all trash.
\- Say "lend your voices" to The Performer's Spirit to trigger the event, and then in either order:
\-\-\-\-\-\- Kill Zi-Thuuli (death touch trigger; spawns adds with caster-disruptive auras).
\-\-\-\-\-\- Kill Maestro of Rancor (kill The Performer and other skeletons as they activate to unlock Maestro's health).
\-\-\---- **Individual 4.5 day lockout for this event.**
\- Click the mirror to port up to the third floor.
\- Clear the area of trash mobs.
\- Obtain the 12 gifts from the NPCs:
\-\-\-\-\-\- an old froglok (hail)
\-\-\-\-\-\- Captain Pete ("wretched sands")
\-\-\-\-\-\- Eggsniffer ("dead")
\-\-\-\-\-\- Farwhendle ("Captain Pete")
\-\-\-\-\-\- Fixxin (hail)
\-\-\-\-\-\- Galdorin ("Abysmal Sea"; "Queen of Thorns")
\-\-\-\-\-\- Glob (hail)
\-\-\-\-\-\- Hasten ("pawns")
\-\-\-\-\-\- Khasva ("malevolence")
\-\-\-\-\-\- Pastseeker (hail in Vah Shir illusion)
\-\-\-\-\-\- Romella ("Mynthi Davissi")
\-\-\-\-\-\- Tired Farmer (hail)
\- Wait for Lanys T`Vyl's spawn.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Fight Lanys T`Vyl to low health.
\- Click the mirror to port up to the fifth floor.
\- Clear the entire wedding party to spawn Valdoon Kel`Novar.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Kill Valdoon Kel`Novar (death touch trigger; targeted AE lifetap).
\-\-\---- **Individual 4.5 day lockout for this event.**
\- Click the mirror to port up to the sixth floor.
\- Clear your way to Venril Sathir's room.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Kill Venril Sathir and the Dracoliche of Tserrina.
\- Click the mirror to port up to the top floor.
\- Set up in the event room; hail Tserrina to start it.
\-\-\-\-\-\- DPS Tserrina until Mayong Mistmoore spawns.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Balance their health to 30% while fending off numerous add waves.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Kill Mayong Mistmoore the Empowered.
\-\-\---- **Individual 4.5 day lockout for this event.**
\- This completes the expedition.

---

**Initiating the Expedition**
You say, 'Hail, Sam Napth'
Sam Napth glares at you angrily before quickly changing demeanor and speaking, 'Welcome back, \_\_\_\_\_... While our previous efforts to put a [stop to Mayong] did not work out as planned surely if we try again it will work out differently!' The halfling pauses for a moment and laughs uneasily, 'Then again you may just be here to work on one of the other tasks?'
You say, 'We'll put a stop to Mayong'
Sam Napth nods, an unnatural grin flashes across his face before he speaks, 'I suppose I am the fool for not seeing this earlier. It is up to you and your allies to put an end to the vampire god... again. Tell me when you are [ready] and I shall transport you as close to the Tower as I can.'
The Tower of Frozen Shadow is now available to you.
You say, 'Ready!'
Sam Napth grins and says, 'Good luck.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered The Iceclad Ocean.

---

**Iceclad Ocean**
_You'll first zone into Iceclad Ocean where you'll find a fallen raid. If you hail the NPCs in this area, this is what you'll see:_
You say, 'Hail, a distraught raider'
a distraught raider says 'So Sam has sent you here as well? Then I shall pray for your safe return from the tower. Tunare did not see fit to heed my wishes for my own allies, so I'm sure her infinite mercy is being saved for you and your party.' The cleric sighs, 'Of course if you would rather [return] to New Tanaan than spill your blood in the icy halls then I would be happy to transport you back.'
You say, 'Hail, an anguished adventurer'
an anguished adventurer says 'So Napth has talked you into storming the tower too?' The half elf chuckles, 'Well I wish you the best of luck, \_\_\_\_\_, you may need it. As you can clearly see by the weapons clutched in my allies' hands, we were not ill-prepared for what lay ahead of us in the tower, yet we stood no chance once we crossed the gate. It's still not too late to [return] to New Tanaan, life is more valuable than pride... To some.' The tired raid leader looks over his fallen allies and sighs. '
You say, 'Hail, a pensive heyokah'
a pensive heyokah glares, 'And hail to you, an obtrusive busy-body. Now away with you, I'm trying to locate an idiot's spirit in the afterlife so I can revive him. He owes me money!' The barbarian kicks a bit of snow over the dead dark elf's body.
You say, 'Hail, an irate reaver'
an irate reaver says 'I bet this fool would be alive if we had any semblance of direction from our godforsaken raid leader! I can count on one hand the number of minions I've lost under my command and that is only because I slew them myself for complaining too much. Back when I was in charge our raiders were a much tougher folk. Not like you modern day milksops trouping around in your 'heroic' armor and your ridiculous...' The reaver continues to complain but you stop listening.'
_You can zone into the Tower of Frozen Shadow by clicking on the tower's door._
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered The Tower of Frozen Shadow.

---

**Tower of Frozen Shadow: Stage 1 (First Floor - The Entrance)**
_On the first floor, you have to keep Warlord Ykesha from being killed and heal him to full. (No loot drops here.)_
You say, 'Hail, Tserrina Syl`Tor'
Tserrina Syl`Tor stands over the body of a familiar fallen Troll. A small stream of blood trickles from her smiling lips as she looks up and speaks, 'Ah the wedding party has arrived, how wonderful!' She pauses, 'Oh, but you are not yet dressed for our joyous night. This will simply not do. No, I must insist that you don yourselves in more [fitting garb]...'
You say, 'Fitting garb?'
Tserrina Syl`Tor smiles and says, 'Bloodstained rags and skinless flesh shall better suit the occasion... Now if you would excuse me, I have a party to prepare.'
Tserrina speaks away from you as she approaches the mirror, 'My loyal servants, please see to it that this meddling troll is done away with and that our esteemed guests receive the 'proper' treatment.' She cackles gleefully as she vanishes from sight.
Objective: Defend Warlord Ykesha and clear the first floor of Tserrina's servants!
_Many, many adds spawn. Some are known to be mezzable; some are stunnable; many have their own AEs (one add type may have an AE mez); some of them may mem blur._
_Once Warlord Ykesha is at 100% health and all adds are dead, you see:_
The walls echo with the sound of Tserrina's voice, despite your victory she sounds ecstatic, 'Well then, I suppose the master was right to invite you today.' Her tone changes to a playful yell, 'Mayong, my love, let these mortals feel the embrace of your presence!'
Warlord Ykesha thanks you for helping him take revenge on Tserrina's lesser minions.
The path to the second floor of the tower is now open.
Warlord Ykesha says 'Dem evil guys tries to kill meez after me helps dems get to tower! Me stay here and you go teach dems a lesson! Bash em gud!'
_NOTE: If you let Warlord Ykesha die, you'll see this emote:_
Warlord Ykesha's body explodes in a burst of ethereal force that empowers Tserrina's remaining guards!

---

**Tower of Frozen Shadow: Stage 2 (Second Floor - The Library)**
_Clear the area of trash mobs. Once the last trash mob dies, you'll see:_
The Performer cocks his dusty skull and poses dramatically. Even in undeath, the minstrel before you has retained his poise and charm. His charred bones rattle as he addresses the room, 'On the eve of this most sacred night we are blessed by your presence. I trust you all [remember your parts] in our great medley?'
You say, 'I remember my parts'
The Performer says, 'Has it really been that long since our last performance?' The Performer cackles gleefully, 'Take a moment to prepare yourselves, when you are ready to [lend your voices] let me know and we shall begin.'
You say, 'Ready to lend our voices'
The Performer Says, 'Wonderful! Pay attention to the cues and sing the next line of the song when called upon. The guards will arrive soon and attempt to break up our entertainment, so fend them off as best you can. Forgive me, but I'm actually giddy. The Master shall regret dragging us here to 'entertain' his mistress's guests!'
As The Performer signals to Aelfric to start the melody a violent shaking overtakes the room! The bodies of the bard troupe are burned and tossed about violently. Severed skulls roll down the aisles landing next to broken hands still clutching ancient instruments. A booming voice cries out in an eerily pleasant tone, 'Caught by surprise, mortals!?'
Zi-Thuuli of the Granite Claw says 'You continue to put up an admirable fight, but your journey ends here!'
Objective: Defeat the Maestro of Rancor and Zi-Thuuli of the Granite Claw!
_Both these nameds go live at once. They each hit for a max ~19,000 (maybe more?)._
_Zi-Thuuli of the Granite Claw casts a gargoyle death touch trigger ("Greater Spreading Stone" which is cured by curse cure); "Greater Immobilizing Stone"; and "Wings of the Greater Gargoyle". He also spawns gargoyle adds called "a Shard of the Granite Claw". These adds each have an aura around them that disrupt spell casting. While they can be melee'd to death, it is best to leave them mezzed. For every tick they spend under a mez spell, they take about 20% damage._
Greater Spreading Stone: Single Target, Chromatic (-1000)
1: Increase Curse Counter by 16
2: Illusion: Gargoyle
3: Improved Spell Effect: Greater Spreading Stone Trigger
Greater Immobilizing Stone: Single Target, Chromatic (-825)
1: Stun (6.00 sec)
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 1000
3: Feign Death
Wings of the Greater Gargoyle: PB AE 1000', Chromatic (-825)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 5500
_The Maestro of Rancor activates the Performer skeletons one by one (these adds activate one at a time based on the Maestro's health). You have to kill these adds in order to unlock the Maestro's health. After the fifth add dies, the Maestro can be killed. Maestro also casts an AE lifetap:_
Deadlier Lifetap: Targeted AE 200', Magic (-850)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 30770
_Upon the deaths of these two, a chest spawns with loot and you gain a 4.5 day lockout timer (reward information is listed in the bottom section of this writeup)._
Zi-Thuuli of the Granite Claw has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Zi-Thuuli's spirit returns to the Demi-Plane of Blood.
Maestro of Rancor has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
The Maestro's spirit returns to the Plane of Hate. His disembodied voice rings in your ears, 'You are on your own now Mayong!'
Tserrina's voice fills the halls. While her tone is still pleasant there are faint bits of frustration in her words, 'Well... You are all certainly proving to be a... lively... bunch. Perhaps my love disagreed with my choice of entertainment... That is fine... I shall offer you my thanks in removing an annoyance and allow you to meet with the rest of our guests on the next floor.'
The Maestro's Repository materializes in the south side of the library.
The path to the third floor of the tower is now open.

---

**Tower of Frozen Shadow: Stage 3 (Third Floor - The Dining Area)**
A bell echoes through the hall and the regal voice of a butler addresses the crowd, 'Honored guests of the Master, dinner will be served in thirty minutes. Please take this time to prepare yourselves for the banquet. Speak to one another and do try to avoid any more violent outbursts. We would not want to damage any of the fine gifts you have brought for our joyous ceremony.'
Objective: Collect the wedding gifts from the 12 honored guests.
The honored guests with gifts remaining to be obtained can be located using the find command.
_Note: These NPCs are findable via the Find (CTRL+F) function) and disappear from the Find function after their gift has been obtained._
an old froglok

Captain Pete

You say, 'Me ship?'
Captain Pete shakes his head, 'Poor memory on yeh 'eh? Famous as I be, you should know the name of my ship! Ya seem familiar, I'm sure we've worked together before!'

Farwhendle Higglespout

You say, 'What thief?'
Farwhendle Higglespout says 'I would expect you to know his name before I have you going off and delivering things to him.'

You say, 'Captain Pete'
Farwhendle Higglespout cackles, 'Nay, I don't actually have some sordid prize for the fellow, but that's a good memory you got there, \_\_\_\_\_. Go ahead and take this gift though. I will be going home before I can deliver it to the Master and The Lady.'

Fixxin Followig grins, 'Excellent! In fact, so excellent I have a prize for your hard work. They tried to confiscate my weapons when I arrived here but I snuck a this past 'em! Galdorin Visigothe
You say, 'Hail, Galdorin Visigothe'
Galdorin Visigothe seems to be mid-thought as you interrupt him, 'Such an interesting collection of stories and tomes stored here...' You realize he was addressing you as he looks up and says, 'I'd be willing to share one of these tomes with anyone travelled enough to tell me where they have seen me perform.'

She pauses again before continuing, 'I do not know how nor why, but I can feel his malaise with this whole situation. You and he are not at truly odds, yet you have convinced yourselves that you are.'

Khasva Vei`Ras regains her composure, 'My apologies, I have been beset on all sides by the faithless and foolish. Though dormant since his defeat at your hands in Solteris he has not been without knowledge of what is occurring on Norrath. It was only a matter of time after you adventurers cast the Alaran artifact to the sky that it would eventually rain down upon us again... A strange twist of fate that a splintered shard would come crashing down here, but Norrath is full of strange twists of fate...'
Khasva Vei`Ras smiles, 'But enough of that, dinner is soon and we both have destinies to fulfill.' Tired Farmer Jestle

_Soon after talking to the NPCs:_
The din of hushed conversation suddenly disperses with the echoing of a bell.
Tserrina speaks, 'As wonderfully thoughtful as I find the gesture, attending this dinner is a privilege I had hoped to save for a more honored guest. As such, I must now offer all of you to her as a small token of reconciliation.'
Lanys T'Vyl coughs in disgust, her voice echoing from Tserrina's bedroom, 'Ugh, the stench of that loathsome harlot still soils these halls. What's worse yet is that the small bit of solace I could take in being the guest of honor at this dinner has been taken from me! The pain you will all suffer here tonight shall be the thing of legends!'
Objective: Defeat Lanys T'Vyl.
_Lanys T`Vyl spawns in the northeastern room of this floor. She is not auto-aggro and can be engaged when you're prepared:_
Lanys T`Vyl points her blade toward \_\_\_\_\_ and smiles.

Lanys T`Vyl is displeased with the amount of people vying for her attention.
Lanys T`Vyl shifts her attention to someone else that has been irritating her and forgets the transgressions of everyone else!
_Note: The Visage of the Banshee from this stage can be used against Lanys:_

Lanys T'Vyl roars, 'I yield to the hatred in your hearts!' She shakes her head and draws her blade back before disappearing from sight.
Tserrina's voice breaks the silence of the wedding hall, her tone is excited but she does not seem to be speaking to you, 'My love, our guests have nearly arrived... Are you yet ready to greet them?'
A few seconds pass and no reply is heard. She now addresses your party, 'Very well mortals, I know my beloved too well to think he had not planned all of this. Just like every time before, you are all simply playing into his plan. Now please, enjoy the party!'
Objective: Defeat all of Tserrina's wedding party.

**Tower of Frozen Shadow: Stage 4 (Fifth Floor - The Wedding)**
_On the fifth floor (wedding area), clear the entire wedding party to spawn Valdoon Kel`Novar. The mobs will activate and charge your raid on their own._
_Note: The Broken Bottle and Jumjum Pie from the previous stage can be used on these mobs to hinder their attacks:_
\_\_\_\_\_ slashes Damab across the face with a Broken Bottle causing them to fight much less effectively.
\_\_\_\_\_ hands a slice of Jumjum Pie to Damab who then eats it and becomes slower, fatter and less able to fight effectively.
_Once the last of the wedding party dies:_
A loud sigh emanates from the ceiling, 'I suppose you mortals think you've earned the right to progress to the next floor now?' The disembodied voice laughs, 'While I thank you for clearing that miserable lot from these halls, I must now put an end to your little charade of progress...'
The impressive body of Valdoon Kel'Novar materializes in the center of the room.
Objective: Defeat Valdoon Kel`Novar.
_NOTE: The Bloodstained Grey Gloves received from the dinner guests can be used against Valdoon here._
\_\_\_\_\_ slaps Valdoon Kel`Novar in the face with their Bloodstained Grey Gloves of the Murderer which confuses him greatly and causes him to fight less effectively.
_Valdoon Kel`Novar hits for a max ~20,000; casts "Greater Spreading Stone" (curse death touch trigger); "Greater Soul Consumption"; and "Deadlier Lifetap":_

Tserrina's keepsake of small trinkets materializes in the wedding hall.

**Tower of Frozen Shadow: Stage 5 (Sixth Floor - Venril & The Dracoliche)**
_The mobs on this floor aren't KOS, but you can kill them if you need more debuff blockers._
_Note: The Cracked Troll Spine can be used against the brittle skeletons._
\_\_\_\_\_ swings their Cracked Troll Spine into a brittle skeleton really hard causing its own spine to break, weakening it significantly.
_Step into Venril Sathir's room:_
Tserrina's words are strained, her previous exuberance sounds as if it has waned, '...D...Deal with these mortals!' She turns from addressing Venril to retreat up the tower.
The low hiss of Sathir's voice invades your mind, 'Do you not sssee the reality of the ssssituation? You have already lossst this fight! As we ssspeak you are already too late to sssstop uss!' The ancient Iksar emperor laughs, 'Fight me if you musssst. You ssssimply delay the inevitable!'
Objective: Defeat Venril Sathir.
A faint whisper follows Tserrina's departure, '...Mayong my love?'
Venril Sathir shouts, 'Let us put that ssssilly woman's gift to use... Arise my pet! Arise from the depthsss of fear and fell these would-be heroes!'
Venril Sathir hisses coldly and begins a dark conjuration.
Tserrina`s Dracoliche roars furiously and begins beating its skeletal wings!

**Tower of Frozen Shadow: Stage 6 (Top Floor - Mayong & Tserrina)**
_Set up in the final room with Tserrina and Mayong. When ready for a fight, hail Tserrina to activate the event:_
You say, 'Hail, Tserrina Syl`Tor'
Tserrina speaks with an obvious air of concern in her voice, 'My love, our guests have arrived. Shall I make any more preparations for our ceremony?'
The ancient vampire stands with his gaze transfixed upon the eerie shard. His attention to the artifact is unwavering as he addresses his mistress for what seems like the first time, 'There is yet much to do my love. Entertain our guests for a few more minutes.'
Tserrina nods, 'Very well.' She turns and addresses your party, 'Mortals, I applaud your efforts and your willingness to ascend my home just to bear witness to the most wondrous day of my life. I shall reward you all with the suffering you so actively desire!'
Tserrina Syl`Tor vanishes before quickly reappearing.
_Mayong Mistmoore disappears. Tserrina spawns on the other side of the room and aggros. She hits for a max ???? (no rampage; no flurry; no known spells)._
_Once Tserrina reaches 75% health, Mayong Mistmoore respawns and aggros. He hits for a max ???? and single-target rampages (no flurry):_
Tserrina cries out, 'My beloved, these pests are becoming more than I can handle. Please... Help me!'
Mayong violently strikes the crystalline formation causing a number of shards to break off and fall to the ground. He draws his blade and turns, his demeanor is uncharacteristically hostile, 'You fools have no idea the danger we are in!'
Mayong Mistmoore mutters under his breath, 'Tserrina...'
_From here, the two have to be balanced in health. If they fall out of balance by any more than 4-5%, they regenerate._
_Mayong Mistmoore has an AE death touch which is preceded by the following emote:_
Mayong Mistmoore raises his sword, preparing to slash anyone standing nearby.
_This is a six-second warning for "Greater Decapitating Chop" (NOTE: The tank can ignore this emote as the DT will not affect Mayong Mistmoore's current target):_
The Master slashes in a circle around himself!
Greater Decapitating Chop: Single Target, Unresistable (0)
1: Feign Death
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 5000000
_During this portion of the event, numerous crystal golems called "a shard of fear" spawn at the crystal in the room. A wave of golems spawns every 40 seconds. This emote is seen nine seconds in advance of their spawn:_
The crystal shard begins buzzing.
_This emote is seen as they spawn:_
Several constructs of crystal break free from the giant shard!
_These golems hit for a max ~8,000; AE rampage; and are mezzable._
_Also during this event, numerous bats called "a voracious bat" spawn. A wave of bats spawns every 45-90 seconds. This is emote is seen a few seconds before their spawn:_
You hear the faint screeching of bats.
_This emote is seen as they spawn:_
The room echoes with the screeching of a dozen bats!
_These bats hit for a max ~2,500 and single-target rampage. Don't be fooled by the low max hit: What they lack in damage, they make up for in large spawn numbers. These bats can be killed with root spells:_
a voracious bat squeaks in horror as it is rooted helplessly to the ground.
a voracious bat squeaks in horror as it is rooted helplessly to the ground.
a voracious bat squeaks in horror as it is rooted helplessly to the ground.
_In addition, any death in the raid causes the spawn of a ghoul called "dark reanimation". These adds hit for a max ~12,000 and are immune to mez (but can be stunned)._
_NOTE: Several of the items collected in from the dinner guests earlier in the expedition can be used here:_
\_\_\_\_\_ reads a passage from Tisnya's Diary to Tserrina Syl`Tor which makes her jealous and causes her to fight less effectively.
\_\_\_\_\_ points their Reflective Mirror toward Tserrina Syl`Tor which causes her to recoil in horror and dampens her ability to call forth the shards of fear.
\_\_\_\_\_ plays a dissonant love song on their Flute of the Unrequited to Tserrina Syl`Tor which makes her uneasy and causes her to fight less effectively.
\_\_\_\_\_ rings their Small Feline Bell in front of Mayong Mistmoore causing him to look slightly melancholy and makes him slower to call forth his army of bats.
\_\_\_\_\_ shows Mayong Mistmoore a Lock of Drachnid Hair causing him to remember simpler times and causes him to fight less effectively.
\_\_\_\_\_ dons their Midnight Veil and looks at Mayong Mistmoore causing him to be less likely to use his sword slash attack.
\_\_\_\_\_ swings their Bloodstained Mining Pick into a shard of fear, shattering it instantly.
_Once Tserrina and Mayong reach about 30%, you'll see this exchange:_
Tserrina stumbles, losing her composure, 'I do not think I can continue much longer my love! I fear our guests may get the best of us soon.'
Mayong continues fighting as he addresses Tserrina, 'Us? Us!? Does your incessant chattering know no end? Has your mind deteriorated to the same horrific state as your tired husk!?'
Tserrina recoils in horror, tears welling in her scarred eyes, 'Mm...my love... We are to be wed today. Why would you act this way?'
Mayong laughs, 'Because you are unnecessary. It was simple misfortune that this shard landed in your icy prison!'
Tserrina cries, 'We were destined to be together! This form, my body, this was your doing! I gave my life to be yours!'
Mayong laughs, brandishing his blade, 'In my hand I hold Erilynne, a beauty that would stun even the most stoic man... In my court I keep Althea, Brenda and Christine, a trio of temptresses who rivaled the loveliness of Erollisi in their prime... My home is host to more unspoiled flesh than you could ever hope to compare to!'
Tserrina lets forth a blood-curdling shriek, 'KILL HIM!'
_Tserrina disappears and Mayong turns into "Mayong Mistmoore the Empowered". It's not known if he actually increases in strength here or if he starts casting any additional AEs. He does keep up with his death touch trigger, and adds continue spawning like normal._
_From this point and until his death, the corpse of anyone who dies is warped to the pit at the tower's zone-in:_
Mayong Mistmoore raises his hand and casts \_\_\_\_\_'s corpse into the pit at the bottom of the tower!
_If you fail at any time (event mobs are left idle), you'll see:_
The room flashes and the top of the tower reverts to an earlier time... except for your party.
_Upon his death:_
For a moment following the vampire god's death the room is silent. The strange fear shard continues to radiate but all seems right with the world once again...
The familiar voice of Sam Napth echoes through the room from the doorway, 'Splendid work, all of you. Once again you've proven yourselves capable of any task set before you, and this one not a moment too soon!'
The halfling peers down into the glazed eyes of Mayong and grins, his tone unusually arrogant as he speaks, 'You're a fool for trying to take this from me Mayong. There is no excuse for not realizing that they would come to put a stop to you.'
The sinister voice of Mayong replies, his previous tone of hostility has been replaced with one of veiled pleasure, 'Do not think for a moment that I was unaware of your plot, dark one. What's more is that you know for a fact that I shall return. Just as Drinal reclaims the sky from Ro I shall reinstate myself when the time is right. You know as well as I that these adventurers will have no more trouble stopping you than they did me... Yet my plans came to fruition this eve. You have failed, 'Sam Napth'.
Sam Napth looks up at the crystal and shouts in an increasingly hostile tone, 'And how is it you think you have won this, Mayong? You are dead and the power of the shard is mine for the taking!'
Mayong's sinister laugh precedes his final retort, 'I did not aim to take the power for myself, Dark one...' With those words the tower begins to shake! You can see sharp lines forming in the crystal and it starts to crack.
Sam Napth shouts in an otherworldly voice, 'NO!'
Sam Napth roars, 'This is not the end of me Mayong, for as long as there are other shards I will be waiting!' With these mysterious words the radically hostile halfing vanishes from sight.
The room returns to its previous silence. The strange fear shard no longer radiates with any power. Mayong has successfully thwarted the strange halfling from obtaining the power of the ancient artifact and you have successfully thwarted Mayong from existing on Norrath for any reasonable duration of time... Still... It seems rather odd that Sam was so interested in the power of fear.
_Loot drops on Mayong Mistmoore's corpse (it's listed at the bottom of this writeup) and you gain a 4.5 day lockout timer for the event._

_This task is the first in a series of six. It's a solo task that you get from Overseer Drent in Shard's Landing._
Hail him to get the task. (dialogue needed)
You have been assigned the task 'Welcome to Shard's Landing'.
_The locations listed below are for guidelines only. The actual ranges for updates are quite large._
_See **this map** for locations pertaining to this task._

---

Explore the Harbinger's Outpost 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This is the large crater in the middle of the zone._
As you make your way down from the walls of the crater you notice the great crystalline structure that acted as the catalyst for all that you see here. The leaders of this camp can be found just southwest of the crystal.
Speak to Overseer Drent 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Overseer Drent ( map) is found at 215, 100, 1 -- in a tent to the crystal's southwest (he also wanders to the fire)._
You say, 'Hail, Overseer Drent'
Overseer Drent nods toward you, 'Greetings traveler and welcome to the outpost of the Harbingers of Thule. Normally I would offer a grand speech to sell you on the pressing importance of joining our ranks immediately, but we are pressed for time and I'm quite certain you've been through this same routine enough times that you understand what needs to be done. For now, I need you to become acquainted with the geography of these hills. Oh, before you go trekking off into the wilderness, speak to Master Hunter Jilare over there. She may have some work for you in the future.'
Speak to Master Hunter Jilare 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Master Hunter Jilare ( map is found at 245, 20, 1 (outside the same tent)._
You say, 'Hail, Master Hunter Jilare'
Master Hunter Jilare chortles, 'What is this prissy \_\_\_\_\_ doing around here at this hour?' Her tone becomes higher pitched and mocking, 'Come to save the world again, smash the baddies and grab their treasures?' She waves her hand dismissively and returns to her normal voice, 'Go run Boxboy Drent's little errands and get back to me if you survive. Then maybe, just maybe I'll have some work for you.'
_This opens up the next 11 steps._
Explore Magus Burlshin's Camp 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location -1450, -1100, 0 ( **map** \-\- southeastern valley, marked by a crystal druid ring)._
Magus Burlshin's camp is situated very specifically on hallowed ground. Every active teleportation spire sits on land that resonates in this same manner. What is particularly interesting about this location is that both arcane and natural energy seems to converge here.
Explore the Valley of the Naeya 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location -920, -1400, 5 ( **map** \-\- southeastern valley)._
The naeya here are generally not aggressive, save for the Alpha Naeya who is fiercely territorial. Although these creatures are unlikely to attack unless provoked, they are very social and will come to the aid of their kin at a moment's notice.
Explore Banescale's Den 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location 800, -1250, 3 ( **map** \-\- entrance of the eastern valley)._
The snakes in this area appear to be of three varieties: the Slatescales which typically rest on the rocks scattered throughout the area, the Ivyscales which try to camouflage themselves by hiding under brush and foliage, and finally the aggressive Banescales that appear more frequently in this den and occasionally throughout the rest of the mountains.
Explore the Village of the Forsaken 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location 420, -1880, 1 ( **map** \-\- eastern valley)._
The noxious stench of excrement and rotting flesh overpower any other details worth mentioning about this ramshackle 'village'. Overseer Drent begins speaking, 'The inhabitants here refer to themselves as 'The Forsaken'. All of our initial attempts at establishing diplomatic relations with the group have resulted in less than favorable results.' In fact, you think you spot the remains of one or two harbinger envoys as you survey the ground. Drent continues, 'The less hostile Alarans to the west refer to this group as 'The Unworthy', though they refuse to explain why...'
Explore Greenscale Nest 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location 650, 1180, 1 ( **map** \-\- due west of the crater, a group of wyverns)._
The wyverns in this area seem particularly interested in the crystalline shards that have landed near their nests. This interest has changed their behavior dramatically. They have become aggressively territorial and remain on guard at all hours now. Exercise caution when wandering near any wyverns in these hills.
Explore Pyrebeak's Peak 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location -275, 705, 150 ( **map** \-\- southwest of the crater, in the mountains)._
The Icebeak kangons make their roost on these snowcapped hills. This species of kangon is typically not aggressive, but you should exercise caution should their grand matriarch Pyrebeak make an appearance...
Explore Corruption's End 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location -1200, 830, 10 ( **map** \-\- southwestern valley)._
Overseer Drent's voice becomes clear in your mind, 'At the heart of this valley is the water supply that sustains the packs of goral and panthers that have made these hills their home. It is believed that the water is the reason these creatures have recently shown signs of mutation. All beasts here are aggressive and territorial, so you should exercise caution when travelling here.'
Explore Worntooth's Run 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location 2050, -350, 1 ( **map** \-\- north of the crater, among the grendlaens)._
The Worntooth grendlaen make their home in this very small plot of land just west of Cragfeast Rock. What is particularly interesting about these creatures is the immense weight of their hides. It is almost as if these living creatures were formed out of stone.
Explore Cragfeast Rock 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location 1860, -1300, 10 ( **map** \-\- northeastern valley)._
Cragfeast Rock is the name given to this valley where a pack of Verdantbeak kangons live symbiotically with a group of selyrah. The herbivorous kangon seem to keep to themselves while the omnivorous selyrah seem to be attracted to the crystalline shards that have landed in the valley.
Explore the Infested Plain 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location 2025, 890, -34 ( **map** \-\- northwestern valley)._
Although the Venomshell beetles can be found scattered throughout the hills, this small stretch of land appears to be their hotbed. Initial studies have suggested that the vegetation where the crystalline shards have landed seem to increase the potency of these beetles' venom.
Explore Stonecoat's Plateau 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location 1500, 1600, 24 ( **map** \-\- southwest of the above step, in the mountains)._
Overseer Drent's voice speaks to you with a hint of hesitation, 'The Frostcoat braxi that inhabit this small hillside are something our soldiers speak of in hushed words. Rumor says that these beasts are somehow smart enough to speak, but choose not to. I'm not convinced, but I'm not about to go challenging them to prove a suspicion...'
Explore the Underground City 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location 450, 2100, -285 ( **map** \-\- entrance of the Alaran city in the southern part of the zone's northwest valley)._
Overseer Drent's voice speaks with renewed resolve, 'Unlike the disheveled Alarans to the east, the inhabitants of this underground city have been far more welcoming to the arrival of people in the hills. We are still in the early stages of forming official diplomatic relations with this group, but we feel they will likely serve as important allies in our efforts to reinstate our father the Faceless to the pantheon... I need you to get acquainted with their city and then return to the outpost.'
Explore the Council Chambers 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location -600, 2200, -402 ( **map**)._
Overseer Drent continues, 'The appointed councilors meet in these halls twice daily, once midday between eleven of morning and four in the afternoon and again in the evening between eight and eleven of evening. Members of the council are signified by the heatless red flame of guidance that shines brightly from their left hand. Their meetings are conducted in absolute silence so we are still unsure what it is that they accomplish or discuss here.'
Explore the Silent Hall 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates around /location -400, 670, -750 ( **map** \-\- the large hall in the far eastern part of the underground city)._
Overseer Drent's voice is quiet but clear in your mind, 'It is of absolute import that you do not speak to anyone in these halls. A non-clergyman making sound here is considered the greatest sacrilege to these people. It is interesting to think that the citizens and priests alike have chosen to call themselves 'The Believers'. From what we have gathered, the upper echelon of this society is marked by the pale ethereal orbs of power around their hands. We are still unsure what the dark flame that marks the others means. Take a moment to survey these halls, as something still does not seem quite right... If you find anything out of the ordinary, be discreet and return here as soon as possible.'
Look for anything out of place 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Small Crystalline Shard [item=104875] is a ground spawn ( **map**) that has a few spawn points in the silent hall. It appears as a small purple shard.
30, 780, -747 _(northwest corner)_
-120, 550, -747 _(northeast area)_
-310, 790, -747 _(southwest area)_
As you survey the crystal shard you come to the realization that nowhere else in the city have you seen any sign that the Alarans have been collecting the crystals that litter the lands above this city... Perhaps Drent would be interested in this.
Return the crystal to Overseer Drent 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Overseer Drent takes the crystal and inspects it carefully before placing it aside, 'So you say you found this in their worship halls?' The Iksar furrows his brow, 'Troubling news, none of our other scouts have reported finding any crystals within the City of The Believers. We were under the impression that they were indifferent to our efforts...' The Overseer changes to a less grave expression, 'Still, you've done well, \_\_\_\_\_. I would like to extend the open invitation of the Harbingers to you. There is still much to be done here if we are to reinstate our father to the pantheon but I am sure with the help of adventurers like you we will restore Norrath to its previous balance! I suggest you speak with Councilman Nostulia or Hunter Jilare for your next assignments, though I could always use more scouts to relay more detailed information about the area.'
Your faction standing with Harbingers of Thule got better.
Now that you are familiar with the general layout of Shard's Landing you can be of use to the Harbingers. Speak to Councilman Nostulia for your next training assignment, Master Hunter Jilare if you are interested in proving your worth as a hunter or Overseer Drent if you would like to gather more information about the various geographical points of interest.
_Rewards:_
225 platinum
Experience (2% at Level 100 and 3 AAs)
_Note: This task is not repeatable._

_This task is the second in a series of six. It's a solo task that begins with Councilman Nostulia ( map) in Shard's Landing. He is found at /location 300, 85, 1 (southwestern part of the crater, in a tent north of Overseer Drent's location)._
_In addition to being a progression task, this will also boost your Alaran language skill level to 100 (if it's not there already)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Welcome to Shard's Landing"
You say, 'Hail, Councilman Nostulia'
Councilman Nostulia looks up, 'Oh yes, \_\_\_\_\_? Drent was just speaking about a rambunctious \_\_\_\_\_ that had shown some promise. I shall skip the pleasantries and get to the point, my job here is simple, I ensure that all of our recruits are ready and able to report on any and everything they see. To that end I need to know that you are fluent in their language. If you are willing to [prove] yourself ready to join our ranks then I have a simple task for you to complete.'
You say, 'I'll prove myself'
Councilman Nostulia says 'Very well, this should be an easy enough job.'
You have been assigned the task 'Words of the Unspoken'.
Councilman Nostulia has tasked you with mastering the Alaran language.
Your first order of business is to travel back to the Underground City. From there you will want to seek out some different pieces of text and then report back to him.

Travel back to the Underground City 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_This updates as you enter the city (connected from the zone's northwestern valley)._
Obtain a Councilor's Memo 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Just east of the council chambers is where many of the councilmen and citizens live. See if you can find a memo or diary from one of them.
_"A Councilor's Memo" is a ground spawn on a table in this area (/location -715, 1710, -500 -- bottom level, second residence to your left if coming from the chambers)._
Obtain a Page of a Citizen's Diary 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ North of the council chambers is another living barracks, see if you can find any personal writings from one of the citizens.
_"Page of a Citizen's Diary" is a ground spawn on a table in this area (/location -280, 2350, -295 -- upper level, first residence to your left if coming from the chambers)._
Obtain a Page of a High Guard's Diary 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ In the barracks north of the council chambers on the northern side are four rooms that the High Guards inhabit. See if you can find any writings of theirs there.
_"Page of a High Guard's Diary" is a ground spawn on a table in this area (/location 5, 2250, -292 -- upper level of the residence to your right if coming from the chambers)._
Obtain a page of Council Minutes 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ In the barracks east of the council chambers are the houses of many councilmen. See if you can find any official documentation about their meetings.
_"Council Minutes" is a ground spawn on a table in this area (/location -925, 1765, -465 -- upper level, first residence to your right if coming from the chambers)._
Obtain A Gardener's Notes 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ To the south of the council chambers is the indoor garden of believers. This area produces nearly all the food to sustain the city and may have some detailed documentation that would be worth examining.
_"A Gardener's Notes" is a ground spawn in this area (/location -1200, 2120, -602 -- just to your right upon entering the area, if coming from the chambers)._
Obtain an Armsman's Missive 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ In the northeastern section of the Underground City is the armory. See if you can find any text of interest in that area.
_"An Armsman's Missive" is a ground spawn on a table at /location 165, 975, -500 (on your map, this is the large room northwest of the Silent Hall)._
Obtain a Sentry's Log 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Just east of the city's entrance is a barracks where a number of miners are housed. They are under constant supervision from the enforcers and taskmasters in the city. See if you can find anything of interest in that area.
_"A Sentry's Log" is a ground spawn on a table in the open area east of the city's entrance (/location 230, 1375, -442 -- central part of this area)._
Obtain a Page of a Gladiator's Journal 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Our understanding of the society is that there are several distinct castes, the lowest being 'the conscripted'. Many of them are housed as gladiators that perform for the entertainment of the citizens. See if you can find any writings by these warriors in their barracks southeast of the city gates.
_"Page of a Gladiator's Journal" is a ground spawn on a table in the open area just northeast of the arena (/location -50, 1350, -502 -- in the north-central part of this area)._
Obtain a Believer's Private Notes 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ The devout worshippers are a curious group. We understand very little about their form of worship. See if you can find anything of use in the silent hall.
_"A Believer's Private Notes" is a ground spawn in front of a bench at about -190, 750, -747 in the Silent Hall (northeastern part of the city -- in the west-central part of the Hall)._
Obtain a Nondescript Clergy Memo 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Reports have stated that a number of clergy stand watch in the arena. See if you can find any texts of note by this group.
_"A Nondescript Clergy Memo" is a ground spawn at /location -585, 1770, -482 (in the arena which is the large area just northeast of the council chambers -- ground spawn along the south-central wall of the arena)._
Report back to Councilman Nostulia 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that you have collected a wide variety of texts, report back to Councilman Nostulia and he will give you further instructions.
You say, 'Hail, Councilman Nostulia'
Councilman Nostulia says 'Ah, so you've collected the texts?' He takes a moment to look over the pieces of paper you present him, 'Very well, this will be a rather simple lesson, which I assume you find to be the best kind of lesson.' He smirks, 'Take this tome and piece together the papers into a master document, copy them -exactly- as written. After you've done that, translate the paper into common and return the perfectly translated work to me. I will not accept anything less than a perfect translation!' The wizened erudite hands you a tome full of blank pages and a quill.'
_You receive a container: "Simple Empty Tome"_
Copy the notes exactly as written 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Combine the 10 texts inside the container to produce a "Tome of Blank Pages" (container) + "Nostulia's Quill" + "Hand Copied Alaran Notes"._
You slowly copy the elaborate symbols that make up the Alaran language onto a series of blank pages until a perfect replica is made.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Hand Copied Alaran Notes.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Nostulia's Quill.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Tome of Blank Pages.
Translate the notes into Common 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_In the Tome, combine the Quill and Copied Notes until the step updates and you produce "Translated Notes" (as you do this, your Alaran will progress to 100)._
You review your work to find a number of glaring errors.
You review your work to find a handful of minor errors.
You review your work and find one or two simple mistakes.
You review your work and realize you've misspelled something.
After several minutes of careful translation you review your work and find it immaculate! You have a clear understanding of the Alaran language.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Translated Notes.
Deliver the Translated Notes to Councilman Nostulia 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Deliver the Translated Notes to Councilman Nostulia so he can assess your success.
Councilman Nostulia looks over the paper carefully then looks back up at you, 'Well, you've proven to be quicker learner than I had anticipated. I suppose some minor congratulations are in order. You are now fully qualified to speak to the natives. I have another simple task for you should you be up for it, though I think Engineer Eilisia may also be interested in your talents.'
Your faction standing with Harbingers of Thule got better.
Although his methods felt somewhat patronizing, you feel inspired by the haste in which Councilman Nostulia was able to help you master the Alaran language. Whether or not you have any real use for their native tongue is another matter though...
_Rewards:_
262 platinum, 5 gold
Experience (11% regular exp at Level 88 and 3 AAs at any level)
_Note: This task is not repeatable._

---

_This solo task begins with Councilman Nostulia ( map) in Shard's Landing. He is found at /location 300, 85, 1 (southwestern part of the crater, in a tent north of Overseer Drent's location)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Welcome to Shard's Landing"
\- Completed "Words of the Unspoken"
You say, 'Hail, Councilman Nostulia'
Councilman Nostulia smiles, 'Welcome back, \_\_\_\_\_. I believe Engineer Eilisia is looking for a \_\_\_\_\_ with your particular talents. Of course there is always the matter of improving our understanding of the believers and their motives, a [job] I am now assured that you are capable of.'
You say, 'What job?'
Councilman Nostulia says 'Very well, this should be an easy enough job.'
You have been assigned the task 'Unspoken Verse'.
You will need to deliver these back to where you originally 'borrowed' the pages from the tomes that you copied for him. Doing so will allow future recruits the same privlege of gathering information about the Underground City and its inhabitants.
The creatures roaming around the junk piles in the Village of the Forsaken will probably be carrying some scraps of paper.
A potent ink and be crafted from the blood of either Selyrah or Kangon in these hills. To finish crafting the ink, you will need a few drops of Wyvern Blood to act as a thickener.

---

Collect Paper from the pests in the Forsaken Village 0/10 (Shard's Landing)
_These drop from the rats, beetles, devourers, and insects in the Forsaken Village (eastern part of the zone)._
Obtain some Bloodred Ink from Kangon or Selyrah 0/5 (Shard's Landing)
_Get this from any kangons or selyrahs in the zone._
Gather some Feartouched Wyvern Blood to thicken the Ink 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Kill any wyvern in the zone._
Travel into the Underground City - watch for ambushes! 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_With the above 16 components in your inventory, make your way to the Underground City, but be prepared for a single mob ambush, a forsaken apparition (rootable; stunnable)._
_There can only be one of these mobs up at one time, so if another player has spawned theirs, you will have to wait. If you are in a group and all on the same step, a single kill of this mob will update whichever group members are on this step. The NPC is leashed to its spawn area and despawns after a short time, if left idle_
Leave a Tome on the Lower Council Judicator's Desk 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Leave a Tome on the Upper Citizen's Table 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Leave a Tome on High Guard Verichitek's Table 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Leave a Tome on the Lower Council Overseer's Desk 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Leave a Tome on the Gardener's Workbench 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Leave a Tome on the Table in the Armory 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Leave a Tome on the Table in the Miner's Barracks 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Leave a Tome on the foot of the Gladiator's Bed 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Leave a Tome near the forgetful Believer in the Silent Hall 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Leave a Tome near the Overseer in the Arena 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_The locations for these drop-offs are the same as in the previous task:_
_\- East of the council chambers (/location -715, 1710, -500 -- bottom level, second residence to your left if coming from the chambers)._
_\- North of the council chambers (/location -280, 2350, -295 -- upper level, first residence to your left if coming from the chambers)._
_\- In the barracks north of the council chambers (/location 5, 2250, -292 -- upper level of the residence to your right if coming from the chambers)._
_\- In the barracks east of the council chambers (/location -925, 1765, -465 -- upper level, first residence to your right if coming from the chambers)._
