_This solo task begins with Engineer Eilisia ( map) in Shard's Landing. She is located in one of the tents in the crater's southwest section._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Welcome to Shard's Landing"
\- Completed "Words of the Unspoken"
You say, 'Hail, Engineer Eilisia'
Engineer Eilisia says 'Well, well, if it isn't the famed \_\_\_\_\_ I have heard so much about. Really making a name for yourself in our ranks, \_\_\_\_\_. Today just happens to be your lucky day. I'm in need of assistance with a data gathering project and you are just fit enough for the job. Let me know if you are [interested] in assisting me.' The gnome looks back down at her notes after what you think was a quick wink in your direction.'
You say, 'I'm interested'
Engineer Eilisia says 'Perfect, a \_\_\_\_\_ like you should have no problem completing this task.' She begins to detail a list of tools you will need to acquire and specific sample types she wants you to obtain...'
You have been assigned the task 'Unusual Goral Coral'.
Engineer Eilisia is spearheading an initiative to study the nature of the Heart of Fear and she needs your help.
You will need a specialized tool to collect a fear crystal sample from the coral that grows in the pond at Corruption's End. Search the barrels and boxes around our camp to find a Mineral Extractor.
One of our envoys was recently sent out with a shipment of various chemical filters. Find out what's become of him and ask for a Simple Chemical Filter. The envoy was last seen heading northeast to scout out the pack of grendlaens that live in Worntooth's Run. You will need this to properly obtain a water sample from Corruption's End.
Magus Burlshin has a number of 'interesting' items. Go speak to him and see if he is willing to part with something capable of melting flesh but preserving stone.

---

Locate a Mineral Extractor from the supply holds in our camp 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Supply barrels and supply boxes are found in the tents in the Harbinger's camp. /open those until you receive the Extractor._
You rummage through the box's contents but fail to find a Mineral Extractor. Perhaps one of the other containers will have it.
You have already checked this box. You may have more luck finding a Mineral Extractor if you check in one of the other containers.
You rummage through the barrel's contents but fail to find a Mineral Extractor. Perhaps one of the other containers will have it.
You reach into the barrel and uncover a Mineral Extractor!

---

Obtain a Simple Chemical Filter from one of our envoys 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_"envoy`s supply box" ( map) is located at 1815, -500, 7 (northeast of the crater just over a hill in Worntooth's Run). /open it to receive a "Simple Chemical Filter"._
You dig through the remains of the broken box and uncover one usable Simple Chemical Filter hidden underneath a scrap of wood!

---

Obtain a Simple Chemical Suspension from Magus Burlshin 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Magus Burlshin ( map) is found at -1450, -1095, 0 (zone-in area, marked by the big crystal shard and a tent)._
You say, 'Hail, Magus Burlshin'
Magus Burlshin listens as you quickly recount the instructions that Eilisia gave you. The erudite nods, 'A chemical suspension...' He smiles, 'I would be happy to part with one of my precious concoctions, for a fair price. You see, the tent I have been staying in since I moved out to these hills is in constant need of repair and so I think this would be a fine opportunity for a trade. Bring me some materials to patch up my tent and I will part with the Simple Chemical Suspension that you seek.'

---

Gather a few Undamaged Naeya Pelts 0/3 (Shard's Landing)
_Kill 3 naeya mobs to receive 3x "Undamaged Naeya Pelt"._

---

Deliver the Undamaged Naeya Pelts to Magus Burlshin 0/3 (Shard's Landing)
You say, 'Hail, Magus Burlshin'
Magus Burlshin says 'Just a few materials to patch up my tent. Hardly an inequitable trade for what you are after.'
_Hand them in:_
Magus Burlshin looks over the pelts and smiles, 'These will do nicely, thank you. Oh, right, you were after the suspension.' He digs through his bags and produces a small, tightly-sealed urn. He holds the object out with both hands and leaves you with this warning, 'Be quite careful with this solution, the acidity of the suspension is easily capable of ridding you of limbs if you are careless.'

---

Use the Mineral Extractor to gather a sample from the coral at Corruption's End 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ The coral that grows in the pond at Corruption's End has been infused with fear crystal dust. Use the Mineral Extractor to obtain a sample so we can analyze how this substance behaves after being metabolized in simple animal life.
_In the southwestern valley of the zone is a pond. There is a "corrupted coral" spawn under the water. Target it and right-click the Mineral Extractor (-1390, 715)._
The coral in this pond looks to be infused with small bits of fear crystal. You will need to use a Mineral Extractor to filter out a sample.
You extract a strain of fear crystal that was growing inside of the coral.

---

Use the Simple Chemical Filter to gather a water sample from Corruption's End 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ The pond at Corruption's End is rich with fear crystal particles. Use the Simple Chemical Filter to collect a handful of this material. It will be important to analyze how the substance behaves after being distilled in a body of water.
_Same location as above, click the Simple Chemical Filter._
You finish collecting a mineral sample.
You filter out a sample of fear crystal dust from the pond water.

---

Gather several Corrupted Goral Samples from Corruption's End 0/3 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ The goral at Corruption's End have been ingesting bits of fear crystal. 'Obtain' some of their flesh.
_Kill three gorals to receive their samples._

---

Gather several Infected Panther Samples from Corruption's End 0/3 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ The panthers at Corruption's End have also been ingesting fear crystal. 'Obtain' some of their flesh.
_Kill three prowlers to receive their samples._

---

Distill the animal samples in the Simple Chemical Suspension 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Use the Simple Chemical Suspension to extract the fear crystal particles from the animal flesh. It is important that we analyze how the substance reacts after being metabolized by complex animal life.
_Combine the above six samples in the Simple Chemical Suspension to produce a Crystallized Flesh Sample._
You place the samples of corrupted animal flesh in the Simple Chemical Suspension. After a few moments the flesh dissolves and all that remains is a condensed shard of fear.

---

Return to Engineer Eilisia with the samples 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Eilisia would like to review the samples you have collected so far. Return to the Harbinger camp and speak with her.
_Hail her and receive a Heart Crystal Condenser._
You say, 'Hail, Engineer Eilisia'
Engineer Eilisia looks up and gives you a wide smile, 'So you've collected the requested samples of fear crystal that have been metabolized by three different sources?' She looks over the small reconstructed crystals you have collected. 'Perfect!' She reaches into her bag and hands you a small arcane looking container. 'You will need to take the metabolized crystal samples and unite them into a single shard. Take this piece over to the Heart of Fear and see if we can harness any sort of reaction.'

---

Combine the samples in the Heart Crystal Condenser 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Eilisia is pleased with the data you have helped gather with your samples. She now requests that you combine the discrete samples into a single shard. You can do this with the Heart Crystal Condenser she has provided you with.
_Combine the three Crystallized Samples in the condenser._
You place the three differently metabolized shards in the condenser and begin the refining process. After a few moments the samples merge into a single glowing shard. It radiates with a faint power that the crystals surrounding Shard's Landing do not seem to possess.

---

Release the essence of the Small Crystal of the Heart to the Heart of Fear 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ The crystal you have created radiates with a faint light that the otherwise lifeless stone surrounding the area does not. Bring this crystal sample near the Heart of Fear that rests in the center of the Harbinger's camp to see if you can harness any sort of reaction.
_Stand on the giant crystal in the middle of the crater for this update (don't fall in the hole!). This is a location update_
You make your way toward the Heart of Fear and hold the small shard above your head. It emits a subtle glow but little else. You feel that something is missing. Speak to Engineer Eilisia to see what she has to say about this.
You look up at the lifeless chunk of crystal but feel nothing special from its presence.

---

Ask Engineer Eilisia why the crystal has had no effect 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ The crystal's reaction was rather unimpressive. See what Eilisia has to say about this.
You say, 'Hail, Engineer Eilisia'
Engineer Eilisia listens as you explain that there was no significant reaction from your crystal. She looks down and sighs, 'I was afraid of this. You see, every time we collect new samples I have a lingering hope that the various ways in which nature and animals metabolize the substance will reveal a new method to empower the fear shards. Obviously we are surrounded by the blasted stuff, but unless it is empowered it will not react to the Heart of Fear. This is the reason we have sent teams around the globe to collect the remnants of this substance. It's not for a lack of material, but for a lack of correctly attuned material.' She begins to whisper as she explains the process of attuning the crystal you hold in your hand...

---

Capture a Sentient Soul using the Small Crystal of the Heart 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ It seems that Eilisia has higher expectations for the naturally metabolized crystal. Although she was hesitant to admit it, there is a known way to empower the crystal shards in order to provoke a reaction from the Heart of Fear.
Seek out an Alaran living in the hills, a member of either The Forsaken or The Believers will do. You will need to weaken their physical form, and then use the crystal to capture their soul. This will be enough to empower the crystal.
_Fight an Alaran (can be most types except for nameds, their PHs, or thralls) to at least 25% and right-click the crystal while basically standing right on top of them to receive an Empowered Crystal of the Heart._
_Note: Alarans summon._
a forsaken believer grasps its chest and falls over dead as \_\_\_\_\_ drains its soul away!
You raise the Small Crystal of the Heart and drain your target's soul!

---

Release the essence of the Empowered Crystal of the Heart to the Heart of Fear 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Take the Empowered Crystal of the Heart back to the Heart of Fear to harness a more potent reaction.
_Again, do this on the large crystal in the center._
You raise the Empowered Crystal of the Heart above your head. A blinding flash sends you tumbling to the ground as the crystal is ripped from your hand and absorbed into the Heart of Fear. The voices of the forsaken fill your ears like innumerable raindrops crashing against the ground on a stormy night. The cries of anguish, the growls of disgust and the roars of terror haunt you... Some awesome presence, some great and godly force seems to beckon you to continue your journey and so you find the will to pick yourself up off of the ground and return to Engineer Eilisia.

---

Report your success to Engineer Eilisia 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
You say, 'Hail, Engineer Eilisia'
Engineer Eilisia listens intently as you recount how the attuned crystal flew from your hand and evoked visions of nightmarish suffering. She offers her hand to yours as a gesture of comfort, 'This is why I knew I could count on a powerful \_\_\_\_\_ such as yourself. A lesser being would have fallen dead or never returned here after such an experience!' She retracts her hand and quickly scribbles down a few notes, 'I owe you my thanks for your efforts today. The data you have helped us collect will be of immense value as we continue to study the nature of the Heart of Fear.' She looks away and returns to her notes.
Your faction standing with Harbingers of Thule got better.
Although she did not quite find the words to articulate it, you feel that your work with the Harbingers to uncover the nature behind the Heart of Fear will be invaluable in their efforts to reinstate the Faceless. Your reputation among the Harbingers continues to grow. In fact, Director Idris Manaar is ready to speak with you now.
_Rewards:_
337 platinum, 5 gold
Experience (about 3% regular exp at 96 and 4 AAs)

This is a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Director Idris Manaar ( map) in Shard's Landing. He is located at 255, 35, 1 (Harbinger camp among all the other NPCs).
Pre-Requisites:
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Welcome to Shard's Landing"
\- Completed "Words of the Unspoken"
\- Completed "Unusual Goral Coral"
\- Completed "The Harbingers of Thule"
NOTE: The lock point for this task is on your last kill step (before you "report back" to the Director).
You say, 'Hail, Director Idris Manaar'
Director Idris Manaar shrugs, 'You survived your introduction, very well. Give me the word when you are [ready] to undertake a small excursion. I suggest you bring allies with you for this.'
You say, 'I am ready'
Director Idris Manaar says 'Very well, we are always in need of samples. This will be the same as your previous excursions. Feel free to enlist the help of allies. Compensating them for their help is entirely on you though...'
You have been assigned the task 'Conquering Your Fears'.
Despite their best efforts the Shardtenders are unable to keep the Shard of Fear completely intact from deterioration and so much of its power is slowly draining into the landing.
Director Idris Manaar has instructed you to travel to three of the living nightmares of three notable Velious residents and obtain several fear shard crystals. These crystals will be used in the construction of a device to channel the escaped spirits of fear so that they can be returned to the Heart of Fear.

---

Travel to the Feartouched Eastern Wastes 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Kill several native animals 0/6 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
Any animal mob native to the Eastern Wastes (except snow bunnies) counts towards this step: Mammoths, rhinos, wolves, cougars, etc.
Obtain a Dim Fearshard from a native animal 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
Loot this item from a corpse (this is a guaranteed drop if you are on the step).
--You have looted a Dim Fearshard.--
The image of a screaming banshee overtakes your thoughts as you recover the fearshard.
Kill several manifestations of fear 0/4 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
>Any fear mob in the zone (samhains, Amygdalans, spinechiller spiders, fear shardlings, etc.) counts towards this step. Note that fear mobs are more sparse than their animal counterparts. Fear mobs tend to be found in the outer parts of the zone.
Obtain a Faded Fearshard from a manifestation of fear 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
Loot this item from a corpse (this is a guaranteed drop if you are on the step).
--You have looted a Faded Fearshard.--
Your mind is overtaken with visions of Amygdalans closing in on you.

---

Travel to the Feartouched Crystal Caverns 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
Kill several Ry`Gorr Orcs 0/6 (Crystal Caverns)
Obtain a Dull Fearshard from a Ry`Gorr Orc 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
Loot this item from a corpse (this is a guaranteed drop if you are on the step).
--You have looted a Dull Fearshard.--
You get the sinking suspicion that you are being followed by nightmarish imps.
Kill several tentacle terrors 0/4 (Crystal Caverns)
Any "terror" mob counts towards this step (not just "a tentacle terror"; can be the stalag terrors, pure terrors, etc. as well). These are found in the area west of Froststone, in the southern half of the Crystal Caverns zone. See **this map** for details about getting around the zone (terror spawns are concentrated in the area of the "broken bridge" towards the bottom of that map, and in the tunnels east of it -- can do a "find" for Bronigan).
Obtain a Pale Fearshard from a tentacle terror 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
Loot this item from a corpse (this is a guaranteed drop if you are on the step).
--You have looted a Pale Fearshard.--
You quickly turn around as you get the impression that two sets of razor sharp claws are primed to bore into your back... Yet no such danger is apparent.

---

Travel to the Feartouched Kael Drakkel 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
Kill several residents of the city 0/6 (Kael Drakkel)
Kill any six giants.
Obtain a Softly Glowing Fearshard from a resident 0/1 (Kael Drakkel)
Loot this item from a corpse (guaranteed drop if you are on the step).
--You have looted a Softly Glowing Fearshard.--
You think you hear the wailing of a harpy in the distance.
Kill several apparitions of fear 0/4 (Kael Drakkel)
These are the mobs that don't belong in Kael Drakkel (twisted prowlers, fey faeries, extinct kedge, drakes, wurms, etc.).
Obtain a Faintly Pulsing Fearshard from an apparition 0/1 (Kael Drakkel)
Loot this item from a corpse (guaranteed drop if you are on the step).
--You have looted a Faintly Pulsing Fearshard.--
The thought of an enormous Iksar skeleton looming over you is inexplicably at the forefront of your consciousness.

---

Report back to Director Idris Manaar 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Task Window Says: Now that you have crystal shards from both the native and foreign beings of each nightmare, return to Director Idris for the materials needed to craft the shards into a usable channelling device.
You say, 'Hail, Director Idris Manaar'
Director Idris Manaar hands you the Soulcapture Crystal Construction Materials.
Director Idris Manaar looks over the broken crystals you have collected and nods. 'Very well, take this carefully crafted reconstruction kit and place the crystal pieces together. This empowered crystal will work as a channeling device to capture some of the nightmares that are escaping from the Heart of Fear. Return the crystal to me when you have recaptured five of these wayward spirits.'
Construct a Soulcapture Crystal 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
In the container, combine the six fearshards.

---

Recapture souls that have escaped from the Heart of Fear 0/5 (Shard's Landing)
Task Window Says: The Soulcapture Crystal can be used to bring the ethereal nightmares that are escaping from the Heart of Fear into corporeal beings.
Bring a number of these nightmares into existence and slay them. Their essence will be captured within the Soulcapture Crystal.
Move to the outside of the Harbinger camp (outside the crater; the valley just west of the crater is known to work) and right-click the crystal. -487, -177 is a spot that has been known to work.
You must activate the crystal right outside of the Harbinger's Outpost. The area between the edge of the crater and the surrounding hills will be your best option.
The crystal emits a bright light as an escaped nightmare starts phasing into existence.
a wayard nightmare takes form.
You feel very uneasy.
A mob called "a wayward nightmare" appears. This mob is auto-aggro on anyone with the task. It hits for a max ~11,500 and is immune to mez and stun. You need to kill five of them.

---

Return the Soulcapture Crystal to Director Idris Manaar 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
You say, 'Hail, Director Idris Manaar'
Director Idris Manaar stares at you with an expression of boredom, 'Yes? Do you have something to report? Don't tell me you've gone and [misplaced] the Soulcapture Crystal Construction Materials...'
Director Idris Manaar holds the nightmare infused crystal up to his face and peers into it carefully. He displays an unusual sense of emotion as he smiles, 'This will do fine. The Heart will reabsorb these spirits and our tenders will renew their efforts in maintaining the barrier between the Heart and the landing.' He pauses and looks over at the large tent to the south, 'You may be ready to speak with Glask.'
Your efforts to recapture the escaped spirits of the Heart of Fear have been successful.
Your faction standing with Harbingers of Thule has been increased by 50.
_Rewards:_
562 platinum, 5 gold
Experience (6 AAs + 5% exp in Level 96)
1 Fragment of Legendary Alaran History
- Fragment of Legendary Alaran History [item=100964]

_This solo task begins with Harbinger Glask ( map) in Shard's Landing. She is located at 185, 70, 1 (inside the same tent as Overseer Drent in the crater's southwest)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Welcome to Shard's Landing"
\- Completed "Words of the Unspoken"
\- Completed "Unusual Goral Coral"
\- Completed "The Harbingers of Thule"
\- Completed "Conquering Your Fears"
You say, 'Hail, Harbinger Glask'
Harbinger Glask raps her sharpened claws against the desk in quick succession and sighs. She looks up at you for a moment then back down at the desk again. She inhales, preparing what you think will be a grand speech about the importance of your role in assisting the Harbingers, but she simply exhales again. A few seconds pass until she finally speaks, her focus still on the desk, 'You have a [job] to do.' Somehow you feel validated even by her attention, even if she did not say your name.
You say, 'Does this job pay well?'
Harbinger Glask says 'The discovery of fearshards in the halls of the Believers is troubling news. All accounts from our envoys who are currently working with their council claim that their little cult down there has no interest in our business up here. What's more, the reports from our spies state that the citizens and slaves of their city have no interest in impeding our mission. I need you to exercise a little diplomacy and attend a sermon within their worship halls. Something tells me that the clergy and the council are not on the same page.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Believers'.
Harbinger Glask has asked you to travel back into the Underground City and attend a sermon of the Clergy in hopes that you can glean some information that their spies have not.

---

Travel to the Underground City 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Upon entering the city ( **map**), you see:_
From what Glask has told you it sounds like the citizens are unaware of the clergy's plot to obtain more of the fearshards that the Harbingers are after. You imagine you'll do well not to cause too much trouble while in the city.

---

Return to the Silent Hall 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ The Silent Hall of worship plays host to a seemingly endless sermon that must be delivered telepathically, seeing as none of our spies have ever reported anyone speaking in these halls... Other than a few adventurers who were quickly 'dealt with' by the believers.
_Upon entering the Silent Hall ( **map**), you see:_
When Glask was speaking to you she put particular emphasis on the word 'diplomacy'. Simply listening to the sermon is all that you were tasked with accomplishing.

---

Sit and listen to the sermon of the clergy 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Clear your mind and listen for whatever it is these Believers hear in this hall.
_Wait for emotes to play out ( **map**)._
A gentle voice fills your ears, yet no one in the hall seems to be speaking, 'You are loved.'
Al is with us. Al is around us. Al knows that in your heart, your intentions are earnest. Whether you have chosen to be here or were ordered to be here. Al forgives your shortcomings and accepts your imperfections.
Al speaks to you as a friend while others may berate you as a child. Al does not encourage trivialities and deception. You are loved just as you are to ali.
Al knows you, perhaps better than you know yourself. Al knows it is your intention to seek some evidence of defamation, but we present ourselves openly and honestly. We judge you only on your standing with us and not your subversive intent.
We present you a choice. To be the lapdog to the worshipers of a dead god or to be the one that clears our name and ensures peace between our peoples.
The crystals that rained down upon our land have tormented our citizens. Many of them lay awake at night, tortured by visions. We have no desire to see our people suffer. It is not us that have gathered these shards of nightmare. They were surreptitiously planted here.
Travel to the site of suffering, the Village of the Unworthy. These tortured souls writhe in agony without Alis love. The love of the one whose name is unspoken. The love that will free us from the perils of this world! Free these souls from their suffering so they may return to Alis arms. It is they who have planted these accursed shards here!
_This step updates at this point._

---

Return to the Village of the Forsaken 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ It was clearly the Unworthy that planted the fearshards in the hall in an effort to draw attention away from themselves. Travel to their village so you can gather evidence of this subversion and free these souls from their suffering.
_This is back in the east-central part of the zone ( **map**). Upon entering the area, you see:_
You feel them watching your every move, some of them hidden in their houses while others are on patrol around the collection of broken hovels. It is time that you freed them from this suffering.

---

Liberate the forsaken souls from their tortured lives 0/6 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Free the tortured souls from their suffering so their spirits can return to the Underground City.
_Kill six several villagers ( **map**) in the Forsaken Village. NOTE: You must be on the mob's hate list to get updates._
_On second kill:_ You feel a great sense of relief as you free the soul from its tortured mortal husk.
_On fourth kill:_ The corpse looks up at you with a smile as its last signs of life vanish.
_On sixth kill:_ You use the Alaran's own dagger to neatly sever its head from its body. The serenity of the moment is broken as the disembodied head begins howling loudly.
_Upon the last kill, you get an "Alaran Head"._
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head says, 'Are you mad, you raving lunatic? Was killing me not enough? Now you must torture me in undeath by dragging me around in your stuffy pack? What exactly do you expect to accomplish?'
_This updates the step._

---

Share the truth with the misinformed head 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Return this undead soul back to the temple as evidence of the Unworthy's actions.
_Go back to the Silent Hall ( **map**). On your way back, the head will be talking to you:_
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head says, 'They've gotten to you, haven't they? They're all in this together. They tried to make us do this and that is why we escaped! What lies have they told you about us?'
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head says, 'You don't have to do this. You could return me to my village and leave me to rest there!'
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head begins shaking violently, 'W..w..wait! No! Don't take me back there! Please, just crush me, incinerate me, grind me to a fine powder! I BEG OF YOU! ANYTHING BUT RETURNING ME TO THE TORMENTS OF THE CLERGY!'
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head says, 'I'm not the one you want. It is the others that are behind this. The ones that commune with the dark god! The ones that are responsible for all of this suffering. It is them, not I, whom you must confront!'
_And upon reaching the Silent Hall:_
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head speaks much more calmly, 'Look around you, these are the conduits of his power. Put a few of these mindless thralls to rest and you will sever the link between the dark one and this land. Think of it as liberating these tortured souls from their slavery just as you freed me from my suffering!'
_This updates the step._

---

Free the thralls from their subjugation 0/5 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ The screaming undead head continued to claim its innocence and rambles on about some evil god. Explore its theory about the thralls in the city being a conduit for this being.
_Kill soulless attendees ( **map**) in the Silent Hall and/or subjugated thralls in the arena._
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head says, 'Can you see it? Can you feel their souls finding freedom now? You are a hero to them!'
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head says, 'Just a few more and Alis grasp will slip from their throats!'
You feel the attention of the congregation on you.
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head begins speaking in a panic, 'No! They have sent their soldiers to kill you. You must stop them before they interrupt your mission!'
Stop the conscripted before they kill you!

---

Stop the conscripted before they kill you 0/3 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ The conscripted are going to kill you if you do not put fear into their hearts. Kill a few of them to send the message that you will not be bullied!
_Kill any conscripted mobs ( **map**). (Note: Despite what task text might lead you to believe, you are not auto-aggro'd by anything here.)_
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head cackles wildly.
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head says, 'Yes, it was them or you! These soulless brutes are not worth the air they breathe!'
You shake your head feverishly and your vision clears. What sense does it make that this soul is urging you to kill its former allies and family? - No, clearly some other force is at work here. Put an end to one of the clergy!

---

Put a member of the clergy to rest 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ A strange realization has dawned on you... Why would this still living soul want you to murder its siblings and family? Weren't the citizens of the Forsaken Village made up of escaped slaves and abandoned worshipers? Something is clearly amiss. Slay one of the clergy to see if you can gather any evidence to clear the air.
_Kill one of "an impassive clergyman" or "a calculating overseer" or "a ruthless overseer" (overseers in the arena; clergymen in the Silent Hall)._

---

Leave the Underground City 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Killing the clergyman has caused the screaming head to go berserk! Get out of the city at once so it will stop attacking you.
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head emits an earsplitting wail and begins viciously biting your arm! Get out of the city immediately!
_From here, you will take 5% hp damage per tick until you get out of the city._
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head bites YOU for \_\_\_\_\_ points of damage.
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head bites YOU for \_\_\_\_\_ points of damage.
The Screaming Severed Alaran Head bites YOU for \_\_\_\_\_ points of damage.
As you leave the Underground City the Screaming Severed Alaran Head ceases its assault on you. You should go speak to Harbinger Glask about this.

---

Return to Harbinger Glask 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Return to Harbinger Glask and see what she has to say about this possessed head.
You say, 'Hail, Harbinger Glask'
Harbinger Glask stares at you with a look of utter contempt. She lets nearly a minute pass before speaking, 'Our spies report that a recently recruited soldier, under direct orders from our party, made their way into the city and attended a sermon without incident. This solider THEN proceeded to waltz back into the city with a severed head, still dripping blood, and massacre a number of the believers in the temple. On a whim this soldier THEN decided to make their way through the halls and kill a number of their defenseless slaves. Though the best part of this story, the very best part is where this soldier assassinated one of the highest ranking clergymen in the city and then ran around like a Thule-damned lunatic screaming until they were out of sight. Now tell me, what in our god's name possessed you to do this? Please enlighten me before I have you put to death!'
Hand the Screaming Severed Alaran Head over to Glask 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Hand the possessed Screaming Severed Alaran Head over to Glask to prove that your story to be true!
Harbinger Glask holds up the bleeding Alaran head and stares at it as it continues to scream loudly. She looks into your eyes and sees your fear before looking back at the head. You stare at the dripping hunk of flesh and a cold chill runs down your spine as you realize that the head has been a lifeless hunk of meat the entire time! Glask smiles, 'I thought it strange that such a reputable member of our ranks would simply lose their mind on a scale as grand as this... No, something else is at play here, manipulating you and perhaps the rest of us as well. It is time we put our diplomatic ties to the test with these 'believers'...
The realization that some greater force has been manipulating you has prompted Harbinger Glask to seek more direct measures in dealing with these Alarans. You have a job to do...
Your faction standing with Harbingers of Thule got better.
_Rewards:_
Fragment of Legendary Alaran History
337 platinum, 5 gold
You gain experience! (6% regular experience in Level 96 + 4 AAs)
- Fragment of Legendary Alaran History [item=100964]

_This group mission begins with Harbinger Glask ( map) in Shard's Landing. She is located at 185, 70, 1 (inside the same tent as Overseer Drent in the crater's southwest)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Welcome to Shard's Landing"
\- Completed "Words of the Unspoken"
\- Completed "Unusual Goral Coral"
\- Completed "The Harbingers of Fear"
\- Completed "Conquering Your Fears"
\- Completed "The Believers"
You say, 'Hail, Harbinger Glask'
Harbinger Glask says 'Good, you're back. I feel it is now time to take more direct [action] against The Believers. Their careful manipulation of fact and acts of subversion have gone on long enough. Accomplish this for me and you will be rewarded with even more delicate work.'
You say, 'What action?'
Harbinger Glask says 'Your first task is to gather enough allies to accomplish anything. Speak to me when you are [ready] and I will send you on your way.'
You have been assigned the task 'Sleepless Nights'.
Harbinger Glask has sent a scout ahead to assess the situation. It is her belief that the clergy has been collecting empowered shards of fear to use Cazic's power to conduct some grand ceremony.
Your first task is to meet up with Glask's scout to find out what is going on.
You say, 'Ready!'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Shard's Landing.

---

Speak with Glask's scout 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Say "help"._
You say, 'Hail, Scout Reksvel'
Scout Reksvel looks up at you with half closed eyes. His hand is wrapped around his own neck, holding closed a massive slash wound. He chokes out a few whispered words, 'The... ceremony. You must... stop... phantasm...' The Iksar's chest heaves as a trickle of blood runs down his cheek, '[Help]... me?'
You say, 'Let me help...'
The wounded Iksar manages a smile. The hope that he may survive this encounter is quickly cut short as a shadowy alaran materializes behind him and forcefully drives a boot through his throat. The Iksar's body spasms violently then falls limp, dead.
_This triggers the spawn of "an enthralled ambusher"._
an enthralled ambusher glares at you with a soulless expression.

---

Defeat the enthralled high guard 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ It seems you are not welcome in the Underground City. Defeat the powerful ambusher!
_The enthralled ambusher hits for a max ~12,000 and has a lot of hitpoints (known to parse around 28 million). DPS it to 95% at which point Itzerak the Forsaken appears:_
You hear a battlecry in the distance.
Itzerak the Forsaken says, 'You must weaken the shield protecting this beast so that I may kill him off!'
_Damage the high guard to 90% at which point Itzerak offers to "kill" the guard. You can kill it yourself (for an achievement) or have Itzerak do it for you._
Itzerak the Forsaken says, 'That's it! Give the word and I shall [kill] this brute.'
You say, 'Kill it!'
Itzerak the Forsaken waves its daggers around wildly then pierces the ambusher in the back of the head.
Itzerak the Forsaken nods, 'Hurry now, you must put a stop to the ceremony.'

---

Speak to Itzerak the Forsaken 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ A powerful barrier prevents your entry into the city. Speak with Itzerak the Forsaken to see if they can get you into the city.
You say, 'Hail, Itzerak the Forsaken'
Itzerak the Forsaken says, in Alaran, 'The clergy has divided the city and imprisoned any resident they could not control. The city is now more dangerous than ever. To break the clergy's hold on the residents you must destroy the sustainers that are channeling the walls that divide the city and then make your way to the sacred ritual hall. When you are [ready] I will shatter this barrier as it seems weaker than the others within.'
You say, 'Ready!'
Itzerak the Forsaken says, in Alaran, 'Tread softly within these halls. May your gods protect you from what lies within.'

---

Make your way to the Silent Hall 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Defeat the Shield Sustainers 0/7 (Shard's Landing)
Defeat a few hostile Believers 0/10 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Make your way to the Silent Hall. It will be the center of the clergy's operations. Defeat anyone who gets in your way as you make your way through the city.
_The Silent Hall is in the northeastern part of the city. Along the way, kill at least 10 enthralled NPCs and any "a shield sustainer" you come across. Most mobs here see invisibility, but some do not._
a shield sustainer shouts, 'Stop the intruders, the High Priest demands it!'
_Upon killing a shield sustainer, you see:_
a shield sustainer has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
a shield sustainer's corpse laughs, 'You are too late to stop the ceremony!'
The barrier protecting the Silent Hall has weakened slightly.
_Upon reaching the Silent Hall, you see the emote:_
You look through the transparent shield that blocks ingress into the Silent Hall and see nothing of interest apart from a small urn that sits where the Silent Herald once stood. You will have to find a less direct route into the clergy's stronghold.

---

Use the portal in the Council Room 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ The only way into the Silent Hall will be through the portal in the Council Room.
_Make your way the long way around to the Council Room, killing the remaining shield sustainers along the path. Upon the death of the last one, you see:_
The walls of the city shake as the final sustainer falls. The barrier protecting the Silent Hall has been severely weakened.
You hear a faint murmuring from the Council Room.
_Once in the Council Room, hail "a council dissident" and say "ready", then step on the platform with the rotating crystals._
You say, 'Hail, a council dissident'
a council dissident says, in Alaran, 'The barrier protecting the Silent Hall cannot be physically breached, but the council has a portal that can take us there. When you are [ready] I will activate the portal.'
You say, 'Ready!'
a council dissident says, in Alaran, 'Very well, it will be up to you to face whatever strange evil the clergy is channeling this time.' The council dissident waves its hand and the portal begins to radiate with power.'

---

Approach the Altar of the Unspoken 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Something seems amiss. The Silent Hall is empty save for the urn sitting on the stage. Investigate the strange artifact.
_When ready for a fight, walk onto the stage with the urn._
Your vision darkens as you feel a strange presence enter the room.
The soundless voice of the silent herald fills your mind but seems to be addressing the crowd, 'These outsiders aim to stop the revival of our lord. It is time you give your lives for Alis!'

---

Defeat the Vengeful Masses 0/30 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ The true nature of the Silent Hall has been revealed. Defend yourselves from the apparitions of Cazic that the heralds of the Phantasm are controlling!
_NOTE: The task locks upon the death of the 30th spirit._
_The believers sacrifice themselves and become apparitions of fear, and attack. Six of these mobs will always be up at a time. They are auto-aggro and continue spawning until 30 have been killed. These hit for a max ~7,000._
_All apparitions appear to be mezzable, except for the amygdalan model. Most (or all?) are rootable/snareable._
_Once 30 have died, one will be left over:_
a vengeful spirit has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
a vengeful spirit returns to the Heart of Fear.
The voice of the Silent Herald enters your mind, 'So you are capable of destroying the easily manipulated abominations of your own fallen god? You will not stop Alis return!'
A dark presence begins radiating from the urn of howling souls.
_"Lesser Vessel of the Phantasm" spawns on the stage at this point. Note that it is not auto-aggro, so you can rest up before engaging._

---

Defeat the Lesser Vessel of the Phantasm 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Defeat the body that the Phantasm has taken control over.
_This is a fairly standard fight. It hits for a max ~15,000 and casts "Force of the Failing Body" (includes a knockback) and "Strike of the Failing Body":_
Force of the Failed Body: PB AE 100', Chromatic (-1000)
1: Decrease Movement by 80%
Strike of the Failing Body: PB AE 200', Chromatic (-980)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 16409
2: Decrease Mana by 3456
3: Decrease Endurance by 3456
Lesser Vessel of the Phantasm has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
You feel some unseen force rise from the vessel's body and dissipate throughout the room.
The room begins to shake as the body housing the unspoken falls dead to the floor. The godly power inhabiting the creature dissipates into the room. You know full well that the clergy will soon be redoubling their efforts to house their god in corporeal form.
a council dissident shouts, in Alaran, 'How is this possible? We thought the unspoken was a thing of myth. The will of the clergy will surely be our undoing!'

---

Claim your spoils from the Urn of Howling Souls 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Task Window Says:_ Destroy the Urn of Howling Souls and claim whatever spoils lie within.
_"Urn of Howling Souls" spawns with loot. Open it to complete the task._
With the Vessel destroyed the urn begins to crack and shatter under your influence.
You have successfully delayed the clergy in their efforts to use the power of fear to reinstate their god, but it is only a matter of time before they will try again. Harbinger Glask will be interested in hearing about what you have seen here.
Your faction standing with Harbingers of Thule got better.

1 Fragment of Legendary Alaran History
300 platinum
Experience

_This task begins with a rat man named Vdrakii in Shard's Landing (in a tent in the southern part of the crater: 120, -45, 1)._
You say, 'Hail, Vdrakii'
Vdrakii fidgets and grips its totem tightly, 'Travel to the Breeding Grounds? [Attune] you must! You must attune!'
You say, 'Attune?'

_Find Tomekeeper Kerkaz in Shard's Landing. He's at /location 435, 25, 0 (in a tent in the southwestern portion of the crater, slightly north of the quest NPC camp)._
You say, 'Hail, Tomekeeper Kerkaz'
Tomekeeper Kerkaz says 'Who dares disturb my... oh, forget it. What do you want? Have you made yourself useful and found a [Dreadmote] or [Terrormote] for me, or did you simply want to [chat]?'
You say, 'Let's chat...'
Tomekeeper Kerkaz says 'Oh, wonderful. How has your day been? What brings you to the area? Are you sightseeing, perhaps? Or are you attempting to heal the very fabric of our existence and bring the Pantheon back in to balance? That's what I am here to do.'
You say, 'I have a Dreadmote'
Tomekeeper Kerkaz says 'Fear is a many-faceted concept. Pure Dread can drive the weak-minded to attempt foolish, foolish deeds in order to ensure what they think is their own safety. Dread is powerful for what it makes the weak do to themselves.'
You have been assigned the task 'Median Dreadmote'.
Tomekeeper Kerkaz in Shard's Landing has asked you to return any Dreadmotes you find as a reward.

_Find Tomekeeper Kerkaz in Shard's Landing. He's at /location 435, 25, 0 (in a tent in the southwestern portion of the crater, slightly north of the quest NPC camp)._
You say, 'Hail, Tomekeeper Kerkaz'
Tomekeeper Kerkaz says 'Who dares disturb my... oh, forget it. What do you want? Have you made yourself useful and found a [Dreadmote] or [Terrormote] for me, or did you simply want to [chat]?'
You say, 'Let's chat...'
Tomekeeper Kerkaz says 'Oh, wonderful. How has your day been? What brings you to the area? Are you sightseeing, perhaps? Or are you attempting to heal the very fabric of our existence and bring the Pantheon back in to balance? That's what I am here to do.'
You say, 'I have a Dreadmote'
Tomekeeper Kerkaz says 'Fear is a many-faceted concept. Pure Dread can drive the weak-minded to attempt foolish, foolish deeds in order to ensure what they think is their own safety. Dread is powerful for what it makes the weak do to themselves.'
You have been assigned the task 'Glowing Dreadmote'.
Tomekeeper Kerkaz in Shard's Landing has asked you to return any Dreadmotes you find as a reward.

---

Deliver 1 Glowing Dreadmote to Tomekeeper Kerkaz 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Dreadmotes drop from nameds and missions throughout the expansion._

_Find Tomekeeper Kerkaz in Shard's Landing. He's at /location 435, 25, 0 (in a tent in the southwestern portion of the crater, slightly north of the quest NPC camp)._
You say, 'Hail, Tomekeeper Kerkaz'
Tomekeeper Kerkaz says 'Who dares disturb my... oh, forget it. What do you want? Have you made yourself useful and found a [Dreadmote] or [Terrormote] for me, or did you simply want to [chat]?'
You say, 'Let's chat...'
Tomekeeper Kerkaz says 'Oh, wonderful. How has your day been? What brings you to the area? Are you sightseeing, perhaps? Or are you attempting to heal the very fabric of our existence and bring the Pantheon back in to balance? That's what I am here to do.'
You say, 'I have a Terrormote'
Tomekeeper Kerkaz says 'Fear can not be contained in one simple emotion. Terror, for instance, is the simplest way to determine the true nature of any being. Who would you abandon in a moment of terror? Who would you kill?'
You have been assigned the task 'Median Terrormote'.
Tomekeeper Kerkaz in Shard's Landing has asked you to return any Dreadmotes you find as a reward.

_Find Tomekeeper Kerkaz in Shard's Landing. He's at /location 435, 25, 0 (in a tent in the southwestern portion of the crater, slightly north of the quest NPC camp)._
You say, 'Hail, Tomekeeper Kerkaz'
Tomekeeper Kerkaz says 'Who dares disturb my... oh, forget it. What do you want? Have you made yourself useful and found a [Dreadmote] or [Terrormote] for me, or did you simply want to [chat]?'
You say, 'Let's chat...'
Tomekeeper Kerkaz says 'Oh, wonderful. How has your day been? What brings you to the area? Are you sightseeing, perhaps? Or are you attempting to heal the very fabric of our existence and bring the Pantheon back in to balance? That's what I am here to do.'
You say, 'I have a Terrormote'
Tomekeeper Kerkaz says 'Fear can not be contained in one simple emotion. Terror, for instance, is the simplest way to determine the true nature of any being. Who would you abandon in a moment of terror? Who would you kill?'
You have been assigned the task 'Glowing Terrormote'.
Tomekeeper Kerkaz in Shard's Landing has asked you to return any Dreadmotes you find as a reward.

---

Deliver 1 Glowing Terrormote to Tomekeeper Kerkaz 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Terrormotes drop from raids in the Rain of Fear expansion._

This task begins with Bodhessel the Caller [npc=41282] ( map) in Shard's Landing at location +470,-1925 (in the Forsaken Village in the zone's east valley).
Pre-Requisites:
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Bodhessel the Caller'
Bodhessel the Caller says 'Tell me, \_\_\_\_\_, have you ever forgotten your [purpose]? Have you ever wandered the wilderness to find your way back [home]?'
You say, 'Back home?'
Bodhessel the Caller gazes past you, their hate-filled eyes boring into the mountain beyond, 'Our home is here. It has been three heaps and twelve legs since I was last [underground]. Riddance is good, but we are not enemies.'
You say, 'Underground?'
Bodhessel the Caller frowns as they look down at their ragged clothes, 'I do not look right anymore. Hope has won the clothing war, but only once, I swear. The Underground City is the dwelling of The Heralds of the Unspoken! Surely you have heard of [Ali].'
You say, 'What purpose?'
Bodhessel the Caller raises their arms to the sky and stares above, 'Purpose? Per pus. You are right: pus is gross, but not frightening. We sow fear in service of Fear itself. Do you know [Ali]?'
You say, 'Ali?'
Bodhessel the Caller says 'You will know Ali soon enough, no mind. Sleep while you can. But they must not sleep. We can stop their sleep before it gets too deep. If it gets deep, they will rise too high. Will you [help] me?'
You say, 'I will help'
Bodhessel the Caller says 'Oh, good. Then we will not kill you. Just scare you to death!' Bodhessel cackles for a good long while before catching itself, 'We have left that city. I did not understand, but then I did. We were lifted up, shaped by the horror to complete the circle. Everyone in that city is the same: others fear them, but they fear no one. That is furious. Fearious. We will make them all fear you, [agreed]?'
You say, 'Agreed!'
Bodhessel the Caller says 'Do you sleep? They sleep in peace. They should have nightmares. You and I will be their nightmares. Go to where they sleep. Go through the mouth. Or is it the nose? Either way, kill all those. Give them fear and be blessed with it yourself, child \_\_\_\_\_.'
You have been assigned the task 'Fear Begins at Home'.
Bodhessel wants you to kill Alaran in the nearby cult compound that it was exiled from. It is clearly insane, but it seems to have influence among the other exiles and may be able to put in a good word for you. Search for an entrance in the canyon to the west.

---

1\. Find the Underground City 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
This is the area that connects to the zone's northwestern valley (labeled on this map for a different task).
2\. Kill Alaran in the housing and council area 0/10 (Shard's Landing)
3\. Return to Bodhessel the Caller 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Rewards:_
150 platinum
You gain experience!!
Your faction with Forsaken Believers has been adjusted by 50.
Your faction with Heralds of the Unspoken has been adjusted by -100.
Your faction with The Believers has been adjusted by -1.
Fragment of Legendary Alaran History [item=100964]
- Fragment of Legendary Alaran History [item=100964]

This is a solo task that begins with Keeper Nenth [npc=41283] ( map) in Shard's Landing. This is a Carnifex mob located at -500, 1615, -502 (this is the arena of the Underground City -- the tunnel area that extends from the zone's northwestern valley).
Pre-requisites:
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Keeper Nenth'
Keeper Nenth stares at you in surprise, 'What could One want of us, that they would dare to disturb our silent meditation? It seems unlikely that the Silent One would have sent such a noisy messenger in our hour of [need].'
You say, 'Your need?'
Keeper Nenth coos to itself, clearly delighted with your interest in its plight, 'Clearly One has not been sent to our aid - and yet, that may not stop One from working such miracles as a messenger may. If One would but hear our [plea], perhaps an agreement may be reached?'
You say, 'What plea?'
Keeper Nenth sighs, covering its heart with one hand, 'Sore has been our heart of late over the fate of those poor wretches known as the forsaken. They who rejected our love are loved all the more strongly and might yet be saved from an even worse [fate].'
You say, 'What fate?'
Keeper Nenth says, in Alaran, 'Among the forsaken, three poor souls stand out. It is said they make treasures of rubbish and guard them closely, foregoing both food and rest. In their madness all sight of hope has been lost, leaving only the most pitiful of existences. One might [free] them of their burdens by relieving them of that which they guard so closely.'
You say, 'How would we free them?'
Keeper Nenth says, in Alaran, 'If One were to seek out those known as Ashki, Lera, and Selya, the cause of their hearts' ache might be found. By retrieving the source of each one's misery, One might redeem them from their fate.'
You have been assigned the task 'Coveted Rubbish'.
Keeper Nenth has asked you to aid in the ridding of forsaken Alarans of their unnatural possessions.

---

1\. Speak to Ashki and learn of its obsession 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Note: There are see-invis KoS NPCs inside NPC houses.
Ashki the Forsaken [npc=41452] ( map) spawns at about -20, -1560, 5 (the middle hut of the three west huts, in the Forsaken Village in the zone's east-central valley).
You say, 'Hail, Ashki the Forsaken'
Ashki the Forsaken says, in Alaran, 'Hush! You'll scare my beloved pets, and I don't want them [running] around and messing up their fur while I'm grooming them.'
You say, 'Running?'
Ashki the Forsaken says, in Alaran, 'Well, admittedly they don't run much anymore, since I broke their necks. \*chuckle\* You see, they kept trying to run away, and I [couldn't let them] do that, now could I?'
You say, 'Couldn't let them?'
Ashki the Forsaken smiles faintly, 'Let's just say, they're my precious pets. I couldn't live without them.' It resumes brushing one of the dead oashim, humming softly.
2\. Search the dead oashims' corpses for the object which causes Ashki's unrest 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Find well-groomed oashim corpses [npc=41485] arond Ashki's house and /open them until you loot a Grease-Blackened Scroll [item=107532].
3\. Speak to Lera and learn of its obsession 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Lera the Forsaken [npc=41469] ( map) spawns in the house at about -210, -1630, 10 (the southwest hut in the Forsaken Village in the zone's east-central valley).
You say, 'Hail, Lera the Forsaken'
Lera the Forsaken says, in Alaran, 'Can't you see I'm busy trying to repair my gardening tools right now? Honestly! How am I supposed to keep my garden free of weeds if my tools keep [breaking] like this?'
You say, 'Breaking?'
Lera the Forsaken says, in Alaran, 'Well, it's not like I mistreat my tools, or anything, but for some reason they keep getting dented and chipped. Maybe the dirt out back is too rough? Is that even possible?? My [plants] seem to be managing alright, but my poor tools just can't seem to take it.'
You say, 'Your plants?'
Lera the Forsaken says, in Alaran, 'Hmph! It's none of your business what kind of plants I'm growing. So kindly let me get back to my work - oh! - and stay out of my garden! If you trample my poor plants, there'll be hell to pay!'
4\. Search the "plants" in the garden for the object which causes Lera's unrest 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Find eerily familiar plants [npc=41501] (these are actually bone piles around Lera's house) and /open them until you loot a Garden-Variety Skull [item=107529].
5\. Speak to Selya and learn of its obsession 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Selya the Forsaken [npc=41471] ( map) is found at 50, -1920, 1 (the middle house of the eastern set of houses in the Forsaken Village in the zone's east-central valley).
You say, 'Hail, Selya the Forsaken'
Selya the Forsaken looks up in alarm, 'Please be careful where you step! Just think [what] would happen if you were to knock over one of my vases and it broke!'
You say, 'What would happen?'
Selya the Forsaken says, in Alaran, 'Oh... er, it would break. Yes! And it would be irreplaceable! These are all my own work, you know, and each one is absolutely priceless, so be very careful!' It sinks back against the wall, apparently stressed just at the thought of broken vases, and mutters to itself, 'Perhaps pottery was a bad idea, after all.'
6\. Destroy vases to find the object which causes Selya's unrest 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
Find poorly crafted vases [npc=41500] around Selya's house and /open them until you loot a Strange Glass Shard [item=107528].
7\. Deliver a Grease-Blackened Scroll to Keeper Nenth 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
8\. Deliver a Garden-Variety Skull to Keeper Nenth 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
9\. Deliver a Strange Glass Shard to Keeper Nenth 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
10\. Speak to Keeper Nenth 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
On these last 3 hails, you'll need to wait for the animation to be over with and right on top of them for the hails to give you credit. You can also hail while invis, and even hail Lera through the wall.
11\. Deliver Nenth's message to Ashki 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
12\. Deliver Nenth's message to Lera 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
13\. Deliver Nenth's message to Selya 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
14\. Return to Keeper Nenth 0/1 (Shard's Landing)
_Rewards:_
225 platinum
Faction with Harbingers of Thule
2% lvl exp and 3 AA's

Master Hunter Jilare explains that some of the stupider recruits that the Harbingers have recently enlisted are being bitten and infected by the creatures that inhabit the Forsaken village.
Make your way to the village and take out a few of the garbage-dwelling vermin that have made the area their home.

_This is the first task in a series of four, a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Gildorn Icebreath ( map) in Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening. He is found at /location -8115, 3160, 147 (outside some Coldain huts that are due south of the entrance to the canyon that leads to Kael Drakkel)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Gildorn Icebreath'
Gildorn Icebreath says 'I don't know if you are extremely foolish, or just brave to a fault to be traveling these lands right now, but either way I could [really use] your help right about now.'
You say, 'Really use?'
Gildorn Icebreath says 'Ever since that strange shard fell from the sky and embedded itself in the tundra, strange things have been going on. First, the nightmarish creatures appeared, and then my entire clan decided to [wander off] and not return.'
You say, 'Where did they wander off?'
Gildorn Icebreath says 'My clan was once twenty strong, and now only I remain. My entire clan disappeared the other night while I was asleep and never returned. Yesterday, I saw one of my clan members near the shard. I hailed him and he just ignored me as if he didn't know who I was. When I tried to get closer to see if he was perhaps injured, he ran off. I gave chase, but was attacked by a fearsome steed of pure darkness. Perhaps you can try to [help] me figure out what is going on?'
You say, 'I will help'
Gildorn Icebreath says 'I have seen some Coldain, Ry`Gorr, and Frost Giants doing something near the shard recently. Perhaps if you could defeat one of these suspicious beings, you might find something on their corpse to give us a clue to what is happening.'
You have been assigned the task 'Scaring Up Some Information'.
Gildorn Icebreath needs your help to learn why his clan disappeared into the Wastes.
Find and defeat a suspicious Coldain, Ry'Gorr, or Frost Giant. Gildorn has seen them near the site of the shard's impact.

---

Find and defeat a suspicious Coldain, Ry'Gorr, or frost giant 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
_The Ry`Gorr ( map) is known to appear at -5160, -115, 160 (a little ways south-southeast of Crystal Caverns)._
_The Coldain ( map) is known to appear at -4735, -780, 150 (southeast of the Crystal Caverns)._
_The Frost Giant ( map) is known to appear at -5150, 545, 153 (directly south of the Crystal Caverns entrance)._
_Note: These cast a targeted AE called "Taste of Fear" (decreases spell haste by 50%)._
Loot a mysterious coin from the suspicious Coldain, Ry'Gorr, or frost giant's corpse 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)

---

Give the mysterious coin to Gildorn Icebreath 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
Speak with Gildorn Icebreath 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
You say, 'Hail, Gildorn Icebreath'
Gildorn Icebreath says 'You say you found this on one of the corpses of the suspicious beings? I have no idea what this is, but I do know someone who may be able to tell you more. His name is Robairn. He is more concerned with his treasure hunting than the dilemma here in the East Wastes, but hopefully he will help you. Robairn's camp is to the southwest of here.'
Give the mysterious coin to Treasure Hunter Robairn to see if he can decipher it 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
Treasure Hunter Robairn ( map) is located at approximately -9220, 4680, 257, in the southwest corner of the zone.
Speak with Treasure Hunter Robairn 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
You say, 'Hail, Treasure Hunter Robairn'
Treasure Hunter Robairn says 'It appears we have a budding treasure hunter in our midst. What an odd token. You wish for me to tell you where it came from? I may be able to help you with that, but first, I need you to take care of a little problem I am having. Some thieves have been invading my camp at night in an attempt to steal my treasure. [Stop] them, and I will attempt to decipher this token for you.'
You say, 'Stop them, how?'
Treasure Hunter Robairn says 'I have quite an ingenious plan all cooked up, I just need you to execute it. Go into the wastes and gather a head and some tattered clothing from a samhain. Return these items to me, and then the real fun can begin.'

---

Loot a samhain head from a samhain 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
_Samhains are found most commonly scattered around the outer areas of the zone, towards the zone boundaries._
Obtain some tattered clothing from a samhain 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
Return the samhain head to Treasure Hunter Robairn 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
Return the tattered clothing to Treasure Hunter Robairn 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
Speak with Treasure Hunter Robairn 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
You say, 'Hail, Treasure Hunter Robairn'
Treasure Hunter Robairn takes the samhain head and tattered clothing and quickly fashions a rather frightening costume. "This ought to do the trick. Put this costume on and find the thieves. The thieves' names are Falmia, Jornin, and Yalfi. They normally hide out to the northeast, in and around some ruins. Once you find them, let them know that I sent you."

---

Use the samhain mask to scare Falmia 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
_At the last step, you received a Samhain Costume, a TEMPORARY scarecrow illusion click-effect item. For each of the next three steps, make sure to have the illusion up before saying "Robairn sent me." to the NPC's. These are Coldains found among the ruins in the north-central part of the zone._
_The ruins are located at about 400, -45, 3. Falmia ( map) is west of this location; Yalfi ( map) is east of it; Jornin ( map) is south of it._
You say, 'Robairn sent me.'
Falmia says 'Tell Robairn I won't bother his treasure anymore!'
Use the samhain mask to scare Jornin 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
You say, 'Robairn sent me.'
Jornin says 'It's a monster! Tell Robairn I am sorry!'
Use the samhain mask to scare Yalfi 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
You say, 'Robairn sent me.'
Yalfi says 'OK, OK! Tell Robairn I promise not to steal from him anymore!'
Return to Treasure Hunter Robairn and have him decipher the mysterious coin 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
Hand in the coin.
Treasure Hunter Robairn says 'Have you scared those pitiful thieves yet? You did? I wish I could have been there to see their faces! Now let's take a look at this token. There appears to be some runes and an engraving of a dragon upon it. Roughly translated, the runes say, Zeixshi-Kar. I have not heard this name before. Unfortunately that's all I can tell from looking at the token. Thanks for your help, and I hope I was able to help you in some small way.'
Speak with Gildorn Icebreath 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
You say, 'Hail, Gildorn Icebreath'
Gildorn Icebreath says 'Zeixshi-Kar? Dragon? Perhaps that is the name of the dragon engraved on the token. We will need to do some more investigating. Speak with me again if you are able to help me further.'
_Rewards:_
150 platinum
Experience (2 AAs)

You say, 'Hail, Gildorn Icebreath'

That was at least two days ago and nobody has seen them since. Perhaps you can look for them to see what may have [happened]? Perhaps they found something of interest.'
You say, 'What happened?'
Gildorn Icebreath says 'You may want to search the outside of the fort first, as entering the fort itself is taking your own life in its hands. Return to me if you find anything.'

Speak with Dirgen 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
_Dirgen ( map) is in the extreme northwestern part of the zone at about 230, 4900, 400._
You say, 'Hail, Dirgen'
Dirgen says 'I thank you for saving my life, but perhaps you shouldn't have. I am a coward. My wife Jorga is about to be sacrificed to a powerful being from the Plane of Fear known as, Zebexiban. Zeixshi-Kar hopes that if he sacrifices enough souls to this creature, that Zebexiban will become his ally. I beg of you, please save her. I am too weak to do so myself. Please speak with Welken again. Maybe he knows how to save her.'
Speak with Welken 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
_Welken ( map) is found at /location -9130, -4180, 144 (this is the zone-in: he is behind the purple crystal overlooking the coast)._
You say, 'Hail, Welken'
Welken says 'My, my. I have become quite popular for a hermit as of late. What can I do for you now? An exorcism you say? I have performed them in the past, but they are far too dangerous to attempt. I cannot risk an evil spirit corrupting my body and using the knowledge I have for evil. Perhaps you can try to [perform] it however.'
You say, 'Perform?'
Welken says 'You will need to gather a few items that will be used in the ceremony to transfer the victim's soul back into their own body. A sample of pure [snow bunny blood], some [enchanted snow], and a [Seashell of Calming Sounds] will be required.'
You say, 'Snow bunny blood?'
Welken says 'I would imagine that you can get snow bunny blood from snow bunnies. Are you sure you are up to performing this exorcism?'
You say, 'Enchanted snow?'
Welken says 'The Snow Dervishes are made almost entirely of enchanted snow. Kill some of them and perhaps you can get enough snow from them.'
You say, 'Seashell of Calming Sounds?'
Welken says 'Unfortunately the shell may not be as easy to obtain as the other two items are. The shell is guarded by a Siren named, [Mirlil]. She perverts the shell's magic to lull victims into her clutches. I am afraid you will need to try to kill Mirlil to obtain the shell.'
You say, 'Mirlil?'
Welken says 'Mirlil appeared not long after the shard struck. A pirate ship approached the southwest shore and when they tried to leave the ship, Mirlil struck and turned the entire crew into mindless thralls. Find the ship and kill Mirlil to obtain the Shell of Calming Sounds.'

_This group mission begins with Dirgen ( map) in Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening. He is in the extreme northwestern part of the zone at about 230, 4900, 400._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Scaring Up Some Information"
\- Completed "Indoctrination"
\- Completed "The Sacrifice"
\- Completed "The Sweet Taste of Revenge"
\- Completed "Confronting Your Fears" (group mission)
You say, 'Hail, Dirgen'
Dirgen says 'Zeixshi-Kar has fallen into a state of depression, or at least it appears that way to me. He stirs little within is protective dome. Now is the time to strike a final blow. Your [confrontation] with the great dragon earlier has affected him. He was not [prepared] for your efforts, nor the disruption you caused by helping to [save] Jorga. But now is the time for you to attempt a final blow, to try to [destroy] the great fear drake while he is weak and distracted.'
You say, 'How can we destroy him?'
Dirgen says 'I can send into the dome, but leaving might be impossible. Defeating the dragon will be up to you. Are you [willing] to risk everything?'
You say, 'We are willing'
Dirgen says 'Good then. You continue to prove your bravery. Let me know when you wish me to [send] you into the dome.'
You have been assigned the task 'Defeat Zeixshi-Kar'.
Now is your chance to defeat the tyrannical Zeixshi-Kar and reduce the effect of the shard of fear.
You say, 'Send me there'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Zeixshi-Kar's Shard.
_NOTE: You cannot campfire into this instanced zone._

---

Kill Zeixshi-Kar 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
Bring your group together, then open the chest to gather your rewards 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)

---

_Note: This event is triggered through dialogue (not aggro until trigger - keyword "death")._
You say, 'Hail, Zeixshi-Kar'
Zeixshi-Kar shouts 'What? How did mortals get in here to disturb me? Ah, you defeated those fools that I trusted with my [power]. And now you've used it to get in here to bother me.'
You say, 'What power?'
Zeixshi-Kar shouts 'A mortal like you would never fully understand what I have learned, the power that I have been able to drag from this... this shard of Fear. Its power has become mine. You should consider this. I was strong before, but now, now you should run. You should fear me. But then, you're not bright enough for that, are you. There is one thing I understand clearly now; the truly [stupid] can't be frightened.'
You say, 'Stupid?!'
Zeixshi-Kar shouts 'Most like to call it bravery, but I know differently. Willingness to die for something is only a misunderstanding of facts. Dying for something is meaningless and stupid. So I will give you one chance to [leave]. The other option for you is [death].'
You say, 'It shall be your death!'
Zeixshi-Kar shouts 'This is what I expected of you.'
_Zeixshi-Kar wakes up and starts flying around the zone (he is still non-aggro at this point, but casts a "Lava Breath" AE/dispell, avoidable by staying away from him)._
_Here, you will have adds to contend with:_
\- First Wave: 4x "a feartattered drake" (spawn shortly after event trigger)
\- Second Wave: Mix of several Coldain/Giants (spawns 10:00 after trigger, or after drakes die - whichever occurs first)
\- Third Wave: Mix of several Coldain/Giants (spawns 11:30 after trigger, or after previous wave dies - whichever occurs first)
\- Fourth Wave: Two captains? One Coldain / One Giant (spawns 13:00 after trigger, or after previous wave dies, whichever occurs first))
\- Fifth Wave: Zeixshi-Kar (spawns 20:00 after trigger, or after previous wave dies, whichever occurs first)
_Note: all adds in this mission summon from 100% health and have very large aggro ranges._
_The drakes die fast and easily, hitting for a max ~10,000 (immune to mez/root/stun)._
_Giants and Coldain also hit for a max ~10,000 and are immune to mez, root, and stun. Those with "soldier" in their name can be charmed, except the charm doesn't work as a regular charm - the mob doesn't become your pet, but will attack mobs of the opposing race._
_Note: Prior to a patch on May 14, 2013, there was an anti-kite mechanic on the adds, where If you tried kiting them, you would spawn an additional add. This was removed in that patch._
_When an add is killed, a short timer starts (10 seconds?), and then the corpse casts an AE: "Sweltering Carcass" (PBAE 20' range nuke for 42,000 damage)._

---

_Zeixshi-Kar goes live after all adds have been killed or after a certain amount of time has passed since the event was triggered (this timer appears to be 20 minutes from the time of trigger)._
_He has a lot of hitpoints; hits for a max ~28,000; and single-target rampages (does not flurry). NOTE: His melee damage and health were decreased in a patch on May 14, 2013. He may hit for less than 28,000 now._
_He casts "Sweeping Tail", a rear AE and knockback, every 15 seconds:_
Sweeping Tail: Directional 200', Unresistable (-800)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 27000
2: Knockback (2) and Toss Up (4)
_He casts the PBAE 400' range knockback "Wing Buffet" every 30 seconds:_
Wing Buffet: PB AE 400', Chromatic (-825)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 19000
_He casts the PBAE 200' range "Lava Breath" every 25 seconds:_
Lava Breath: PB AE 200', Fire (-800)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 35000
2: Cancel Magic (9)
_And every 45 seconds, he casts "Crystallized Fear" on a random player, encasing them in place:_
Crystallizing Fear: Single Target, Magic (-10000)
1: Mesmerize (0) _(5 minutes)_
2: Invulnerability
_The player inflicted with "Crystallized Fear" cannot cast or attack, and is invulnerable. The freeze lasts five minutes. To free the target, you need to DPS the crystal dead. It's a good idea to free them as soon as possible since the dragon will soon cast the crystal freeze again. (Due to the nature of this mechanic, it's beneficial to have at least two healers in the group)._
_Kill Zeixshi-Kar and open the chest to complete the task._
Zeixshi-Kar has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
The dome of fear protecting the shard fades away.
_Rewards:_
450 platinum
Experience

Speak with Falmonius 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
Falmonius is an Erudite in yellow robes on the top shelf of the PoK library entry tier, right next to a Magician vendor.
If people care these days about the quest text being here on the quest page, here it is:
After handing in pages:
Hurble places the pages into the badly tattered spell book and the tome begins to glow. Hurble quickly throws the tome to the ground. 'Um, you may want to stand back.' The tome erupts in purple flames. The flames grow in intensity and a mass of magical energy bursts forth, almost knocking you to the ground. Six motes of light fly from the book and head into various directions further into the Eastern Wastes. Hurble looks worried. 'I don't think that was supposed to happen. I suppose I have no choice, but to tell you what's [really going on].'
You say, 'What's really going on?'
Hurble says, 'The truth is that I stole these spell books from my master, Falmonius and when he finds out, he will not be very pleased with me to put it mildly. This particular spell book was used to imprison six very angry shadows that Falmonius captured while in the Plane of Shadow. There must be some sort of mysterious magic here that has animated the spell books. I am afraid I am going to have to ask you to talk to [Falmonius].'
You say, 'You want me to be your fall guy with Falmonius?'
Hurble says, 'He is not going to be pleased, but he needs to know what has happened here. I would talk to him, but I am pretty sure he would incinerate me on the spot when he found out what I have done. When he isn't stalking the various planes of existence, he can be found perusing the spell vendors in the Plane of Knowledge. Take the spell book and give it to him. He will know what must be done.'
After handing in book:
You say, 'Hail, Falmonius'
Falmonius's brow furrows as you explain what just took place in the Eastern Wastes. 'Hurble! That idiot! I shall deal with him later. In the meantime it is vital that those shadows be [rebound] to the tome.'
You say, 'How would they be rebound?'
Falmonius says 'From what you have described, those motes of light that escaped the tome are most likely the shadows, escaping their prison. Those shadows must be contained! Gather some adventuring supplies and once you are ready to continue, speak with me again.
_Rewards:_
337 platinum, 5 gold
Experience (3-4% in Level 96 + 4 AAs)
_NOTE: The Crystal Caverns task "Stalking the Shadows" follows this one (given by Falmonius)._

_This is a kill task that begins with Baffod the Wayward ( map) in Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening at /location -4050, 40, 136 (outside the Ry'Gorr fort in the middle of the zone; southeast corner)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No other pre-requisites
You say, 'Hail, Baffod the Wayward'
Baffod the Wayward says 'Ach! 'Tis good to see a fellow adventurer out here. What brings you to this [place]?'
You say, 'What place?'
Baffod the Wayward says 'Sadly, tis a wee bit changed since last I was out this way. Speaking of which, I don't suppose yeh've seen a group of adventurers roamin' about nearby? I'm tryin' ta [find] me allies.'
You say, 'Find your allies?'
Baffod the Wayward says 'Ach, nay. I dunnae need any [help] findin' me way back. I only lost track of 'em fer a moment, I tell yeh.'
You say, 'I will help'
Baffod the Wayward scratches his beard thoughtfully, 'Well, I'm sure I'll find me friends again in no time, but if yer lookin' ta be useful, I'm guess I'm a li'l low on [food]. And those blasted [giants] could kill a Dwarf, trapsin' aroun' like they own the bloody place!'
You say, 'What about the giants?'
Baffod the Wayward says 'Those blasted giants're everywhere, and dunnae seem to care who they step on. It'd be a right favor if yeh could help me by cutting some of the big lugs down ta size, if yeh get me drift.'
You have been assigned the task 'Lost Without a Compass'.
Baffod has asked you to slay some giants, so that he can find his way back to his friends without getting trampled.

_This is a kill task that begins with a giant named Silnik ( map) at /location -1820, 2930, 144 in Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening (outside the giant fort in the northwestern part of the zone)._
You say, 'Hail, Silnik'
Silnik glances down, then suddenly turns pale and closes his eyes, and starts to clutch desperately at the banner behind him, 'Dear Brell! I'm going to [fall]!'
You say, 'Fall?'
Silnik says 'I'm not good with heights; they make me dizzy. Gnomes just aren't cut out for things like this!' He opens one eye carefully, keeping his gaze carefully skyward. After a few deep breaths he relaxes a bit and asks hopefully, in your general direction, 'I don't suppose my [companions] sent you to help me?'
You say, 'Your companions?'
Silnik says 'Baffod, Taelanie, and Tramric. Baffod somehow managed to get lost - again - and I wound up being left alone while Taelanie went to find him, and Tramric went to scout ahead. So when I saw a pair of giants approaching, I cast an illusion, to disguise myself as a giant, in the hopes of avoiding a fight. But it [backfired].'
You say, 'Backfired?'
Silnik says 'The next thing I knew, I'd been recruited to join their army. I can't even sneak away to escape; whenever I move I get dizzy. It's all because of this blasted illusion! If I could just turn back into a Gnome, I'd be fine, but I don't dare take off my disguise with so many enemies around. Won't you [help] me?'
You say, 'I will help'
Silnik says 'Thank Brell! If you could cause a distraction - maybe rid the fort here of some of its inhabitants? - that might allow me to sneak away unnoticed.'
You have been assigned the task 'HO-HO-Help!'.
Silnik has asked you to slay the inhabitants of the fort so she can finally remove her disguise and return to her friends.

Tramric the Pessimistic says 'What's that? You say there's no hailstorm after all? Are you sure? It looks like it might, you know. And unless I can find some way to [defeat] all these obstacles, there's no point in fighting our way through a hailstorm just to get mauled by a cougar.'
You say, 'Defeat them?'
Tramric the Pessimistic says 'You want to help us by cutting down the number of cougars and dervishes? I guess I can't stop you, but if it starts to hail, I recommend finding a safe place to take shelter. That's what I intend to do.'
You have been assigned the task 'Never Say 'Hi''.
