_This is the second task in a series of three. It is a solo task that begins with Captain Dunstan Coldheart ( map \- full zone map) in the Crystal Caverns (located in a room in the center of the Coldain city, Froststone at -255, 230, -400)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "An Abundance of Orcs"
You say, 'Hail, Captain Dunstan Coldheart'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'I cannot risk a Ry`Gorr attack on Froststone. While our will is strong, these stone walls won't withstand a horde of orc invaders. It pains me to suggest it, but I think a [truce] is in order. Or have you come to me for [other reasons]?'
You say, 'Other reasons?'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'Froststone's defenses are already spread too thin. I cannot afford to send more scouts out to investigate the mining camps. Since you have already proven your ability to deftly navigate these caverns, I wonder if you would be [willing] to investigate what the Ry`Gorr are up to?'
You say, 'No thanks; what about that truce?'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'The Ry`Gorr orcs mostly keep to mining. The fact that they are sending forces to Froststone suggests that we have something they want. What that is, I do not know, but whatever it is will be key to bargaining for peace. I need a neutral party to approach the Ry`Gorr and determine their terms for a truce. As both an outsider and a proven ally to the coldain, I think you would work well as an [emissary].'
You say, 'I'll be an emissary'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'Your goal will be simple, but not without danger. Find a messenger within the Ry`Gorr clan and speak to him of our desire for peace. Do your best to keep the dialog neutral and open.'
You have been assigned the task 'Ry`Gorr Reconnaissance'.
Captain Dunstan Coldheart has asked you to serve as an emissary of Froststone, in hopes that you can secure a truce between the Coldain dwarves and Clan Ry`Gorr.
Find a Ry`Gorr messenger and offer a truce between his clan and the Coldain. Orc messengers would likely linger near the cavern's entrance.

---

Find and speak to a Ry`Gorr messenger 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_This NPC is a roamer near the zone-in._
You say, 'Hail, a Ry`Gorr messenger'
a Ry`Gorr messenger seems amused by your greeting, 'You must be brave or stupid to stop and chat with an orc. What is it that you want?'
You say, 'We want peace' _("truce" also works)_
a Ry`Gorr messenger senses an enemy nearby and readies for battle!
_It attacks (standard trash mob)._
Kill the Ry`Gorr messenger 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ While attempting to negotiate a truce, you were attacked! Kill the hostile Ry`Gorr messenger.
Loot a Folded Note 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ The dead orc appears to be collecting a note of some sort.

---

Take the note to Captain Dunstan Coldheart 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
Captain Dunstan unfolds the note and begins to read.
Speak to Captain Dunstan Coldheart 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
You say, 'Hail, Captain Dunstan Coldheart'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart carefully refolds the note as he begins to speak, 'A secret meeting has been called between the note's author and clan Ry`Gorr. It would appear that the two have struck some sort of a bargain, but the terms and conditions have changed. If the orcs won't tell us what they're up to, then I suppose we may have to find out for ourselves. According to the note, the rendezvous will take place tonight in the East Wastes, near the cavern's secret exit.'

---

Head to the rendezvous location mentioned in the note 0/1 (Zeixshi-Karâ€™s Awakening)
_This is a /location update at about -3400, 1010, 148 in Zeixshi-Karâ€™s Awakening (outside the Ry'Gorr fort)._
Speak to Emissary Kordim 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ The area is empty, except for a frost giant Emissary.
_The Emissary ( map) is found outside the entrance of the Ry'Gorr fort. Note that speaking with him triggers the spawn of two additional mobs._
_Note: If doing this task as a group, you can have one person hail him, fade their aggro, have the next hail him, fade their aggro, etc. - until the last person hails him. Then, when you kill him, the whole group gets credit for the kill (otherwise you'll need to repeat for each person who needs it)._
You say, 'Hail, Emissary Kordim'
Emissary Kordim looks upon you with disgust, 'What is the meaning of this? The note said we would be meeting with coldain who holds the shard. Do they insult us by sending a \_\_\_\_\_ to do their bidding instead? We agreed upon a price. We have paid it. The frost giants do not wish to renegotiate. Now you will either hand over the shard, or pay with your life! Guards!
Defeat Emissary Kordim 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ The frost giants appear to think you owe them a shard, and are determined to kill you to retrieve it!
_Emissary Kordim attacks (hits for a max ~11,000), along with 2x "a frost giant scout" (hit for a max ~10,000)._

---

Inform Captain Dunstan Coldheart of the frost giant ambush 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Return to Captain Dunstan and report the recent showdown with the frost giants.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Dunstan Coldheart'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart listens to you recount the events that unfolded in the East Wastes. 'So the frost giants received a summons as well? It seems whoever wrote those notes hoped to pit the giants and orcs against each other. A mysterious shard, sold to both the Ry`Gorr and frost giants, but given to neither. A clever set up, indeed. What concerns me the most is the claim that the entire scheme was set up by one of my own. If a resident of Froststone is behind this, they will pay with their life. If I begin asking questions, it'll surely spark suspicion and spook whoever is behind this. I must beg your help again, and ask that you question Froststone residents until some answers can be found.'
Question dwarves within Froststone until the traitor is revealed 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Captain Dunstan would like you to speak to any and all Froststone residents until the traitorous author of the note can be found.
_Hail the Coldain in Froststone until you get the update. The NPC of note is Nadalia Coldmist ( map \- zone map) at /location -95, 265, -383 -- the northwestern part of the city on an upper level, but these are some of the responses you will see from other residents upon hailing them:_
Dirk Coldsmith nods knowingly, 'Questions about shards, strange new crystals being mined by the Ry`Gorr... it doesn't take an erudite to connect the dots here. Froststone had best prepare for the worst.'
Kramble Gemshard scans a list of recent deposits before answering, 'I keep accurate records of every item placed in this bank, and there's no indication of any suspicious transactions. If someone wished to store a mysterious shard here, I would know it.'
Scout Grandan says 'I report directly to Captain Dunstan. Any questions you have should be addressed to him. Good day.'
Tacy MistHeart peers at you curiously, 'I have no knowledge of notes, orcs, or giants. Does this have anything to do with the recent infestation of fear creatures?'
Engineer Colle flashes an uneasy smile while keeping his eyes nervously glued to the floor, 'Hello, \_\_\_\_\_. No time to chat, I'm afraid. Always work to be done.'
_And Nadalia:_
You say, 'Hail, Nadalia Coldmist'
Nadalia Coldmist struggles with silent contemplation before finally speaking, 'I don't like being the one to incriminate a good friend, but I worry for Danela's safety. She came to me some time ago, looking for a place to store a chest for safekeeping. She wouldn't tell me what was within the chest or how she acquired it, but insisted I keep its [location] a secret.
You say, 'What location?'
Nadalia Coldmist says 'I agreed to help without question, since Danela has been a friend of mine for some time. I hid the chest in a small storage area beneath the stone floor in my room. That night I hardly slept, as my rest was plagued by vivid nightmares filled with horrid creatures. As the days went on, the [nightmares] intensified and began to blur the lines of reality. At times it became hard to tell whether I was awake or sleeping, or if the tentacle terror that appeared next to me was really there at all.'
You say, 'Nightmares?'
Nadalia Coldmist continues, 'By the time Danela returned, I was a complete hermit, bound to my room by paralyzing fear. She appeared to have no concern for my condition; her sole focus was on retrieving the [chest]. She seemed obsessed with its contents, saying it would bring her much wealth and power. That was the last time I saw my dear friend Danela.'
You say, 'What chest?'
Nadalia Coldmist says 'It wasn't long after she retrieved the chest that my nightmares began to subside. Within a few weeks the waking terrors had completely vanished. Months went by without incident. I secretly worried for Danela, but I couldn't come forward with my concerns. She made me swear to keep her secret. It wasn't until recently, when creatures tainted by fear began appearing, that I truly knew something horrible must have [happened].'
You say, 'What happened?'
Nadalia Coldmist says 'For some time I thought my nightmares had returned, but then others began noticing these creatures too; tentacle terrors and spinechiller spiders, lurking throughout the caverns. I knew Danela must have been involved, but I refused to admit it.' The remorseful coldain weeps for her friend, 'Now I fear it is too late.'

---

Tell Captain Dunstan Coldheart what you have learned 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Nadalia has confessed that her friend Danela might be the traitor. This is information Captain Dunstan would like to know.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Dunstan Coldheart'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart lets out a long sigh, 'So it is true. Our own Danela is to blame. This shard she has acquired sounds dangerous, and is likely the cause of the recent arrival of spinechillers and terrors. Danela must be brought in for questioning, and the shard needs to be located and destroyed before things get worse. Her room is on the second floor, in the north western portion of Froststone.'
Head to Danela's living quarters where you can then apprehend her 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Captain Dunstan has asked you to search Danela's quarters in the northwestern area of Froststone.
_Her living quarters ( map \- full zone map) are found at /location -175, 340, -383 (in a room to Nadalia's southwest). This triggers the spawn of two mobs._
The room is empty with no sign of Danela or the crystal shard. Heavy footsteps can be heard coming closer from across the hall.
Defeat the henchmen 0/2 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Henchmen were waiting for you in Danela's room.
_2x "a henchman" spawn and attack. They hit for a max ~13,000 and are stunnable and rootable._

---

Report your findings to Captain Dunstan Coldheart 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Captain Dunstan would appreciate a full report of what happened while searching Danela's room.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Dunstan Coldheart'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart listens carefully to your report before speaking, 'So Danela has already fled and the shard was nowhere to be found? The longer that crystal remains in our caverns, the more exposed we become to the fear that it seems to emanate. We need to locate the shard and destroy it, before it contaminates our minds as it has already done to Danela.'
At Captain Dunstan's request, you identified the traitor among the coldain, but were unable to retrieve the mysterious shard.
_Rewards:_
150 platinum
Experience (2 AAs + 1-2% exp in Level 96)

_This is the third task in a series of three. It is a solo task that begins with Captain Dunstan Coldheart ( map \- full zone map) in the Crystal Caverns (located in a room in the center of the Coldain city, Froststone at -255, 230, -400)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "An Abundance of Orcs"
\- Completed "Ry`Gorr Reconnaissance"
You say, 'Hail, Captain Dunstan Coldheart'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'This shard that Danela is hoarding appears to be releasing fear into the atmosphere, transforming the creatures that dwell here into something more monstrous. The effect it appears to have on sentient beings is alarming as well. We must [find] the fear shard before we all fall victim to its corruption. Or have you come to me for [other reasons]?'
You say, 'Let's find it'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'Danela could have hidden the shard anywhere. The caverns are vast, and we simply don't have enough time to canvas every nook and crevice searching for something we've never even seen. The one thing we know is that this crystal shard is emitting powerful fear that is able to penetrate the minds and bodies of all it comes into contact with. This sort of disturbance doesn't go unnoticed, but we need to find a way to better [detect] it.'
You say, 'How do we detect it?'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'Froststone is home to an [engineer] who has created many innovative gadgets over the years. He is a bit awkward and withdrawn, but I believe his imagination and craftsmanship are what will help us find this fear shard.'
You say, 'Who is the engineer?'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'His name is Colle. He keeps himself secluded on the upper floor of Froststone. Speak with him and explain the situation. Hopefully he'll be able to craft something to help us locate the shard.'
You have been assigned the task 'Finding the Fear '.
Captain Dunstan has asked you to aid Engineer Colle in creating an item that can locate the fear shard.
The reclusive inventor named Colle should be able to create an item capable of locating the fear shard. He's known to linger on the second floor of Froststone.

---

Speak to Engineer Colle 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Engineer Colle ( map \- full zone map) is found on the second level of Froststone._
You say, 'Hail, Engineer Colle'
Engineer Colle focuses on the floor as you recount the details surrounding the hidden fear shard. The reclusive coldain inventor thinks for few moments before an enlightened smile spreads across his face. 'Oh, this is a clever idea, indeed!' Clearly pleased with himself, Engineer Cole decides to share some details with you. 'Since the hidden shard seems to radiate fear, I will craft a compass whose needle will point you to large clusters of fear. I still have some details to work out, but I have a list of items that I'll require.'

---

Collect Flawless Terrorite from tentacle terrors 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
Collect Velium Sheet Metal from Ry`Gorr orcs 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
Collect a Spinechiller Fang from a spinechiller spider 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Colle has asked you to collect various items he'll need to craft his compass.
_The above updates occur randomly from kills (no item looting involved)._

---

Return to Engineer Colle 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that you have everything Colle has requested, return to the engineer and see if he can craft the compass.
You say, 'Hail, Engineer Colle'
Engineer Colle takes the requested items for you and begins to assemble the gadget with dexterous coordination. In a matter of moments, the dwarf has the compass complete and places it in your hands. 'It's a rather ingenious device, if I do say so myself. It's powered by small amounts of fear essence found within creatures, and when charged, the needle will point to large concentrations of fear. Good luck!'
_You receive a "Dreadstone Compass"._

---

Kill fear-tainted creatures to power the Dreadstone Compass 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ In order to power the compass, you'll need to kill tentacle terrors and spinechillers.
_Kill tentacle terrors and spinechiller spiders to progress this step. This will take 5-7 kills. You will see emotes as you kill the mobs:_
The compass needle moves slightly as the essence of fear is harnessed.
The Dreadstone Compass is fully charged and ready for use.

---

Use the Dreadstone Compass to locate where the fear shard is being kept 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ The compass should point in the direction of concentrated fear.
_Right-click the compass to generate a path which will lead you to a random area. Once you get to the area, a named spawns._
Defeat a crystal glare lord 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ An evil eye has appeared through a crack in the cavern wall. Kill it before it kills you!
A crack opens up in the wall, revealing a new area within the caverns.
_The glare lord fight is on par with standard trash mobs._

---

Report back to Captain Dunstan Coldheart 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Dunstan is expecting a full report.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Dunstan Coldheart'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart appears relieved to see you. 'My guards reported a cave in fairly close to Froststone, exposing a hidden portion of the caverns. I hadn't heard from you and began to wonder if you had fallen victim to the icy rubble. At least we know where the shard is located. I've sent a team of scouts ahead to investigate the newly exposed area within the caverns. Thank you for risking your life for Froststone. I speak on the behalf of all coldain when I express our gratitude.'
You found the location of the fear shard within Crystal Caverns, but were unable to retrieve it.
_Rewards:_
225 platinum
Experience (3 AAs + 2-3% exp in Level 96)

_This is a group mission that begins with Captain Dunstan Coldheart ( map \- full zone map) in the Crystal Caverns (located in a room in the center of the Coldain city, Froststone at -255, 230, -400)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "An Abundance of Orcs"
\- Completed "Ry`Gorr Reconnaissance"
\- Completed "Finding the Fear"
You say, 'Hail, Captain Dunstan Coldheart'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'My scouts have returned and given me their full report on the situation. It appears as though the newly discovered areas within the caverns are crawling with fear-tainted creatures and large crystal [formations]. Or have you come to me for [other reasons]?'
You say, 'What formations?'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'We believe the shard Danela has hidden is responsible for the changes throughout the caverns, including the smaller crystal deposits that the Ry`Gorr have been mining. Still, there have been no sightings of the fear crystal, or of Danela. My scouts continue to search the caverns, but are unable to get past the barrier of powerful [creatures] and crystals.'
You say, 'Creatures?'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'A few of my scouts have fallen victim to these creatures, often meeting their demise after one blow. It seems that the closer the proximity to the central pit, the stronger the creature. I have assembled a group of [experts] who are working on ways to help defend against the fear-tainted forces.'
You say, 'Experts?'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'Leading up the group is my top advisor, Niva Coldmist. Alchemist Davlin is a master of concoctions that can cure or kill. He's been working on a protection potion to help our troops survive in battle against our fear-tainted foes. Dodrik Iceblade is an innovative smithy who can craft durable armor from almost any material. I'm confident I've gathered the best and brightest to aid in the recovery of the fear shard, but my group of experts will not be complete until you and your allies [join]. Your combined knowledge and skill will be the key to our success.'
You say, 'We will join'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'Are you sure? This is a lot to take on. You and your friends will be facing creatures strengthened by fear; creatures who have taken out many of my scouts with one swipe. Heed my warning, do not go anywhere near the central pit without the proper armor and magical protection. The creatures within will tear you and your friends to bits. If these are risks you're willing to take, then I will send you to the caverns of fear when you're [ready].'
You have been assigned the task 'Into the Caverns of Fear'.
Captain Dunstan has asked you to join his group of experts in the Caverns of Fear, in hopes of finding the missing fear shard.
Speak with each of the Coldain at the small camp within the caverns to see how you can help.
You say, 'Ready!'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'Good luck. Once you've arrived, speak to Niva for a quick debriefing.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Caverns of Fear.

---

1\. Speak with Alchemist Davlin 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
2\. Speak with Dodrik Iceblade 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
3\. Speak with Niva Coldmist 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Hail each of the Coldain._
Alchemist Davlin says 'I've been expecting you, \_\_\_\_\_. Captain Dunstan informed me that a group of adventurers were willing to test out my protection elixirs. Don't look so worried; my latest trials have had very few side effects. Now, before I can continue, I'll need some spore samples from the corrupted sporali that dwell within this cavern.'
Dodrik Iceblade says 'Well met, \_\_\_\_\_. Froststone's finest smithy, at your service.' The blacksmith looks your group up and down while shaking his head, 'Your armor won't hold up against the fear-tainted critters crawling in the central pit. I can craft some sturdy armor for you and your crew, but I'll need a few large chunks of flawless dreadstone before I can begin.'
Niva Coldmist gives you a crisp salute, 'Hello \_\_\_\_\_ and friends. The name's Niva and I'm in charge of operations down here. You look like an apt bunch, so I'll debrief you as quickly as possible. We believe the main fear shard is being held in the central pit within these caverns. Unfortunately, all entrances are blocked off by large crystals. We've been trying to blast through, but our explosives aren't strong enough. I hope to enhance them with a fiery substance found on wraiths within this cavern. Your first order is to retrieve a sample and return it to me.

---

4\. Obtain Fear Spores from corrupted sporali 0/2 (Crystal Caverns)
5\. Deliver the Fear Spores to Alchemist Davlin 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
6\. Obtain Flawless Dreadstones from tainted orcs 0/6 (Crystal Caverns)
7\. Deliver the Flawless Dreadstones to Dodrik Iceblade 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
8\. Obtain Glowing Embers from a fiery wraith 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
9\. Deliver the Glowing Embers to Niva Coldmist 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
> _Task Window Says:_ Davlin needs fear spores to create a protection poison. Dodrik needs dreadstone to craft special armor for you and your allies. Niva needs glowing embers in order to make explosives capable of blasting through the large, purple crystals.
_These mobs are found in the caverns leading to and around the Ry`Gorr pit._
Davlin takes the spores and sprinkles them into a frothy mixture.
Niva handles the glowing embers with care.
Dodrik begins to work immediately, heating and hammering the dreadstone.

---

10\. Acquire an Elixir of Protection from Alchemist Davlin 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
You say, 'Hail, Alchemist Davlin'
Alchemist Davlin hands you a small glass bottle that contains a thick, purple liquid. 'Everyone who plans to enter the central pit needs to protect themselves by drinking this elixir, but only do so when you're ready for battle, as the effects may not last very long and will only work against the creatures in the central pit.'
_You receive an Elixir of Protection. (Everyone should hail Davlin at this point, to receive this item.)_
11\. Acquire Dreadstone Armor from Dodrik Iceblade 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
You say, 'Hail, Dodrik Iceblade'
Dodrik Iceblade hands you a surprisingly lightweight breastplate made of dark metal. 'I've crafted enough armor to outfit your entire party, so no excuses for entering the central pit unprepared. Keep in mind, I made this armor to defend against the monstrosities in the central pit. It may not work so well when fighting other creatures.'
_You receive Dreadstone Armor. (Everyone should hail Dodrik at this point, to receive this item.)_
12\. Use the Elixir of Protection 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
13\. Use the Dreadstone Armor 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_NOTE: The task locks upon using these items. Right-click the above two items to put two buffs on you (everyone in the group needs to do this)._
14\. Speak to Niva Coldmist once your group is properly protected 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
You say, 'Hail, Niva Coldmist'
Niva Coldmist carefully hands you a small bundle of explosives. 'These small sticks pack a huge punch. Hopefully, the blast will be big enough to break through the large crystal formations and allow passage into the central pit. I cannot stress enough how important it is for your party to be protected by Davlin's elixir and Dodrik's armor before entering.
_You receive a Bundle of Explosives._

---

15\. Use the Bundle of Explosives to destroy a large crystal formation 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Right-click the Bundle of Explosives at the large crystal formation (entrance of the pit)._
16\. Defeat the fear-tainted creatures within the pit 0/6 (Crystal Caverns)

_This is a group mission that begins with Captain Dunstan Coldheart ( map \- full zone map) in the Crystal Caverns (located in a room in the center of the Coldain city, Froststone at -255, 230, -400)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "An Abundance of Orcs"
\- Completed "Ry`Gorr Reconnaissance"
\- Completed "Finding the Fear"
\- Completed "Into the Caverns of Fear" (mission)
You say, 'Hail, Captain Dunstan Coldheart'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart does his best to hide the concern in his voice when speaking, 'Niva told me of your actions within the caverns. You can't blame yourself for Danela's escape. At least now we know where she's been holing up, and with the inner caverns cleared, we'll have firm fighting grounds for when we [lure] Danela from hiding. Or are you here for [other reasons]?'
You say, 'How do we lure her?'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'The central pit may not look large, but it is a sizable space filled with many tunnels that wind their way to the top of the caverns. Danela could be hiding anywhere. Niva Coldmist is working on a way to force Danela to come out and face us. She's asked specifically for your help in orchestrating the traitor's defeat. It will likely take a [raid] force to take the traitor down, but I will not turn away your [group] if you're willing to aid the coldain.'
You say, 'My group will handle her'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'Let me know when you are [prepared] to leave and I'll lead you back to the caverns of fear where Niva can inform you of our plans.'
You have been assigned the task 'Danela's Stand'.
Captain Dunstan has asked you to work with the Coldain forces to defeat Danela and recover the fear shard. Niva Coldmist should be able to provide further instruction.
You say, 'I am prepared!'
Captain Dunstan Coldheart says 'Good luck. The fate of Froststone rests in your hands.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Caverns of Fear.

---

**Task Steps**
Speak to Niva Coldmist 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
Make your way to the pit 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Niva caused an explosion that should force Danela from hiding. Head to the central pit where she is expected to be.
Engage Danela and witness her transformation 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Obtain visual confirmation that Danela has submitted herself to the power of fear.
_NOTE: The task locks once Danela reaches this transformation at 70% health._
Drop a boulder on Danela while she's in terror form 0/2 (Crystal Caverns)
Defeat Ry`Gorr orcs 0/8 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Might and magic won't be good enough to tear Danela from her terror form. Find a way to drop boulders from the ceiling onto her head, breaking the traitor's concentration. The Ry`Gorr miners might have explosives good for blasting boulders.
Defeat Danela 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Defeat Danela while she is too weak to channel her terror form!
Claim your reward from Danela's Lockbox 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Task Window Says:_ Danela's Lockbox contains your reward.

---

**The Event**
_Speak with Niva Coldmist to spawn Danela Icewind in the pit._
You say, 'Hail, Niva Coldmist'
Niva Coldmist nods in silent greeting, 'You've arrived just in time. We're nearly finished with our [preparations].'
You say, 'What preparations?'
Niva Coldmist says 'The scouts have been collecting supplies to help build more explosives. We should have enough blasting power to cause the cavern walls to come crumbling down. Danela will either become trapped in the tunnels, or forced out into the open to face us. Either way, the traitor will die. When you're [ready] I'll light the fuse.'
You say, 'Ready!'
Niva Coldmist covers her ears while shouting, 'Brace yourselves! This is going to be one powerful blast!'
_Make your way to the pit and engage Danela Icewind. She hits for a max (???). She casts "Instilled Fear" on random targets (1-tick blind) and casts "Terrorize" every 35 seconds._
Instilled Fear: Single Target, Magic (-940)
1: Decrease HP when cast by 33000
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 15000 per tick
3: Blindness (1)
Terrorize: Targeted AE 15', Magic (-940)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 38000
2: 20% Chance to trigger: Crystalized
_She may also cast "Falling Rock" upon her transformation:_
Falling Rock: PB AE 1000', Unresistable (-950)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 34000
_DPS Danela to 70%, at which point she turns into a tentacle terror and goes inactive. This updates the first step here and opens up the next two steps which you will complete as you progress the event._
The ceiling begins to crumble the heavy footsteps of orcs can be heard within the tunnels.
_When Danela goes inactive at 70%, 3-4 Ry`Gorr miners spawn in the area above the pit. They are non-aggro, but spawn explosive barrels on random players (these tick down a "fuse" emote which you can move out of range from):_
A Ry`Gorr miner throws a barrel of dynamite at \_\_\_\_\_.
Explosion: PB AE 15', Unresistable (-940)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 38000
_Also when Danela goes inactive, several objects called "a boulder" spawn on the ceiling high above the pit. When you kill a Ry`Gorr miner, it spawns a ground spawn in place of its corpse. Pick up the ground spawn (an explosive), target one of the boulders, and right-click the explosive (you'll need a few clicks per boulder) to drop them on Danela. This updates the "Drop a boulder..." step._
_Note: For a visual as to how what the boulders look like on the ceiling, see this image (this is the raid version, so there may be fewer boulders spawned, but this is what they look like -- they are the spherical objects)._
_After she's been hit with a few boulders, Danela goes aggro. Take her to 30% at which point she goes inactive again. You'll then need to kill 3-4 more miners and complete the boulder process again. After you've finished it a second time, she goes aggro again, and you can kill her._
Danela Icewind has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Danela Icewind's corpse hits the cold cavern floor with ground-shaking force.

You say, 'Hail, Veldmir Velweaver'
Veldmir Velweaver says 'Hello \_\_\_\_\_. Please excuse the mess.' The dwarf gestures to the many [corpses] at his feet, 'Had I known I was going to have visitors, I might have cleaned the place up a bit.'
You say, 'What corpses?'

You say, 'Research?'
Veldmir Velweaver smirks, 'Oh don't be coy! You've been here long enough to notice changes in the native population. Spiders, tentacles, and even a few coldain have been touched by fear! Captain Dunstan is doing his part to figure out the cause, and I'm doing my part to figure out a [cure].'
You say, 'What cure?'
Veldmir Velweaver nods fervently, 'Something needs to be done to reverse the effects, or we'll all lose our minds to fear. That is not a scenario any of us want to witness. I've been conducting experiments in an attempt to isolate the fear and remove it, but it is very difficult obtaining test subjects. The creatures within the caverns are all so hostile. It's almost impossible to collect a [living sample] for my studies.'
You say, 'A living sample?'
Veldmir Velweaver says 'I need a control subject, a creature that has not been tainted. I will also need a subject that is already contaminated with the essence of fear. All must be docile and living, which will prove to be difficult without [Tranquilizer Darts].'
You have been assigned the task 'Subdued Subjects'.
Veldmir Velweaver is trying to create a cure for the fear that is plaguing Crystal Caverns, but to do so, he needs living test subjects.
You'll need tranquilizer darts to subdue the test subjects. Derron Coldmist should be willing to craft them.
You say, 'What about the tranquilizer darts?'
Veldmir Velweaver says 'Do you not have any Tranquilizer Darts yet?' The coldain scientist sighs, 'Well then, I suggest you speak to Derron Coldmist. I know he's very busy, but I'm sure if you collect the raw materials he'll be willing to make you some. You'll then use the darts to subdue the test subjects and lure them back to me.'

---

Speak with Derron Coldmist 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Derron Coldmist ( map \- full zone map) is found in the southern part of Frostone (upper level) at /location -315, 200, -383._
You say, 'Hail, Derron Coldmist'
Derron Coldmist nods as you make your request for tranquilizer darts, 'I can make those, but I'll need a few things first. Bring me an icy tentacle and a crystal venom sac and I will craft your darts.'
Retrieve an icy tentacle 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
Retrieve a crystal venom sac 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
Return to Derron Coldmist 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
Use the darts to subdue a Ry`Gorr watchman and lure it to Veldmir Velweaver 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Right-click the dart on a Ry`Gorr watchman. It will become your pet. Lead it back to Veldmir. (Note: You can't invis or fade or you lose the pet.)_
Use the darts to subdue a spinechiller spider and lure it to Veldmir Velweaver 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Right-click the dart on a spinechiller spider. It will become your pet. Lead it back to Veldmir. (Note: You can't invis or fade or you lose the pet.)_
Speak to Veldmir Velweaver 0/1 (Crystal Caverns)
_Rewards:_
150 platinum
Experience (2 AAs)

This is the first task in a series of three. It is a solo task that begins with Captain Bvellos [npc=41305] ( map) in the bank of Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness. He is found inside the bank at /location -300, 1420, -195 (the bank is in the center of the city).
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Must have at least indifferent faction with Dragon Death Keep (kill frost giants and/or apparitions to increase it)
You say, 'Hail, Captain Bvellos'
Captain Bvellos says 'Halt! As a captain commissioned by the authority of King Tormax, I ought to remove you from the city immediately, or kill you where you stand. You have heard his orders have you not? All mercenaries have henceforth been barred from entering Kael Drakkel. But we both know decrees pronounced in citadels are rarely heard or regarded in alleyways. I have seen your kind skulking in dark corners -- I have [seen] many things as of late.'
You say, 'What have you seen?'
Captain Bvellos says 'Mercenaries coming and going, couriers rushing about, concealing heavy bundles. Strange apparitions appearing -- just last night I stabbed my father through the heart as he tried to tear off my skin with his teeth. And he has been dead for twenty years. No sooner had I plunged my dagger into him than he disappeared into the night like a mist. Nothing has seemed real since we received these new [weapons] from Tormax's court.'
You say, 'What weapons?'
Captain Bvellos says 'These blades, glowing with power -- surely they have some connection with the madness that has gripped the king and suffused the city. Shortly after the kromzek received these new weapons, King Tormax made his mad decrees. Mercenaries were expelled from the city, living visions began to haunt the citizenry, coldain and dragons made incursions into the city, and the kromzek were ordered to regard the kromrif with suspicion, watching them for evidence of their hand in the strange events. Now I have seen [couriers] rushing throughout the city. Wherever they stop, more apparitions and unrest appear.'
You say, 'Couriers?'
Captain Bvellos says 'I have my suspicions about who they are working for, but I need proof. I cannot easily raise my hand against them lest it draw outrage from the king. As much as I dislike it, I need mercenaries such as you. If you are [willing], waylay any couriers you see, and bring what they are carrying. If I can trace the origin of these new weapons, perhaps I can put an end to the madness that has descended upon Kael.'
You say, 'I am willing'
Captain Bvellos says 'Hurry. I do not want to meet my father again in this life.'
You have been assigned the task 'Deliver Us Unto Evil'.
Captain Bvellos believes the new weapons given to the giants of Kael are somehow the cause of the chaos in the city. He has asked you to track down the source of the weapons.
Kill the couriers wandering throughout Kael and find any evidence they are carrying.

---

1\. Steal the goods that the couriers in Kael are carrying 0/4 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
Loot 4 Fearforged Daggers [item=106625] from a courier [npc=41662] that wanders the zone (note: the couriers do not have faction hits).
2\. Find evidence on the couriers that reveals their distribution source 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
Kill another courier and loot a Note From Svekk [item=106632].
3\. Deliver the stolen weapons to Captain Bvellos 0/4 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
Captain Bvellos says 'These are the weapons you recovered from the couriers? Then it is as I thought. The weapons are still being distributed throughout the city. If you have any further evidence of who commands the couriers, let me see it.'
4\. Show Captain Bvellos the note from Svekk 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
Captain Bvellos says 'Svekk Fangbinder, Wenglawks's lackey -- I should have guessed. Did you read this note? Apparently Svekk has been hiring mercenaries to smuggle materials into Kael, which are then used to forge the new weapons. Being a mercenary yourself, perhaps you could offer your services to Svekk. Convince him to send you on a smuggling run. Discover where the materials are coming from, and where they are delivered. Once I know, I can move against Svekk. Kael will yet be returned to its equilibrium!'

---

5\. Ask Svekk Fangbinder if you can work for him 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ According to the note you found on a courier, Svekk Fangbinder has been coordinating shipments of material entering the city and the forging of weapons. Captain Bvellos suggests you offer your services to Svekk as a smuggler, so you can discover more about the operation.
Svekk Fangbinder [npc=41961] ( map) is at /location 155, 1950, -191 (in a building in the northwestern part of the city's center - this is northwest of the bank).
You say, 'Hail, Svekk Fangbinder'
Svekk Fangbinder says 'What? You wish to deliver goods for me? It's certainly bold of you to stride around Kael in daylight when the king's threat hangs over your head. I can use someone like you. I want you to have a talk with my contact in the Eastern Wastes, Drjek. He has a delivery that needs to enter Kael unnoticed.'
6\. Tell Drjek that Svekk has sent you 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
_Task Window Says:_ You have been hired as a smuggler, working for Svekk Fangbinder. Drjek in Eastern Wastes has a shipment for you to pick up.
Drjek [npc=41570] ( map) is found in the northwestern part of Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening at around -4380, 4045, 143 (about halfway between Kael and the giant fort).
You say, 'Hail, Drjek'
Drjek says 'Delivery? I do not have time to worry about such things with these greedy coldain marauders attacking our operation. Take care of them, and then we can talk!'
7\. Kill 3 coldain marauders 0/3 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
_Task Window Says:_ Coldain marauders are attacking Drjek's outpost. You must defeat them before you can pick up the shipment.
Kill the Coldain marauders fighting the orcs next to Drjek.
8\. Hail Drjek and receive the shipment 0/1 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that it is safe, tell Drjek you are ready to transport the shipment.
You say, 'Hail, Drjek'
Drjek says 'Well, you look a whit healthier than the last whelps Svekk sent me, and you did handle those coldain admirably. This is the largest sliver of crystal I have yet acquired. Deliver it to Wevek Redforge -- he is waiting for it to forge another set of weapons for the kromzek. Oh, and if you see any of my other delivery agents on your way, go ahead and kill them. Finish their deliveries for them. I know they are stealing from us! I think you are the only one I can trust! But If I find out otherwise...I might have to deliver everything myself.'
You receive Large Sliver of Fear [item=106915].

---

9\. (Optional) Steal small slivers of crystal from untrustworthy smugglers 0/4 (Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening)
10\. (Optional) Deliver the small slivers of crystal to Captain Bvellos 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
11\. Head to Wevek Redforge and confront anything that impedes your progress 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
12\. Kill 2 hostile apparitions 0/2 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ Drjek has told you to deliver a large crystal sliver to Wevek Redforge. Drjek also said he doesn't trust most of his smugglers. If you see any, kill them and deliver their goods to Captain Bvellos for examination. The large crystal you are carrying has the potential to generate nightmarish creatures. If this happens, kill the creatures.
For the optional steps, smugglers [npc=41549] can be found in the canyon leading to Kael Drakkel. Kill them until you have looted 4x Small Sliver of Fear [item=108829], then give those items to Bvellos.
Note that the two hostile apparitions [npc=42111] will spawn on you at a random time after you re-enter Kael. You can just stay at the zone-in area and await their spawn or chance making your way through the city. They each hit for a max ~13,000; AE rampage; cast "Crippling Contusion"; and have about 2.7 million hitpoints each. They are known to be rootable and mezzable, and they do not summon.
Crippling Contusion: Targeted AE 25', Magic (-940)
1: Decrease HP when cast by 27000
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 8000 per tick _(3 ticks)_
3: Decrease Attack Speed by 50%
4: Increase Curse Counter by 25
Wevek Redforge [npc=42091] ( map) is found at location 250, 850, -130. If coming from the Eastern Wastes, pass through the first archway, keep going, pass through the second archway, and hang an immediate right (north). He is in a building in the northeastern part of this area.
Upon turning in the optional element:
Captain Bvellos says 'So this is what the mercenaries have been sneaking into Kael? By the power of Zek, what malevolence emanates from these crystals? I feel the world growing smaller and darker just holding one in my hand. If blades are being forged with this material, it is no surprise why insanity has descended upon Kael.'
The other steps update upon the deaths of the hostile apparitions.

---

13\. Deliver the large crystal sliver to Wevek Redforge 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
14\. Ask Wevek Redforge what he knows about the crystal deliveries 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
You say, 'Hail, Wevek Redforge'
Wevek Redforge says 'Are you feeling alright? You look pale. Most mercenaries who bring me supplies arrive looking nervous and haggard. You are no exception. ' As Wevek takes the large crystal sliver from you, his gloved hands tremble, and his eyes reflect the purple light of the crystal. 'I hate these things. How much strife has rung throughout this city with every blow of my hammer against the anvil? But I cannot stop forging the weapons that will bring ruin upon my brethren. They will not let me...'
Wevek Redforge says 'No, do not make me say who it is that compels my work!'
Drjek says 'Silence, Wevek! Not another word to these pack mules! Do you want Wenglawks to hear that your mouth has been more active than your hammer?' Drjek glowers at you. 'It looks like you did your job, but remember my words: Do what you are told and do not ask questions, unless you want to end your days in a block of ice.'
Wevek Redforge says 'Apologies, Drjek. My hammering will be the only sound you hear from me.'
15\. Tell Bvellos what you learned from Svekk Fangbinder 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ Drjek threatened Wevek Redforge, and in the process revealed that Wenglawks Kkeak is involved in creating the malevolent weapons. Inform Captain Bvellos of what you have learned.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Bvellos'
Captain Bvellos says 'Wenglawks has been coordinating the shipments of crystal and the forging of weapons? I have suspected he might be involved, but now I have proof. His treachery will not escape punishment much longer! You must relay this information to Rejnak Coldspear, Fjokar Frozenshard's retainer. He has been investigating some additional leads, and your discoveries will undoubtedly assist him. Perhaps soon I will be able to sleep without my sword at my side.'
You have discovered Wenglawks Kkeak has been coordinating deliveries of crystal shards and the forging of weapons. Speak with Fjokar Frozenshard's retainer, Rejnak Coldspear, and see if this information will aid his investigation.
_Rewards:_
225 platinum
Experience (3 AAs + 2-3% exp in Level 96)

This is the third task in a series of three. It is a solo task that begins with Noble Helssen [npc=41307] ( map) in Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness. He is located en route to the throne room of Kael Drakkel (southern part of the zone).
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed Deliver Us Unto Evil [quest=6059]
\- Completed Them Bones [quest=6060]
\- Must have at least indifferent faction with Dragon Death Keep (kill frost giants and/or apparitions to increase it)
You say, 'Hail, Noble Helssen'
Noble Helssen says 'You are the one who helped Fjokar and Rejnak with their investigation? You have done Kael a great service! Thanks to you we now know the nature of the threat and those responsible for it. If King Tormax were in his right mind, he would no doubt praise your deeds. The damage has already been done, though. The [weapons] spread by the Iceshards have crippled the mind of the city, and those who possess the weapons, although the blades cause harm, cling to them as though the glowing steel is the only thing fending off swift death.'
You say, 'Weapons?'
Noble Helssen says 'According to the information you have provided me, the only way to rid the city of our collective hallucinations is to destroy anything that has been tainted by those purple [crystals]. This will not be an [easy] task.'
You say, 'Crystals?'
Noble Helssen says 'Reports from my regiments in the Eastern Wastes saw the sky split open. The clouds parted, and a streak of purple fire stabbed into the ice like a bar of molten iron boiling a blacksmith's water trough. Not long after, I lost contact with most of my regiments. Word I did receive spoke of crystal shards from the impact site affecting creatures in strange ways. Some of my troops were seen carrying and coveting these objects, and attempts to reason with them and bring them back to Kael were met with violence. '
You say, 'Easy?'
Noble Helssen says 'The blades have already been distributed throughout the city, to young and old alike. Unless we can manage to pry the weapons from the fingers of every giant in Kael, this madness will not end. And we still must convince King Tormax to [relinquish] the crystalline axe he has been carrying. It has amplified his delusions, and the threat to the city will remain as long as its king dwells under the shadow of madness.'
You say, 'Relinquish?'
Noble Helssen says 'I wonder if there is not another way to take possession of the crystal weapons than through violence. If that were the only way, then we would end up killing half this city. No, we must somehow knock the weapons from their hands. A powerful spell might be what we [need].'
You say, 'Need?'
Noble Helssen says 'Would you be [willing] to speak with Drenlo Helmright, a priest of Zek? He has knowledge of arcane words of war, and he might know of a technique to strip an opponent's weapon without harm.'
You say, 'I am willing.'
Noble Helssen says 'Thank you. Together we can rid the city of the blight the Iceshards have brought upon it. King Tormax's mind will once again be his own!'
You have been assigned the task 'A Cure for Madness'.
The weapons carried by the Kromzek and King Tormax are causing hallucinations and madness to spread throughout Kael. Noble Helssen has asked you to find a way to take the weapons and destroy them.
Drenlo Helmright, a priest of Zek, might have an idea of how you can obtain the weapons possessed by the Kromzek.

---

1\. Speak with Drenlo Helmright 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
Drenlo Helmright [npc=41756] ( map) is located at 1160, 1130, -44 (north of the arena in the Gkrean Prophet of Tallon's room). He's on Find (Ctrl+F).
You say, 'Hail, Drenlo Helmright'
Drenlo Helmright says 'Magic, did you say? We have no magic to disarm an opponent. We are warriors of Zek; we defeat an enemy in face-to-face combat! Noble Helssen must be desperate for a remedy to Kael's illness if he thinks I could speak a word and force every giant to drop their weapons. That said, I do know of weapons that can do what you seek: swords, blessed by Rallos Zek himself, that can knock a weapon out of any hand with only a swing. Sadly, several of these swords were recently [stolen] from our temple chambers.'
You say, 'Stolen?'
Drenlo Helmright says 'Shortly after the crystal weapons were delivered to the kromzek and madness came upon the king, several of our acolytes disappeared. When we searched for them, we found the swords were also missing. I can only assume the acolytes stole them. Since these giants had just been initiated into our order, they were not among the kromzek who received a crystal weapon, so I believe they felt slighted. If you can find these acolytes, you might find the sword as well.'

---

2\. Confront a thieving acolyte 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ Thieving acolytes have stolen the Blessed Sword of Strategic Combat, which can be used to easily disarm opponents. Find a thief and confront him.
a thrieving acolyte [npc=41701] are found in various parts of the zone (the main city area). They're on Find (Ctrl+F).
You say, 'Hail, a thieving acolyte'
a thieving acolyte glowers at you as you approach him. He clutches a bundle of glowing weapons that hangs around his waist and points a large sword at your head. 'Stay back, beast! Feed upon the other giants too weak to cling to their weapons! These are my weapons, and they shall cut down every one of your kind!
The thieving acolyte grows angry at your speech and lets his guard down.
3\. Kill a thieving acolyte 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ The thief has no intention of returning the weapon. Kill him and take it from his dead hands.
Thieving acolytes hit for a max ~12,500 and AE rampage. There is no faction hit for killing them.
4\. Recover a Blessed Sword of Strategic Combat 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
Loot Blessed Sword of Strategic Combat [item=105278] from the acolyte's corpse.

---

5\. Tell Drenlo Helmright that you have recovered a Blessed Sword of Strategic Combat 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that you have recovered a sword, Drenlo Helmright will know what to do with it.
You say, 'Hail, Drenlo Helmright'
Drenlo Helmright says 'You have retrieved a sword? Then Kael may yet be saved. You must battle with my brethren. When they are weakened, use the sword to knock the crystal blade out of their hand. But be swift: I doubt the sword will remain on the ground long without being coveted. Go now and collect as many crystal blades as you can. The future of Kael depends upon you!'
6\. Disarm several giants using the Blessed Sword of Strategic Combat 0/5 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
7\. Pick up up the dropped crystal weapons before someone else does 0/5 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ To take the tainted weapons away from the giants, you must weaken them in combat and knock the weapons from their hands using the Blessed Sword of Strategic Combat. Once a weapon lies on the ground, you can recover it, but be careful that another giant does not covet it.
Find giants that are wielding Fear-Tinged weapons [item=106343] (you can tell them by their purple graphics). DPS them to below 30% and then use the sword to knock their weapons out of their hands. The weapon appears on the ground, away from the giant you were just fighting. You'll want to walk over the weapon on the ground quickly, otherwise a nearby giant will pick it up.
Fear-Tinged Weapons are automatically picked up by walking over them in the above step.

---

8\. Ask Drenlo Helmright what you should do with the recovered crystal weapons 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ Drenlo Helmright will know where you can destroy the tainted weapons.
You say, 'Hail, Drenlo Helmright'
Drenlo Helmright says 'Though this is only the beginning, you have done much to remove the blight upon Kael. I doubt, though that it is merely enough to collect those weapons. They must be destroyed. Find the holy bonfires we have lit around the city to ward off the apparitions. The fires may burn strongly enough to destroy the weapons. When you have done this, speak to Noble Helssen. We still must wake the king from his fevered dream.'
9\. Throw the crystal weapons into the holy bonfires 0/5 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ The weapons can only be destroyed by exposing them to the holy bonfires scattered through Kael. Do not let anything stop you from completing your task.
Get close to one of the holy bonfires ( map) in the zone (one of which is found diagonally across from the bank in the center of the city) and right-click the weapons. Note: Each time you do this, "a mysterious apparition" spawns and attacks.
As you cast the crystal weapon into the fire it breaks, and an apparition rises from its smoke.
10\. Kill anything that tries to prevent you from destroying the weapons 0/5 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
Kill the mob that spawns each time you destroy a weapon. Note that this mob is a belly caster (need to be in melee range to land spells).

---

11\. Tell Noble Helssen that the weapons have been destroyed 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ Noble Helssen will want to know that the weapons have been destroyed.
You say, 'Hail, Noble Helssen'
Noble Helssen says 'You have destroyed the weapons? Then I know what you must do: Confront King Tormax. If you can take the axe from him, I believe his mind will be freed. I will tell the court of our plan, so that they will not interfere. Good fortune to you, adventurer! King Tormax is a formidable warrior. I do not doubt it will take much strength to prevail in this fight!'

---

12\. Speak to King Tormax 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ King Tormax is still under the influence of the axe he wields. You must convince him to part with it.
Head into the throne room and confront King Tormax [npc=41817] ( map). Note: He aggro's you when you hail him. You can fade this aggro and engage at any time afterwards.
You say, 'Hail, King Tormax'
King Tormax says 'You lowly iceworm pupa! You come here on behalf of dwarves and dragons to steal my weapons? You ask that I stand down and drop the guard of my city, that I lay down my axe while my enemies rampage over all I hold dear? I will cut away every piece of your body and crunch them under heel like powdered snow!'
King Tormax says 'Death to any creature that aids dragons and coldain!'
13\. Weaken King Tormax and knock the axe out of his hand 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ Since the king will not part with the axe, you must weaken him and strike it from his hands with the Blessed Sword.
Fight King Tormax past 60% (about 2.2 million hitpoints of damage worth) and use the Blessed Sword on him. Note: This is a harder fight than a standard Kael mob.
He hits for over 16,000 (often hits for max); summons from 100% health; is immune to slow; and casts the AE Royal Decimation every 30 seconds.
Royal Decimation: Unknown(32) 300', Magic (-940)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 65000
2: Stun (2.00 sec)
Once you click the sword on him, you see:
King Tormax parries your Blessed Sword and knocks you out with a heavy blow.

---

14\. Inform Noble Helssen that you failed to take the axe from King Tormax 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ King Tormax was too powerful, and he has shattered your Blessed Sword. Tell Noble Helssen that you will need to find another way to free the king from his madness.
You say, 'Hail, Noble Helssen'
Noble Helssen says 'I do not fault you for your failure. As I said, King Tormax is a formidable warrior. We will have to find another way to release him from the power of the axe. And still the Iceshard brothers must be held accountable for their actions.'
You have destroyed many of the weapons that have been harming the citizens of Kael, however King Tormax will not give up his axe, and the Iceshard brothers are still free to cause trouble within the city.
_Rewards:_
225 platinum
Experience (3 AAs + 2-3% exp in Level 96)

This is a group mission that begins with Rejnak Coldspear [npc=41306] ( map) in Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness. He is located behind the throne room of the zone (southernmost point in the zone) - in the east back room.
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed Deliver Us Unto Evil [quest=6059]
\- Completed Them Bones [quest=6060]
\- Completed A Cure for Madness [quest=6061]
\- Must have positive faction with Dragon Death Keep (kill frost giants and/or apparitions to increase it)
You say, 'Hail, Rejnak Coldspear'
Rejnak Coldspear says 'You have done well collecting [evidence]! I don't like what has been discovered, though...'
Rejnak Coldspear says 'The truth is painful, but our response will be more so: The Iceshard brothers have betrayed the King and every citizen of Kael. You have proven this to us, and now we must act. Fjokar and Noble Helssen are readying to meet Captain Bvellos and [assault] Iceshard Manor. Though once they were our brethren, Klaggan and Vorken will not live beyond this day.'
You say, 'An assault?'
Rejnak Coldspear says 'If you wish to assist, [meet] us outside Dragondeath Keep. The Iceshards shall rue the day they brought madness upon Kael!'
You have been assigned the task 'Traitors Among Us'.
With your help, Captain Bvellos and Noble Helssen have determined the Iceshard brothers are responsible for causing the King's malady and bringing chaos to Kael. Now you must join the attack upon Iceshard Manor to punish the traitors.
You say, 'I'll meet you there!'
Rejnak Coldspear says 'I shall see you soon, \_\_\_\_\_.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Kael Drakkel Mission.

---

1\. Speak with Noble Helssen 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
You'll have a few giants assisting you through this mission. They will follow you automatically.
You say, 'Hail, Noble Helssen'
Noble Helssen shouts 'Captain Bvellos waits outside Iceshard Manor, assessing the strength of the Iceshards' forces. We know the brothers have seized control of the kromrif through fear and anger. The traitors wield shards of power, and it would be unwise to underestimate the brothers' capabilities. Rejnak, have you made preparations for the King?'
Rejnak Coldspear shouts 'The priests await his arrival at the temple. When Yetarr and Kyenka receive word that the Iceshards have been dealt with, and that the streets are safe, they will accompany the King to the temple.'
Fjokar Frozenshard shouts 'A pilgrimage alone will not break the crystal axe's hold upon the King. We may need Klaggan and Vorken's knowledge to release the King. We should not kill them before we have gotten answers.'
Noble Helssen shouts 'I blame no one here if hatred guides a blade that cuts too deep. Whether or not the traitors yet draw breath at the end of the day, we will save the King. Let us meet Captain Bvellos. Adventurers, we follow you to Iceshard Manor.'

---

2\. Make your way to the entrance of Iceshard Manor 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
This is the building in the southern part of the zone. If you were coming from Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening, hang a left (south) after passing through the second archway.
You won't be able to make it all the way as the area will be blocked by walls of ice. Note that there is a death touch aura around this area that will be removed later on. Do not approach or you will receive a Death Touch.
3\. Speak with Captain Bvellos 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
You say, 'Hail, Captain Bvellos'
Captain Bvellos shouts 'Halt! Do not get closer to the Manor! The Iceshards must have known we were preparing to strike: They have erected a barrier. A chill wind blows from the ice walls and penetrates my bones. The magic of the crystals must be at work.'
Fjokar Frozenshard shouts 'You have tested your blade against this barrier, no? Do not tell me you cower in fear of a chill breeze!'
Captain Bvellos shouts 'Do you think half my blade was swallowed by a walrus? Of course I challenged the barrier! We will need more than steel to destroy it.'
Noble Helssen shouts 'Sheathe your words, both of you! Bvellos, you have known of this obstacle longer than we. What do you suggest we do?'
Captain Bvellos shouts 'Lean upon Wevek Redforge. He has admitted to crafting the weapons that plague the city. He is fortunate I have not yet claimed his head, and in this matter he may redeem himself.'

---

4\. Speak with Wevek Redforge 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
If you were coming from Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening, hang a right (north) after passing through the second archway. Wevek is in one of these buildings. After hailing him you will have about a minute before Drjek enters the room and attacks.
You say, 'Hail, Wevek Redforge'
Wevek Redforge shouts 'Have you come to kill me? If you don't do it, Drjek will. The first time I touched those horrible crystals, my fate was written. I have sacrificed Kael to appease my cowardice. My head is yours to take. Do so swiftly that I might die a death befitting a warrior of Zek.'
Captain Bvellos shouts 'Do not think I am reluctant to kill you, Wevek, but your head must remain upon your shoulders for now. What do you know of the barrier that protects Iceshard Manor?'
Wevek Redforge shouts 'I know that Drjek is coming to kill me. Klaggan and Vorken have no need of me now, for it was I who created the barrier.'
Fjokar Frozenshard shouts 'You traitorous bastard, I have heard enough of your mewling excuses and self-pity!'
Noble Helssen shouts 'Stay your blade, Fjokar! Let him speak.'
Wevek Redforge shouts 'I crafted five crystals that generate the cold wind that blows from the barrier. And the walls themselves I wove with filaments of the crystal, giving them strength to withstand ordinary weapons. You will never enter the Manor. I have doomed the city...'
Rejnak Coldspear shouts 'Is there nothing you can do? Surely the one who created such a thing would know how to dismantle it!'
Wevek Redforge shouts 'The five generator crystals are weaker than the barrier, but they are guarded by the Iceshards' loyalists. If you were able to bring me pieces of these crystals, I might be able to forge a weapon strong enough to break through the barrier. But not if Drjek claims my head -- and I hear footsteps at the door!'
Drjek shouts 'Wevek, you have interfered with the Iceshards' plans for the last time! With your death, no one will be able to remove the barrier. I told you I would kill you, and I hold to my word!'
5\. Kill Drjek 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ Drjek is coming to prevent Wevek Redforge from revealing the secret of the barrier. Kill Drjek before he can silence Wevek.
Drjek doesn't appear to be any more difficult than a standard trash mob.
Drjek has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
6\. Speak with Wevek Redforge 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
You say, 'Hail, Wevek Redforge'
Wevek Redforge shouts 'Go and bring me the pieces of crystal. I will forge your weapon on one condition: You will kill me when I have finished. A coward such as I does not deserve to live.'

---

7\. Destroy the crystal shards boosting the power of the barrier in front of Iceshard Manor 0/5 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Crystal locations:_
\- on a platform next to the Wakening Land zone-in (far western part of the zone)
\- inside the small building due west of the bank (center of the zone)
\- inside one of the buildings northwest of the bank (center of the zone)
\- outside one of the vendor buildings in the same area as Wevek's building
\- in one of the archways leading in from Zeixshi-Kar's Awakening (east part of the zone)
Note: Each crystal is guarded by two crystal guards [npc=42591] that are leashed to it. These giants cast a 2-tick damage shield on themselves:
Crystal Defender: Self 0', Unresistable (0)
1: Increase Damage Shield by 500
2: Increase Chance to Reflect Spell by 10%
The crystals are belly-casters. Once they reach 40%, they spawn "a shard seeker" which attacks (the shade is a simple mob for its level).
Pick up the Crystal Remains [item=106593] (on the ground in place of the crystal corpses). Take them to Wevek and hail him to receive a Barrier Breaker [item=106613] (Temporary).
8\. Deliver pieces of the destroyed shards to Wevek Redforge 0/5 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
9\. Speak with Wevek Redforge 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
You say, 'Hail, Wevek Redforge'
Wevek Redforge shouts 'It is finished: Take this axe and undo the damage I have done to the city. May the axe's edge first taste the nape of my neck. May my blood be the first offering of payment due for all of our traitorous actions.'
Noble Helssen shouts 'Adventurers, you have proven yourselves noble and wise. I leave unto you the fate of this traitor. '
Fjokar Frozenshard shouts 'You would leave this matter to them? Your actions seem foolish, but as you are a noble, I defer to your authority rather than your intellect. Come, all, we should not tarry.'
Noble Helssen shouts 'The word has been spread; the kromzek have assembled. Today Iceshard Manor shall fall. Adventurers, destroy the barrier!'

---

10\. Use the weapon crafted by Wevek Redforge to weaken and destroy the barriers 0/3 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
From a distance (or you'll be death touched), target the Iceshard Manor walls of ice and right-click the Barrier Breaker. Do this for all three walls. You'll get an emote, and you can then approach the walls and attack them to destroy them.
Flame leaps from your crystal axe and destroys the regenerative power of the ice wall.
Weakening the ice wall with the power of the axe destroys the magic defending Iceshard Manor.
As the barrier crumbles, the kromzek rush into Iceshard Manor, eager to kill the traitors within.
Note: once the 3 ice walls have been destroyed, you may kill Wevek Redforge and loot the Kromrif Locksmith Tools [item=109181] for the quest A Ticket to the Show [quest=6193]. Killing Wevek also grants the achievement A Just Sentence [quest=6546].

---

11\. Penetrate Iceshard Manor and find Klaggan and Vorken 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
12\. Speak with Bjoskhua Blackfist 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ The brothers are not here. Speak with Bjoskhua Blackfist and find out where they went.
Note: About 60 seconds after the hail, all three will attack.
You say, 'Hail, Bjoskhua Blackfist'
Bjoskhua Blackfist shouts 'You seek the Iceshards? They are not here. The cowards have left us, their servants, to atone for the crimes they committed. The punishment dealt to the loyal is often worse than that dealt to the leaders they follow. But what could we have done? Does not a servant, if he wishes to live, respond to his master's call?'
Captain Bvellos shouts 'And what of King Tormax? Is he not the master of your masters? Were you deaf when he called?'
Clrakk Blackfist shouts 'Do you call a madman your master? He whom you call king declared war upon the kromrif. I will never call master one who orders my death!'
Rejnak Coldspear shouts 'And who brought this madness upon the King? Your masters, the ones who have left you to die at our hands. Did you not know the plans they held? Do you three not manage the affairs of this manor? Your lies of ignorance will make poor shields against our blades!'
Nojas Blackfist shouts 'We claim only the right to defend our lives. How many years have the kromrif been relegated to the gutters of this city? The kromzek reign in Dragondeath Keep and curry favor with Rallos Zek in the temple. The kromrif rot in Iceshard Manor, their power dwindling, waiting in fear for the day they know will come: the day the kromzek storm the Manor, as you have done, and demand our heads!'
Bjoskhua Blackfist shouts 'What could the Iceshards have done? Cowardly though they may be, they knew this day would arrive. The crystals merely gave us a chance at victory -- and now you are about to snatch that from us, along with our lives. We will not surrender to you. We will not kneel before a mad king who treats his subjects with contempt!'
Fjokar Frozenshard shouts 'If you will not prostrate yourselves before the authority of the King, then your corpses will do so in your stead!'
From here, they attack.
13\. Defeat the three Blackfist brothers 0/3 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ The Blackfist brothers will not give up the location of the Iceshards. Kill them.
Clrakk Blackfist [npc=42580] is stunnable, but not mezzable or snareable. He casts "Lifedraw Blade" (adds a lifetap proc to his hits):
Lifedraw Blade: Self 0', Unresistable (0)
1: Lifetap from Weapon Damage
Bjoskhua Blackfist [npc=42579] is mezzable, but not stunnable or snareable. He casts "Violent Detonation":
Violent Detonation: Targeted AE 30', Fire (-960)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 45000
Nojas Blackfist [npc=42581] is snareable, but not mezzable or stunnable. He casts "Gripping Hold":
Gripping Hold: Targeted AE 30', Magic (-960)
1: Decrease Movement by 20000%
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 10 per tick
3: Increase Curse Counter by 30
Upon the death of the last Blackfist:
Noble Helssen shouts 'The manor has been cleansed, but still the Iceshards live. By now the King must be waiting outside the temple entrance. Go to him and speak with Yetarr. Begin the ceremony without me. I must search for the Iceshards. If they remain within Kael, they shall not live long.'
The task locks.

---

14\. Speak to Yetarr in front of the temple 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
_Task Window Says:_ The king is being led to the temple grounds, where a ritual will take place. Go there and speak to Yetarr.
Yetarr is located in the northern part of the zone, near the Arena, at /way +1457,+1267.
Note: The Iceshard brothers attack a little over two minutes following Yetarr's hail.
You say, 'Hail, Yetarr'
Yetarr shouts 'You did not find the Iceshards? Then we must hurry. Already I fear for the safety of Kael as the King's mind fades, but with Klaggan and Vorken alive, we are all in even greater danger.'
King Tormax grips his axe tightly and growls. 'Why do you bring me under sky, under danger? You fools, do you wish to kill your King? Do you wish to kill us all? The dragon looks down upon us! Can you not see it above? Can you not hear its screeches and feel its hot breath?'
Kyenka shouts 'Semkak, Gkrean, begin the ceremony. May your words find favor with Rallos Zek.'
Semkak Prophet of Vallon shouts 'Rallos Zek, mightiest Warlord, hear our words! Grant King Tormax his mind that he may wield his blade in your name and slay your enemies! With clear thought he will bring death to the coldain and all inferior creatures detestable to you!'
Noble Helssen shouts 'Yetarr, Kyenka, they are here! The Iceshards!'
Semkak Prophet of Vallon shouts '...and walk upon this land with death in hand, cutting to pieces the weak and unworthy...'
Vorken Iceshard shouts 'Prayer is for the weak and unworthy! Those who have power wield it; they do not petition for it from others!'
Captain Bvellos shouts 'Blades ready! Kill the traitors!'
Noble Helssen shouts 'Stay your swords! Do you not see what they carry?'
a crystal of fear begins to vibrate. King Tormax starts shaking, his axe moving synchronously with the crystal's vibration frequency. His lips curl into a snarl, and saliva drips from his mouth.
Klaggan Iceshard shouts 'Drop your weapons and back away, or King Tormax himself will sever your heads!'
Vorken Iceshard shouts 'Tormax is now ours to command. We are his masters, as it should have been long ago! YOU are now the traitors!'
Wenglawks Kkeak bellows with laughter. 'Look at you, Bvellos, shocked and afraid, wondering if and when King Tormax will take your head! Now you must know what I have felt all these years!'
Wenglawks Kkeak shouts 'He who bows to one man finds his head on the block when his master loses power. But if you bow only to yourself, it does not matter who rises or falls. Your allegiance remains with yourself, and you make allies with whoever keeps you alive. Fanatic loyalty is a trait shared by those who rest in an early grave!'
Wenglawks Kkeak shouts 'Coldain, dragons, giants -- it does not matter. In the end the highest loyalty is bought with coin. Do you think any of us would be where we are if my mercantile savvy had not purchased this crystal from the foolish dragon in Eastern Wastes?'
Wenglawks Kkeak shouts 'My coin and my wits have outlasted you all! And now my newest business partners will give to me the respect and rewards King Tormax should have so many years ago!'
Vorken Iceshard shouts 'Yes, Wenglawks, we will give the reward you deserve! King Tormax, kill this coward! He has betrayed you to the dragons and coldain!'
King Tormax roars with rage and lifts his axe as Wenglawks cowers behind the pulsing crystal.
Wenglawks Kkeak shouts 'Klaggan, this is not part of our deal! After all I have given you!'
Klaggan Iceshard shouts 'What have you given to us? All you have done you did for yourself! Had we been the ones reigning within Dragondeath Keep, you would have bent the crystal against us! The only thing more insidious than the disloyal is one who feigns loyalty! Tormax, kill him!'
Wenglawks Kkeak screams as King Tormax's axe rips through his body. As Tormax swings, the axe cleaves through Wenglawks and strikes the crystal behind which the traitor was hiding. As the crystal begins to sputter, the King staggers back.
Noble Helssen shouts 'Now, adventurers, draw your weapons! Attack the traitors while King Tormax is stunned!'
15\. Defeat the Iceshard brothers 0/2 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
The brothers auto-aggro (summon from 100% health). Vorken casts Heartstab while Klaggan casts Circle of Steel:
Heartstab: Single Target, Magic (-960)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 65000
Circle of Steel: PB AE 150', Magic (-960)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 55000
Upon their deaths:
Captain Bvellos spits on Wenglawks' body. 'A proper reward for traitors!'
Noble Helssen shouts 'I welcome their deaths as you do, but now we cannot question them about the King's mind.'
Gkrean Prophet of Tallon shouts 'King Tormax, are you well?'
King Tormax shakes violently, gripping his axe. He roars to the sky, 'Yelinak, Dane, I see you! Come, fight me! Fight me and die like true warriors!'
Noble Helssen shouts 'The King will not heed you, Gkrean. The crystal still controls his mind. Adventurers, something must be done before the King loses the last shred of his sanity.'
Fjokar Frozenshard shouts 'We should lead the King back to the Keep. Let us not allow him to be shamed like this in the open.'
Noble Helssen shouts 'No, do not touch him. He will rip you apart. Adventurers, we again need your [help].'

---

16\. Accept your reward 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
You have killed Klaggan and Vorken Iceshard, but the crystal shard of fear still controls King Tormax. A strong force must be gathered to protect the city from King Tormax and bring him back to sanity.

**Note: This is the group mission for "The Madness of King Tormax". For the raid, see this quest entry [quest=6064].**
_This is a group mission that begins with Noble Helssen ( map) in Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness. He is located en route to the throne room of Kael Drakkel (southern part of the zone)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Deliver Us Unto Evil"
\- Completed "Them Bones"
\- Completed "A Cure for Madness"
\- Completed "Traitors Among Us" (mission)
\- Must have positive faction with Dragon Death Keep (kill frost giants and/or apparitions to increase it)
You say, 'Hail, Noble Helssen'
Noble Helssen says '\_\_\_\_\_, you have done well removing the tainted [weapons] from the city and defeating the Iceshards, but now the King's life is in danger. He is under the influence of the crystal, and if he cannot be saved, then Kael will be enveloped in his madness. If you can muster a [large] force, we can divest the King of the crystal's power. If you can only field a [small] group, still we must try!'
You say, 'I have a small group'

You say, 'Let's confront him'

Speak with Noble Helssen 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
You say, 'Hail, Noble Helssen'
Noble Helssen says 'We have failed to wake King Tormax from his trance of rage. Every second he grows more agitated, such that we cannot approach him. He defends the crystal, brandishing his axe at anyone who dares glance at the malevolent thing. We have no choice: We must [destroy] the crystal! If you have not the heart to face such trials, [leave] now!'
You say, 'Destroy?'
Noble Helssen says 'Whatever the King may do, or whatever strange apparitions may confront us, we must destroy the crystal. We will fight the King if there is no other option, but we cannot let him fall in battle. Are you [ready]?'
You say, 'Ready!'
Noble Helssen says 'Go, adventurers, free the King from his madness!'
_King Tormax attacks. He hits for a max ~11,000; does not summon; casts "Banishment of Fears" every 30 seconds; and casts "Axe Swipe" every 40 seconds:_
Banishment of Fears: PB AE 100', Magic (-940)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 25000
Axe Swipe: Directional 100', Magic (-940)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 35000

_Lord Yelinak hits for a max ~16,000 and casts "Tail Thunder" (rear AE), "Chilling Breath" (frontal AE), and "Wing Gust" (PBAE). Each of these is preceded by an emote 10 seconds in advance of its cast:_
**Tail Thunder**

Tail Thunder: Directional 70', Magic (-950)

4: Decrease Hitpoints by 25000 per tick
