_Destroy the fear shard._
a crystal of fear has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!

---

Speak to King Tormax 0/1 (Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness)
You say, 'Hail, King Tormax'
King Tormax looks at the temple grounds. His retainers watch his face and keep their hands upon their weapons. Slowly the King's faculties return. 'Against whom have I fought? Blood seeps from wounds I knew not that I had, and my hand is numb as though I have wielded steel against steel.'
Noble Helssen shouts 'Forgive us your wounds, my King, for your mind was not your own. The brothers of Iceshard wielded a crystal of immense power against you -- against all the citizens of Kael. The brothers now lie in their own blood. May their memory be purged from our minds and records. But though we cut them down, we could not sever the crystal's hold upon you without force.'
Yetarr shouts 'My King, you should retire to the Keep. Allow your wounds and your mind to mend.'
King Tormax raises his hand and silences his retainer. 'My mind has remained long enough in idleness. Searching my memory is like peering through a thick fog: I see only flashes of steel and the faces of Dain Frostreaver and Lord Yelinak peering at me, mocking me. What has become of the city in my absence?
Noble Helssen shouts 'There is much to recount. Many of our people are dead, and it shall be no easy task repairing the trust between the kromrif and kromzek. With your return, though, there is hope the city will not fall to fear and civil war. At your command, my King, we shall enter the Keep and begin immediately to repair the destruction wrought by the Iceshards.'
King Tormax looks to Noble Helssen and creases his brow. 'Your words sting more than your steel. My wounds do not compare to those inflicted upon Kael Drakkel. We shall return to the Keep, but I shall take no aid until I have given it to the city.'
Noble Helssen shouts 'As you command, so shall it be done!' Addressing the adventurers before him, Noble Helssen continues, 'Adventurers, you have proven your worth. You have saved King Tormax and the entire city. I hold you as warriors of great strength and honored friends of Kael Drakkel. When you [leave] here, do so knowing that we are indebted to you.'

---

_This is a kill task that begins with Bjorik the Heartstrong ( map) in Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness. He's located at -40, 1545, -195 (just north of the bank in the city center)._
You say, 'Hail, Bjorik the Heartstrong'
Bjorik the Heartstrong says 'Keep away from me, you blood-sucking leech! I've seen what your kind is [capable] of.'
You say, 'Capable?'
Bjorik the Heartstrong says 'Each night I see the same dream: all is calm as I guard the Shrine, when suddenly, the arena is flooded by hundreds of tiny figures! The shrill sound of battle rings in my ears, as they strike down the mighty Derakor. Then one - just like you! - turns towards me and shrieks to the rest, "[Clear the trash]!"'
You say, 'Clear the trash?'
Bjorik the Heartstrong passes a hand over his eyes wearily, 'And now, it is all too real. Once-mighty Kromzek lie strewn upon the floor, while their tiny slayers roam these great halls laying ruin... And you, tiny one; you are [one of them]! Tell me one reason I should not slay you right here, and avenge their memories!'
You say, 'I'm not one of them!'
Bjorik the Heartstrong says 'Do you deny it?! Are our halls not littered with the bodies of those slain by the murderous Coldain, who thirst only for the blood of my kind?! If you would prove yourself other than they; go forth, and rid us of this blight! Only then will I stay my hand when next our paths cross.'
You have been assigned the task 'Taking Out the Trash'.
Bjorik has challenged you to prove you're not allied with the invaders, by slaying them.

_This task begins with Kvojik ( map) in Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness. He's located at -425, 2340, -295 (across from the Wakening Land zone on the western side of Kael)._
You say, 'Hail, Kvojik'
Kvojik glances at you, raising his brow in surprise, 'Oh, I see. You wish to challenge me. Very well, little one, I shall give you the honor of dying in battle, although I must disappoint your hopes of a noble death, for you are not [worthy] of my blade!'
You say, 'I am worthy!'
Kvojik says 'You surprise me, little one, for I thought I had slain you in a single stroke! Clearly, you are neither so weak, nor so pitiful as you appear. It is well then, that I did not use my axe, for I can see now that you have a great strength of heart - a trait which I respect above all others. It is for this [reason] that I have yet to enter the battle which my kinsmen so desperately fight.'
You say, 'What reason?'
Kvojik says 'I have sworn that my axe, Steel Singer, shall never taste the blood of weaklings, for to bathe it in the blood of the weak-hearted may weaken its strength; I shall only raise my weapon against those who I deem worthy to whet Steel Singer's blade - and I fear that these invaders may not be. Oh! If only I knew how to measure the strength of their [hearts]!'
You say, 'Hearts?'
Kvojik says 'That's it - of course! When you are rested, go and collect the hearts of some of these invaders. I shall compare them to see which of them - if any - may be worthy opponents for my Steel Singer.'
You have been assigned the task 'Weight of a Worthy Heart'.
Kvojik has asked you to bring him the hearts of his foes, that he may measure their worth as opponents.

8\. Kill a ritualist of Vallon Zek 0/1 (Kael Drakkel)
9\. Kill a ritualist of Rallos Zek 0/1 (Kael Drakkel)
a ritualist of Tallon Zek [npc=41690] ( map) spawns in the rooms connected to the arena (northeast of the arena in Gkrean Prophet of Tallon [npc=41175]'s room).
a ritualist of Vallon Zek [npc=41691] ( map) spawns in the rooms connected to the arena (northwest of the arena in Semkak Prophet of Vallon [npc=41182]'s room).
a ritualist of Rallos Zek [npc=41692] ( map) spawns in the very northern part of the zone, by The Statue of Rallos Zek [npc=41186]'s room (around 2450, 1390, -36).
NOTE: The ritualist of Rallos Zek summons from 100% health (the other two may as well, but this particular one is the only one reported.)
Target your pet mercenary and use the Flask of Kromrif Ale [item=106467] on it to increase its drunken state (which also increases its damage output). Keep clicking it until it's at a point where it's proccing a spell. This spell damages the shielding of the ritualists you need to kill. Five procs on a ritualist will eliminate its shield. The mercenary must keep attacking at full power, otherwise the ritualists can regenerate.
10\. Inform Merc McFader of the results of your battle 0/1 (Kael Drakkel)
11\. Tell Nojas Blackfist that you succeeded in stopping the ritualists 0/1 (Kael Drakkel)

_This task begins with Welverd Steelbairn ( map) in Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness. He's located at 100, 1215, -135. If coming from the Eastern Wastes, pass through the first archway, keep going, pass through the second archway, and hang an immediate right (north). He is outside one of the buildings in this area._
You say, 'Hail, Welverd Steelbairn'
Welverd Steelbairn says 'Do you smell that? The miasma begins to waft through Kael, rising from the corpses that lie unburied. Were it not for the preservative qualities of ice, we would all be choking on the stench of rotting flesh by now. But it is [difficult] to approach the bodies of our fallen brethren in order to bury them.'
You say, 'Difficult?'
Welverd Steelbairn says 'It is not only because of their repellent smell. There seems to be a kind of darkness clinging to the bodies, some feeling that penetrates whoever draws near. I think it must have some relation to the strange [apparitions] that have arrived in Kael.'
You say, 'Apparitions?'
Welverd Steelbairn says 'I struck one down the other day -- one of those twisted dogs. I did not want the meat to go to waste, so I took its body home and cooked it. Even though the meat was burnt, it still tasted raw. Leaving my home later in the evening, I walked near a kromrif's corpse. Crawling around the body were fat, shadowy [worms].'
You say, 'What worms?'
Welverd Steelbairn says 'I had never seen anything like those worms, and I thought I was imagining things. On my way home, I did not see the worms there. The next morning, I ate more of the meat, and I walked the path once more. The corpse still lay on the ground, and the worms had returned. I hid behind a snowdrift and watched as they slowly [disappeared] from my sight, seeming to melt into the snow.'
You say, 'Disappeared?'
Welverd Steelbairn says 'It must be the meat. It gave me a glimpse into a dark world unknown to giants. The discomfort I felt before around the corpses must come from these shadowy worms. If I could somehow banish them from Kael, we could retrieve our dead and give them proper burial. Would you be willing to [deal] with these worms for me? I do not have the heart to face them, as difficult as it is for me to admit.'
You say, 'I will deal with them'
Welverd Steelbairn says 'Thank you. Here is some of the meat I saved from the dead apparition. If you eat it, you will surely see the worms. If you run out of meat, kill and eat more apparitions.'
You have been assigned the task 'Bring Out Your Dead'.
_You receive "Apparition Flesh"._
The dead in Kael lie unburied, but Welverd Steelbairn wants to change this. To allow the giants to properly care for the deceased, you must kill the shadow worms that have been feeding upon the dead giants.
The shadow worms can be found near corpses of giants. In order to see and fight the shadow worms without causing grave harm to yourself, you must consume the flesh of apparitions.

Kill 6 soul scavengers 0/6 (Kael Drakkel)

_You can kill other apparitions to pick up more flesh clicks as you need them._
Return to Welverd Steelbairn 0/1 (Kael Drakkel)
(Optional) Kill apparitions of dragons, coldain, and other creatures to gain more flesh pieces 0/20 (Kael Drakkel)

_This is a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Kiltar ( map) in Kael Drakkel: The King's Madness. He is found at the zone-in (-15, -615)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Kiltar'
Kiltar says 'Greetings, little thing. You have entered into the great city of Kael Drakkel, home of the Kromzek as well as a few of my kind, the Kromrif. If you are to walk among my people as a peer, you must [prove yourself] as a friend, not a foe.'
You say, 'Prove myself?'
Kiltar says 'Strange happenings are afoot and if you could help me [investigate], I would be most thankful. I have been ordered by King Tormax himself not to leave my post, or else I would look into these matters myself.'
You say, 'I will investigate'
Kiltar says 'Though the relationship between the Kromzek and Kromrif is not without tension at times, we have worked together to secure a home for ourselves. Our chief concern has been the coldain, but lately something strange and far more [sinister] is threatening our city.'
You have been assigned the task 'Madness Reigns'.
Kael Drakkel is in the midst of a spreading madness. Kiltar has asked you to speak with some of his friends so you can perhaps learn more about what is going on within the city.
You say, 'Something sinister?'
Kiltar says 'Our king has gone mad and the majority of our citizens are hallucinating, claiming they see visions of terrible creatures. The whole city is on the brink of a civil war. My own friends have even fallen victim to this mysterious plague. Why I haven't fallen victim to this same madness, I do not know. I would ask that you visit some of my friends and try to learn more about what is [going on].'
You say, 'What's going on?'
Kiltar says 'If the coldain are behind this, they will surely pay with their lives. I need to have proof however before anything further can be done.'

_This task is the first in a series of three and begins with Foreman Sukar ( map) at the zone-in of the Breeding Grounds (-20, 0, 4)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Foreman Sukar'
Foreman Sukar greets you with a troubled smile, 'I am Sukar, leader of many brave [workers] who are trained in the careful extraction and preservation of dragon artifacts. Excavation crews have long been present in Dragon Necropolis, eager to uncover bones or other relics that might make their finder wealthy, but my crew is quite different. We are more concerned about what can be [learned] from the bones and relics that are found.
You say, 'What can be learned?'
Foreman Sukar says 'We have always done our best to avoid disrupting the dragon [death ritual]. We remove artifacts with care, and when able, return them to their original resting place once our [studies] are complete. The recent discovery of the [Breeding Grounds] has given my crew and poachers alike something to get excited about.'
You say, 'What death ritual?'
Foreman Sukar says 'Despite their reputation for being beasts of destruction, dragons are quite refined creatures with a very structured society. They persevere even in the face of extinction, often outliving countless other creatures that also call Norrath home. For such long and grand lives, it seems fitting that these creatures would meet death with dignity. Dragons from all over Norrath make their way to the necropolis when the end is near, allowing their bones to rest peacefully among their ancestors.'
You say, 'Tell me about the breeding grounds'
Foreman Sukar gestures to the area around him, 'It wasn't until recently that this area was discovered. As shards of fear rained down upon Norrath, one large chunk of crystal tore through the tundra within the Western Wastes, pierced through the heart of Dragon Necropolis, and eventually lodged itself into the core of what we now call the Breeding Grounds. This name was not given by its inhabitants though, but by those who have come here and witnessed the miraculous arrival of a [new breed] of dragons.
You say, 'What new breed?'
Foreman Sukar says 'We don't know much about the dragons that dwell in this area, but the more we explore and study, the more we begin to understand. It is evident that the fear crystal that lodged itself into the cavern floor is having an effect on the dragons that dwell here. Some of their scales have a unique purple hue, and they appear to mature at an accelerated rated. My studies have come to an unsettling halt though, as my [excavation crew] has disappeared.'
You say, 'What about these studies?'
Foreman Sukar flashes a modest grin, 'Our research would not be possible without the generosity of Mr. Napth. Not only is he a charitable benefactor, but the philanthropist genuinely seems interested in our findings. While his curiosity leans more toward crystals clusters than the dragons, it's still refreshing to know that our research is being funded by someone who believes in the cause.
You say, 'And your workers?'
Foreman Sukar says 'I run a diverse team, made up of individuals trained in the extraction and preservation of dragon bones, relics, and other artifacts. My crewmembers have all been instructed not to disturb the native inhabitants in any way. We strive to maintain a non-threatening presence, devoting our efforts to learning and observing, rather than looting and killing. We haven't had too many issues with the dragons here, as we've always kept a safe distance, but they are growing increasingly hostile. I worry for my crewmembers' safety, and have yet to find an adventurer willing to [help] me find them.'
You say, 'I will help'
Foreman Sukar says 'Many thanks, \_\_\_\_\_. I trust that you will be able to locate my crew and help them return to me safely. Their last known excursion was to the frozen area which rests beneath where we stand now. They were sent to collect egg shells from recent hatchlings, but have not been heard from for days.'
You have been assigned the task 'A Chilling Rescue'.
Sukar's excavation crew has gone missing. He's asked for your help in locating them.

---

Find the missing excavation crew 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_This updates at around 180, -30, -150 ( map \-\- this is in the ice area that's underneath the zone-in, so you'll have to travel through the eastern tunnel system to get there). There are no markings on the ground; you just have to run over the location (due west out of the tunnel into the ice cavern)._
Beneath the thick layer of ice lie the frozen remains of Sukar's crew, though one survivor can be seen trapped beneath the frozen barrier.
Return to Foreman Sukar 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ While Sukar will be saddened to hear of his crew's frozen fate, he will be happy to hear there is a survivor.
You say, 'Hail, Foreman Sukar'
Foreman Sukar drops his gaze to the floor as a heavy sigh escapes his lips. 'I am crippled by the loss of my crewmembers, but an effort must be made to rescue the sole survivor. The ice is too thick to crack, and likely won't melt by any normal means. A flame ignited by lava and fueled by phase venom should be enough to turn the ice to water. I am in no shape to collect the needed items on my own. Please, I beg you, gather the materials and return to me so that we can rescue my crewmember before it's too late.'

---

Recover a brittle patch of rat fur 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Recover a dragon claw 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Recover a phase spider venom sac 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Sukar has asked you to collect some materials to build a torch. Brittle rat fur can be found on any Chetari. A dragon claw could be found in piles of dragon bones. A venom sac can be found on phase spiders.
_These are random updates from chetari kills (tunnels to the east of the zone-in); piles of dragon bones kills ( map \-\- objects scattered throughout the side rooms in the Chetari tunnels); and phase spider kills (found in northernmost part of the zone)._
Return to Foreman Sukar 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that you have all the required items, Sukar should be able to fashion a torch that is capable of melting the thick ice.
You say, 'Hail, Foreman Sukar'
Foreman Sukar takes the items from you and begins to wind the brittle hair around the larger end of the dragon claw. After forming a tight ball at its tip, he coats it generously with phase spider venom. With a quick but careful hand, he places the complete Dragon Claw Torch in your grasp. 'Carrying this torch as you walk across an active volcano should be enough to ignite it. As soon as it's lit, make your way to the ice patch where my crewmember is trapped. Touch the torch to the ice and step back, as the flames will flicker high.'
_You receive a "Dragonclaw Torch"._

---

Run over an active volcano to light the Dragonclaw Torch 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ In order to light the torch, you'll need to quickly run over an active volcano.
_With the Dragonclaw Torch on you, run over any of the "volcanoes" in the lava areas of the zone (there a few locations near the zone-in). Note: This update breaks invisibility._
The Dragonclaw Torch ignites into a blinding flame as you walk over the active volcano.
Use the Dragonclaw Torch while on the ice patch 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that the torch is lit, head to the ice patch where the halfling was trapped and attempt to melt the ice.
_Go back to the excavation crew update location and right-click the torch there._
In a bizarre reaction, the frozen pond ignites when the torch's flames lick its cool exterior, causing the ice to melt and the halfling excavator to escape.
Return to Foreman Sukar 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Inform Sukar that the trapped excavator has been freed.
You say, 'Hail, Foreman Sukar'
Foreman Sukar greets your arrival with somber gratitude. 'I cannot dwell on the dead, but instead must be grateful that you were able to save a life. I have sent the one you rescued back to Shard's Landing to rest and recuperate. Someone should notify his mother, Haela, of his rescue since he won't be back in the Thicket for some time. The tale of his icy entrapment is one you may be [interested] in hearing, however.
You helped rescue one of Sukar's missing crewmembers.
_His reference to Misty Thicket involves the task " The Long Lost Puppet [quest=6191]", and "interested" leads in to the next task in this series._
_Rewards:_
187 platinum, 5 gold
Experience (2 AAs + 2-3% regular exp in Level 96)

_This task is the second in a series of three. It is a solo task that begins with Foreman Sukar ( map) at the zone-in of the Breeding Grounds (-20, 0, 4)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
_\- Level 85_
_\- Completed "A Chilling Rescue"_
You say, 'Hail, Foreman Sukar'
Foreman Sukar says 'The excavator you rescued claimed that he and the crew were recovering broken egg shells near a nest of frozen dragon eggs when suddenly one of them began to hatch. The noise drew the attention of an elder [frostwing] who immediately tossed them into the water with one swipe of her wing. Without hesitation the dragon released her icy breath on top of the water, creating a frozen grave for the crew trapped below.'
You say, 'Tell me about the frostwing'
Foreman Sukar says 'The frostwing are ice dragons that dwell within the Breeding Grounds. Like many of the inhabitants here, not much is known about their history, though we do know that a specific sect of frostwing call themselves the Va`Ker. We have made a lot of progress in our relationship with these dragons. It is surprising to me that the Va`Ker are initiating attacks. Something isn't right... I implore you to [speak] to their leader, Eyska, on my behalf.'
You say, 'I will speak to her'
Foreman Sukar nods with understanding. 'Very well. Be cautious, \_\_\_\_\_. While my crew has worked hard to establish an amicable relationship with the Va`Ker elders, it seems this delicate alliance has been recently rattled.'
You have been assigned the task 'Treading Lightly'.
Foreman Sukar doesn't understand why the Va`Ker have been attacking his crewmembers. He has asked you to speak with their leader, Eyska, in hopes that you will be able to repair whatever damage has been done.

---

Find and speak to Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Eyska Va`Ker, the Broodmother [npc=41319] ( map) is found at location 415, 500, 27 (end of the tunnel that extends from the zone's western-most cavern). Note: Two KOS drakes flutter at her side.
You say, 'Hail, Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother'
Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother scowls down at you, scraping her sharp claws across the ice in a threatening gesture. 'I will assume that since you speak for them, you belong to them; so repeat my warning to your masters: any who trespass within these caverns will meet their death. My brethren foolishly agreed to let your kind study our surroundings, so long as you kept away from our young. You betrayed your words by slaughtering my unborn children, and that grotesque act will not go unpunished! Now leave my chambers and do not return, or I shall spill your guts over this icy floor!'

---

Return to Foreman Sukar 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ You should let Sukar know that Eyska claims his crew has been slaughtering her children.
You say, 'Hail, Foreman Sukar'
Foreman Sukar's face is filled with disbelief, 'The Broodmother claimed we have slaughtered her unborn children? This cannot be true. I handpicked the excavation crew myself. Each and every member had the utmost respect for dragonkind, and wouldn't dream of causing harm to the eggs within these walls. There must be another [hand] at work here.
You say, 'What's at hand?'
Foreman Sukar says 'Someone or something is destroying the dragon eggs, but I cannot fathom who. I suppose the quickest way to find out what is happening is to set up a scenario where we can witness the events ourselves. We can collect un-hatched eggs and place them around the Breeding Grounds as bait. Surely whoever is killing the unborn dragons won't be able to resist this lure. Before egg collection can begin, you'll need to create an [incubator]. The preservation of the future hatchlings is imperative! Also, you'll need to have Asupi mix an [Ashen Elixir] for you.'
You say, 'What about the Ashen Elixir?'
Foreman Sukar says 'If you've noticed, the dragon eggs within the Breeding Ground seem to respond to even the slightest movement. If you travel too close to the egg, it will hatch. This poses a problem, you see, since you'll need to be very close to the egg to place it in the incubator. Asupi is a Paebala who relies on his stealth to travel the caverns, scavenging for food. He has perfected a potion that will make you as quiet as a mouse, and as light as a drake made of ash. While he will mix this elixir for you at no cost, he does require some materials.'
You say, 'And the incubator?'
Foreman Sukar says 'Most of the necessary items can be found within the Breeding Grounds, though some will need to be fashioned using materials found or purchased elsewhere. While I am quite versed in dragon history, I know little to nothing of smithing. If you are anything like me, and lack the skills the fashion the incubator yourself, Irus Tindlefootin in Shard's Landing will be able to make one if you give her the proper materials and compensate her for her efforts.'

---

Acquire a Dragon Egg Incubator 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Recover pristine ashwing scales 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Recover a drop of Chetari blood 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Foreman Sukar has decided the best way to determine who or what is killing the Va`Ker is to collect dragon eggs to use as bait. You may craft a Dragon Incubator by combining Glowing Lava Rock, Planar Alloy, a Glass Disk, and a Mana Battery (Class One) at a forge. Additionally, you can give the needed items to Irus Tindlefoot in Shard's Landing, and she can craft one for you. Glowing Lava Rocks can be found on magma dragons.
The two "Recover..." updates are not actual items - they are only kills (random updates from any "ashwing" and "chetari" mob, respectively). Note that ashwings are uncommon spawns as static mobs, but can be spawned with some frequency by stepping on eggs.
For the incubator, this is a no-fail smithing combine:
Mana Battery - Class One [item=11460] \+ Glowing Lava Rock [item=108440] \+ Planar Alloy [item=108594] \+ Glass Disk [item=47171] = Dragon Egg Incubator [item=108449]
The Mana Battery - Class One [item=11460] is vendorbought or crafted (tinkering); the Glowing Lava Rock [item=108440] drops from magma dragons in the Breeding Grounds (found in the northeastern lava cavern); and the Planar Alloy [item=108594] (jewelcraft) and Glass Disk [item=47171] (jewelcraft) are crafted.
Alternatively, you can hand in the following items to Craftkeeper Irus Tindlefoot [npc=41363] ( map) in Shard's Landing (in one of the tents in the crater's southwest):
\- Mana Battery - Class One [item=11460]
\- Glowing Lava Rock [item=108440]
\- Platinum Bar [item=14324]
\- Planar Energy Shard [item=104840]
\- Glass Disk [item=47171]
\-\-\- 10 platinum
You say, 'Hail, Craftkeeper Irus Tindlefoot'
Craftkeeper Irus Tindlefoot shares a forced smile as she winces, 'Ah, a welcome customer. Hail to you, \_\_\_\_\_.' Her tone becomes slightly sarcastic, 'My 'brilliant' husband has insisted that we set up shop out here in this 'lovely' location to sell 'useful' wares to craftsmen travelling through. Please survey our wares to see if you are in need of anything.' She continues speaking in a whisper, 'I don't see why I couldn't just sell my own baked goods and save you the trouble of having to make these things yourself.' She shakes her head slightly still wincing and forcing a fake smile.
_She gives you a Dragon Egg Incubator [item=108449] in exchange for the above items._
NOTE: using the Alternatively, way to obtain the Dragon Egg Incubator did not update my task but if you take the Dragon Egg Incubator to Foreman Sukar (The Breeding Grounds) and this will update your task correctly.

---

Speak to Asupi Muksap 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Asupi Muksap will mix you an Ashen Elixir if you collect the required ingredients first.
Asupi Muksap [npc=41340] ( map) is located around 200, -350, -99 (from the zone-in area, head east into the narrow tunnels and to the northwestern-most room in those tunnels).
You say, 'Hail, Asupi Muksap'
Asupi Muksap uses his filthy paws to retrieve the necessary items from your grasp. With whiskers twitching, he places a few drops of chetari blood in a liquid-filled vial before crushing, then sprinkling in the drake scales. After a quick shake, he hands you the now cloudy vial with some advice, 'Drink before you go near any dragon eggs and you will not wake the unborn whelps within. Go near without drinking, and you'll be sorry... or dead. Probably dead.'
You receive an Ashen Elixir [item=108462]. Use this buff for the next step.

---

Use the incubator to collect dragon eggs (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Locate dragon eggs around the Breeding Grounds and use the incubator to collect them.
With the buff on, walk over a dragon egg and click it. Note: If you lose the buff, you can return to Asupi for another Elixir. Failure to do this step without the buff will result in broken eggs.
Note: Pets and mercenaries also break eggs.
The dragon egg shrinks into nothing as the incubator rattles and feels slightly heavier than before.

---

Return the Dragon Egg Incubator to Foreman Sukar 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Give the Dragon Egg Incubator to Foreman Sukar.
Foreman Sukar gives the incubator a quick inspection before nodding with approval. 'These eggs should work well as [bait].'
You used a special incubator to collect dragon eggs around the Breeding Grounds to use as bait.
_"bait" leads into the next task._
337 platinum, 5 gold
Experience

_This task is the third in a series of three. It is a solo task that begins with Foreman Sukar ( map) at the zone-in of the Breeding Grounds (-20, 0, 4)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "A Chilling Rescue"
\- Completed "Treading Lightly"
You say, 'Hail, Foreman Sukar'
Foreman Sukar keeps his tone low as he details the plan to find out whom or what is slaughtering the dragon whelps within the Breeding Grounds. 'Use the incubator at various spots within the cavern to [dispense] an un-hatched egg, which will serve as bait. Make sure you stay close and observe what happens. When you've placed all the dragon eggs, report back to me.'
You say, 'Dispense?'
Foreman Sukar places the incubator carefully in your grasp, 'I've inspected all the dragon eggs and they appear to be unharmed. I don't like leaving these defenseless eggs out as bait, but I fear it's the only way we'll be able to find out who or what is preying on the dragons' young.'
You have been assigned the task 'Eggs as Bait'.
Foreman Sukar has asked you to place dragon eggs around the Breeding Grounds to catch who or what is destroying the Va`Ker's young.

---

Place a dragon egg on the frozen pond 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Use the Dragon Egg Incubator at around 200, 35, -150 (this is in the ice cavern directly below the zone-in area, near the excavator update in a previous task)._
_Using the incubator at this location triggers the spawn of three mobs (which appear single in increments). They hit for a max ~11,000 and have an average amount of hitpoints. You have two minutes to kill the three mobs, or the task is reset to this step._
The incubator rattles slightly as a dragon egg appears before you.
a vicious terrorwing shrieks and flies toward you!
Protect the dragon egg from predators 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
a vicious terrorwing has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
a vicious terrorwing falls to the ground.

---

Place a dragon egg near the cluster of fear crystals 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Use the Dragon Egg Incubator at around 850, -530, -120 (this is in the northeastern cavern of the zone -- in the vicinity of Charra's spawn point). This triggers the spawn of three mobs (which appear single in increments). You have two minutes to kill the three mobs, or the task is reset to this step._
Protect the dragon egg from predators 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Repeat as in previous steps._

---

Place a dragon egg on the middle ledge above the mausoleum 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Use the Dragon Egg Incubator at around 1685, 170, 130 (this is in the northern-most cavern of the zone; the fear area -- click it on the middle balcony that overlooks the treasure room). A hungry drake will fly in and consume the egg._
The incubator rattles slightly as a dragon egg appears before you.
Immediately after it lands, the terrorwing devours the un-hatched dragon, leaving only traces of broken shell behind before flying away.
Protect the dragon egg from predators 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_There is nothing you can do about the egg! It's gone._

---

Report back to Foreman Sukar with your findings 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ You should inform Sukar that the Terrorwing have been eating the Va`Ker's young.
You say, 'Hail, Foreman Sukar'
Foreman Sukar gasps in horror, 'You observed a terrorwing feeding on the eggs of another dragon? Dragon's do not eat their young! This must be some sort of horrible mistake. Are you [sure] that is what you witnessed?'
You say, 'I'm sure!'
Foreman Sukar shivers slightly as the memory of a horrific undead dragon flashes through his mind. After a brief moment of stunned silence, he shakes the memory from his thoughts. 'If this is indeed true, the other dragons within these caverns are in grave danger. Eyska and her brood must be warned.'
Tell Eyska Va`Ker of your findings 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Eyska should be informed of what the Terrorwing are doing. _( map)_
You say, 'Hail, Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother'
Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother eyes you carefully, uncertain whether she should trust your words. After a considerable pause, curious fear wins out and she speaks, 'Dragons have a taste for almost any flesh, but we do not feast on our own unborn. However, I have heard of the dragons you speak of; the dragons whose scales are flecked with crystal. Slaughter their kind until you find an enlarged stomach. Bring it to me, and I shall spill its contents to look for evidence of your claims.' Eyska sharpens her claw against the ice in front of you as a warning, 'If the proof cannot be found, I will slice your stomach instead.'

---

Slay fear dragons until you recover an enlarged dragon stomach 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Eyska requires proof that the Terrorwing are devouring her young. She's asked you to slay fear dragons until you recover an enlarged stomach, which she will examine for proof.
_This is a random update upon kills of terrorwing or fearwing mobs._
Return to Eyska Va`Ker with your proof 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Return with your proof to Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother.
You say, 'Hail, Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother'
Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother tosses the enlarged stomach on the ice before her. It slides a few feet away before the Va`Ker leader slashes at it with her claw, spilling the stomach's contents onto the icy floor. Eyska's looks on in horror as the still warm remains of her whelps cause steam to rise within her chambers. 'My children...', she weeps for the loss of her young as the rage builds in her bowels, building as it moves through her body, finally escaping her mouth in violent roar that echoes off the icy walls. 'They will pay for what they have done.'
You helped expose the Terrorwing's horrific deeds, while earning slight favor with the Va`Ker.
Your faction standing with Va`Ker got better.
_Rewards:_
225 platinum
Experience

_This is a group mission that begins with "Eyska Va`Ker, the Broodmother" ( map) in the Breeding Grounds, found at location 415, 500, 27 (end of the tunnel that extends from the zone's western-most cavern)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "A Chilling Rescue"
\- Completed "Treading Lightly"
\- Completed "Eggs As Bait"
\- Completed "The Rise of the Ancients" (mission)
You say, 'Hail, Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother'
Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother says 'With Zalikor's undead army defeated, the [entrance] to his lair is now defenseless, though it rests too close to the crystal for me to enter. The fear that emanates from the cluster warps the minds and bodies of all dragons who linger near it, and I will not become a terror to my own kind as Zalikor has.'
You say, 'What about the entrance?'
Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother says 'Only the fire dragons have any resistance to the corruption of Fear, for fear has never had a place in their hearts. They took up a stout defense of the crystal to keep it from those that have been corrupted, at great expense. For they do suffer from that corruption, despite their fiery hearts, and they are forced to kill those of their own that grow too tainted. But with all of the damage your people have done to my lava kin, Zalikor has forced them out and made his lair in the heart of these caverns, close to the fear crystal. He's surrounded himself with dragon eggs to ensure that the when they hatch, the whelps will be born into terror. If your [group] or [raid] wish to aid the Va`Ker, I will show you the way.'
You say, 'I have a group'
Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother says 'Zalikor is aware of our presence, and is likely hiding deep within his lair, though I doubt he'll stay hidden long if we [slaughter] his unborn. His lair is littered with crystal eggs, each with a whelp growing inside that will soon be part of Zalikor's army and must be killed.'
You say, 'Slaughter?'
Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother says 'Although I cannot venture into the heart of the caverns, I will summon the Guardians of Va`Ker. Each holds an artifact that will summon the power of our kind, providing an enhancement to much of your magic, though you must defeat the guardians if you wish to wield their power. When you are ready to [go], I will show you the way to Zalikor's lair.'
You have been assigned the task 'Zalikor's Lair'.
You say, 'Let's go!'
Eyska Va`Ker, The Broodmother says 'May the strength of the Va`Ker flow through your veins.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered The Breeding Grounds.

---

Obtain a Va`Ker artifact 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Around the zone are six dragons. Each of these dragons hits for a max ~13,000 and has nothing special about their fights. They each drop an artifact. You need at least one of these to update the task, but you can loot all of them if you want for later use (not necessary, but you may find it helpful)._
_Each artifact, in the end fight, can be used to spawn an aura that increases your spell, DOT, and ranged DPS._
_NOTE: Looting an artifact locks the task._
_\- Fesik ( map \-\- in the dead-end tunnel west of the zone-in) drops "Fesik's Totem of Might" (aura: ranged attacks)._
_\- Darlak ( map \-\- in the lava cavern due north of the zone-in) drops "Darlak's Flame" (aura: fire)._
_\- Nesifi ( map \-\- in the fear area's treasure room, far north from the zone-in) drops "Nesifi's Bane" (aura: disease/poison)._
_\- Veros ( map \-\- on the ledge overlooking the treasure room) drops "Veros' Talisman" (aura: magic)._
_\- Elsa`Ker ( map \-\- in the basement ice area, south room) drops "Frozen Scale of Elsa`Ker" (aura: cold)._
_\- Isia`Ker ( map \-\- in the basement ice area, north room) drops "Charm of the Va`Ker" (aura: chromatic/prismatic)._

---

Kill cursed whelps to lure Zalikor from hiding 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Zalikor's egg-littered lair can be found near the large crystal formation. Kill his whelps to lure him from hiding.
_Head to the magma cavern in the northeast part of the zone and kill the eggs there to spawn whelps. Upon killing a number of whelps (this may be random?), Zalikor ( map) spawns._
_Note that Zalikor spawns at the fear crystal. Since the whelps can be pulled out of the lair, you can set yourself up so that you kill them outside his aggro range. You will see this emote once he appears:_
Provoked by the slaughter of his whelps, Zalikor appears to defend his lair!
_Remaining crystal eggs do not despawn, and will hatch if you step over them._

---

Defeat Zalikor 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ It's time to slay the dragon!
Zalikor, Devourer of Dragons lowers his head while baring a mouthful of razor sharp teeth. His eyes lock onto yours as he extends his wings, ready for battle!
_Zalikor hits for a max ~18,000 (possibly more) and casts "Terror Blast" (note: this AE has a knockback component and can knock you into eggs that spawn adds):_
Terror Blast: PB AE 80', Magic (-960)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 38000
_At certain intervals throughout this part of the fight, Zalikor will spawn a crystal egg on a random single target:_
_Seen by all:_ \_\_\_\_\_ has been encased in a crystal egg shell.
_Seen by target:_ You are encased in a crystal egg shell.
_This egg must be killed in order to free the player (just target the player to DPS the egg, as the egg itself isn't targetable). If this isn't done in time, the inflicted player will be death touched:_
Devour: Single Target, Unresistable (-1000)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 500000
_At 70%, Zalikor flies above the area and the ground becomes covered in a damage aura. You will want to quickly make your way up to the platforms above the cavern._
_Zalikor, in the air, does not need to be tanked. He flies around the room and needs to be DPS'd via ranged attacks._
_The artifact(s) you looted in the first part of the task can be helpful here. When clicked, they spawn an aura on the platform that boosts your spell damage, DOT damage, and ranged attacks._
_For a map of aura locations, see this image._
_Aura locations for your "breedinggrounds.txt" map file:_
P 714.6077, -911.3725, -58.4100, 0, 0, 240, 1, cold
P 742.7405, -799.9087, -39.9400, 0, 0, 240, 1, chromatic/prismatic
P 576.6707, -625.3662, -29.5146, 0, 0, 240, 1, magic
P 302.2020, -939.6352, -62.1588, 0, 0, 240, 1, disease/poison
P 384.1714, -609.7662, -63.0402, 0, 0, 240, 1, ranged
P 565.9908, -1110.8364, -62.3940, 0, 0, 240, 1, fire
_In-game /locations:_
_\- Fesik's aura (ranged attacks) spawns on the southwestern platform (600, -385, -63)._
_\- Darlak's aura (fire) spawns on the northeastern platform (1100, -565, -63)._
_\- Nesifi's aura (disease/poison) spawns on the northwestern platform (940, -300, -63)._
_\- Veros' aura (magic) spaws on the southeastern platform (625, -575, -29)._
_\- Elsa`Ker's aura (cold) spawns on an east-central platform (910, -715, -58)._
_\- Isia`Ker's aura (chromatic/prismatic) spawns on an east-central platform (800, -745, 39)._
_NOTE: During the air phase, Zalikor has one emote-based attack:_
Zalikor aims its fiery breath toward \_\_\_\_\_.
_Shortly after this emote, Zalikor does a location-based AE in the location where the player was standing at the time of the emote, which also knocks back anyone standing in the location:_
Fire Blast: Single Target, Unresistable (-960)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 55000
_At 30%, the flying phase ends and Zalikor goes back to the ground. This is the same fight as from 100%-70% (including the crystal eggs)._
_Kill him to update this step._
Zalikor, Devourer of Dragons has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Zalikor, Devourer of Dragons's corpse goes limp as it crashes to the ground, causing the cavern walls to tremor.

---

Take your reward from the Dragonbone Chest 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
You have defeated Zalikor, the cannibalistic fear dragon.

_This task is the first in a series of four. It is a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Gevani Willowsprite ( map) in Evantil, the Vile Oak. He's found at -590, 3, 2. This is at the base of the tree, just west of the ramp that leads upwards from the ground level._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Gevani Willowsprite'
Gevani Willowsprite says 'Nature cries out to me. This land has become corrupted. The pain this land is feeling saddens me to my very core. You must help me find a way to [cleanse] the evil that has taken hold here!'
You say, 'Cleanse the evil?'
Gevani Willowsprite says 'When a fragment of the fear shard struck this area, this vile oak grew from the tainted land. In turn, it continues to spawn fear and evil, corrupting all creatures that dwell here. I am getting ahead of myself however. Let's start with something simple. I would like for you to help me with an [experiment].'
You say, 'Experiment?'
Gevani Willowsprite says 'The [seeds] of the fear fruit that the vile oak produces can grow into a myriad of various, fear-tainted creatures. Should we plant some seeds into some of the various fungus patches that grow about, I wonder what effect, if any, that a blessed mixture of fungus food would have on the seeds.'
You say, 'Seeds?'
Gevani Willowsprite says 'Collect some fear fruit seeds from any of the creatures that inhabit this area and plant them in the various patches of fungus in the wilderness outside of the tree. Once the seeds have been planted, add this [blessed fungus food] mixture to the fungus patch. The fungus food should greatly accelerate the germination of the seeds, and hopefully the blessing placed upon the fungus food will produce a normal, healthy fungus man. If you somehow misplace your fungus food just let me [know] and I can give you some more.'
_You receive 8x "Blessed Fungus Food"._
You have been assigned the task 'Fun with Fungus'.
A druid named Gevani Willowsprite would like for you to perform an experiment for him to see how corrupted the lands surrounding Evantil, the Vile Oak, have become.

She has a knack for getting into trouble and I haven't seen her lately.'

Bally has eaten fear fruit from Evantil, Heart of the Oak and is surely doomed unless a cure can be found.

_This task is the fourth in a series of four. It is a solo task that begins with Yioan in Beasts' Domain. This is an Alaran found at -620, 2755, 10 (due south of Kalda and Mea Treg who are in the zone's northwestern corner)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Fun with Fungus"
\- Completed "What a Mess"
\- Completed "Forbidden Fruit"
You say, 'Hail, Yioan'
Yioan says, in Alaran, 'Thank you for coming. I did indeed wish to speak with you. I don't condone how you killed my people in Evantil, however, I do understand that they are hopeless and need to be put out of their misery. You should at least know how they came to be known as the [wretched]. We owe them that at least.'
You say, 'What about the wretched?'
Yioan says, in Alaran, 'When the fear shard struck the area now known as Evantil, the Vile Oak, several members of our tribe ventured out to see what had happened. They never returned. They saw the forbidden fear fruit growing atop Evantil and tasted its nectar. From then on they were hopelessly addicted to its [debilitating effects].'
You say, 'What debilitating effects?'
Yioan says, in Alaran, 'The fear fruit contains the essence of pure fear and those that consume it are unable to resist what it does to their bodies and minds. The grasp of fear overtakes and consumes them, making them want more and more of the fruit, until they are left a paranoid, fearful shell of their once former selves. It can also mutate the body, making it change into a form more appropriate for the Plane of Fear, than for our plane. Although one of our clan members has made strides in providing temporary relief from the fruit, more has to be done. We need a [cure]. They say it's impossible, but nothing is impossible.'
You say, 'What about a cure?'
Yioan says, in Alaran, 'I would like to analyze the brains of the wretched. Perhaps I can see what chemicals are at play. Unfortunately this means more of the wretched will need to be killed. This is a grisly task, but I fear it is necessary. Will you [help] me?'
You say, 'I will help'
Yioan says, in Alaran, 'I am in your debt. Collect some brains from the wretched, and put them in this brain fluid extractor. Once you have enough brain fluid, return it to me. Try not to lose your brain fluid extractor, but if you do, I will [give] you another one.'
You have been assigned the task 'Searching for a Cure'.
Yioan wants you to collect some brains of the wretched Alarans that dwell within Evantil, the Vile Oak for experimentation to see if a cure can be made to counteract the effects of the fear fruit.
_Upon requesting the task, you receive a "Brain Fluid Extractor"._

---

Kill wretched alarans in Evantil and collect their brains 0/12 (Evantil, the Vile Oak)
Use the Brain Fluid Extractor to obtain Vials of Brain Fluid 0/12 (Evantil, the Vile Oak)
_Kill wretched alarans (found throughout the tree) and place their brains inside the Extractor to produce vials of brain fluid._
_Note: Brains are NOT pre-lootable. They drop maybe once out of every 3-4 kills._
Give the Vials of Brain Fluid to Yioan 0/12 (Beasts' Domain)
Speak with Yioan 0/1 (Beasts' Domain)
You say, 'Hail, Yioan'
Yioan says, in Alaran, 'Thank you. These samples should hopefully help further the study of a cure for the effects of the fear fruit.'
_Rewards:_
300 platinum
Experience (4 AAs + 3-4% exp at Level 96)

_This group mission begins with Yioan in Beasts' Domain. This is an Alaran found at -620, 2755, 10 (due south of Kalda and Mea Treg who are in the zone's northwestern corner)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Fun with Fungus"
\- Completed "What a Mess"
\- Completed "Forbidden Fruit"
\- Completed "Searching for a Cure"
You say, 'Hail, Yioan'
Yioan says, in Alaran, 'The vials of brain fluid you have given me have been put to good use. The elixir I was able to create from researching them does not work exactly as I had hoped, but I believe it can help with preventing those who consume the fear fruit from becoming addicted. You have already done much for me and my people, but I ask that you please help me further. I want you to [test] the elixir. If you wish, we can discuss the [wretched].'
You say, 'How can we test it?'
Yioan says, in Alaran, ''I will not lie to you; this will be very dangerous, but you have proven to me that you are strong. Before you depart to Evantil, you will need to use the elixir I created. It will protect you from becoming addicted to the fear fruit." Yioan hands you the elixir. You carefully swallow a sample of it. It tastes horrible, but does not appear to have any harmful effects. Yioan continues, "When you are ready to depart to Evantil, please let me [know]. When you arrive, find the shaman known as, Waleni. Waleni was once part of our tribe, but is now part of the wretched. Waleni should be able to guide you further.''
You have been assigned the task 'Fear Not'.
Yioan in the Beasts' Domain has made an elixir from the vials of brain fluid you previously collected. The elixir is said to prevent one from becoming addicted to the fear fruit. Yioan wants you to test the elixir by consuming some fear fruit and then speaking with one of the wretched alarans in Evantil, named Waleni.
You say, 'What do you know!'
Yioan says, in Alaran, 'I await your safe return.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Evantil - The Vile Oak.

---

Speak with Waleni 0/1 (Evantil, the Vile Oak)
You say, 'Hail, Waleni'
Waleni says, in Alaran, 'I have foreseen your coming. You are the ones that can help my people. The fear fruit induces visions when consumed, but these are not mere visions. They are apparitions from the Plane of Fear. These spirits have made it known that we are their eternal slaves, and they delight in torturing us. You must [destroy] them.'
_Note: The task locks at this point._
You say, 'We will destroy them'
Waleni says, in Alaran, ''You will need to consume this fear fruit before you will be able to see the visions of fear.' Waleni gives you a large fear fruit. You reluctantly eat it and immediately a feeling of absolute fear overcomes you. Thankfully Yioan's elixir has made it so you will not become addicted. "Seek out the visions of fear throughout Evantil, destroy them, and take their souls. Return to me when you have done so. If you need to return to Yioan in the Beasts' Domain, I can [transport] you there.''
_Task Window Says:_ Waleni wants you to kill six visions of fear that only appear to those who have consumed fear fruit. Waleni hopes that by defeating those visions, the wretched can be saved from the vile effects of the fear fruit. Defeat Aphomat, Obapeth, Xartabta, Erotoz, Atbius, and Soziel, and collect their souls.

_This group mission begins with Yioan in Beasts' Domain. This is an Alaran found at -620, 2755, 10 (due south of Kalda and Mea Treg who are in the zone's northwestern corner)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Fun with Fungus"
\- Completed "What a Mess"
\- Completed "Forbidden Fruit"
\- Completed "Searching for a Cure"
\- Completed "Fear Not" (mission)
You say, 'Hail, Yioan'
Yioan says, in Alaran, 'We have discovered much about the effects of the fear fruit. Now I would ask you to go into the heart of the great tree and see if you can stop, or at least slow, the influence of the fear shard on Evantil. I have discovered that there is a beast guarding the shard. It is a nest, of sorts, infested with ants. This beast bathes in the power of the shard and its ants infest the tree and pollinate the fruit with fear. [Kill the nest] and the ants, if you can, and I am sure that the influence of fear will be reduced. If this is too dangerous for you, another [test] of the elixir would help me understand the [wretched] better.'
You say, 'Kill the nest?'
Yioan says, in Alaran, 'It is dangerous and you most certainly will need a lot of assistance. You have proven yourself brave already, so if this proves too dangerous, you should not feel obliged to assist us. But if you have enough allies to mount a true raid and are [willing], simply let me know. If you have only a smaller group, there is may be something you can do to [assist].'
You say, 'We will assist you'
Yioan says, in Alaran, 'I am pleased to hear this. When you and your allies are [ready] to go, tell me and I shall transport you to Evantil. Be wary, though. It may know of your presence and employ hearty defenses to prevent your entry.'
You have been assigned the task 'Evantil: Heart of the Oak'.
In order to reduce the effect of the fear shard on the great oak, you have been asked to destroy the beast that houses the ants at the heart of the oak. Those ants are the key to the 'pollination' of the fruit with the power of fear.
Getting past the defenses into the tree will require defeating the molars. Yioan reminded you that trees generally do not like fire.
You say, 'Ready!'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Evantil - The Vile Oak.

---

Destroy the Nest Protector and the aggressive ants in the Heart of the Oak 0/1 (Evantil, the Vile Oak)
**Part 1: The Molars**
_Run up the ramp and into the tree to trigger the event. (Whoever triggers it will be ported to the zone-in, but can run back.)_
The tree seems to come to life with a great exhalation. Embers spring to life in old campfires as leaves swirl around your feet.
_At the top of the ramp leading into the tree are two treants: "Molar" and "Impacted Molar". You need to kill the two treants while also killing the adds that spawn. The Molars each hit for a max ~18,000; are permanently rooted; do not summon; and are only susceptible to melee damage and fire-based nukes/DOTs._
_As long as the Molars are alive, adds will be spawning and auto-aggro'ing your group (these adds have cross-zone aggro and will seek you out wherever you may be). You'll get one add every 60-90 seconds. Adds hit for a max ~12,500._
_To help deal with the adds and the Molars, you can get a fire damage proc by running over one of the two campfires across the canyon. The buff is called "Up In Flames", but also has a DOT component to it. This buff is not necessary if you have enough DPS on your own._
Up In Flames: Single Target, Unresistable (0) _(90 seconds)_
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 4000 per tick
4: Add Proc: Touch of Flame rate mod 150
_Note that if you try to pass the Molars while they are still alive (or any adds are still alive), you will be ported to the zone-in:_
A great gust of moldy wind flings you from the heights.
_You can melee the Molars without being kicked away, but have to stay in front of them._
_In addition to the Molars and adds, you will also have oozes called "a drop of sap" spawning in the area. These are non-aggro and not killable, and have an aura around them, so you will want to avoid stepping in them:_
Sapping Strength: Single Target, Unresistable (0) _(3 ticks)_
1: Decrease Spell Haste by 50%
2: Limit: Combat Skills Not Allowed
3: Decrease Movement by 80%
4: Inhibit Melee Attacks by (50%)
_If the Molars are left idle, you'll get emotes warning of a reset:_
The molars blocking the entrance to the great tree grow strong as they stand idle.
A creaking sounds preceeds a great, warm wind. All of your efforts are swept away and things return to normal within the great oak.
_Once the Molars and all adds are dead, you can move up into the tree._
Impacted Molar has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Molar has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
The unnerving breathing from the great tree stops. Things become eerily quiet.
**Part 2: The Nest Protector**
_The main encounter here, "Nest Protector" spawns on the second floor of the tree (see this image for The Ant Queen \-\- the Nest Protector is found in the larger of the two rooms on the tree's second floor)._
_Along the way to this location, you'll see numerous ants ("an ant soldier"). These don't see invisibility and don't factor into the task's progression, so you can invis past them if you want. You can also clear them as they don't have many hitpoints and don't hit too hard (~7,000). Don't pull them from a distance, however, as they will sometimes warp around. If they aggro the Nest Protector and you are not there to engage it, the task will reset to the beginning._
_In the group mission, the Nest Protector has a standard aggro range, so you can set up and prepare just outside its room._
_The Nest Protector hits for a max ~16,000 and single-target rampages. It casts:_
Forceful Explosion: PB AE 35', Magic (-800)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 20000
Life Harvest: Single Target, Poison (-950)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 34000
_It spawns adds (1x "an aggressive ant" at a time: mezzable; stunnable; hits for a max ~10,000). You will get one add on engage and more adds as the fight goes on. It's not confirmed whether these adds are timed or if they are based on the health of the Nest Protector, but as few as 10 adds and as many as 12 (in total) have been reported, so they may be timed. If they are timed, they appear at a rate of one every 10-15 seconds (perhaps up to a maximum number of spawns alive at once). These adds have a fair amount of hitpoints, so crowd control appears to be the best option, rather than killing them as they spawn._
_Oozes occasionally spawn, with the aura "Sappy Slime":_
Sappy Slime: Single Target, Unresistable (0)
1: Decrease CHA by 40
3: Decrease Movement by 40%
_There is an aura that circles the perimeter of the room, "a spore cloud". If you get caught in it, you get the debuff "Pollination" which leads to "Explosive Sneeze":_
Pollination: Single Target, Poison (-800)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 1500 per tick _(4 ticks)_
2: Increase Disease Counter by 50
3: Trigger Effect: Explosive Sneeze on Fade _(knockback + nuke for 17,500 hp)_
_Around the room are five flower mobs called "a mantrap". These will target random players and pull them to their location, inflicting them with "Flowery Grasp" (holds them in position and an indefinite silence). In order to free the player, that particular mantrap needs to be killed (mantraps have relatively few hitpoints). Note that these instantly respawn._
Flowery Grasp: Single Target, Unresistable (-10000)
1: Slow Push (-300)
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 5000 per tick
3: Amnesia (Silence vs Melee Effect)
4: Silence
_Kill the Nest Protector and all aggressive ants to update this task step. Note: The task locks upon the death of the last ant or the Nest Protector (whichever is killed last)._
**About Wipeouts & Resets**
_If you wipe out on the Molar phase, you will need to drop the task and get a new one (the auto-aggro adds keep spawning even after Molars reset, effectively preventing in-zone CR)._
_If you wipe out while the Nest Protector is still alive, you will have to repeat the entire task (including the Molars)._
_If you wipe out after the Nest Protector is dead, but aggressive ants are still alive, the event does NOT reset (they simply keep leashing themselves to the room). You can CR and move in to kill the ants after rezzing and rebuffing._

_This task is the first in a series of six. It's a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Reena Kedson ( map) in Grelleth's Palace, the Chateau of Filth. She is located at 1200, 265, 0 (zone-in area)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Reena Kedson'
Reena Kedson says '\_\_\_\_\_? Nice to see you. I hope you're here to help us out. These Fear Shards are causing more trouble than we expected. Still, I've had enough of these Alaran gods. We have enough trouble with the Norrathian ones. Let's put an end to this together, as one people. And we have a [plan].'
You say, 'What plan?'
Reena Kedson says 'It's simple. In theory. First, gather [information] on our enemies. Second, we'll have to take out the [scouts] and any other [defenses]. Then, after we gain [access], we'll have to deal with the palace [forces], and recover any [clues] as to their further plans.'
You say, 'What information?'
Reena Kedson says 'First, you'll need to talk to each member of the Valley Expedition so you're up to date. After that, we'll need you out on the field finding what you can. When you are ready, talk to me first.'
You have been assigned the task 'Rise of the Swinetor'.
Gather information about Grelleth and her army. Details about the swinetor's advance will be crucial to the success of the expedition.

---

Talk with Reena Kedson 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_This opens up the next five steps. All the hail NPCs are found at the zone-in area (note: Relco is a little ways from the pack, northwest)._
Consult with Ain Kavus 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
You say, 'Hail, Ain Kavus'
Ain Kavus says '\_\_\_\_\_, it's good to see you. Thanks to you and your people, my home of Sarith is seeing freedom and safety again. And now, we'll deal with this new threat together as well. The swinetor have never been this bold to my knowledge. This source of Fear is going to put Alaris and all of Norrath in danger.'
Consult with Marrien Kavus 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
You say, 'Hail, Marrien Kavus'
Marrien Kavus says 'Ain and I consider it an honor to work with the Norrathians against this new threat. The swinetor are generally stupid, but they are strong. We may need to test our mettle against their main forces guarding the palace. Just a skirmish. We can't launch a full attack yet.'
Consult with Jaris Calmur 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
You say, 'Hail, Jaris Calmur'
Jaris Calmur says '\_\_\_\_\_, Reena mentioned you'd be over. That disgusting fortress of refuse is locked up tighter than you would think. They have powerful necromancers and decay priests, as well as brutal warriors, keeping it defended. I think the scouts are the key though. See what you can find on them.'
Consult with Sherri Ganes 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
You say, 'Hail, Sherri Ganes'
Sherri Ganes says 'These swinetor are disgusting, \_\_\_\_\_. Have you seen that lake and the piles of refuse? I think we can find some clues in there, though. I'm going back out shortly, so let's keep an eye out for anything that might give us some more information on them. Try to keep your lunch down, if you can.'
Consult with Relco Finn 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
You say, 'Hail, Relco Finn'
Relco Finn says 'Oh? So you're \_\_\_\_\_, huh? All these others keep talkin' about you. Anyway, what we really need to do is see if we can sneak inside and find anything useful. Uh, that's all you though. I'm busy out here.'
Find information on swinetor scouts 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Kill palace scouts until you get this update._
a palace scout has a tattered note on it. You take it. It's signed by a Turo, and shows instructions on how the scouts should start to spread out over Sarith and start looking up for places to put outposts and camps in the Beast's Domain. This looks serious.
Find information on swinetor palace guards 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Kill palace guards until you get this update._
a palace guard has a muddy notice tucked into its belt. You remove it. Someone named Zurel has ordered the guards to be on alert for intruders, and shows hints of a push up towards the expedition camp. Reena and the others should hear about this.
Search the polluted lake for information 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_A "Filth-Encrusted Note" is a ground spawn at 2435, 1200, 14 (southeastern coast of the lake). It appears as a scroll on the ground. Right-click it for the update._
The note reads, 'Turo ordered me to take care of pushing back the idiots who have trespassed into our new, much more improved valley. Alarans and Norrathians both. Lelri and Lelro have brought extra beasts to start doing raids. Grab more food during these. Swinetor warriors, I'll get to the point: It's time to smash! - Gulta the Filthy.'
Search the junk piles outside the palace 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_"Wuran's Decree" is a ground spawn at 4160, 25, 110 (south of the palace's entrance ramp). It appears as a book on the ground. Right-click it for the update._
The decree reads, 'Swinetor, fellow worshippers of Sholoth: I will be preparing wards with the help of the necromancers and Kotul to guard us from this expedition that threatens our queen and our eventual domination of this world. We will win, because of Grelleth's power, and because of Sholoth's favor. For Sholoth, Wuran.'
Search the palace entrance for documents 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_"Kotul's Journal Page" is a ground spawn at 5185, -70, 200 (just inside the palace, due north of the doorway that opens into the first big room). It appears as an open book on the ground. Right-click it for the update._
The torn page reads, 'Even the stupidest of my fellow swinetor realize what this new move means. I don't know how it is my mother managed to get this power, but I know it is exactly what we've been waiting for. Zurel has the palace under control, her guards patrolling the corridors regularly at my insistence. This expedition on our doorstep won't be enough to stop us. As for the plans moving forward -.' The rest is cut off.
Report to Reena Kedson 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
You say, 'Hail, Reena Kedson'
Reena Kedson says 'So, Grelleth and her offspring are ready to move. I was afraid of this. I was hoping we'd have more time. Turo is her youngest, is in charge of sending the scouts out. Lelri and Lelro are twins, and are in charge of the beasts. Wuran is the priest of decay who handles palace protection with his sister Zurel, a fighter who organizes the palace guards. That leaves Kotul, her elder son, apparently brilliant for a swinetor and a necromancer to boot. Heh. This is going to make all that business in Windsong Sanctuary look like a treat.'
You've gathered a significant amount of information about Grelleth and her offspring: Turo, Wuran, Lelri, Lelro, Zurel, and Kotul. The expedition will need additional help to have any hope against the swinetor threat.
_Rewards:_
150 platinum
Experience (2 AAs)

_This task is the second in a series of six. It's a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Reena Kedson ( map) in Grelleth's Palace, the Chateau of Filth. She is located at 1200, 265, 0 (zone-in area)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Rise of the Swinetor"
You say, 'Hail, Reena Kedson'
Reena Kedson says '\_\_\_\_\_? Nice to see you. I hope you're here to help us out. These Fear Shards are causing more trouble than we expected. Still, I've had enough of these Alaran gods. We have enough trouble with the Norrathian ones. Let's put an end to this together, as one people. And we have a [plan].'
You say, 'What plan?'
Reena Kedson says 'It's simple. In theory. First, gather [information] on our enemies. Second, we'll have to take out the [scouts] and any other [defenses]. Then, after we gain [access], we'll have to deal with the palace [forces], and recover any [clues] as to their further plans.'
You say, 'Scouts?'
Reena Kedson says 'They are becoming a serious threat. We can't get reinforcements or resources into this valley with them skulking around and launching ambushes. See if you can find any information on this Turo. We'll need to find him. If you come across anything, let Ain know.'
You have been assigned the task 'Dirty Tactics'.
The scouts are causing trouble for the expedition, and they are the forefront for the swinetor advance. You'll need to help the expedition for them to have any chance.
Learn what Turo is having the scouts do. Defeat scouts until you find information.

---

Find information on Turo from the scouts 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_This is a random update from killing palace scouts (all over the outside of the zone)._
a palace scout gasps as they clutch their wounds. 'No more pain! Gulta you want! Turo needs Gulta to spread swinetor power! Turo hides in palace!'

---

Speak to Ain Kavus 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Task Window Says:_ It appears Gulta the Filthy is the lynchpin in the forward assault since Turo refuses to show himself as of late. Return to Ain Kavus with your findings.
_Ain Kavus ( map) is at the expedition camp._
You say, 'Hail, Ain Kavus'
Ain Kavus says 'It looks like Gulta the Filthy is our primary target. Turo is relying on Gulta to keep the scouts advancing. We can use this to our advantage. You should speak to Relco, he was working on ideas to lay traps and ambushes for the swinetor.'

---

Find out Relco's plan 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Relco ( map) is a little ways east of the expedition camp._
You say, 'Hail, Relco Finn'
Relco Finn says 'Oh? So this is about Gulta, right? She's a pig. Literally and metaphorically. I've seen her doing the rounds near the polluted lake, and she's always eating some filthy thing or another. Well, I got the plan to lure her out. Let's make a swinetor's favorite meal. Take this pot and fill it with the water they use for cooking out of that disgusting lake. Then add some bear meat, I think the quartermaster has some. When you're ready, lay it out near the lake. Good luck. I'll be staying here.'
_You receive an Empty Rusty Stew Pot._

---

Create a rotting feast 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Task Window Says:_ Gulta is known for her appetite. Craft a special swinetor feast to lure her out and ambush her. Fill the pot with water from the polluted lake outside Grelleth's Palace. Then, cook it with bear meat at an oven. There is an oven near the quartermaster, you recall, near the expedition team. The quartermaster was also selling bear meat.
_Go to the polluted lake and right-click the pot there to fill it with polluted water (changes to "Filthy Water-Filled Stew Pot"):_
You fill the pot with the filthy polluted water.
_Then with it, combine "Bear Meat" (sold by the quartermaster NPC at the zone-in) in an oven (next to the quartermaster) to produce a "Rotting Feast"._

---

Go to the polluted lake with the rotting feast 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Right-click the Rotting Feast at the lake:_
You lay out the cooked, rotting food.
_This spawns Gulta the Filthy, who needs to be killed._
Gulta the Filthy squeals, 'A trap! I'll kill you anyway, then take that lovely food!'
Defeat Gulta the Filthy 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Gulta the Filthy hits for a max ~13,500. While she doesn't have any special AEs or abilities, she is a Necromancer and sometimes casts Necro snare spells (pullers beware)._
_Note: Only one "Gulta the Filthy" can be alive at a time, so if another group has spawned her, you'll have to wait until they kill her before you can spawn her yourself._
Gulta the Filthy has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Gulta the Filthy's corpse falls to the ground, hand outstretched towards the putrid smelling rotted feast.
_Upon her death, Turo appears briefly, but does not aggro._
Turo says 'You aren't as clever as you think. I've been watching you the whole time. The first opportunity I get, I will drive this blade into your eye. But I'll fight on my own terms.'

---

Report to Reena Kedson 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Task Window Says:_ Turo is not pleased with your actions, but Reena should be. Report your success to her in the valley of filth outside Grelleth's Palace.
You say, 'Hail, Reena Kedson'
Reena Kedson says 'With Gulta gone, Turo is going to stay hidden in the castle like the coward he is. The scouts are not going to be much of a threat anymore. However, we've still got other things to deal with. I know, no rest for the legendary hero, right \_\_\_\_\_?'
The scout advancement has been halted, but Grelleth and Turo won't give up easily. The expedition will still need help.
_Rewards:_
187 platinum, 5 gold
Experience

_This task is the fourth in a series of six. It's a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Reena Kedson ( map) in Grelleth's Palace, the Chateau of Filth. She is located at 1200, 265, 0 (zone-in area)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Rise of the Swinetor"
\- Completed "Dirty Tactics"
\- Completed "Double Trouble"
You say, 'Hail, Reena Kedson'
Reena Kedson says '\_\_\_\_\_\_? Nice to see you. I hope you're here to help us out. These Fear Shards are causing more trouble than we expected. Still, I've had enough of these Alaran gods. We have enough trouble with the Norrathian ones. Let's put an end to this together, as one people. And we have a [plan].'
You say, 'Plan?'
Reena Kedson says 'It's simple. In theory. First, gather [information] on our enemies. Second, we'll have to take out the [scouts] and any other [defenses]. Then, after we gain [access], we'll have to deal with the palace [forces], and recover any [clues] as to their further plans.'
You say, 'Access?'
Reena Kedson says 'The minute we gain a foothold, they pull out another barrier. This time of the magical variety. It looks like Wuran, a priest of decay and Grelleth's son, has established a magical perimeter that very shortly we won't be able to pierce. I've got Jaris working on this, but he's going to need help. I'm recommending you.'
You have been assigned the task 'Halt the Decay'
Jarius Calmur has reported to Reena that after your initial successes, Grelleth's priests of decay have set up wards, under her son Wuran's direction. These will prevent any further attacks on the palace by any sizable force without incurring casualties. You'll need to get rid of the wards.

---

Discuss the wards with Jaris 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Hail Jaris Calmur ( map), also in the expedition camp._
You say, 'Hail, Jaris Calmur'
Jaris Calmur says 'I informed Reena, but the wards that Wuran and the other decay priests and necromantic filthcasters have put up are alarmingly strong. It's made effective against both Alaran and Norrathian, but those swinetor will never feel the effects. I can dispel them, but I'd need some source of their magic. Can I count on you for that?'
Jaris Calmur says 'Our plans will be perfect. We can't afford to make mistakes with magic this powerful.'

---

Defeat swinetor filthcasters and decay priests 0/3 (Grelleth's Palace)
Recover a swinetor magical trinket and give it to Jaris Calmur 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Task Window Says:_ Kill the filthcasters and priests setting up the wards. Retrieve magical trinkets found in the upper floors of the palace for Jaris to form a countermeasure to the wards.
_The kill targets are found throughout the outdoor area and in the palace._
_The trinkets are found in the upper floor of the palace (scattered as ground spawns). Known spawn points:_
5815, -330, 402 (in a room just outside of Kelmur the Quartermaster's area on the second floor)
6645, 185, 413 (in the small dead end room with bookcases)
6640, 200, 413 (in the small dead end room with bookcases)
6420, 60, 395 (in a room full of rusted barrels and equipment)
6285, 345, 400 (on a slanted table)
6175, 280, 400 (on a flat table)
_Upon turn-in:_
Jaris Calmur says 'Here is the wardbreaker. A fine piece of magical craftsmanship if I do say so myself. I couldn't have done it without you, of course. Take it up to the palace and use it near the entrance. That should shatter every ward in that so-called palace.'
_You receive a "Ward Breaker"._

---

Use the ward breaker near the palace entrance 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Task Window Says:_ Use the custom designed Ward Breaker made by Jaris to destroy the wards. Use it by the palace.
_Right-click the breaker by the palace entrance._
Jaris' ward breaker device emits a flash of energy and flickers appear all around the palace as the wards are dispelled. You hear a frantic, irritated voice in your head, 'So you can destroy my precious wards. But you still won't win! Sholoth is on our side. For Sholoth and Grelleth!'
Give your report to Reena Kedson 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
You say, 'Hail, Reena Kedson'
Reena Kedson says '\_\_\_\_\_, you never fail to impress. With their magical defenses gone, the swinetor are going to get desperate. I think it's time to stop with the guerellia strikes and hit them hard. What do you say?'
Wuran's wards are destroyed and the priests and filthcasters halted. The campaign against the swinetor has achieved a significant victory. Wuran, however, is not pleased.
_Rewards:_
150 platinum
Experience
