You say, 'Hail, Reena Kedson'
Reena Kedson says '\_\_\_\_\_? Nice to see you. I hope you're here to help us out. These Fear Shards are causing more trouble than we expected. Still, I've had enough of these Alaran gods. We have enough trouble with the Norrathian ones. Let's put an end to this together, as one people. And we have a [plan].'
You say, 'What plan?'
Reena Kedson says 'It's simple. In theory. First, gather [information] on our enemies. Second, we'll have to take out the [scouts] and any other [defenses]. Then, after we gain [access], we'll have to deal with the palace [forces], and recover any [clues] as to their further plans.'
You say, 'What about the forces?'
Reena Kedson says 'We're ready for our first real attack. We need to take out a few of the more powerful swinetor that Grelleth commands, and, if possible, Zurel as well. Zurel is the eldest daughter and taking her out would be just the break we need. Sherri has a list of others we need to take care of as well. Go talk to her when you can, and we'll be ready.'
You have been assigned the task 'Raw Aggression'.
Zurel, a skilled warrior in control of the soldiers that serve Grelleth, now no longer has any external defenses. Bring the fight directly to her most valued minions to leave her without a coordinated attack force.
Sherri has information on the targets. Speak to her at the expedition camp.

---

Attend Sherri Ganes' briefing 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Hail Sherri Ganes ( map), also in the expedition camp._
You say, 'Hail, Sherri Ganes'
Sherri Ganes says 'Reena sent you? Great, let's get started. We know Zurel runs the palace defenses with an iron fist. With Wuran's wards down, she's going to be relying even more on her top swinetor. That includes Gorvna, the jailer, who guards the expedition members they've captured among others. Kelmur, the quartermaster, who has succeed in collecting way too many quality Alaran weapons. And Pulq, the Beast Master, who organizes the creature oriented palace defenses. Take them out, along with as many palace guards as you can. We'll be dealing with the other targets while you remove those three.'

---

Take out palace guards 0/3 (Grelleth's Palace)
Eliminate Gorvna the Jailer 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Eliminate Kelmur the Quartermaster 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Eliminate Pulq the Beastmaster 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Task Window Says:_ Eliminate the swinetor Zurel feels is key to the palace defense. Gorvna can likely be found near the jail. Kelmur oversees weapon maintenance so look for racks of weapons. Pulq was last seen near the filthy water pits in the palace by a scout.
_Gorvna ( map) is located on the second floor jail at about 6175, 730, 290 (northwestern part of the palace's second floor). She casts "Filth Blast":_
Filth Blast: Unknown(32) 100', Disease (-900)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 22500
_Kelmur ( map) is located on the top floor at 5870, -270, 400 (in the large room south of the throne room). He casts "Swinetor Tackle":_
Swinetor Tackle: Single Target, (-200)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 25000
_Pulq ( map) is located in the lower floor of the palace at about 5625, -300, -30 (eastern part of the basement that leads into the large circular room). He casts "Whip & Spin":_
Whip & Spin: Single Target, (-200)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 25000
2: SpinStun

---

Report to Reena 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
You say, 'Hail, Reena Kedson'
Reena Kedson says 'Great to see you back alive. This means we're almost ready for an all-out attack. But there is one thing we need to make sure of, first. We have to make sure we find out what they're up to, to make certain they aren't expecting us. If we don't take out Grelleth's son Kotul, and especially Grelleth herself, we may just be delaying another swinetor uprising. Knowledge is strength, as Jaris is fond of saying.'
Your first strike has eliminated several key Swinetor. However, Zurel is still at large and the fight is not over.
Reena Kedson says 'Where is Relco? I can't keep watching him to keep him out of trouble.'

150 platinum

_This task is the sixth in a series of six. It's a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Reena Kedson ( map) in Grelleth's Palace, the Chateau of Filth. She is located at 1200, 265, 0 (zone-in area)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Rise of the Swinetor"
\- Completed "Dirty Tactics"
\- Completed "Double Trouble
\- Completed "Halt of Decay"
\- Completed "Raw Aggression"
You say, 'Hail, Reena Kedson'
Reena Kedson says '\_\_\_\_\_? Nice to see you. I hope you're here to help us out. These Fear Shards are causing more trouble than we expected. Still, I've had enough of these Alaran gods. We have enough trouble with the Norrathian ones. Let's put an end to this together, as one people. And we have a [plan].'
You say, 'What plan?'
Reena Kedson says 'It's simple. In theory. First, gather [information] on our enemies. Second, we'll have to take out the [scouts] and any other [defenses]. Then, after we gain [access], we'll have to deal with the palace [forces], and recover any [clues] as to their further plans.'
You say, 'What clues?'
Reena Kedson says 'We're almost ready for an all out attack. But this is the perfect time to find out the scope of their true plans before we do. I need you to infiltrate the palace and see what you can find out. We'll keep the swinetor busy while you do.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Art of War'.
The Swinetor are on their heels. Find out what you can about Grelleth and her chief advisor Kotul.
The swinetor plans will likely be kept in the room of scavenged spell books and scrolls that Kotul and the necromancers use. The prisoners will be held in the dungeons or locked in cells.

---

Dispatch swinetor that get in the way 0/3 (Grelleth's Palace)
Find a swinetor map and give it to Reena Kedson 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_This is a ground spawn in the northwestern part of the palace's top floor: 6650, 190, 417 (last room in the northwest part of top floor, on a shelf)._
Reena Kedson says 'What'd you find? This map. It's outlined to a degree I'd expect from a proper military strategist, not some muck-dwelling swinetor. I'll have Jaris analyze this for the details. Short story, not that I need to tell you, but it's got a full on invasion plan, including taking Sarith and eventually Argath.'
Find the expedition prisoners the swinetor captured 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Hail an expedition prisoner ( map) in the jail (northwestern part of the palace's second floor)._
You say, 'Hail, an expedition prisoner'
an expedition prisoner says 'Thanks, I owe you for the rescue. I can get out by myself, don't worry. More importantly, you need to tell Ain and Reena about what happened. Kotul, Grelleth's son, is organizing a full-scale invasion. He's even practicing some dark magic using his mother's fear crystal that could summon an army of undead and shadow creatures. We are running out of time. I'll free the others, you worry about getting that information into the right hands.'
Tell Reena Kedson everything you've learned 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
You say, 'Hail, Reena Kedson'
Reena Kedson says 'This is disturbing. We can't wait any longer. Grelleth's army is going to sweep over this continent if we don't do something. Alright, talk with Ain. He's coordinating the large scale movements. Leading a band of peaceful civillians into a successful uprising is the kind of leadership I can respect.'
You have plans, maps, and information, but none of it is good. Grelleth will be need to be stopped if Alaris and Norrath are to be protected.
_Rewards:_
112 platinum, 5 gold
Experience

\- Completed "Rise of the Swinetor"

\- Completed "Raw Aggression"

You say, 'Hail, Ain Kavus'
Ain Kavus says '\_\_\_\_\_, Reena has told me all that you have done to prepare our forces for the attack on the Chateau of Filth. Now I must call upon you again, gather together a small [strike force] and we shall begin our assault!'
You say, 'I have a strike force'
Ain Kavus says 'Let me know when you are [ready] to depart.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Machinations of Kotul'.
Ain has asked you to help defeat the forces of Queen Grelleth. Their defense within the palace have prevented us from mounting a full-scale offensive, and your task is to infiltrate with a smaller force to disrupt them.
You say, 'Ready!'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...

---

Consult with Ain Kavus before entering the palace 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_NOTE: The task locks upon this hail._
You say, 'Hail, Ain Kavus'
Ain Kavus says 'This will not be an easy task. I have sent troops to find alternate ways into this palace. I cannot guess how long it will take, but I'm certain that they will arrive. Work in concert with them or it is unlikely that you will survive. Now move forward quickly, I have unlocked the door before us, but I cannot promise that it will remain unlocked for long.'

---

Defeat the Swinetor defenses 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Defeat Turo 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Task Window Says:_ The main difficulty your smaller force will probably encounter will be the main force guarding the foyer. Ain will be sending you help, so make the best use of it.
_Enter the foyer and aggro the two scouts there:_
a scout says 'Intruder! Intruder! Intruder!'
a scout says 'Intruder! Intruder! Intruder!'
a scout shouts 'Oink!'
a scout shouts 'By the smell in my snout! Run!'
a bandit shouts 'You idiot! Your butt won't fit behind that! Hide someplace better.'
a bandit shouts 'You're the idiot! Stop shouting when we're trying to ambush the bad guys!'
_Soon after this, several Alarans join you to help:_
a soldier shouts 'Finally we have won through! Now to destroy the enemy!'
a wind warrior shouts 'I have never before smelled such a stench! Dying for a cause is better than being forced to crawl through those rotted crevasses again!'
_The Alarans will attack the Swinetor around the room, including the flingers on the balcony, who will hitting random players with the spell "Rotten Fleshbomb" until they are killed:_
Rotten Fleshbomb: Targeted AE 30', Prismatic (-700)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 5500
_The Alarans will kill the flingers while you focus on the bandits and brutes down below. Once the flingers are dead, Turo appears on the balcony and blinds everyone in the zone:_
a soldier shouts 'We have defeated these scum up here! We shall forge ahead and begin dealing with the rest!'
Turo shouts 'Aha! Time to clean up a bit of this mess!'
a soldier shouts 'What is this? Darkness? Darkness is the tool of cowards!'
Turo shouts 'Now for you, whatever you are! My magic isn't going to be able to kill you like it does those skinny rats, but it should be good enough!'
You are completely disoriented!
Billowing Smog: Targeted AE 300', Unresistable (0)
1: Blindness (1)
2: Shadowstep
_This causes all remaining Swinetor mobs to aggro you (plus 3-4 additional Swinetor that spawn in the adjacent hallway and charge you). These mobs are all mezzable._
_For a short time, Turo does "Knife Toss" at random:_
Knife Toss: Directional 0', Chromatic (-500)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 13000
2: Stun (2.00 sec)
_Not long after, you will see this emote and Turo will leave the scene (you don't actually kill him), updating the "Defeat Turo" step:_
Turo shouts 'Hrm... I've run out of knives. I'm certainly not coming down there to dirty my hands with your blood. Besides, I have siblings and servants to do that for me. Get 'em boys! Goodbye, fools!'
_Kill all remaining Swinetor to update the "defenses" step._
Pick up the scroll that Turo dropped when he left 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Pick up "A Tear-Stained Note", left on the ground at /way +5413,-86,+292 in Turo's place. It reads:
You rely too much on others to do your dirty work for you. You need to understand that their failure is your failure. I left our front line defenses to you, and you have proven weak and cowardly. I know how much you are frightened by almost anything, and it is embarrassing to me. Your example to your siblings and my people is intolerable. You have much to prove, child. Don't return to me until you have made up for your failures.

---

Defeat the twins Lelro and Lelri 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Task Window Says:_ Ain warned you that the twins Lelri and Lelro are masters with beasts. Their interference with supply lines and reinforcements needs to be reduced.
_Head upstairs into the dining room where you'll find several rats. Kill the rats to spawn Lelri and Lelro in the south end of the room (they are not auto-aggro)._
_Lelri and Lelro each hit for a max ~9,000. They must be kept balanced within 20% health of each other, and separated 50'+ range from each other. If they fall out of balance, the lower one will heal. If they get too close in range, they set off a large AE (double cast):_
Twinstrike: PB AE 800', (-10000)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 22154 to 27692 (random)
_In addition to the balance and distance, they spawn two oashim adds at 75% and 50% health (adds are mezzable; hit for a max ~7,500)._
_Once they get lower in health, they go non-aggro and leave the room:_
Lelri shouts 'Enough of this, brother. I don't want to play with these things anymore. I'm going to see how mother is doing.'
Lelro shouts 'Okay, brother. Let's get out of here.'
Pick up the scroll that fell from one of the twins when they turned into rats 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Pick up "An Unfinished Note", left on the ground in place of one of the twins. It reads:_
It was all Turo's fault, mother! They poisoned our pets. They could never beat them without some sort of trickery! And you know that Turo is good with poison and stuff like that. Lelro says that our beasts are the best! As soon as the bad people are gone from our house we will have new and stronger beasts for you!

---

Defeat Wuran 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Task Window Says:_ Wuran, according to Ain, is either a complete idiot, or a powerful necromancer. Stories vary wildly. You need to find him and push him back into the palace.
_This encounter takes place in the room opposite the dining room. Kill the five tortured skeletons in the room to make Wuran active. He casts "Wilting Touch":_
Wilting Touch: Targeted AE 0', Poison (-750)
1: Decrease HP when cast by 15000
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 710 per tick
3: Decrease Movement by 50%
4: Decrease Attack Speed by 50%
5: Increase Poison Counter by 13
_He spawns an add ("an enslaved ghost") at 50% health. Kill the add and take Wuran to 35% health for the update._
Zurel shouts 'Stop fooling around, brother. We have no more time for this. mother wishes us to complete Kotul's plan.'
Wuran shouts 'Really? But his plan is so... technical. I'd rather stay here and play more!'
Zurel shouts 'Mother said that she would like to see you, Wuran. She says she misses you very much. Let me clear out these pests and take you to her.'
_At this time, everyone is hit with "Commanding Bellow" (nuke for 4,000 + feign death)._
Zurel shouts 'Come, brother.'
Wuran shouts 'Goodie! Mom will be pleased to know that I made a ghost! A ghost!'
Pick up the scroll that Wuran was reading when you entered 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_"A Crisp Note" is a ground spawn. It reads:_
Brother, we need you to rebuild your wards. There is no time to waste. Please stop playing with your foolish undead and get our defenses restored. I will be sending our sister to encourage you to do so if I do not see any progress very soon.

---

Locate Kotul and see if you can learn anything from him 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Task Window Says:_ Kotul may be the most dangerous of Grelleth's children, if only for his intellect. Ain warns you that an encounter with him may be more than you can handle, but that any efforts you make against him would be helpful.
_Note: Hailing him triggers a named spawn._
You say, 'Hail, Kotul'
Kotul says 'Really? You have been annoying me for this long and you have the audacity to just walk up to me and hail me as if I was some peasant? Well, you would know from peasantry, wouldn't you. I will not deal with you pests myself, I have more to deal with. I do have an idea, though. I shall use you to test one of my newest experiments. Goodbye, fools.'
Defeat the Necromantic Experiment 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_This is an ooze that needs to be killed. Every 80 seconds, a random player gets an emote indicating that they are 10 seconds away from becoming very high on the ooze's hate list. If, after this happens, the ooze gets on top of the player, it leeches itself to the player with a DOT+snare+slow ("Necromantic Drain") and self-buffs with +AC/regen ("Necromantic Boost"):_
Necromantic Drain: Single Target, Unresistable (0)
1: Inhibit Melee Attacks by (75%)
2: Decrease ATK by 550
3: Decrease Movement by 80%
4: Unknown #343 (100/75/0)
5: Decrease Hitpoints by 4000 per tick
Necromantic Boost: Self 0', Unresistable (0)
1: Increase AC by 210
2: Increase Hitpoints by 1000 per tick
3: Mitigate Spell Damage by 40%, 1000000 total
4: Mitigate Melee Damage by 40%, 1000000 total
_In the room are several pools. Each pool has an aura in it (damage debuff for players). However, if the ooze is pushed or positioned in one of these pools, that pool loses its aura and any players affected by the above emote will become unattached._
_Kill the ooze to update this step._
The Necromantic Experiment has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Pick up the scrap of paper that fell from Kotul's robe when he left 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Pick up "A Single Diary Page", which reads:_
If only my siblings were competent. Zurel, at least, is good at what she does, and what she does is extremely useful to me. The others... I can make use of them, but they are not what I really need. Their failure is making mother angry. She takes that anger out of me simply because I'm the only one smart enough to organize this mess. I can't tell her this, but our enemies are stronger than I had expected. I shall have to find a better way to defeat them. If I can only convince mother to lend a little of her newfound power to her children, we should have little problem with the intruders.

Return to Ain with what you have learned 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
You say, 'Hail, Ain Kavus'
Ain Kavus says 'Thank you for your assistance. While you did not destroy the children of filth, you drove them back. This should allow us to get a larger force inside for a deeper strike.'
Open the chest that Ain left for you 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)

You say, 'Hail, Ain Kavus'
Ain Kavus says '\_\_\_\_\_, it is good to see you alive and well. Our first assault on the Chateau of Filth has proved very effective. ---

**Task Steps**
Let Ain Kavus know that you are 'ready' to depart 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Confront Queen Grelleth 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Defeat Turo 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Defeat Lelri and Lelro 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Defeat Wuran 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Defeat Zurel 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Defeat Kotul 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Defeat Grelleth 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Defeat all of Grelleth's remaining minions 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Claim your rewards from Grelleth's pile of refuse 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)

---


---

**Summary**
\- Say 'ready' to zone in.
\- Say 'fight' to Grelleth to trigger the event.
\- Grelleth is permanently rooted and does not summon, so you can back away from the throne to fight.
\- The encounter:
\-\-\- 100%: 2x "a palace guard", then another 2x "a palace guard" after the first two are dead.
\-\-\- 98%: Turo.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Spawns 1x "an assassin" at 70% and 40%.
\-\-\- 87%: Lelri and Lelro.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Spawn timed adds: 4x "an oashim swarmling" at unknown intervals.
\-\-\- 82%: Wuran.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Spawns 1x "a priest of decay" at 70% and 40%.
\-\-\- 72%: Zurel.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Spawns 1x "an elite soldier" at 70% and 40%.
\-\-\- 62%: Kotul.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Spawns "Turo`s Remains" at 92%.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Spawns "Lelri`s Remains" and "Lelro`s Remains" at 82%.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Spawns "Wuran`s Remains" at 72%.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Spawns "Zurel`s Remains" at 62%.
\-\-\-\-\-\- The "Remains" adds retain their earlier abilities and mechanics, but hit for less and have less hitpoints.
\-\-\- 52%: Grelleth powers up, becomes unrooted, and starts summoning.
\-\-\-\-\-\- From this point until her death, every 90 seconds, she does an emote that requires you to switch tanks.
\-\-\- 21%: 1x "a reanimated servant" spawns.
\-\-\- 19%: 1x "a reanimated servant" spawns.
\- Kill the queen and all adds to win the event.

---


---

**In Detail**
Let Ain Kavus know that you are 'ready' to depart 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
You say, 'Ready!'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Grelleth's Palace, the Chateau of Filth.
_Make your way into the throne room where you will see Queen Grelleth (non-aggro), a few sleeping guards, and some expedition NPCs._

---

Confront Queen Grelleth 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Task Window Says:_ Queen Grelleth will not give you the privilege of battle without a proper introduction.
_Approach Grelleth (not aggro until triggered) and speak with her ("fight" to initiate the event)._
You say, 'Hail, Grelleth, her Majesty the Queen'
Grelleth, her Majesty the Queen sniffs the air, 'My god, children what is the awful stench that has approached our throne!? This miserable pest couldn't be the dinner offering this silly expedition has brought us could it? Tell me pest, do you intend to put up a [fight] or are you a [willing sacrifice]?'
_It is not advisable to offer a sacrifice:_
You say, 'I am a willing sacrifice'
Grelleth, her Majesty the Queen claps her hands together cheerfully, 'Excellent!' She leans forward and cuts \_\_\_\_\_'s head clean off!
YOU were injured by a trap.
You have been knocked unconscious!
You died.
_So, instead:_
You say, 'We want a fight'
Grelleth, her Majesty the Queen recoils in confusion at your response, 'You enter my domain, threaten my babies and challenge me to battle? Who in the world do you think you are!? You... you miserable, greedy, insolent sack of revolting flesh! CHILDREN, OUR FEAST HAS ARRIVED!'
Grelleth, her Majesty the Queen begins stomping the ground beneath her violently as she moves in to crush her next foe.
_Grelleth goes aggro and remains aggro through the entire event, although she is permanently rooted for the time being. Note that she does not summon, so you can leave her be and stay outside her melee and spell range. From this point to her death, she casts these two spells (she will have other spells in her arsenal, later in the event):_
Execution: Single Target, (-1200)
1: Decrease HP when cast by 12308 to 15385 (random)
Queen's Swing: PB AE 100', (-1200)
1: Decrease HP when cast by 15385 to 16923 (random)
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 3077 to 3231 (random) per tick
_Upon event trigger, 2x "a palace guard" spawn and attack. Kill them:_
a palace guard has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!

_Task Window Says:_ Kotul the brilliant, exercise caution when doing battle with him.

_At 92%:_

Defeat Grelleth 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
Defeat all of Grelleth's remaining minions 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Task Window Says:_ Now that you have put an end to her children, Grelleth is ready to give you the privilege of battle! Defeat Grelleth and all her remaining reinforcements.
_At 52% health, Grelleth becomes unrooted:_
Grelleth snarls and grinds her teeth, 'Very well, it is time to show you how I earned this crown!' She tosses her hand-axes to the ground and takes hold of a mightier weapon.
Your allies look toward the newly empowered queen and make a dash for the door!
_She gains an ability called "Fearsome Bellow" (targeted 30' range AE; nuke for 40,000 hp + stat decrease for 8 ticks):_
Fearsome Bellow: Targeted AE 30', Unresistable (-10000)
1: Decrease HP when cast by 39562
9: Decrease Stats by 100
_This AE is preceded by an emote (occurs every 90 seconds; flashes up on screen and in text):_
Grelleth prepares to strike \_\_\_\_\_ with a powerful attack! Someone else should take her attention.
_When you see this emote, you have 15 seconds to switch tanks. Once you switch tanks, you'll see this:_
Grelleth, her Majesty the Queen is forced to turn to a new target!
\_\_\_\_\_ suddenly has someone's complete attention.
_You still need the new tank to keep aggro, however, because she will still perform a "check" at the end of 15 seconds. If her target is different from whoever was tanking at the original emote, you'll see this success emote (flashes on screen):_
Grelleth has lost her focus on \_\_\_\_\_.
_At this point, it's safe for the original tank to take aggro again._
_If you fail to do the tank switch, you will see this:_
Grelleth unleashes a powerful attack on \_\_\_\_\_!
Grelleth, her Majesty the Queen drives her foot through her victim's skull leaving nothing but a pulpy mass.
_...And she casts "Fearsome Bellow" (each time she manages to cast this, she also increases her damage output by 10%._
_In addition to all of the above, she also spawns two health-based adds: 1x "a reanimated servant" at 21% and 19% health (these adds are mezzable)._
_NOTE: If you wipe out, the event does not reset. The Queen does, however, regenerate to 100% and retains the abilities she had at whatever health you left her at (so, if you wipe out at 30%, she will regenerate to 100%, but will be unrooted, summon, and will do the tank emote from the start). Any adds you have already killed will not respawn. Any adds that were alive at the time of the wipeout will remain up (they are NOT auto-aggro, so you can CR in the zone)._
_Kill the Queen along with all adds to win the event._
Grelleth, her Majesty the Queen has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
Grelleth, her Majesty the Queen falls to the floor with clenched fists. She looks around the room at the remains of her brood before whispering, 'My beautiful babies, how could this have happened?' Her eyes close and after a few heavy heaves her breath ceases.
From the back of the room you hear the familiar sound of scraping wood. The inner sanctum door opens revealing a massive pile of refuse with a few shiny objects sticking out of it. You are now welcome to claim your... 'prizes'.

---

Claim your rewards from Grelleth's pile of refuse 0/1 (Grelleth's Palace)
_Task Window Says:_ The door in the back of the hall has opened revealing a pile of refuse with a few shiny treasures sticking out of it. Go claim your rewards!
You sift through the pile of putrid waste to find a few articles of treasure. Thoughts of your latest conquest are fresh in mind as you begin to wonder how it was the great 'queen' was so easily defeated. The dread fear that this victory may have been nothing but a hollow illusion and that the real queen may be safely residing in another castle of filth sets upon you... but you are happy enough to claim the spoils of this charade and be on your way.

**Extra Stuff: Your Allies**
_In addition to the Queen and her many adds, you'll also see a few expedition members in the zone. While not a whole lot of practical help, you will have some moral support from them as they assist you in attacking._
_These NPCs are not a part of the task's progression. You don't have to interact with them, and whether they survive or retreat, has no bearing on the task's outcome._
**Reena Kedson**
You say, 'Hail, Reena Kedson'
Reena Kedson says 'It is a shame it has come to this.'
_When aggro'd:_ Reena Kedson holds her nose as she charges into the fray.
_When retreating:_ Reena Kedson strains her voice to shout above the din of battle, 'It must be the stench that's getting to me. I must retreat for now.'
**Ain Kavus**
You say, 'Hail, Ain Kavus'
Ain Kavus smiles, '\_\_\_\_\_! You're not a moment too soon! The wretched fiend has shown her disgusting face but refuses to give us the pleasure of battle without what she calls 'a proper feast' present.'
_When aggro'd:_ Ain Kavus points its blade toward its next foe.
_When retreating:_ Ain Kavus staggers back and shouts, 'Strike at these swine with all the fervor within you! I must make my leave.'
**Sherri Ganes**
You say, 'Hail, Sherri Ganes'
Sherri Ganes snarls angrily, 'Wretched pigs don't even have the decency to die quiet! Go let 'er know it's time for us to eat bacon!'
_When aggro'd:_ Sherri Ganes grins from ear to ear as she dives into the fight.
_When retreating:_ Sherri Ganes coughs up a bit of blood as she staggers toward the exit. She calls back to you with a rather confident boast, 'Little piggies make the best bacon. Bring me what's left of their carcasses when you're done here!'
**Relco Finn**
You say, 'Hail, Relco Finn'
Relco Finn stands at attention and salutes you crisply, 'Right on time, \_\_\_\_\_! Our remaining allies are up ahead in a standoff with the trash queen. Should you need to make a hasty retreat just use the door behind you there.' The halfling points at the rickety wooden door.
_When aggro'd:_ Relco Finn sighs loudly before charging into battle.
_When retreating:_ Relco Finn grabs his arm and sighs as he begins limping away from the battle, 'Looks like you'll have to win this one without me.'

_This task begins with Sir Birton ( map) in the Chapterhouse of the Fallen. He is found at location 65, 545, 0 (on the main floor are two large rooms -- he is in the northwest part of the west room)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Sir Birton'
Sir Birton says 'Stay your weapons; I have no intent on harming you. A much greater [threat] dwells in the depths of these once sacred halls.'
You say, 'What threat?'
Sir Birton says 'The necromancers of the Burning Dead have infiltrated the lower levels, and seek to raise the dead for some nefarious scheme. We must find a way to stop them. No; you must find a way to [stop them].'
You say, 'How do we stop them?'
Sir Birton says 'If you are not afraid of the walking dead, and if you are, I don't know why you have traveled here, you must find a way to infiltrate the ranks of the Burning Dead and discover their plans. I may have a way to help you gain access to one of their leaders, [Falsin Bonecraft].'
You say, 'Who is Falsin Bonecraft?'
Sir Birton says 'Falsin is a despicable little gnome who delights in having undead servants do his dirty work. However, I do not think he would be opposed to having a new gnomish recruit if the opportunity presented itself. Will you help to [infiltrate] the ranks of the Burning Dead?'
You say, 'I will infiltrate them'
Sir Birton says 'I knew I could count on you. Take these Burning Dead robes. When used, they will cast an illusion spell upon you so that you can blend in among the necromancers. The undead however may see through your disguise, so use caution. If you [need more robes] just let me know and I will give you some more. That is all. May Marr's blessing be upon you.'
_You receive "Burning Dead Robes"._
You have been assigned the task 'Infiltrating the Burning Dead'.
An undead paladin named Sir Birton has asked you to infiltrate the Burning Dead cult that has spread throughout the deeper regions of the Chapterhouse.
Use the Burning Dead Robes to disguise yourself as a member of the Burning Dead and speak with Falsin Bonecraft.

Speak with the leader of the Burning Dead, Falsin Bonecraft 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
_Falsin Bonecraft ( map) is found at /location 0, 815, -91 (down one level from the main floor -- the western half of that level)._
_Use the illusion before speaking to him._
You say, 'Hail, Falsin Bonecraft'
Falsin Bonecraft says 'Ah, another initiate eager to prove their worth to the Burning Dead? So be it. There is a lot to be done before the ritual commences, and you will prove your worth by completing some tasks given by some of my neophytes. Seek out Yarin Shroudfear, Plinki Bonebrood, and Orson Gravegloom and do what they say. Disobey, and I will kill you and then reanimate your bones to clean the latrines. Now go.'
Speak with Yarin Shroudfear 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
You say, 'Hail, Yarin Shroudfear'
Yarin Shroudfear says 'Falsin sent you to help me? Good, I am very busy and there are lots of things that need to be done. Some of the mummies need their linen wrappings changed, the ghouls need to be fed, and some of the zombies need some pep, as they are becoming too complacent. Give them some of this energy elixir. Let me know if you need more [linen wrappings], [rotten flesh], or [energy elixir]. Oh, I almost forgot; there is also a skeleton that has become too intelligent and continues to resist our efforts to control him. Seek out Coffinhowl and destroy him.'
You have been assigned the task 'Undead Maintenance'.
Complete the task that Yarin Shroudfear has assigned to you 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
_Complete the task " Undead Maintenance [quest=6098]"._
Speak with Plinki Bonebrood 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
You say, 'Hail, Plinki Bonebrood'
Plinki Bonebrood says 'Some of our more unconventional experiments have gone awry. Seek out these failed experiments and destroy them. And make sure to kill the neophyte responsible for these failed experiments. His name is Jurso Fumblefink.'
You have been assigned the task 'Breaking Bones'.
Complete the task that Plinki Bonebrood has assigned to you 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
_Complete the task " Breaking Bones [quest=6099]"._
Speak with Orson Gravegloom 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
You say, 'Hail, Orson Gravegloom'
Orson Gravegloom says 'Oh, hello. I'm Orson. The others here like to make fun of me because they think I am not so smart, but I will prove them wrong! In the meantime, can you [take care] of something for me? I am way behind in my studies and if I raise another zombie that decides it would rather recite poetry than act all zombie-like, I will fail my exam again.'
You say, 'I'd love to take care of it...'
Orson Gravegloom says 'We need lots of organs for some sort of upcoming ritual. I'm not sure what it's all about, but I am sure it will be all gory and stuff. We will need an appendix, a spleen, a liver, a tongue, a pair of eyes, a spinal cord, and a heart. I was told that the heart we need belongs to a paladin named, Sir Graxton Talonheart. He probably wants to keep his heart, so expect a fight. Once you have all that stuff, place everything into the coffin nearby. Why? I don't know, just cause that's what you're supposed to do.'
You have been assigned the task 'Organ Trail'.
Complete the task that Orson Gravegloom has assigned to you 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
_Complete the task " Organ Trail [quest=6100]"._
Speak with Sir Birton 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
You say, 'Hail, Sir Birton'
Sir Birton says 'My sources inform me that you have blended in well with the Burning Dead and are well on your way to getting on their good side; if they have one that is. I just hope you didn't enjoy your grisly tasks too much. There is still much to be done before you fully gain their trust however. We must find out more about their upcoming ritual. Use the burning dead robes to disguise yourself again and seek out a necromancer known as Bertrand the Butcher. I hear he is eager to show new recruits the tricks of the trade. Gain his trust and hopefully we can learn more about the upcoming ritual. If you [need more robes] just let me know.'

450 platinum
Experience (6 AAs)

Let me know if you need more [linen wrappings], [rotten flesh], or [energy elixir]. Oh, I almost forgot; there is also a skeleton that has become too intelligent and continues to resist our efforts to control him. Seek out Coffinhowl and destroy him.'

You say, 'Hail, Orson Gravegloom'
Orson Gravegloom says 'Oh, hello. I'm Orson. The others here like to make fun of me because they think I am not so smart, but I will prove them wrong! In the meantime, can you [take care] of something for me? I am way behind in my studies and if I raise another zombie that decides it would rather recite poetry than act all zombie-like, I will fail my exam again.'
You say, 'I'd love to take care of it...'
Orson Gravegloom says 'We need lots of organs for some sort of upcoming ritual. I'm not sure what it's all about, but I am sure it will be all gory and stuff. We will need an appendix, a spleen, a liver, a tongue, a pair of eyes, a spinal cord, and a heart. I was told that the heart we need belongs to a paladin named, Sir Graxton Talonheart. He probably wants to keep his heart, so expect a fight. Once you have all that stuff, place everything into the coffin nearby. Why? I don't know, just cause that's what you're supposed to do.'
You have been assigned the task 'Organ Trail'.
Orson Gravegloom has asked you to complete a task that he doesn't have time to do himself.
Find an appendix, a spleen, a liver, a tongue, a pair of eyes, and a spinal cord, and then place them in the coffin near Orson Gravegloom. These parts are scattered throughout the tunnels that the Burning Dead inhabit as well as the prison area. Locate the imprisoned paladin, Sir Graxton Talondrake, and then take his heart.

_This solo task is the second in a series of three. It begins with Bertrand the Butcher ( map) in the Chapterhouse of the Fallen. He is found at location -265, 81, -91. This is the south hallway that extends from the prison area (the prison area being one floor down from the zone-in level, east side)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Infiltrating the Burning Dead"
_Note: You must use the "Burning Dead Robes" illusion before you can speak with Bertrand (say "need more robes" to Sir Birton - map)._
You say, 'Hail, Bertrand the Butcher'
Bertrand the Butcher says 'So you're the new initiate everyone has been talking about? Good, I need you to do something for me. A colleague of mine named Gertrude Darksworn and I have a bet. I believe that Halflings would make suitably fine undead minions, and Gertrude thinks they will not. Let's [prove her wrong].'
You say, 'I'll prove her wrong'
Bertrand the Butcher says 'Head to the examination room behind me and find the unconscious Halflings. A skeletal nurse and a necromancer boneraiser will be waiting to assist you with the surgery to prepare them to be raised as an undead minion, so I can prove Gertrude wrong once and for all. Don't worry; the Halfling won't feel a thing, and if they do feel it, that's just too bad!'
Gertrude Darksworn says 'I can't wait to prove you wrong, Bertrand!'
You have been assigned the task 'Operation'.
Bertrand has a bet going with one of his colleagues named Gertrude Darksworn regarding if Halflings make suitable undead servants or not. Bertrand thinks they will and Gertrude thinks they will not. Head to the examination room behind Bertrand and Gertrude and try to pick an operating table that is not already being used by a fellow adventurer.

_This task is the third in a series of three. It is a solo task that begins with Wilfred Gorefinder ( map) in the Chapterhouse of the Fallen. He is found at location -325, 930, -91. This is in the southwestern area of the Burning Dead halls in the western half of the zone's second floor._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Infiltrating the Burning Dead"
\- Completed "Operation"
_Note: You must use the "Burning Dead Robes" illusion before you can speak with Wilfred (say "need more robes" to Sir Birton - map)._
You say, 'Hail, Wilfred Gorefinder'
Wilfred Gorefinder says 'You're the new initiate, eh? There's something not right about you, but if Falsin trusts you, I guess I have no choice but to do the same. I can use your help though. There are a lot of tasks that we need to complete before we can turn our full attention to the upcoming ritual. The task I need your help with has me particularly [perplexed].'
You say, 'Perplexed?'
Wilfred Gorefinder says 'Someone is killing members of the Burning Dead and raising them as skeletons. This has to stop. We don't know who the murderer is yet. That's where you come in. I want you to [find] whoever is responsible for these heinous crimes and kill them.'
You say, 'I will find them'
Wilfred Gorefinder says 'I have just finished working on a device that should help you with your investigation. I call it the Ghost-o-Matic. It is a wondrous contraption that combines the best of gnomish necromancy and tinkering. To use it, simply place the remains of the one you wish to contact into the device along with a piece of ghostly parchment, and a message from the recently deceased will pop out for you to read. I know; it's quite brilliant if I do say so myself. Take the Ghost-o-Matic and this parchment and find the murderer! If you lose your parchment or the Ghost-o-Matic, let me [know], so I can replace them for you. Once you have dealt with the murderer, speak with my assistant, Gibble. I have other matters to attend to.'
You have been assigned the task 'Dead Gnomes Tell No Tales... Or Do They?'.
Wilfred Gorefinder is investigating a rather curious matter involving members of the Burning Dead being murderer and raised as skeletons, which just isn't right. See if you can help him with his investigation.
_You receive 1x "Ghost-o-Matic" + 3x "Ghostly Parchment"._

Escape from Lord Taros 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
_Task Window Says:_ Menizzia has summoned High Lord William Taros, a fallen knight of incredible power. You cannot possibly hope to defeat him now. Run, for your lives!
_You'll need to avoid Taros without getting too close to him (damage aura) or too far behind him (death touch) while clearing the area of mobs._
_From Menizzia's room: Head through the east tunnel, fight the single mob there, and then go into the second room. Kill five mobs there._
_From the second room: Head through the north tunnel and into the third room. Kill four mobs there._
_From the third room: Head into the tunnel to your west, to the end of it, fight the single mob there, and then into the connecting room to that tunnel's south. This is the final room (a few more mobs to kill)._
_Once in this room, wait for Lord Taros to catch up, and for the script to unfold. Afterwards, Menizzia goes aggro._
_Note: For reference points, see the map associated with Braintaster. His northeastern spawn location is the "third room" as described above. His southwestern spawn location is the final room._

Holy Defender Ioris shouts 'You there, I will keep Taros occupied. You must return to Menizzia and stop the resurrection of Marnek at any cost, even your own lives! All will perish if Marnek returns!'
Menizzia shouts 'Did someone call my name? Your efforts here have all been for naught. Marnek lives again, and nothing you do here can change that, yet clearly I cannot trust this walking bag of bones to dispatch the likes of you. Better I deal with you myself and be done with it!'
Menizzia shouts 'I may not be able to destroy you Ioris, but this is MY realm, and you have no power here. Begone!'
Menizzia banishes Holy Defender Ioris and saps any remaining energy from Taros in the process. Taros falls to the ground in a heap of lifeless bones.

This group mission begins with Holy Defender Ioris [npc=41329] ( map) in the Chapterhouse of the Fallen [zone=874] at location -125, -70, -1 -- in the side room just north of the zone-in from the Commonlands (southeast of the Shard's Landing portal).
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed Infiltrating the Burning Dead [quest=6097]
\- Completed Operation [quest=6101]
\- Completed Dead Gnomes Tell No Tales... Or Do They? [quest=6102]
\- Completed Run, You Fools! [quest=6103] (mission)
You say, 'Hail, Holy Defender Ioris'
Holy Defender Ioris appears relieved at your presence. 'Praise Marr, you're alive! I was worried my stubbornness would result in your death.' The paladin lowers her head in silent acceptance of what must be done. Her eyes reveal distrust as she glares upward toward the shadowknight who stands within hearing distance. 'It was wrong of me to refuse the [help] of a foe, who was willing to banish a common enemy. Marnek's summoning was a result of my pride, not your [failure].'
Bloodreaver Narek [npc=42310] allows a smug grin to spread across his face as Ioris admits her wrongdoing.
You say, 'What failure?'
Holy Defender Ioris says 'I was able to fend off Menizzia [npc=42672], allowing for your escape, but her power proved much too strong to stop the summoning. Marnek now has a foot in both the realm of the dead, as well as the living, meaning he will need to be fought on both fronts. The necromancer grows stronger with every moment we remain idle.' Ioris gestures to the shadowknight in the corner, 'Despite my distaste for the followers of Innoruk, I have agreed to accept Narek's help, as he knows more about the realm of the dead than I care to. He will aid you in passing through to the realm of the dead, while I will ensure that you return to the realm of the living unharmed. Have you prepared a small, but efficient [group], or have you gathered a [raid] force to destroy Marnek once and for all?'
You say, 'I have a group'
Holy Defender Ioris says 'Very well. When you are ready to [go], I will lead your group into the summoning chamber where Marnek resides.'
You have been assigned the task 'A Matter of Life and Death'.
Head into Marnek's summoning chamber and destroy the ancient necromancer who has a hold over the realm of the dead, as well as the living.
You say, 'Let's go'
Holy Defender Ioris says 'May the strength of Marr be with you.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Chapterhouse of the Fallen.
Bloodreaver Narek says 'Marnek's chambers can be found through the tunnel straight ahead. I will stay here and channel the strength of Innoruuk so that the dark pool can provide passage to the realm of the dead. Remember, contact with living creatures while in the in the other realm will cause you harm; Remaining in the dead realm for too long will cause certain death.'

---

**Task Steps**
1\. Engage Marnek within the realm of the living 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
Task Window Says: Marnek can be found in the summoning chamber, through the tunnel south of Holy Defender Ioris.
2\. Witness Marnek's transition into the realm of the dead 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
Task Window Says: According to Irois and Narek, Marnek is able to switch between the realms of the living and the dead.
3\. Sacrifice one of your own in the pool of the dead 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
4\. Kill wraiths within Marnek's summoning chamber 0/8 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
Task Window Says: Wraiths can only be harmed by those within the realm of the dead.
5\. Kill Marnek 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
Task Window Says: Kill the ancient necromancer!
6\. Claim your reward from the ornate chest 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
Task Window Says: After you have claimed your reward, Holy Defender Ioris will escort you back to the Chapterhouse.

---

**In Detail**
1\. Engage Marnek within the realm of the living 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
This updates when you aggro Marnek Jaull [npc=42690].
2\. Witness Marnek's transition into the realm of the dead 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
Marnek hits for a max ~18,000 and AE rampages. He casts Necrotic Roots (single-target nuke for 21,000 + DoT for 32,000/tick + root; 60 curse counters) and Scorching Bones (DoT for 39,000/tick; cured by going into the water at either end of the room you're fighting in - north or south).
Take him to 80% health at which point he turns into a skeleton. From here on out, he will alternate forms (human / skeleton). He is damageable by normal means in human form, but not in skeleton form (more information about this follows).
You'll see this emote when he turns "dead":
Marnek enters the realm of the dead, growing in power while shielding himself against attacks from the living.
You'll see this emote when he turns "live" again:
Marnek returns to the realm of the living, shielding himself from attacks from the dead.
3\. Sacrifice one of your own in the pool of the dead 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
At least one person needs to go into the water in the north end of the room (NOTE: This isn't the actual water; it's a "pool", similar to a placeable guild hall pool just below the ramp).
When a player enters the north pool, two things happen: The player is put in a shroud and an add called a skeleton [npc=42692] spawns.
The skeleton needs to be killed. It procs the spell Stun every five seconds:
Stun: Single Target, Unresistable (-980)
1: Stun (4.00 sec/200)
Anyone with the shroud can use the shroud's bane ability to DPS Marnek while he in his skeleton form. The catch is that if you stay in the shroud form too long, you will be death touched. The time limit is not known for sure, but the shroud does come with a buff, so the time limit may be the duration of the buff (not confirmed). To remove the shroud form, go into the water pool at the south end of the room.
Note: When a shrouded player removes a shroud from themselves, they get a short-term debuff called Resurrection Sickness on them that prevents them from re-shrouding. This only lasts a few ticks, however.
You can re-apply the shroud form any time by going into the north water (this spawns an add for each person who does this) and take it off any time by going into the south water. Just make sure you're not in it too long. Note that you cannot refresh the buff. You have to take it off and re-apply it rather than overwriting your existing buff.
Also note that if you approach Marnek while he is in his human form, while you are shrouded, you will take extra damage.
Marnek continues alternating his form based on his health: 70% (human); 50% (skeleton); 40% (human); 20% (skeleton); 10% (human).
4\. Kill wraiths within Marnek's summoning chamber 0/8 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
Adds called a wraith [npc=42963] are encountered throughout the event at health intervals. One wraith appears at 94%, 84%, 74%, 64%, 54%, 44%, 34%, 24%, 14%, and 4%. There may also be an 11th wraith, but this is not confirmed.
The wraiths can only be damaged with the shrouds. A shroud's "Lure" ability can be used to leash the wraith to the shrouded player while the wraith can be DPS'd via melee using the shroud's weapons.
WARNING: Make sure you have all eight wraith kill updates before you kill Marnek, or the task gets bugged (the chest spawns, but you can't open it).
5\. Kill Marnek 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)
6\. Claim your reward from the ornate chest 0/1 (Chapterhouse of the Fallen)

_This task is the second in a series of three. It is a solo task that begins with Thistlebrush ( map) in the Valley of King Xorbb at location -1385, -970, 107 (a little ways north of the zone-in)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed The Halfling Trail [quest=6106]
You say, 'Hail, Thistlebrush'
Thistlebrush says 'Your efforts have helped us much, especially Brantun and Barleyburr when [they] were lost in the valley. Thank you!'
Thistlebrush holds out his hand toward you, and flames leap to life, dancing about on his palm. 'Brantun and Barleyburr yet live! Our hope is not lost, thanks to you!' With his other hand, Thistlebrush holds the haft of a torch and dips it into the living fire. 'But as you know, they have not escaped [danger].'
You say, 'What danger?'
Thistlebrush says 'Whilst goblins crowd the halls of underearth, Brantun and Barleyburr cannot emerge from hiding and descend to the seat of Xorbb. Besides, with Brantun's leg broken and Barleyburr's constant hunger gnawing at his mind, the two would not make it far. We must aid them with food and healing, but first we must create a [distraction].' Thistlebrush proffers to you the lit torch.'
You say, 'A distraction?'
Thistlebrush says 'We will spread pandemonium among the minotaur camps and lure the goblins to the surface to aid their fellow minions. Once the mayhem evacuates the caverns, you can deliver aid to Brantun and Barleyburr, and they can continue their journey. You will take up this torch, [right]?'
You say, 'Right!'
Thistlebrush hands you the torch, and his eyes gleam in its light. 'Burn the tents of the minotaurs. They will bellow with rage, and the goblins will answer their call.'
You have been assigned the task 'We Have to Go Deeper'.
_You receive "Thistlebrush's Everburning Torch"._
Brantun and Barleyburr have escaped the goblin cook's mallet, but now they are hiding within the goblin halls, injured and waiting for a chance to resume their quest. Thistlebrush wants you to create a distraction that will lure some of the goblins out of their halls. Then you can deliver aid to Brantun and Barleyburr.
By destroying minotaur tents along the western river, we can put Xorbb's forces in disarray. Goblins will come to the surface to aid the minotaurs in salvaging their encampments. Use the torch Thistlebrush gave you to light the tents on fire.

---

Destroy 7 of the minotaur shelters to create a diversion 0/7 (Valley of King Xorbb)
Throughout the valley are several minotaur shelters [npc=42369] scattered about (in the various mino camps around the zone). Use the torch on these tents. When you do so, some waterbrigade goblins spawn and try to heal the tents. These goblins don't have many hitpoints and don't hit too hard for their level (max ~6,500), but they can sometimes appear in large numbers.

---

Speak with Thistlebrush 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Tell Thistlebrush Xorbb's forces are in disarray and that you lured out the goblins.
You say, 'Hail, Thistlebrush'
Thistlebrush says 'The valley teems with goblins and minotaurs, as though you stamped upon an anthill. The goblin nest has emptied, and will remain so while the detritus of your handiwork has been cleared. Now is the time to deliver aid to Brantun and Barleyburr.' Thistlebrush removes a pouch from his pocket. 'This poultice will soothe Brantun's leg and give him the strength to walk, though it cannot fully restore his mobility. It is the best I can do from afar.' Thistlebrush rubs his chin for a moment. 'Barleyburr needs ham. He thrives upon it. I fear without sufficient ham supply, the plan will be ruined, for Barleyburr will be too weak to bolster Brantun's spirit, let alone his own. Having none of the meat myself, you must steal it from the minotaurs' spits. Once you have some, deliver the ham and poultice to Brantun and Barleyburr.'
You receive Thistlebrush's Poultice [item=108347].

---

Kill a minotaur cook that is watching over his ham 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
Steal some ham off of a minotaur spit 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Thistlebrush has given you a poultice to deliver to Brantun, but Barleyburr still needs ham to keep his strength. You will need to kill a minotaur cook and steal a piece of ham that is roasting on his spit.
Known spawn points for minotaur cooks [npc=42368] ( map):
\\* -675, 635, -73 (south-central part of the zone; east of the north end of the large lake/waterfall)
\\* 690, 195, -45 (north-central part of the zone; southeast from the architect camp - across the river)
\\* 700, 730, -60 (northwestern part of the zone; southwest from the architect camp - same side of river)
\\* 1025, -705, 136 (northeast from the north exit out of the crater area)
Minotaur cooks hit for an average of 14k; AE rampage (about full damage); have a fair amount of hitpoints; and cast "Meat Cleaver" on random targets:
Meat Cleaver: Single Target, Magic (-950)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 60000
The spits are right next to the minotaur cooks. Click one to receive a Large Ham Chunk [item=107987].
You cut a piece of ham from the spit.

---

Tell Brantun that you have created a diversion and brought supplies 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
Brantun [npc=42414] (and Barleyburr -- map) are in the underground system at around /waypoint -811,+903,-372.18 in the narrow hallway that's just west of the bar / kitchen area. He's on Find (Ctrl+F).
You say, 'Hail, Brantun'
Brantun lurches at you, sword drawn, aiming steel at your throat. Barleyburr grabs Brantun's sleeve and barely restrains him from spilling your blood. Brantun speaks slowly but keeps his sword pointed at you. 'You are no goblin, but can I trust you? Many like you would think no more of killing a halfling than killing a goat. Although, you say Thistlebrush sent you?' Brantun lowers his sword but keeps his hand clenched around the hilt and his eyes narrowed. 'Then prove to us your words.'
Give the large chunk of ham to Barleyburr 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
Barleyburr grabs the ham from your hands. His eyes widen, and a smile breaks across his face before he brings the ham to his lips and kisses it. 'The minute I saw you, I knew you were an upstanding \_\_\_\_\_, \_\_\_\_\_, who definitely values the finer things in life! Brantun, how could you be so suspicious of \_\_\_\_\_? Anyone who bears the gift of ham is a wonderful friend to have!' Barleyburr claps you on the shoulder. 'When this whole Xorbb business is done, all of us will sit down and share some cured ham, pints of ale, and excellent company!'
Give Brantun the poultice for his leg 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
Brantun rolls up his pant leg and applies the poultice over the ridge of tibia poking through the skin. He stifles a cry as his skin glows and the wound begins to close. After a moment's rest, he rises and begins to walk about, limping, although more mobile than he had been. Out of breath, he addresses you. 'You spoke truthfully, \_\_\_\_\_, but a slab of ham and a mended leg will not guarantee our success. Even with your diversion, I doubt we can penetrate Xorbb's heart while the eyes gaze upon us.'
Ask Brantun what he needs to continue the quest 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
You say, 'Hail, Brantun'
Brantun says 'While we hid, we listened. The goblins in their tavern spoke of the eyes that watch over Xorbb's domain. They are his lieutenants and generals, his tacticians and seers. They see what you and I cannot. They penetrate even the most ancient incantations of invisibility. We will never avoid their gaze -- unless what the goblins say is true. Within the mines of crystals, which sprouted from veins touched by the heart of fear, living shards wander tunnels like ghosts, invisible even to the eyes that patrol the mines. The miners told tales of these wraithlike crystals flickering into existence before vanishing once more, and many miners are afraid to work alone. If we could manage to obtain pieces of these crystals, Thistlebrush might be able to extract their power and give to us a means to avoid the eyes.'

---

Speak with Thistlebrush 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Tell Thistlebrush that Brantun and Barleyburr cannot make it past the eyes of Xorbb unseen. Brantun overheard goblins saying that pieces of living crystal shards in the crystal mines can blind in and out of existence. Thistlebrush might know how to harness this power.
You say, 'Hail, Thistlebrush'
Thistlebrush looks into the distance. His eyes appear glassy, and he slowly nods while he speaks. 'What Brantun describes must be powerful magic, elemental in its form. The heart of fear must have spread roots throughout this valley, and even the rocks and soil bear its seed. I know a spell -- I do not know its origin, so ancient is it -- that might reveal to you that which cannot be seen.' Thistlebrush holds out his hand. A cloud as black as midnight begins to swirl around Thistlebrush's palm, and a small idol takes shape in his hand. 'Place this upon the ground, and the hidden becomes visible. Go now to the crystal mines. Brantun and Barleyburr depend upon what you discover!"
You receive a Visibility Totem [item=108349].

---

Loot 4 Multiphasic Facets from multiphasic crystals 0/4 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Thistlebrush has given you a totem of ancient magic that might reveal the unseen creatures of crystal. In the crystal mines to the west, drop a totem, reveal the hidden beings, and try to take pieces of crystal from their bodies after you kill them.
Go to the mining/crystal area of the underground system (these are the caves in the northernmost part of your map). Right-clicking the Visibility Totem spawns an aura in place. Mobs called a multiphasic crystal [npc=42442] wander the entirety of the crystal mines, but they are only visible and attackable if they are in one of these auras. In order to kill one, it has to be kept inside the aura until its death.
Once a totem is dropped on the ground, it generates an aura with a fair range. If you have multiple group members on this step, you can set it up so that you have a large range. Keep an eye out for "a multiphasic crystal" (hyrda model) to appear. These roam through the tunnels.
a multiphasic crystal" is not KOS and not social with anything else (including each other).
They don't hit hard (a max ~7,000); flurry; are belly casters (stand on them to land spells); and have a series of emotes that lead up to an AE (they keep cycling through them until dead):
a multiphasic crystal's first head begins to glow.
a multiphasic crystal's second head begins to glow.
a multiphasic crystal's third head begins to glow.
a multiphasic crystal's heads discharge their energy. _("Triphobic Discharge" is cast)_
a multiphasic crystal's heads are drained of power.
Triphobic Discharge: PB AE 55', Prismatic (-950)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 70000
2: 20% Chance to trigger: Triphobia
Triphobia" is a 60-second fear.
They drop 1-3 crystals per kill.

---

Speak with Thistlebrush 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
You say, 'Hail, Thistlebrush'
Thistlebrush's face darkens, as though a cloud were passing overhead. 'These crystals do not belong to this world.' He covers them inside his hands, and a black glow emanates from the cracks between his fingers. Revealing his palms, he displays to you two rings forged of the crystal. Darkness seems to hang about Thistlebrush's head, and he speaks slowly. 'With these rings, Brantun and Barleyburr will walk in the realm of the crystal. The eyes will not see them. But I cannot say who or what else might be watching when the rings encompass their fingers. Go now. Regardless the cost, we must see this matter to the end.'
You receive 2x Multiphasic Ring [item=108352].

---

Give a Multiphasic Ring to Brantun 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
Give a Multiphasic Ring to Barleyburr 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Using some strange power, Thistlebrush has fused the crystals into rings. Wearers of the rings will possess the power of invisibility. Now Brantun and Barleyburr will be able to avoid the eyes of Xorbb.
Barleyburr shudders as you hand him the ring. 'Must we wear such a thing, Brantun? It is heavy, unnatural...' Barleyburr places the ring in his pack, and weight seems to lift from him. 'We best get to moving now. The sooner we finish our journey, the sooner we enjoy that feast, \_\_\_\_\_!'
Brantun says 'So the shards exist...I did not know Thistlebrush's abilities were so advanced as to harness a power such as this.' Brantun holds the ring in his hand, and his visage grows darker, even under torchlight. 'It is heavier than it looks.'

---

Speak with Brantun 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
You say, 'Hail, Brantun'
Brantun says 'Thank you, \_\_\_\_\_. Await our message. When we near the heart of Xorbb's power, we will call for Thistlebrush to execute his final stratagem. The next time we meet, I pray it is above ground!'
You have succeeded in bringing aid to Brantun and Barleyburr. With the tunnels evacuated of many goblins, and with the rings you have given Brantun and Barleyburr, they can now make their way toward Xorbb's seat of power. Stay in contact with Thistlebrush to know when Brantun and Barleyburr send their final message.

225 platinum
Experience (3 AAs + 2-3% in Level 98)
