_This task is the third in a series of three. It is a solo task that begins with Thistlebrush ( map) in the Valley of King Xorbb at location -1385, -970, 107 (a little ways north of the zone-in)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed The Halfling Trail [quest=6106]
\- Completed We Have to Go Deeper [quest=6107]
You say, 'Hail, Thistlebrush'
Thistlebrush says 'Your efforts have helped us much, especially Brantun and Barleyburr: when [they] were lost in the valley, and when they were in [danger] of being discovered after escaping the goblin chef. Thank you!'
Thistlebrush shakes his head and narrows his eyes. 'Lost again. We have not received a message from Brantun and Barleyburr for several nights. I fear they have fallen into graver [trouble] than they have before.'
You say, 'What trouble now?'
Thistlebrush says 'I sent forth my subterranean friends. They burrowed into this valley and scoured the tunnels for signs. They ferried to me the message that two of Xorbb's lieutenants have shown themselves: Sviir and Syrkl. This can only mean that matters important to them have arisen in the underground. They must have [discovered] Brantun and Barleyburr.'
You say, 'How were they discovered?'
Thistlebrush says 'Their perception must be infallible to see through the cloak of the rings. There is only one path for you to follow: Uncover the eyes. Stare into them and learn what they know -- if you can [withstand] their gaze. Only then will we find Brantun and Barleyburr.'
You say, 'I can withstand it'
Thistlebrush nods. 'I know you believe yourself strong, and I doubt not that you are. However, can you see the world clearly? Can you view all with unclouded eye? Can you cut down your foe with a mere look? If you can, perhaps you are ready to [face] the eyes of Xorbb.
You say, 'I will face them'
Thistlebrush says 'Speak then with Thoribald, Thorndig, and Threshrock. I sent them into the depths, and they have been tracking the eyes and searching for Brantun and Barleyburr. Unless you confront Xorbb's lieutenants, our hope will be lost beneath this valley.'
You have been assigned the task 'Escape From the Prison of Xorbb'.
Thistlebrush has once again lost contact with Brantun and Barleyburr. With King Xorbb's lieutenants alerted to the halflings' presence, it is likely that Brantun and Barleyburr have been captured or killed. Descend beneath the valley and investigate their fate.
Speak with Thoribald, one of Thistlebrush's messengers, to see if she has found any signs of Brantun and Barleyburr's presence.

---

Speak with Thoribald 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
Thoribald [npc=42423] ( map) is a burynai found at /waypoint -486,+1272,-400.67 (middle of the westernmost stretch of the main passageways that the underground river runs through). He's on Find (Ctrl+F).
You say, 'Hail, Thoribald'
Thoribald wipes her paws and shuffles closer to you. Her voice is a gruff growl. 'This tunnel is dirtier than any burrow I've dug. Goblins are such filthy creatures! Most wouldn't notice amidst all the refuse, but I found bits of ham strewn along the canals and saw two crocodiles fighting over chunks. Brantun and Barleyburr must have come this way. Thorndig carried on further ahead. She might have found more signs.'

---

Speak with Thorndig 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Thoribald found some of Barleyburr's ham, and she pointed you in the direction of Thorndig, who is on the trail of the two halflings.
Thorndig [npc=42424] ( map) is a burynai found at /waypoint -46,+488,-400.66 (from Thoribald, follow the main passageway north, then east).
You say, 'Hail, Thorndig'
Thorndig brushes dirt off the wall. 'See the scratchings? No, you wouldn't; your eyes are too big -- and would you even know our code? It is in Brantun's hand. He and Barleyburr are lost, crisscrossing the canals and looping back on their own paths. Even though they walk in invisible space, they feel a presence watching them, like a shadow creeping upon them as Ro falls below a ridge. They have begun marking their path along the walls and have quickened their pace, trying to outrun the sense of dread that is fast overtaking them. That is all I gleaned, aside from the arrow pointing the direction they next took. Threshrock has gone to investigate. She will know more.'

---

Speak with Threshrock 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Brantun and Barleyburr were lost among the canals and feeling watched by a malevolent presence. Theshrock has ventured toward the halflings' last known location.
Threshrock [npc=42425] ( map) is a burynai found at /waypoint +489,+139,-400.66 (from Thorndig, head north).
You say, 'Hail, Threshrock'
Threshrock places a paw on her mouth and speaks in a whisper. 'Make no noise! It is close, the eye that pierces your spirit! Brantun wrote of it upon this wall. He and Barleyburr saw it looming around a corner. It looked directly at them, piercing through their cloak of invisibility. They felt their skin and eyes burn as it looked upon them without blinking. They ran when it began to float toward them, and hid themselves within this adjacent room. I know not what happened next, but I can feel a powerful presence of dread inhabiting the room, and I dare not look to see what is within. That I leave to someone braver than I!' Threshrock covers her eyes.

---

Confront Lord Sviir and discover what happened to Brantun and Barleyburr 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Brantun and Barleyburr were cornered by one of Xorbb's lieutenants, who could see through their invisibility rings. Confront Lord Sviir and find out what became of Brantun and Barleyburr.
Lord Sviir [npc=42419] ( map) is found in the room behind Threshrock. Note: Hailing him will cause him to attack (after a small delay).
Have everyone in your group hail him before he attacks.
You say, 'Hail, Lord Sviir'
Lord Sviir's pupil dilates, and your consciousness flounders within that dark cistern. Into your thoughts a voice enters, as clear as an orator addressing a crowd. 'Do you know why you have come? You do not seek the halflings; you seek what King Xorbb holds: power. He controls the piece of a god, the root of power: fear. A mind powerful enough to control fear, to conquer it, can also wield it. With fear, one look will decimate a regiment more thoroughly than a valley bristling with swords, and will send your foes fleeing before you.
Lord Sviir says 'King Xorbb once knew fear. Chained by the goblins of Runnyeye, locked in the depths, he feared the dark. He feared the years upon years of sightlessness awaiting him, knowing that in time he would be blind, that though Ro may yet shine upon him, he would only ever know interminable darkness. Then the shard fell, tearing through the goblin bastion, streaming light and the burning wreckage of Runnyeye dominion into the gloaming of King Xorbb's cell. He conquered it: Claiming the shard of fear, he rose from the wreckage and laid waste to the remaining goblins before him. He conquered and made the valley anew.'
Lord Sviir's pupil begins to glow with a distant flame. 'And you ask of halflings when you know of such power? What has their race done that warrants such concern? Soon their home will be destroyed, along with any who defy the will of King Xorbb. Do you wish to stop such power or obtain it for yourself? To me it matters little, but be honest with yourself. Perhaps I should let you rot within the prison as I did those halflings. You will have plenty of time to reckon with your true self when you have sat in your cell as long as King Xorbb did.' The flame grows brighter in Sviir's pupil. 'But I see you are not amenable to such a suggestion. I warn you: I have been granted a taste of the King's power, as have his other lieutenants. Test your strength if you will.'

---

Defeat Lord Sviir 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Sviir sent the halflings to prison, but he will not be as lenient toward you. Kill him.
Lord Sviir hits for a max ~30,000; is a belly caster (stand on top of him to land spells); single-target rampages; flurries; and casts "Stasis Gaze" on a random target every 20 seconds:
Stasis Gaze: Single Target, Magic (-950)
1: Decrease Movement by 10000%
3: Increase Curse Counter by 45
4: Decrease HP when cast by 40000
Lord Sviir has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
a lupine spirit materializes in front of you, and its figure shimmers and shifts, seeming to belong neither to this plane of existence or another. It looks at you and speaks. 'Greetings, \_\_\_\_\_, I am Lupex, Thistlebrush's guide, if you will. Leave this room, and we shall continue your journey.'
a lupine spirit says 'My nose tells me Branton and Barleyburr are Very Far to the SOUTH and EAST.'

---

Follow the lupine spirit on the trail of Brantun and Barleyburr's scent 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Lupex has appeared to guide you to the prison where Brantun and Barleyburr are being held. Follow the wolf's directions.
This step will update automatically once you get to the prison location at /waypoint -766,+220,-512.66 in the next step. As you make your way there, the wolf will let off several emotes:
a lupine spirit says 'You know of the halflings and their plan to destroy the shard? And you now know Brantun and Barleyburr have been taken to the underground prison? Then you know as much as I. Thistlebrush has sent me to you, for my nose is keen. I can smell the paths of creatures both in this plane and in others. I can lead you to the halflings. Let us head south.'
a lupine spirit barks at you, motioning to its left. 'Do you know of the shard? Many say it is the piece of a god, one of many strewn about when his essence exploded into the sky. He was a god of fear, of darkness, of trembling. Merely a piece of this god has the power to bend reality, to alter and twist the minds of those who claim it and everything around them. Do you have the fortitude to draw near to something of such power? Do the halflings we now seek? Turn southeast.
a lupine spirit raises its head at sniffs the air of the tunnel on its left. 'I have traveled many strange lands and seen creatures and cities I could not have imagined. I have passed through the dark and light, through planes both mortal and immortal. I have seen the power this god holds over the mortal souls in this world. Without him they are maniacal and blithely suicidal; with him they are protected but enslaved in their own minds. Without even knowing the god's name, they sacrifice themselves upon its altar. That is true power. Can you confront something of this magnitude? Could you ever hope to destroy it, let alone control it? Go southeast.
a lupine spirit says 'Thistlebrush knows this, as do I. Brantun and Barleyburr, courageous as they are, have little hope of destroying the power this Xorbb wields. At best they could wrest it from Xorbb and place it under their own control. But what can honest-minded halflings attempt against the menacing hatred I feel emanating from Xorbb? If the halflings break under the strain of the shard or Xorbb's gaze, the task of grasping the shard will fall to you or me. Thistlebrush has attested to the strength of your will and purpose. He also knows my mind is not wholly of this world, not wholly bound by the powers of fear. We must act as necessary. Enter the room on the right: the prison. Brantun and Barleyburr should be held on a lower level.'
And upon reaching your destination:
a lupine spirit says 'We have found them, so for now my duty has been fulfilled. I will take my leave and walk the planes, though I will keep my eye upon all of you, watching for when the time comes. Farewell!'

---

Brantun and Barleyburr are being held in a cell; speak with Brantun 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Follow the lupine spirit on the trail of Brantun and Barleyburr's scent.
Brantun and Barleyburr are now in prison. A lupine spirit spawns and will automatically follow you, giving you directions as you move along. It will lead you to around -790, 225, -513. This is the prison (large circular room) in the southeastern section of the underground area. They are in cells across from each other in a hallway that extends downward from the large undead-filled room.
Target Brantun and hail him.
You say, 'Hail, Brantun'
Brantun grabs his cell bars and hoists himself up to look upon you. His face is ashen and streaked with blood and dirt. '\_\_\_\_\_, you found us! I thought we would rot in here!' Brantun slumps to the floor. 'But we might as well. It stole the rings from us: that horrible eye that always lurked at the edge of our vision, watching us. When I close my eyes, I can still see it. Sleeping and waking here seem the same. Bones clack along the stones, sour death fills my nostrils, and the eye floats through the corridor, enters my cell, and burrows into my mind. I want to cloak myself with the ring and hide from the gaze of the eye, but it -- they call it Syrkl -- carries the rings on its tendrils, mocking their power. It also holds the key to our cells. But do not fight it yet! It controls and is empowered by the dead. Unless you can wield an evil eye's gaze against Syrkl's minions, you will have little chance of defeating it. So, we will likely die within this cell.' Brantun turns away from you and clenches his fist.
Speak with Barleyburr. 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
You say, 'Hail, Barleyburr'
Barleyburr smiles at you, even though he, like Brantun, is pale and bleeding from the cuts on his face and scalp. 'Great to see you again, \_\_\_\_\_! I don't suppose you brought a bit of food, did you? The last ham you gave me was ruined by some bumbling goblins. They actually tried to throw me down that pit! It was quite a fall, but I had some of that ham stuffed in my britches, and it cushioned my landing. They confiscated it after they found me alive and threw me in here. By the way, how did you find us? Lupex? I haven't heard of him before, but Thistlebrush has plenty of creatures running around. It's hard to remember all their names! But I'm rambling now. It's just so good to see a familiar face here, to remind me that we still have some hope. Now all you have to do is get the key and our rings from that Syrkl creature, and our quest will continue. I know you can do it, \_\_\_\_\_!

---

Kill evil eyes and remove their lenses 0/15 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Lord Syrkl, another one of Xorbb's lieutenants, controls the prison and has taken the rings from Brantun and Barleyburr. Before you can confront him, though, you must kill several evil eyes and take the lenses. Only with these will you be able to easily defeat the undead minions summoned by Lord Syrkl.
Vitreous Lens [item=108357] will only drop if you have this task. They drop 1-4 at a time off any evil eye mob in the zone.

---

Confront Lord Syrkl 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
Lord Syrkl [npc=42420] ( map) is in the middle of the large circular room. He will go aggro soon after being hailed.
You say, 'Hail, Lord Syrkl'
Lord Syrkl catches you in the reflection of its eye. Your image begins to melt as Syrkl's voice enters your head. 'The halflings? King Xorbb has reserved for them a life of introspection. Their remaining years will be served here, so they may contemplate the hubris of slinking into his domain with power stolen from him, like a thief attending a lord's dinner party, bearing wine pilfered from the lord's own cellar.
Lord Syrkl says 'Do you know what King Xorbb has suffered to become that lord? Do you know how many years he spent in the depths underneath this valley? And vicious thieves like you and the halflings would return him to that prison and murder all his followers. I see you are deaf to my words of wisdom. You do not have the capacity for contemplation. There is only one fate for you.' Your image drowns within a cloud of red that billows across Syrkl's iris.'
He attacks.
Defeat Lord Syrkl 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Kill Lord Syrkl to retrieve the prison key and the rings he stole from Brantun and Barleyburr.
Lord Syrkl hits for a max ~30,000; is a belly caster (stand on top of him to land spells); single-target rampages; and flurries.
At 80%, 50%, and 30% health, he spawns 3x a skullcluster [npc=42619] (these hit for a max ~3,500). To kill these, you can use the Vitreous Lens [item=108357] or just DPS them normally. (You can also just ignore the adds and burn through Lord Syrkl, if you have the power to do so. His adds will despawn upon his death.)
During the fight, Lord Syrkl does an emote:
Lord Syrkl draws a charge from each of its subordinates and prepares to fire a blast.
This indicates he is five seconds away from casting Multiplicative Beam. The number of casts are determined by the how many skulls are alive.
Multiplicative Beam: Unknown(44) 15', Magic (-1050)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 10000
As he lowers in health, he will also have a few more things to say:
Lord Syrkl says 'We were once weak, crushed under foot by Runnyeye. I too knew my own pains and tortures at their hands. But King Xorbb has made us strong. The power to control death is mine, and with this power I bring death to you.'
Lord Syrkl's eye narrows and burns with hatred. 'You wield the eyes of my brethren against me! There will be no leniency for you -- no pardon, no prison, not even a burial. These bones will pile atop yours, stripping your flesh and leaving you unrecognizable to everything you once loved or loved you. You will be erased from my sight!
Lord Syrkl's eye begins to twitch, leaking humor from a wide gash. 'My death will gain you nothing. I am but a servant, carrying out the will of the King. My strength is insignificant compared to his. Devour me if you can, like a predator its prey, but I will claw your eyes as you do. When you stagger blindly within the light of my master's fire, a mere thought will be all he needs to send a lance through your heart!
Lord Syrkl has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
You have recovered Brantun and Barleyburr's rings, as well as the key to their cells.
Upon his death, you receive 2x Recovered Multiphasic Ring [item=108542] and 1x Xorbb Prison Key [item=108543] (everyone in the group who is on this step receives these items).

---

Return to Brantun and Barleyburr 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
Return to their prison cells.
You can now use the key taken from Lord Syrkl to unlock the doors of Brantun and Barleyburr's cells.
Speak with Barleyburr 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
You say, 'Hail, Barleyburr'
Barleyburr leaps to his feet and claps you on the back. '\_\_\_\_\_, I knew you would come through for us!' Barleyburr takes his ring from you but frowns and stares at his palm. 'This might not help us much. Xorbb's lieutenants can see us when we wear it, and it gives me an awful feeling of dread when I put it on. But I suppose I don't have much choice, do I? It's better than walking about this place in plain sight. Again, thank you, \_\_\_\_\_. We will finish what we have begun, because of you. Brantun, are you ready? We have work to do!'
Speak with Brantun 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
You say, 'Hail, Brantun'
Brantun clutches his ring tightly when you hand it to him. He looks past you as he speaks. 'There will be no forgiveness. Do you know what it is like to watch helplessly as your friend is thrown into a pit, or to be beaten half dead for days and nights -- or whatever passes for days and nights in this windowless prison? I feel no pity for Xorbb. That someone who suffered as he did can inflict such suffering on others is inexcusable. Wounded animals that lash out in agony should be destroyed, lest they destroy everything around them. We will deliver that destruction, no matter the cost. Halflings will not be mutilated by Xorbb's flailing attempts at vengeance. I will not be cowed by such a beast!' Brantun's brow darkens, and the hand clutching the ring begins to glow. 'Barleyburr, it is time. \_\_\_\_\_, tell Thistlebrush we are ready. Begin the assault upon Xorbb's troops, and we will penetrate the seat of his power and destroy it. The end is near.'

---

Tell Thistlebrush what transpired 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)
_Task Window Says:_ Brantun and Barleyburr are going to make their move on King Xorbb's seat of power. Tell Thistlebrush it is time to begin the assault.
You say, 'Hail, Thistlebrush'
Thistlebrush looks to the sky, as though watching clouds gather overhead. 'Then the time is at hand. Truly, I thought you would find them dead. Lupex found them, you say? That name makes me shiver, for I do not know it. It is not a spirit or animal I have seen. But I have felt ill of ease lately -- and not solely because of our plight. I have felt a presence about me that I cannot shake, but I thought it only agitation. Guard your mind, for I do not know whether Xorbb's influence extends beyond this plane.' Thistlebrush looks you in the eye. 'Now, though, we must prepare for war. Speak with me when you are ready to execute the plan.'
You have succeeded in finding and rescuing Brantun and Barleyburr. Along the way you managed to defeat two of King Xorbb's lieutenants. Now Brantun and Barleyburr are approaching the heart of King Xorbb's power, the shard of fear. It is time to execute Thistlebrush's plan and engage King Xorbb's troops in battle.

You say, 'Hail, Thistlebrush'

You also handled yourself magnificently in our [war] against Xorbb's forces. Thank you!'

**Task Steps**

_Task Window Says:_ Speak with Barleyburr and find out what happened to Brantun.
Speak with Lupex 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)

_Task Window Says:_ Defeat Xorbb and save Norrath.

**Summary**
\- Say "destroy" to Barleyburr.
\- Say "kill" to Lupex.
\- Say "escape" to King Xorbb to trigger the event.
\- Spells:
\-\-\- Buffed with "Reflective Lens" (500 damage shield; 70% chance to reflect spells).
\-\-\-\-\-\- This is removeable (see below).
\-\-\- Casts "Futile Resistance" (stat reduction).
\-\-\- Casts "Dominating Gaze" (3-tick charm preceded by an emote; face away to avoid).
\-\-\-\-\-\- The emote offers a 5-second warning to face away.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Emote: King Xorbb shouts '\_\_\_\_\_' (where the blank is a player name).
\-\-\-\-\-\- At the beginning, he emotes one at a time; midway, two at a time; towards the end, three at a time.
\-\-\- Casts "Oblivion Gaze" (60k nuke + other detriments, preceded by a directional emote; avoidable).
\-\-\- Casts "Omnisight Beam" (20k nuke, directional).
\-\-\-\-\-\- This is cast every 35 seconds (has a 15-second warning emote).
\-\-\-\-\-\- Up until 65%, applies to only one direction.
\-\-\-\-\-\- After 65%, applies to two directions.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Directions will be emoted as "LEFT", "RIGHT", "FORWARD", and "BACKWARD".
\-\-\- Casts "Shard Injection" (AE stun, preceded by warning emote).
\-\-\-\-\-\- Cast only while his "Reflective Lens" buff is down.
\-\-\- Casts "Deathrift" (34k AE nuke if too many people charmed).
\- Base Adds:
\-\-\- About every 3 minutes (varies), Xorbb goes non-combat and spawns four adds (one of each type).
\-\-\-\-\-\- One type of goblin can be mezzed or charmed. The other goblin is not known to be CC'able.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Fungus men can be rooted.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Minotaurs are immune to root/mez/charm/stun.
\-\-\- At 20%, 15%, 10%, 5%, and 0% health, Xorbb spawns one additional add (random type as above).
\- Mini Nameds (based on Xorbb's health %):
\-\-\- 85%: Soul Gazer (random single-target charm, "Servant of the Eye")
\-\-\- 65%: The Proudheart Shell (random single-target push, "Crystal Drift")
\-\-\- 45%: Soul Stealer (does not attack; emotes about following a player; had an aura that dispells)
\-\-\- 35%: Soul Gazer (repeated)
\-\-\- 25%: Brantun the Corrupted (casts "Infernal Transformation" on random target; after 6 seconds, turns player into a crystal with a damage aura)
\- Removing Xorbb's Reflection Buff:
\-\-\- When Xorbb went non-combat (as outlined above), he spawned four adds and moved to one of the lenses that are around the perimeter of the room.
\-\-\- These adds each drop an item with a buff effect.
\-\-\- After the adds are dead and looted, 1-3 players (with the item on them) should run to the front of the lens that Xorbb is currently located behind.
\-\-\- After a certain amount of time, he will emote that he's about to fire off his "Gaze" spell from that lens.
\-\-\- Those players with the item in hand should wait a few seconds and then click the buff on themselves.
\-\-\-\-\-\- When he fires his "Gaze" spell at this time, the buffs cause it to reflect back onto Xorbb. This removes his "Reflective Lens" buff for 90-120 seconds.
\-\-\- From 100% to 85% health, one player must have the buff and be in position to reflect it.
\-\-\- From 85% to 66% health, two players must have the buff and be in position to reflect it.
\-\-\- From 66% to 0% health, three players must have the buff and be in position to reflect it.
\-\-\- Note that while his "Reflective Lens" buff is down, he starts casting his "Shard Injection" AE stun (which is preceded by an emote)

**Speak with Barleyburr**
_Barleyburr stands at the zone-in point:_
You say, 'Hail, Barleyburr'
Barleyburr practically pulls your arm off as he takes hold of your sleeve and whispers hurriedly, eyes darting about. 'You came, \_\_\_\_\_, you came! And you brought friends! But, oh, it must be too late now! Our mission has [failed]. I have failed. I let Brantun down; I let everyone down! If you wanted to [leave] I wouldn't blame you!
You say, 'Failed?'
Barleyburr says 'We stood before Xorbb -- the King. As we stared up at the crystal, the heart of fear, wondering how to destroy it, preparing the explosive powder we had sewn away in our packs and clothing, he materialized before us. The King descended, engulfing our vision in his endless iris. Our thoughts sank into that black disk, and we couldn't move a muscle as his [thoughts] washed around us and through us.'
You say, 'What thoughts?'
Barleyburr says 'I don't want to remember such things: seeing the whole of Rivervale burning in the night, its citizens drowning in fire; glimpsing a horde of goblins and minotaurs washing across the hills and valleys of Antonica, consuming crops and towns like locusts; and knowing that all who oppose the King will end up dead or in the darkest abyssal prison that could be conceived. The power I saw was enormous...and disgusting. And then he [spoke] to us.'
You say, 'Who spoke?'
Barleyburr says 'Sorry, \_\_\_\_\_, my mind and belly are too anxious to remember exactly what he said. I almost vomited with fear as he spoke. He told us our time upon this world had ended. Our time now belonged to him, and was his to do with as he pleased. We had amused him with our infiltration plan, and he had decided to employ us as soldiers in his invisible vanguard that walk into towns and wreak havoc upon the citizens as the King's army marches upon them. Either this, or he would mount our bodies upon poles and carry them at the front of his army, as he would the corpses of any other adventurer who might be [brave] enough or foolish enough to oppose him.'
You say, 'Brave?'
Barleyburr says 'I am such a coward! I was shaking all over, and when I looked at Brantun, I saw his face contorted with rage. The ring in his palm was glowing and pulsing in time with the fear crystal. He did not look to be the same person I have known for so long. He knelt and stretched out a hand to the King. Shards fell from the fear crystal above us and swirled around Brantun. They swarmed over him and covered his body, and soon he looked like he was wearing an armored suit of crystal. The ring floated from his palm and slipped onto his finger. He [disappeared] from sight, probably forever.'
You say, 'Disappeared?'
Barleyburr says 'You probably would have been braver than I, \_\_\_\_\_. I ran and hid myself here. The King disappeared along with Brantun, and I have not seen either of them since. I don't know where Brantun has gone, but I'm certain the King has taken control of his mind. How will I ever find Brantun and [destroy] the crystal now? I don' think I could face King Xorbb again...'
You say, 'How can we destroy it?'
Barleyburr says 'With you here, \_\_\_\_\_, maybe we can manage it. But...wait, I feel a presence!'
_Lupex spawns nearby._

---

**Speak with Lupex**
You say, 'Hail, Lupex'
Lupex says 'Do not tremble, Barleyburr. I knew you would need help, and so I have led these adventurers to you. Brantun has fallen to his own pride and the raw fear emanating from the crystal. You will be unable to rescue Brantun or destroy the crystal as long as Xorbb lives, for he has linked himself to the source of fear. Adventurers, fulfill your purpose: [Kill] Xorbb.'
You say, 'Kill him?'
Lupex says 'He is still within this chamber. I will call to him.' Lupex raises his head to howl, but he does so without a sound. You see a massive eye materialize near the altar. 'He has come. Confront him.'
_King Xorbb spawns in the middle of the room._

---

**Speak with King Xorbb & Triggering the Event**
You say, 'Hail, King Xorbb'
King Xorbb stares into you. Images and words not of your own enter your mind. You feel as though you are standing amid the darkest night, looking into a bonfire that burns as if it would consume the world. 'What do you know of the [darkness], \_\_\_\_\_?'
You say, 'What darkness?'
King Xorbb says 'It is the catalyst of vision. First the sparks appear, flashing like flint struck in the depths of night. Then the fires of green, blue, orange, and red sweep across your lens, outlining the hills, rivers, and sunsets you will never see again. In time, you paint your own world in fire. The grass is green and deep; the sky is blue and endless; the blood of your [enemies] is crimson, running like rainwater down the staves upon which they hang.'
You say, 'Enemies?'
King Xorbb says 'They locked me in the darkness, but I recreated the world they stole from me. My cell became the valley I once knew, and the rivers choked on the bodies of my enemies and all who had conspired to imprison me. I vowed if I were ever to [escape], I would create the valley I had seen in my cell. I would have my vengeance. I would have my conquest.'
You say, 'You will not escape'
King Xorbb says 'Another spark in the darkness: In an instant it burned with the power of Ro and flooded in white my imagined valley. When again I could see, there was the crystal shard, glowing and smoldering with a power I had never known. I claimed it. Ascending through the rift it had torn in the bedrock, I remade the valley in the image I had seen countless times throughout my endless night. Soon all my enemies will suffer as I did, and their blood will flow. Those in Norrath who do not kneel before me will know only the darkness of the abyss, as I once did!'
_About 60 seconds pass and he aggro's._

---

**King Xorbb: The Fight**
_King Xorbb hits for a max ~16,500 (does not flurry or rampage). He is auto-aggro; summons from 100%; and is NOT rooted in place (but is leashed to the room he's in). He buffs himself with "Reflective Lens" (stays on him for the whole phase):_
Reflective Lens: Self 0', Unresistable (0)
1: Increase Damage Shield by 500
2: Increase Chance to Reflect Spell by 70%
_He also frequently casts "Futile Resistance":_
Futile Resistance: PB AE 1500', Unresistable (0)
1: Decrease All Resists by 800

---

**King Xorbb: Charm Emotes**
_Xorbb has a few emotes. One of them is a five-second warning for a single-target charm:_
King Xorbb shouts 'Avert your gaze or suffer:'
King Xorbb shouts '\_\_\_\_\_'
_The blank is the name of a player (this is the line to use as an audio trigger). In the beginning of the fight, only one player is targeted. Towards the middle of the fight, two players are targeted at a time. And towards the end of the fight, three players are targeted at a time._
_Once this emote goes off, the target has five seconds to face away from Xorbb. Failure to do so will result in this..._
King Xorbb shouts '\_\_\_\_\_ did not avert their gaze! They will serve me!'
_...And the targeted player will be hit with "Dominating Gaze":_
Dominating Gaze: Single Target, Magic (-960)
1: Charm up to level 300 _(2 ticks)_
_Note: If four or more players are charmed at any given time, he begins AEing "Deathrift":_
Deathrift: PB AE 500', (-250)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 34000
_If followed successfully, you will see this:_
King Xorbb shouts '\_\_\_\_\_ averted their gaze and escaped punishment.'

---

**King Xorbb: Direction Emotes**
_Xorbb also has directional emotes. From 100% to 65%, he emotes a single direction. From 65% to his death, he emotes about two directions. These emotes look like this:_
King Xorbb prepares to fire a beam LEFT.
King Xorbb prepares to fire a beam RIGHT.
King Xorbb prepares to fire a beam FORWARD.
King Xorbb prepares to fire a beam BACKWARD.
King Xorbb prepares to fire a beam BACKWARD and RIGHT.
King Xorbb prepares to fire a beam FORWARD and LEFT.
King Xorbb prepares to fire a beam RIGHT and LEFT.
_This emote is done every 35-40 seconds, and is a 15-second warning to the directional spell "Omnisight Beam":_
Omnisight Beam: Directional 300', (-250)

**King Xorbb: The Lens & Adds**
_Every three minutes, but as you get closer to 40% on the boss they come at 2 min 45, then 2 min 30 sec it seems, Xorbb goes non-aggro:_
King Xorbb readies his focal lenses for a brutal attack.
_When he does this, he moves to one of the crystal lens in the room. At the same time this happens, four adds spawn and auto-aggro your group. There are four types of adds. You will always get one of each:_
a weakminded goblin

a flamenerve goblin

Goblin Fire: Single Target, Fire (-960)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 13000 per tick
2: Increase Curse Counter by 30
a hobblefooted fungus
_Rootable; immune to stun/mez; hits for a max ~8,000; casts "Fungus Bite":_
Fungus Bite: Single Target, Poison (-960)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 6900 per tick
2: Increase Poison Counter by 35
a stalwart minotaur

Thunderground: PB AE 50', Magic (-960)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 28000
_Each of these adds drops an item called "Barrier Shard Crystal". Once the adds are dead, these items should be looted and whoever has one should move to the front of the lens that Xorbb is located behind and wait for this emote:_
King Xorbb chooses a lens from which to fire.
_This is a 20-second warning for "Oblivion Gaze" which will be fired from the lens he's located at. Upon seeing this emote, players should wait a few seconds and then click the Barrier Shard Crystal buff on themselves (the buff is short-lasting, so if you click it too soon, it will wear off before the AE fires off)._
_20 seconds after the above emote, you see this emote as "Oblivion Gaze" is cast from the lens:_
King Xorbb fires his beam through the focal lens.
Oblivion Gaze: PB AE 3000', Unresistable (0)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 60000

King Xorbb is struck by the the oblivion beam as it reflects off of \_\_\_\_\_
King Xorbb loses his reflective protection for 120 seconds as enough people reflect his spell.
Your immunity buff protected you from the spell Oblivion Gaze!
_From 100% to 85% health, one player must have the buff and be in position to reflect it. From 85% to 66% health, two players must have the buff and be in position to reflect it. From 66% to 0% health, three players must have the buff and be in position to reflect it._

**King Xorbb's Death**
King Xorbb has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
_Lupex appears and makes its way towards the crystal._
Lupex shouts 'You have done it, as I knew you would. Now that Xorbb is no longer linked to the crystal, its power can be handled. I will not ask you to do such a dangerous thing, for mortal minds are swiftly destroyed by fear and power. I will settle the matter. Its influence will no longer concern your realm.'
Lupex begins to absorb the power of the crystal shard.
Lupex disappears into a different realm of existence, taking the shard's power with him.
_An ornate chest spawns on Xorbb's throne. Open it to complete the task:_
You have defeated King Xorbb and saved Norrath from his vengeance. Lupex, who left as mysteriously as he appeared, has absorbed the power of the crystal shard and disappeared. No one, not even Thistlebrush, knows who or what this creature is. Your instincts tell you that you have not seen the end of this matter. The true reign of fear has yet to begin.
You say, 'Hail, Barleyburr'
Barleyburr looks at Brantun. 'I forgive you. I'm the one who should be sorry, though. I was scared too! I ran when I should have stood and fought or smacked some sense into you! But you're alive, and that's what matters! Xorbb is dead, and the crystal has been drained of power. We saved all of Rivervale! You don't have to worry about appearing strong; the town has been saved, and that's what [matters]!
You say, 'Matters?'
Barleyburr says 'We have our lives and our town. We still have so many things to enjoy. We just went on a grand adventure and lived to tell about it, and there are many more adventures to be had! I don't care what some elf or human thinks about my bravery or battle prowess. I'm not going to live my life inside their heads! I'm going to raise my pigs, walk the valleys, and enjoy the sun. Brantun, you'll fight bandits, protect the town, and keep our families safe. We'll do what we love, and leave it to others to worry whether our actions were great or small.' Barleyburr smiles. 'And speaking of what we love, we should get back to Rivervale soon. It's about time we had some thick slabs of ham and celebrated our victory properly!'
You say, 'Hail, Brantun'
Brantun hangs his head. 'I do not deserve such mercy or kindness as you have shown me. For my actions, you should have destroyed me. In my [fear] I gave in to Xorbb and would have sacrificed all of Rivervale to save myself. I do not ask you to forgive me, Barleyburr, but I am sorry -- sorrier than you could know.' Barleyburr only nods and places his hand on Brantun's shoulder.
You say, 'Fear?'
Brantun says 'I only ever desired to be strong, to be a standard of my people, but wanting everyone to know of my strength made me weak. It allowed Xorbb and the shard of fear to manipulate me. I could not allow myself to be paraded about on one of Xorbb's pikes like a trophy. I thought it would be better to be hated and feared as a destroyer of cities than to be seen as a failed symbol, another hapless halfling dead and mocked. I thought there were only two choices, but I was wrong, Barleyburr. You all have shown me there is another way. You are never as strong as when you admit your weaknesses and accept the help of others.'
You say, 'Hail, Thistlebrush'
Thistlebrush says 'This outcome is far better than I had feared. Brantun, Barleyburr, and present company, thanks to you, Rivervale, and likely all of Norrath, has been spared. Our strategy, though at great cost, has won us victory. The only question that remains is who this [Lupex] is.'
You say, 'Who is Lupex?'
Thistlebrush says 'This spirit, whatever it is, has taken the power of the crystal and rendered it inert. And since Lupex has disappeared from this plane, I no longer feel the oppressive presence that has hovered about me for days. It is too soon to say who or what Lupex is, or what it wants with the power of the crystal. I fear, though, that we have not seen the end of its influence on Norrath. But let us be glad now of our success and [return] to Rivervale as heroes!'

_This is a kill task that begins with "Expedition Elite Guard" ( map) in Grelleth's Palace, the Chateau of Filth. He is located at 1200, 200, 0 (zone-in area among all the expedition NPCs)._
You say, 'Hail, Expedition Elite Guard'
Expedition Elite Guard says 'Honor to you, friend. I'm Reena Kedson's bodyguard. My name? It's not important. I was hired to... erm... "watch over" her and her companions and ensure their success. I am a [pratictal] man, I don't dabble in intricate plots and schemes. Our enemies are all around us, help me make their presence more... scarce. My employer will handsomely reward you for your trouble.'
You say, 'Practical?'
Expedition Elite Guard says 'War is a simple matter really: the less enemies there are left alive, the more likely we are to win. My master... I mean, my employer, needs me to keep a close eye on Reena and her companions so it will be your duty to kill us some swinetor! They are gathering en masse so we must thin out their ranks. You should be taking out their Scouts, their Guard, their evil Casters and their meddling Beastlords with their pets.'
You have been assigned the task 'Raw Counter Intelligence'.
Reena's bodyguard wants you to eliminate some Swinetor scouts.
The Palace Scouts can be found throughout the area.

---

_This is a solo task begins with Aranu ( map) in Evantil, the Vile Oak. This is an Alaran located at 120, 440, 15 (at the base of the tree, west-central side)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Aranu'
Aranu says, in Alaran, 'Hello, wanderer. Stay your weapons; I have no interest in harming you. I have come here to try to find a cure for the horrible effects the fear fruit are having on my people. I believe I just might have [found something] that may work.'
You say, 'You found something?'
Aranu says, in Alaran, 'The evil magic that leaks into the surrounding land from the vile oak has produced some horrible mutations in the creatures that live here. The strangest has to be the gibbering fear breeder. It is an elusive creature whose offspring look nothing like the adults at all. In fact, they look very similar to small eyeballs. I assume this is to try to scare off any predators that would try to eat them; not that their adult form is any more pleasing. Inside of the stomachs of these offspring is something [wonderful].'
You say, 'What was wonderful?'
Aranu says, in Alaran, 'While the offspring of the gibbering fear breeder are still young and in eyeball form, pearl-like growths are formed within their stomachs. There are many different types of these growths and I have found that when ground into powder form, they can offer some temporary relief from the addictive fear fruit. I need more samples however. Can you [help] me? Perhaps if I can get enough samples, I can create a more long lasting form of relief from the effects of the fear fruit.'
You say, 'I will help'
Aranu says, in Alaran, 'Thank you. Your kindness will not be forgotten. Collect [fearbreeder offspring stomachs] from fearbreeder offspring and return them to me. I have become quite adept at scraping the growths from the stomachs without damaging them.'
You have been assigned the task 'Strong Stomachs Needed'.
Aranu needs you to collect some fearbreeder stomachs so that the valuable, pearl-like growths that form inside their stomachs can be extracted to help make a substance that can help provide relief from the effects of the fear fruits.
Kill gibbering offspring breeders or gibbering fear breeders and give the fearbreeder offspring stomachs to Aranu. Aranu can extract the growths from the stomachs for you. You will need to collect some swirled pearlescent growths, large pearlescent growths, oddly shaped pearlescent growths, small pearlescent growths, delicate pearlescent growths, slimy pearlescent growths, and grimy pearlescent growths.

---

_This is a solo task that begins with Gimthra ( map) in Evantil, the Vile Oak. She is found at -185, 345, 20. This is at the very base of the tree (southwest corner, on the inside of the "gorge" that surrounds the tree's south side)_
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Gimthra'
Gimthra tips her mug to the sky and chugs. After a few seconds, she carelessly tosses the metal tankard to the ground and wipes the dripping foam from her lips with her arm. She reeks of beer as she looks up at you and grins. 'You here for the [dragons]?'
You say, 'Dragons...'
Gimthra doesn't wait for your response. She cuts you off and starts walking around you in a wide, wobbly circle, waving her arms while she rants, 'Yeah, they told me there'd be dragons here too!' Gimthra starts pantomiming her descriptions as she continues, 'Giant, scaly beasts with big wings, twenty rows of teeth, and at least fifty-foot torch radius on the flames it can shoot from its mouth. I came here for dragons, I came here for [treasure], I came here for glory! Instead I get a bunch of [weird bugs]. No thanks.
You say, 'What treasure?'
Gimthra's eyes darken and she tears off her bracer and throws it as far as she can, 'Dragon treasure! I was told there would be mountains of treasure the size of...' Gimthra's voice trails off as she loses focus and struggles to think, '...well, mountains, I guess. Lots of mountains of treasure!' Gimthra's eyes light up and she stumbles towards you. 'Can you imagine if there were mountains of treasure here? Those [wimpy druids] told me there was never any treasure here. You think they're hiding it?'
You say, 'What about the weird bugs?'
Gimthra laughs and puts her arm around your shoulder, 'Well, all bugs are kind of weird, you know? But these bugs are, uh, extra weird. There's like all-white snakes and some wolves made out of trees or something and, oh, there's these little floating eyeballs that are super weird!' Gimthra holds you at arm's distance, steadying herself by holding onto you, and looks you in the eyes, 'How have you not seen these, Gnome? They're like everywhere. You've seen those [wimpy druids] at least, right? I hope I'm not hallucinating all this.'
You say, 'Wimpy druids?'
Gimthra picks up her tankard and fills it with beer at the nearest keg while she talks, 'They're just to the east near the base of this big tree. But there's not much use talking to them. All they care about is that stupid tree. They think it's such a big deal.' Gimthra takes on a mocking tone as she mimics the druids, 'Stop hassling us about dragons and treasure, Gimthra. Go away so we can hug our tree, Gimthra.' She spits out some beer on the ground and takes another swig before looking back at you, 'I mean, come on! The tree isn't even that big! I could totally [cut that tree down] in like two chops of an axe.'
You say, 'Cut that tree down?'
Gimthra jumps at you and puts her finger in your chest while shouting at you with her beer-heavy breath, 'What? You don't think I can't do it? You don't think I can cut down this little wimpy tree? I've cut down trees twice its size without breaking a sweat. I'll do it right now, I'll prove it to you. Go get me an [axe]!'
You say, 'An axe?'
Gimthra says 'Yeah, an axe, dummy. Does it look like I'm carrying an axe big enough to chop down this tree? Go get me some piles of scrap metal and wood. I'll make the axe myself and then chop this tree down, dwarf-style.'
You have been assigned the task 'A Feat of Drunken Strength'.
You met a drunk dwarf who insists she can cut down the massive tree that sits in the middle of the region. You don't see any way that she could possibly succeed, but it might be entertaining to watch her try.
She challenged you to bring her wood from the treants that wander around the outskirts of the area so she can build an axe. She'll also need some metal scraps. You can find them suspended inside saps and oozelings around outcroppings close to the tree.

---

Collect pieces of wood from treants 0/5 (Evantil, the Vile Oak)
Collect metal scraps from saps 0/3 (Evantil, the Vile Oak)
_Treants are all over the outer area of the zone. Oozes are in the chasm and top-side as well._
Give the materials to Gimthra 0/1 (Evantil, the Vile Oak)
_Hail her and follow through dialogue, then say "a pet snake" for the update._
Find a pretty flower 0/1 (Evantil, the Vile Oak)
_These are the flower mobs that are found wandering about the same area. There is no item involved here. It's a random update on kills._
Steal an animal trap from the wretched living in the tree 0/1 (Evantil, the Vile Oak)
_Go up the ramp that leads into the tree entrance (the ramp is southeast of Gimthra's camp, nearby the main cluster of quest NPCs). The animal trap is a ground spawn next to the Alaran at the top of this ramp (in the first room). It's along the wall and is bright orange in appearance. (-225, -95, 241)_
Fight a snake until it passes out, then throw the trap on it while it's unconscious 0/1 (Evantil, the Vile Oak)
_Fight snakes until you get a proper update message._
Give the snake and the flower to Gimthra 0/1 (Evantil, the Vile Oak)
Ask the gnome nearby for help 0/1 (Evantil, the Vile Oak)
_Hail Anorak ( map), who stands nearby._

_This is a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Kesar ( map) at the zone-in of the Breeding Grounds (-20, 0, 4)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Kesar'
Kesar says 'Hello. Care to take a shot at [training] a dragon? It is both rewarding and terrifying at the same time!'
You say, 'Training?'
Kesar says 'Don't worry; it's not that difficult. Are you [interested]?'
You say, 'I'm interested'
Kesar says 'Excellent! First thing we will need to do is get some treats for the young dragons. You can't teach them if they aren't motivated. Take this pickle juice and collect some chetari brains. Place a chetari brain inside the pickle juice to make a pickled chetari brain. The dragons here just love them. If you need [more pickle juice] just let me know.'
_You receive "Pickle Juice" (single-slot container)._
You have been assigned the task 'The Dragon Whisperer'.
Kesar has offered you the chance of learning the basics of training dragons.

---

Kill chetari and collect their brains 0/4 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Brains can drop from four types of Chetaris:_
a Chetari deathbender
a Chetari hoarder
a Chetari scavenger
a Chetari seeker
_Once looted, combine them one at a time in the "Pickle Juice" container to produce "A Pickled Chetari Brain"._

---

Speak with Kesar 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
You say, 'Hail, Kesar'
Kesar says 'Did you make some pickled chetari brains? I hope so. Approach one of the three young dragons that are not being trained at the moment and give them a pickled chetari brain to continue.'
Give a young dragon a Pickled Chetari Brain 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Teach a young dragon to sit 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Target the young dragon next to Kesar and tell it to "sit" (you may need to repeat this a few times)._
Give a young dragon a Pickled Chetari Brain 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Teach a young dragon to stand 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Target the young dragon next to Kesar and tell it to "stand" (you may need to repeat this a few times)._
Give a young dragon a Pickled Chetari Brain 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Teach a young dragon to play dead 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Target the young dragon next to Kesar and tell it to "play dead" (you may need to repeat this a few times)._
Give a young dragon a Pickled Chetari Brain 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Teach a young dragon to NOT breathe fire 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Target the young dragon next to Kesar and say to it "do not breathe fire" (you may need to repeat this a few times)._
_Your exchange might look something like this:_
You say, 'Sit'
The young dragon sits down. You have successfully taught the young to sit!
You say, 'Stand'
The young dragon sits down. You have failed to teach the dragon to stand up. Try again!
You say, 'Stand'
The young dragon breathes fire. You have failed to teach the dragon to stand up. Try again!
You say, 'Stand'
The young dragon stands up. You have successfully taught the young to stand up!
You say, 'Play dead'
The young dragon plays dead. You have successfully taught the young to play dead!
You say, 'Do NOT breathe fire'
The young dragon breathes fire. You have failed to teach the dragon to not breathe fire. Try again!
You say, 'Do NOT breathe fire'
The young dragon does not breathe fire. You have successfully taught the young to not breathe fire!
Speak with Kesar 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Once done, hail Kesar._
You say, 'Hail, Kesar'
Kesar says 'I was watching how you handled the dragons. Not too shabby for a first time dragon trainer. A living dragon trainer is a successful dragon trainer as they say. You are by no means a master dragon trainer yet, but you at least know the basics now. Please take this for your hard work.'
_Rewards:_
187 platinum, 5 gold
Experience (2 AAs + 1-2% exp in Level 96)

_This is a solo task that begins with Asupi Muksap ( map) in the Breeding Grounds. He is located around 200, -350, -99 (from the zone-in area, head east into the narrow tunnels and to the northwestern-most room in those tunnels)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Asupi Muksap'
Asupi Muksap's whiskers twitch as he speaks to you with a surprising command of the common tongue, 'Hail to you, \_\_\_\_\_. Tell me, do you have a discerning [palette]?
You say, 'Palette?'
Asupi Muksap says 'While the Paebala and [Chetari] share somewhat of the same diet, our tastes are much more refined than our primitive counterparts. They choose to feed off the rancid corpses of dragons, while we prefer to feast on finer [delicacies].'
You say, 'What delicacies?'
Asupi Muksap says 'A personal favorite of mine is dragon pate. It's mixed with a delectable blend of herbs and spices that will dance on your tongue! I'm always happy to share my culinary delights with someone else who appreciates a tasty morsel. If you bring me the [ingredients] I need, I'll be happy to prepare for you my delicious pate!'
You say, 'What ingredients?'
Asupi Muksap hands you a lined knapsack. 'Fills this knapsack with dragon livers. Don't worry, the lining shouldn't leak. I'll also require a Dirty Onion, and some Fire Roasted Garlic, both of which can be foraged around the caverns.'
_You receive a "Lined Knapsack"._
You have been assigned the task 'Delectable Dragon Pate'.
Asupi Muksap has offered to make you some dragon patte if you bring him the ingredients he needs.

With an accomplished grin spread across his face, the ratman extends the freslhy prepared delicacy, 'One bite of this pate, and you'll be back for more!'
After collecting the required ingredients for Asupi Muksap, he made you some Delectable Dragon Pate.

_This is a solo task that begins with Asupi Muksap ( map) in the Breeding Grounds. He is located around 200, -350, -99 (from the zone-in area, head east into the narrow tunnels and to the northwestern-most room in those tunnels)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Asupi Muksap'
Asupi Muksap's whiskers twitch as he speaks to you with a surprising command of the common tongue, 'Hail to you, \_\_\_\_\_. Tell me, do you have a discerning [palette]?
You say, 'Palette?'
Asupi Muksap says 'While the Paebala and [Chetari] share somewhat of the same diet, our tastes are much more refined than our primitive counterparts. They choose to feed off the rancid corpses of dragons, while we prefer to feast on finer [delicacies].'
You say, 'What about the Chetari?'
Asupi Muksap's eyes squint as his voice drops to a more serious tone, 'Chetari are the filthy ratmen that followed us here from the Necropolis. They breed like rabbits, polluting any area they inhabit. Those mindless scavengers already outnumber the Paebala, and will soon deplete the [food supply] with their insatiable appetite for decomposing dragon flesh.
You say, 'Food supply?'
Asupi Muksap says 'Unlike Dragon Necropolis, this cavern breathes new life rather than constant death. We must sustain ourselves on the flesh of dragons, but a dragon corpse is often hard to come by. We are few, and they are many, which is why the Paebala look for [allies] in adventurers like you. Someone with your skills can bring those large beasts to the ground, take their spoils, and leave the corpse for us to feed on.'
You say, 'What allies?'
Asupi Muksap says 'A true ally would [help] us get rid of the Chetari. I can say with certainty that Norrath would be better off without them. Of course I don't expect you to get your hands dirty...' The ratman flashes a quick smile, revealing tiny, pointed teeth. 'The Chetari's insatiable hunger will be the cause of their demise. You will simply lead them to it.'
You say, 'I will help'
Asupi Muksap nods in approval, and begins to disclose his plan, 'The best way to quietly reduce the Chetari population is to poison their food supply, but it's not as simple as pouring poison into their food. The scavengers will be able to detect any additives to their food, so we need to start at the [source].'
You have been assigned the task 'Poisoning the Food Supply'.
Asupi Muksap has asked you to help poison the Chetari's food supply. Asupi needs a few ingredients before he can mix the poison.
You say, 'Tell me about the source'
Asupi Muksap continues, 'If you can poison the dragons before you kill them, then the meat that clings to their bones will also be tainted, but undetectable to the Chetari. I have the formula for the poison all figured out, I just need you to collect the ingredients. Fear Fungi grows in warm spots within the caverns. You can scrape volcanic ash from the wings of lava dragons. Once you have the required items, return to me and I will coat your weapons in poison.'

---

Speak to Asupi 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
You say, 'Hail, Asupi Muksap'
Asupi Muksap begins to cast a spell.
Your weapon is coated in poison.
Asupi Muksap takes the items from you and begins to mix them together into a thick liquid that he then drips over your weapons. 'Be careful not to get any of this on your skin. It could have some negative side effects... Other than that, as long as your weapon remains coated, you should be able to poison any large, non-lava dragon you fight.'
Loot Tainted Dragon Flesh from the corpse of a sickly dragon 0/2 (The Breeding Grounds)
Kill any two regular fear or ice dragons while you have the poison buff on you. This turns the dragon green and indicates that they are poisoned. Kill and loot from corpses.
Place the Tainted Dragon Flesh inside a pile of dragon bones 0/2 (The Breeding Grounds)
The piles of dragon bones are found throughout the Chetari tunnels (you'll probably need to clear the room first).
Return to Asupi 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
You say, 'Hail, Asupi Muksap'
Asupi Muksap's lips curl up into a mischievous grin. 'So the deed is done? Good, good. I'm sure those filthy Chetari will devour every last morsel of that tainted meat! You've helped more than you know.'
You have helped Asupi reduce the Chetari population by poisoning their food supply.
_Rewards:_
225 platinum
Experience (3 AAs)

_This is a solo task that begins with Shamptan the Summoner ( map) in the Breeding Grounds at location 1175, 185, -39 (in the archway that opens up into the northern-most part of the zone)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Shamptan the summoner'
Shamptan the summoner's bones rattle as they move, suspended in the air in the shape of a dragon. It turns its empty eye sockets to you and speaks without moving its jaw, 'These [new] black dragons shouldn't be here. Just like [you].'
You say, 'What new dragons?'
Shamptan the summoner says 'For countless years, our kind has used this mausoleum as a final resting place, a proper closing to the long chapters of dragon life. The flamewings, the icewings, they've earned their place here. But this [dark brood] are interlopers, assaulting our sacred grounds and feeding on the energies of our dead. This is not right, it must be [dealt with].'
You say, 'What do you mean, you?'
Shamptan the summoner says 'Me? I've been here since the beginning, \_\_\_\_\_, and I earned my rest. But it is my job to keep guard over this masoleum and I will not stand idly by while these [usurpers] vandalize our home.'
You say, 'Usurpers?'
Shamptan the summoner says 'For countless years, our kind has used this mausoleum as a final resting place, a proper closing to the long chapters of dragon life. The flamewings, the icewings, they've earned their place here. But this [dark brood] are interlopers, assaulting our sacred grounds and feeding on the energies of our dead. This is not right, it must be [dealt with].'
You say, 'Dealt with?'
Shamptan the summoner says 'The dragons that created this masoleum were wise. They knew we would eventually be discovered here and they ensured [safety measures] were in place to protect it.'
You say, 'What safety measures?'
Shamptan the summoner says 'Ancient guardian dragons can be summoned to cleanse the mausoleum in times of trouble. I will need your [help], however, as I cannot move if I want to [remain unseen].'
You say, 'Dark brood?'
Shamptan the summoner says 'I don't know where they came from, and I don't care. They must be [eliminated].'
You say, 'Eliminated?'
Shamptan the summoner says 'The dragons that created this masoleum were wise. They knew we would eventually be discovered here and they ensured [safety measures] were in place to protect it.'
You say, 'Remain unseen?'
Shamptan the summoner says 'Inside this rune circle, I'm able to reveal myself to whoever I please. Outside of it, though, I'd be immediately spotted, and no doubt killed by the fearwings. Now, will you [help] me?'
You say, 'I will help'
Shamptan the summoner says 'Good. I'm sure the medallion we need is in one of the treasure piles around the center pillar of this room. Search the bins filled with gold until you find a medallion with a white crystal in it. '
You have been assigned the task 'A Desperate Summoning'.
The dragon mausoleum has been overrun by a corrupted brood of dragons called the fearwings. You found an animated dragon skeleton that claims to know a way to summon ancient guardians to cleanse the dragons' resting place.

---

Find the amulet 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Search the treasure piles around the pillar in the center of the room for a crystal amulet.
_North of Shamptan, around the pillar in the center, are boxes of treasure. Click on them until you get an update and emote._
A chill runs up your arm as your fingers grip the amulet at the bottom of the bag and pull it out.
Ask Shamptan what to do with the amulet 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
You say, 'Hail, Shamptan the summoner'
Shamptan the summoner says 'I'm glad you found it so quickly. Now, hold the amulet out and I will prepare it.' A soft glowing light begins to pulsate inside the amulets crystal when you hold it out. 'The first part of the summoning ritual is [unsavory]. But it is important. You must [promise] me that you do it.'
You say, 'I promise...'
Shamptan the summoner says 'The amulet must be powered with the essence of youth from all four dragon broods. You must find a young ashwing, scalewing, flamewing, and icewing, [kill them], and absorb their power into the amulet.'
You say, 'Unsavory?'
Shamptan the summoner says 'The dragons wanted to ensure that this summoning would not be pursued lightly, so they placed a heavy price on it: a sacrifice of [their young].'
You say, 'Their young?'
Shamptan the summoner says 'The amulet must be powered with the essence of youth from all four dragon broods. You must find a young ashwing, scalewing, flamewing, and icewing, [kill them], and absorb their power into the amulet.'
You say, 'Kill them?'
Shamptan the summoner says 'It's not pleasant business, but someone must do it. To save the others.'
Essence of a young flamewing absorbed 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Essence of a young ashwing absorbed 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Essence of a young icewing absorbed 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Essence of a young scalewing absorbed 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Task Window Says:_ Take the empowered amulet and absorb the essence from each of the four broods. Find a young flamewing near the mausoleum and kill it to absorb its essence. Kill a young ashwing near the mausoleum to absorb its essence into the amulet. Kill a young icewing in the egg chamber to the west and absorb its essence into the amulet. Kill a young scalewing in the icy egg chamber and absorb its essence into the amulet. You may need to step on the eggs to lure the young out of hiding.
_Note: The "young" spawns can be triggered in the "egg" rooms in the different parts of the zone. Upon triggering a spawn, you get two mobs which auto-aggro (even through invis)._
Bring the empowered amulet back to Shamptan the Summoner 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Kill a young fearwing in the mausoleum 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_Fearwings are found in the same area as the treasure updates earlier._
Kill a phase spider in the north tunnels 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
_These are found in the tunnels extending from the treasure room._
Kill the elder fearwing guarding the dragon statue 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Place the amulet on the dragon statue 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
When you do this, you see the following in yellow:
The amulet fits into the round indentation at the top of the dragon statue. A dark beam shoots out from the front of it and a large, black dragon appears in the sky.
Instead of a guardian, a massive fearwing dragon is summoned by the amulet. It flickers, seeming to shift in and out of existence as it looks down around the room with an evil glint in its eye. After a brief moment it bares its massive teeth and grunts, 'Fear this day, pathetic dragons of Norrath. The fearwings have come to undo you.'
The massive dragon laughs as it phases out of this plane and begins its genocidal hunt.
Find Shamptan 0/1 (The Breeding Grounds)
Shamptan the summoner has slipped into the shadows without a trace. Without him, you have no idea how to stop the Fearwing Hunter before it can terrorize the dragons that call this home.
_Shamptan the Summoner disappears, and this task is not repeatable._
_Rewards:_
337 platinum, 5 gold
Experience (4 AAs)

_This task begins with Aliskar Darkbane ( map) in the Chapterhouse of the Fallen (location 20, 140, 0, in the large room just west of the zone-in from Shard's Landing)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Aliskar Darkbane'
Aliskar Darkbane says 'Hail, adventurer. Can you spare a moment to [help] me?'
You say, 'Help?'
Aliskar Darkbane says 'As you can imagine, being undead has its downsides and some of us can handle it better than others. For example, my poor brother Baldrik is not handling it well at all. The years of undeath he has suffered has severely taken a toll on him. Once a proud paladin, he has been reduced to a gibbering madman. I try to help him when I can, but it has become too dangerous to venture down below to visit him ever since the Burning Dead recently started to appear in great numbers. If you can find it in your heart, please try to [find him] and see if he needs anything.'
You say, 'I will find him'

_This is a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Grimbus ( map) in the Chapterhouse of the Fallen. He is found at location 475, 185, -220 (in the lowest part of the zone; the far north end of the underground river)._
_Note: This task locks as soon as you obtain it._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No tasks
You say, 'Hail, Grimbus'
Grimbus says 'I don't get many visitors down here. Are you looking for some [work]? If you have a strong stomach, I may just have something for you.'
You say, 'Work?'
Grimbus says 'I was once part of the Burning Dead necromancers. Somehow I managed to anger the wrong person and as punishment, I was sent down here to dispose of unwanted body parts that are left over from necromantic experiments. It's a hard, lonely life, but I keep going. Lately though I have been unable to attend to my duties due to an [injury].'
You say, 'Injury?'
Grimbus says 'As I was placing some body parts into the disposal crates one day, a basilisk, attracted to the smell of the rotting flesh, appeared and attacked me. I got away, but not without one of my legs being turned to stone. I can barely walk now. Hopefully it will heal on its own, but in the meantime, I am unable to dispose of the body parts. Do you think you can [help]? I don't own much, but I will find something to reward you for your help.'
You say, 'I can help'
Grimbus says 'Thank you. The job itself isn't too difficult. Simply pick up the bags of unwanted body parts that are thrown down the chute into the river and place them into one of the disposal crates. Slimes will appear and dissolve both the crates and the body parts. They are rather efficient cleaners. There are a couple of [problems] you will need to keep an eye out for however.'
You say, 'What problems?'
Grimbus says 'Sometimes scavenging basilisks appear to try to eat the body parts. As you can probably understand, I hate basilisks. Kill any that may show up. Also, that strange, purple shard here in the caverns can sometimes cause [strange things] to happen.'
You say, 'What strange things?'
Grimbus says 'On occasion, some of the body parts will be affected by the shard's dark magic and come to life. Mostly it's severed hands, which is just plain creepy. Kill any of those that may appear as well. The last thing I need is a bunch of severed hands crawling all over me when I try to sleep. You best be on your way. The body parts are really starting to pile up. Good luck.'
You have been assigned the task 'Feeding Time'.
Grimbus wants you to help him dispose of some unwanted body parts by collecting them near and in the river and then placing them in various disposal crates.
Place a Bag of Unwanted Body Parts into the dusty, bloody, gory, filthy, dilapidated, and deteriorating disposal crates. Kill any scavenging basilisks that may appear when you place the body parts into the crates. Kill any reanimated body parts that may appear when you place the body parts into the crates.

You say, 'Hail, Gronk the Krystul King'
Gronk the Krystul King raises his crystal-studded club in the air and points at you with his massive fingers. 'Humble yourself before da mighty Gronk, \_\_\_\_\_! You are in da presence of da shiniest [warrior]. Kneel!'
You say, 'Warrior?'
Gronk the Krystul King smashes his club down onto the corpse of the halfling stretched across the steps. Blood splatters your armor as Gronk shouts, 'I am Gronk, Krystul King! All da [shinies] of dis gobbie cave are Gronk's! Gronk [fear no one] and everyone fears Gronk!'

You say, 'Hail, a dying scout'

a dying scout says 'Then maybe... I'm being given a second chance?... I was supposed to scout out the pit and learn what I could... but I've failed... This mission has cost me my life... But if I don't finish, it will cost more lives... Please! Will you [carry out] this mission in my place?'
You say, 'I'll carry out the mission!'
a dying scout says 'Thank you!... please, find out what's going on in the pit and report it to Dabbin, near the tunnel to the Gorge... and ask him... to look after my little 'lings, and tell them I love them...'

---

03. Try talking to one of the imprisoned Halflings 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)



_Speak to one of the "a halfling prisoner" ( map) mobs in any of the cells that surround the large circular room east of the dying scout's location._



You say, 'Hail, a halfling prisoner'




a halfling prisoner says 'How did you get in here? Have you come to [free] us?!'




You say, 'I can't free you...'




a halfling prisoner says 'What? Oh... I see. I'm sorry to hear that. \*sigh\* Well, if it's information you need, at least, I think I can help. But in exchange, please tell Dabbin about our plight. [Agreed]?'




You say, 'Agreed!'




a halfling prisoner says 'Alright, it's a deal; we'll hold strong until help comes and help you all we can in the meantime. Now, the best person to give you information would be one of the Goblins which run this place - although I doubt if any of them would willingly comply with such a request - but, I've got an [idea] how we can get around that.'




You say, 'What idea?'




a halfling prisoner says 'There's a Goblin, by the name of Grolak, who's nearly blind with old age. I've seen him mistake both Halflings and the undead monstrosities here for fellow Goblins! If you approach him pretending to be a Goblin, he may just fall for it.'

04. Speak with Grolak the Ancient 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)



_Grolak the Ancient ( map) is found in one of the southeast prison cells (-1125, 75, -430)._



You say, 'Hail, Grolak the Ancient'




Grolak the Ancient says 'Eh? What? Were you raised by werewolves or something?! Don't you know it's rude to address your elders in that hideous, "Common" tongue?! You kids today! I suppose next you'll all be skipping around dressed like Halflings! \*sigh\* Oh well. I suppose it's not all your fault; I'll yell at your parents later. Now - I take it you're my new apprentice, [yes]?'




You say, 'Yes, of course'




Grolak the Ancient says 'Right then. Now, we'll need [lightning], some [minotaur parts], and something to bind the parts together. Hmm... [pondweed] should do! Naturally, as my apprentice, it's up to you to collect these - hah! I hope you're up to it.'




You say, 'Lightning?'




Grolak the Ancient says 'I don't hold with these modern, lightning-free reanimation spells kids use nowadays. In MY day, we used to wait WEEKS for a good thunderstorm - and we were GRATEFUL when one arrived! \*sigh\* But we're short on thunderstorms here, so we'll have to make do with what we can steal from the dervishes in the valley. You can use this box to store the lightning from cloudburst whirlwinds or cyclones.'




_You receive "Empty Lightning Box"._



You say, 'Minotaur parts?'




Grolak the Ancient says 'Oh, just about anything will work. Preferably a few heads, though. Tough as rocks those things are - which is about how clever the beasts are, anyway. You'll find most of the lazy things in the valley above, grazing and fertilizing the fields. Just be sure to leave no witnesses! If they notice some of their herd is missing, we'll blame it on the Halflings.'




You say, 'Pondweed?'




Grolak the Ancient says 'There's a lake near the waterfall in the valley. Just try not to drown yourself while gathering those plants,' he sniggers maliciously, 'After all, it'd be a waste of perfectly good weeds.'




_This opens up the next five steps._

05. Use your Empty Lightning Box to steal lightning from a cloudburst dervish 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)



_Right-click the box on "a cloudburst whirlwind" or "a cloudburst cyclone" (these spawn in the forest area east of the zone-in)._

06. Loot 3 Minotaur Head 0/3 (Valley of King Xorbb)

07. Loot 1 Minotaur Torso 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)

08. Loot 3 Minotaur Limb 0/3 (Valley of King Xorbb)

09. Gather 3 Wiry Pondweeds from the lake in the valley 0/3 (Valley of King Xorbb)



_Wiry Pondweed is a ground spawn in the lake in the southeastern part of the zone (and at the bottom of the waterfall). There are many ground spawns._

10. Report to Grolak the Ancient 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)

11. Follow Grolak's instructions to assemble your golem 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)



_Combine 3x minotaur head, 1x minotaur torso, 3x minotaur limb, and 3x pondweed inside the Runed Coffin._

12. Deliver 1 Hollowflesh Golem to Grolak the Ancient 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)



Grolak the Ancient gives a few experimental tugs on the golem's limbs, 'Hmm... you're quite a natural! Most beginners try to bind the entire body the same way, and wind up with loosely joined limbs which fall off, or joints bound too tightly to move. There's good strength and flexibility in this one, though, so let's go to the [next step].'

13. Listen to Grolak's instructions 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)



You say, 'What next step?'




Grolak the Ancient says, in Goblin, 'I've set it up now, so pay close attention: I'm going to reanimate the golem and I'll need you to unleash that lightning on it at the right moment. Unfortunately, however, I'll be busy casting my spell, and won't be able to talk. You'll need to watch carefully for my signal, so let me know when you're [ready].'




You say, 'Ready!'

14. On Grolakâ€™s signal use the Box of Captured Lightning on the golem 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)



_When Grolak emotes..._



Grolak the Ancient glances in your direction, and nods his head violently: now!




_...click the Charged Box of Lightning._

15. Speak to Grolak 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)



You say, 'Hail, Grolak the Ancient'




Grolak the Ancient says, in Goblin, 'Hmm, not bad. Although you took forever with that lightning!' He glares accusingly at you, 'I'm sure you'll do better next time, won't you? Good. Now run along. I need to rest these old bones of mine, before I end up like our new friend here!'

16. Report to Dabbin 0/1 (Valley of King Xorbb)



_Dabbin Sneakfoot ( map) is found just west of the zone-in._

_Rewards:_
225 platinum
Experience (3 AAs)
