_This is a solo task, the second task in a series of four. It begins with Grulid in the aqueduct area at 1500, -45, 143 (also findable with CTRL+F)._
_To get to this area, you can jump down the well in the very far northeastern part of the zone or use one of the four portals scattered throughout the zone. For mapped locations, see the image on this NPC entry [npc=43146]._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completion of "Prove Your Worth, Slave"
You say, 'Hail, Grulid'
Grulid says 'Ah yes, you must be the new \_\_\_\_\_ that Kilithyr mentioned. Welcome to the camp. Tell me, how long do you think you've been trapped in this city? [Months]? [Days]? [Years]?'
You say, 'Only a matter of days...'
Grulid says 'Then you are truly new. It only takes a week for most people to believe they've spent half a lifetime here. There is a [powerful magic] over this place.'
You say, 'Or, months...'
Grulid says 'Is that so? What if I told you that you've actually been here for less than a day, but some [powerful magic] is rewriting your memories?'
You say, 'Maybe it's been years...'
Grulid says 'Is that so? What if I told you that you've actually been here for less than a day, but some [powerful magic] is rewriting your memories?'
You say, 'Powerful magic?'
Grulid says 'I'm working to unweave its influence over the refugees here, but it is extremely resilient. The source of [this mage]'s power is monumental.'
You say, 'Who is this mage?'
Grulid says 'I believe it is Vyzh'dra, the shissar leader here. He seems to be in charge and his tower is the only part of the city that [never wavers].'
You say, 'Never wavers?'
Grulid says 'Yes, I mean exactly what I said. This city fluctuates, not only along time, but also in space. Parts of it vanish or reappear, seemingly at random. Very few possess the [mental fortitude] to remember these changes. Most succumb to the magic's pressuring influence and believe the city was always the way it is right now.'
You say, 'Mental fortitude?'
Grulid says 'Yes, you might be strong enough to see through the mist. Let's find out. My [apprentice] went missing two days ago. He had planned to visit the canal district in the northern side of town, but something must have gone wrong. [Find him].'
You say, 'Who is your apprentice?'
Grulid says 'A young dark elf I was training to aid me in peeling back the veil over this city. It would be a major setback to our progress here if we cannot [find him].'
You say, 'I will find him'
Grulid says 'You'll have to fight your way through the north tunnel to get to the teleporter that leads to that part of town. After you teleport, take an immediate left and you'll find the gemmed road leading into the canal district. Start your search there.'
You have been assigned the task 'How Puzzling All These Changes Are'.
Something weird is happening in Chelsith, and you're helping the underground slave resistance uncover the city's secrets.

---

Find the canal district 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Grulid has asked you to find his lost apprentice who was last seen heading into Chelsith's canal district. He recommends that you start your entrance to the canal district, which can be found along the northern wall of the residential area. Fight your way through the tunnel leading north out of camp, and use the teleporter at the end of it. It will take you right to it.
_Head through the north tunnel and into the portal at the end. This places you in the northern part of the zone. Once there, move forward to the gap in the wall ( map)._

---

Ask nearby slaves what happened here 0/3 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ You found a gaping hole in the city's wall at the back of the residential area that seemed to disappear into nothingness. Either Grulid lied to you about there ever being a canal district, or it has vanished, like he said some parts of the city have been doing lately. Ask some of the nearby confused slaves if they remember the canal district.
_Hail the nearby "a confused slave" mobs. There are three of them near the hole in the wall._
a confused slave says 'This wall has protected the city for countless generations. We'd never build outside of it.'
a confused slave says 'Canal district? There's never been a canal district in Chelsith. Why would we need canals?'
a confused slave says 'Canal district... that sounds vaguely familiar. Didn't there used to be a canal district near here? No, it couldn't have been in Chelsith. I must be thinking of a different city.'

---

Kill a shissar noble near the disappearing wall 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ One of the slaves you talked to seemed to barely remember the canal district, but the others seemed completely fooled by the magic in the city. You can sense residual magic in the wall's gap, however. You should test its power by luring a shissar noble from a nearby home close to the area and killing it.
_Bring "a scheming noble" or "a tranquil meditator" from one of the nearby buildings to the gap in the wall. It will get a debuff on it, weakening it and turning into a crystal hydra. Kill it._
a scheming noble has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
The shissar crumbles into crystallized chunks when it dies near the disappearing wall. Most of them shatter on impact, but you're able to find one preserved piece.

---

Collect crystal body parts 0/6 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ The shissar noble turned into crystal when you killed it near the wall and shattered into a hundred pieces. You should do this more carefully with other adult shissar in the area, and collect crystal body parts to take to Grulid for study.
_Repeat the above process six times with any standard shissar mobs. (These are kill updates; no items involved.)_

---

Return to Grulid 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ You've collected a bag full of crystal body parts. Bring them to Grulid back at the camp so that he can investigate the magic at work in this city. Jumping down the well in the northeastern corner of the zone is probably the safest way back to camp.
You say, 'Hail, Grulid'
Grulid says 'Yes, I can see it in your eyes. You've seen the city change. Quick, \_\_\_\_\_, give me whatever you've [brought] in those bags.'
You say, 'Just what have I brought?'
Grulid says 'Crystal body parts? A head, a tail, an arm. Are these shissar? How did you [acquire] these?'
You say, 'Acquire?'
Grulid nods without looking up at you, his hands sliding along the crystal, 'Yes, yes, whatever you said is good. Leave me to study these. Oh, I almost forgot, shissar [invaded the camp] while you were gone.'
You say, 'Invaded the camp?'
Grulid says 'They kidnapped several recruits. Kilithyr wants everyone to help get them back. So, um, go do that while I study these.'

---

Kill Shissar invaders and rebel informants in the north and west tunnels 0/10 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ While you were gone, Vyz'hrda sent guards into the resistance camp, and they kidnapped several slaves. Help the camp get revenge by killing the guards invading the north and west paths in the aqueduct.
_Kill 10 shissar in the north and west tunnels._

---

Find the kidnapped rebels in the market area 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ You've carved a path through the shissar-infested aqueduct, but did not find the kidnapped resistance fighters. Use the teleporter at the end of the path to go to the surface and search for them in the buildings near the marketplace above.
_This updates on the rooftop of the northeastern-most building in the zone (2460, -820, 358)._

---

Free slaves in the market area 0/12 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ All of the kidnapped resistance fighters are dead. You stumbled across their bodies in the market area. Avenge their deaths and acquire new recruits by killing slave traders in the market area and freeing the slaves there.
_Kill slave traders ( map) to update this step. (Note that the slave must be alive when the trader is killed.)_
a slave trader says 'I'll see you in chains.'
a bruised slave says 'This has to be done!'
_Slave traders and bruised slaves are aggro-linked. Each "a slave trader" is linked with 0-2 "a bruised slave". The traders hit for a max ~13,500 while the slaves hit for a max ~5,500. They are susceptible to mez, stun, and roots. As you kill the traders, you see this as the slave(s) stop attacking:_
a slave trader has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
a slave trader's corpse collapses.
A slave stops fighting you when the slave trader falls, and looks at you with thankful eyes.
a bruised slave says 'The \_\_\_\_\_ has freed us! Let's escape to the aqueduct and join the rebels.'

---

Return to Grulid 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ You've freed a lot of slaves, most of whom seem eager to join your cause. Report your findings to Grulid in the resistance camp.
You say, 'Hail, Grulid'
Grulid says 'Did you find our kidnapped compatriots, \_\_\_\_\_? Shissar can be [ruthless].'
You say, 'They are pretty ruthless...'
Grulid says 'Well that's a shame. There were good men and women in that pack. But, let me tell you what I [discovered] about these crystals!'
You say, 'What was discovered?'
Grulid says 'This crystal material is the core essence of the shissar here. Most of them, at least. The guards, the scientists, the slave drivers, they're [all fake]!'
You say, 'All fake?'
Grulid says 'Whatever power is fueling them is very real, but these are not real people. It's not even a real city. It's all made of this crystal stuff. I was able to successfully trigger their disguise again, making the crystal appear as flesh before reverting back to crystal again. Do you know [what this means]?'
You say, 'What this means?'
Grulid says 'We're prisoners in an artificial world! That's why the canal district disappeared and guards continually replenish when we kill them. We needn't be held back by [petty morals] here.'
You say, 'Petty morals?'
Grulid says 'Kilithyr will know what to do. Find him in the room behind me and tell him the big news.'
You've discovered that this version of Chelsith that you're trapped in is fake. It appears to be constructed at least partially out of crystals, including most of its residents, although you have no idea how that's possible. Shissar guards have increased their brutality and aggressiveness in response to your meddling.
_Rewards:_
Experience (4 AAs + 3% regular exp. at Level 100)
300 platinum

_This is a solo task, the third task in a series of four. It begins with Kilithyr in the aqueduct area (findable with CTRL+F). He is at 1520, 50, 143._
_To get to this area, you can jump down the well in the very far northeastern part of the zone or use one of the four portals scattered throughout the zone. For mapped locations, see the image on this NPC entry [npc=43146]._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completion of "Prove Your Worth, Slave"
\- Completion of "How Puzzling All These Changes Are"
You say, 'Hail, Kilithyr'
Kilithyr says 'A fake city! Can you believe these dirty shissar have been holding us in a make-believe prison? The [scars] feel real enough.'
You say, 'What scars?'
Kilithyr says 'We've all bore our fair share of the bloody burden, and it's time we make the shissar bear theirs. If the people here are fake, we don't need to [hold back on our methods].'
You say, 'Hold back on our methods?'
Kilithyr says 'Think about it! If the shissar here [are not real people], then we should have no problem blowing them up with explosives.'
You say, 'They are not real people...'
Kilithyr says 'We don't actually know how many people are real here, but your tests in the residential area indicate that at least that section is fake. We'll focus [our efforts] on that part of town for now.'
You say, 'Our efforts?'
Kilithyr says 'We're going to raise hell and get the attention of whatever shissar is running this freak show. Get out there and make a scene, \_\_\_\_\_.'
You have been assigned the task 'Hold Nothing Back'.
The news that the city you're trapped in is fake has convinced the slaves to no longer hold back in their attempts to break free. You've been tasked with causing as much mayhem to the populace as possible.

---

1\. Collect cursed weapons from cultists 0/5 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Start by collecting weapons from the shissar, troll cultists, and a spiritspeaker hiding in the aqueduct. You can find them in the southern and eastern tunnels of the aqueduct.
_Kill cultist mobs in the south and east tunnels of the aqueducts until you have five updates._

---

2\. Kill metalworkers 0/5 (Chelsith Reborn)
3\. Place cursed weapons into equipment chests 0/5 (Chelsith Reborn)
4\. Collect hunks of living flame 0/8 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Head up to the surface and find the industrial area in the northwest part of the city. Kill the metalworkers building the shissar weapons and armor. Place the cursed weapons you stole into the equipment chests in the area, usually located near forges. And while you're there, collect hunks of living flame from the flame golems and flame arcanists working the forges.
_Metalworkers are found in the industrial area ( map \-\- northwestern quarter of the zone, in and around the buildings)._
_For the equipment updates, you just have to click on five of them. If you are part of a group getting these updates and all on the same step, they update automatically for everyone in your group. NOTE: When you do this, a non-aggro mob spawns and casts an AE knockback (this will break any invis buff)._
You slipped a cursed weapon into the equipment chest, where an unsuspecting Shissar is sure to grab it.
a new recruit punts you aside. 'Out of my way, ugly slave! I need to grab weapons before my patrol starts.'
a new recruit says 'What's happening? Ahhhhh!'
a new recruit crumples to the ground in sheer agony as the cursed weapons tear his flesh apart.
_Flame golems and flame arcanists ( map) are found in the same area. This isn't an actual item; just a kill update. Upon the last one, you receive a "Living Flame"._

---

5\. Collect holy relics from male shissar elders 0/8 (Chelsith Reborn)
6\. Kill shissar matriarchs 0/4 (Chelsith Reborn)
7\. Light shissar young on fire 0/12 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ You must strike at the shissar in their homes if you really want to get Vyzh'dra's attention. Kill male shissar elders and rip the holy symbols off their clothes and jewelry. Kill shissar matriarches in their homes. Then use the living flame item you took from the industrial area to light the defenseless shissar young on fire. Don't let their cries dissuade you. Remember, everyone here is made from crystal, and not real.
_Head to the residential area in the north-central part of the zone and kill any adult shissar in the area until you have eight updates (a scheming noble, a tranquil mediator and a troubled seer are some of the mobs that will update this step). Upon the last update, you receive "Bundle of Holy Symbols"._
_Matriarches are found in the north-central part of the zone ( map)._
_The young shissar (which are aggro-linked with their matriarch) are found in the same area. Use the "Living Flame" on the young shissar._
The living flame leaps from your fingertips and engulfs the shissar young in a ball of fire. The small shissar reverts to lifeless crystal and shatters under the heated pressure.

---

8\. Throw the symbol package to cultists in the sewers 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Retreat back to the aqueducts and throw the shissar holy symbols you've found to a cultist or a necromancer in the south or eastern tunnels, by clicking the item in your inventory. With any luck, they'll use them to curse the shissar and demoralize them even further. Keep your distance though, the cultists are still dangerous.
_With any shissar or troll cultist targeted (from a distance), right-click the Bundle of Holy Symbols._
You throw the bundle of shissar holy symbols to the cultist, who cackles wickedly.
an escaped cultist says 'We'll curse a hundred shissar with these! But don't think this makes us friends, cretin.'

---

9\. Speak to Kilithyr 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Find Kilithyr and report the results of your chaos quest to him.
You say, 'Hail, Kilithyr'
Kilithyr says 'If that doesn't get the attention of whoever's really in charge here, I don't know what will. Good work, \_\_\_\_\_. And don't [feel bad].'
You say, 'Who says I feel bad?'
Kilithyr says 'In a normal city, these acts would be despicable. Here, we might as well be lighting bricks on fire. These crystal-beings don't have souls, no matter how real they look.'
You've sown chaos among the crystal-created populace of this Chelsith clone. You hope Kilithyr and Grulid know what they're talking about, because this is brutal violence.

---

_Rewards:_
Experience (4 AAs + 2-3% regular exp at Level 100)
300 platinum

_This is a solo task, the fourth task in a series of four. It begins with Kilithyr in the aqueduct area (findable with CTRL+F). He is at 1520, 50, 143._
_To get to this area, you can jump down the well in the very far northeastern part of the zone or use one of the four portals scattered throughout the zone. For mapped locations, see the image on this NPC entry [npc=43146]._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completion of "Prove Your Worth, Slave"
\- Completion of "How Puzzling All These Changes Are"
\- Completion of "Hold Nothing Back"
You say, 'Hail, Kilithyr'
Kilithyr says 'You've done good so far, \_\_\_\_\_. Our [scars] will not be in vain. We're not free yet, but the time is right to [make our final move].'
You say, 'Make our final move?'
Kilithyr says 'We need to storm Vyzh'dra's tower if we're going to break his spell over this place and free ourselves. I've been readying what few fighters we have here for the coming battle, but I need you to [weaken the tower defenses].'
You say, 'I will weaken the tower defenses'
Kilithyr says 'Take this sheet of paper. I've written down the biggest threats we need you to weaken, and the scouting info we need to make our strike count. Good luck out there.'
You have been assigned the task 'Ready The Killing Blow'.
You've discovered that Vyzh'dra has built this fake version of Chelsith from some evil power stored in his tower, and have volunteered to lead the forward team that will lay the foundation for an invasion of the tower.

---

Locate Vyzh`dra's labs 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Kilithyr believes Vyzh'dra keeps his laboratories near his tower in the western quarter of the city. Find them so you can see what technology and magic your army will be up against.
_The labs are located just west of the giant tower ( map)._

---

Collect research papers from shissar scientists 0/10 (Chelsith Reborn)
Rip a volatile tumor from the corpse of an infected test subject 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
Use the tumor to pour volatile chemicals onto shissar in the laboratory area 0/5 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ You've found the laboratories and the science and magic going on here is way beyond your comprehension. Steal 10 research papers from scientists in the area. Kill infected test subjects until you find one with a tumor filled with volatile chemicals that you can cut off without damaging. Use the volatile tumor to melt away the outer crystallized bodies of shissar in the laboratory area, preventing their regeneration. You will need to get them close to death before the chemicals will be effective.
_For the research papers, you need to kill shissar in the area (any diabolists, lab assistants, mistshapers, etc. from this area seem to count)._
_Kill "an infected test subject" (in the same area) until you receive a "Volatile Tumor"._
The test subject falls to the ground and you're able to carve an infected hunk of flesh off of its corpse.
_With the tumor in hand, weaken any shissar from the labs area to 20% health or lower. Then right-click the Volatile Tumor on them. This changes them into a crystal hydra and updates the step (you'll need to do this five times)._
_If you try clicking on a shissar that's not low in health, you see:_
This shissar is strong enough to resist the effects of the volatile chemicals. Try weakening it before using this item.
_If you try clicking on a shissar that isn't from the labs area, you see:_
Your current target is immune to the effects of the volatile chemicals. Try pouring them on shissar in the laboratory area.
_If you try clicking on a shissar that's already been clicked, you see:_
That guard has already had its outer covering melted away. Find a shissar that hasn't been revealed as a crystal.
_A successful click looks like:_
The volatile chemicals from the tumor pour into the open wounds of the injured shissar, quickly infesting its internal crystalline structure. It will not be able to rebuild for a long time.

---

Find the gladiator training camp near the arena 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Many slaves have reported of being forced to fight as gladiators in the arena for the shissars' amusement. Find the gladiator training arena down the hill to the south.
_Head south to this area ( map)._

---

Defeat renowned gladiators to increase your reputation among the fighters 0/3 (Chelsith Reborn)
Collect armor sets from the gladiator training area 0/5 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ There are a lot of strong slaves training down here that you could recruit for your cause. They only understand the language of violence, so find the named gladiators and defeat them in combat. Defeating famous gladiators will earn the respect of other fighters in the area, and will earn you a following that will fight for the slave rebellion. The armor stored down here is of surprisingly high quality. Grab a few pieces off the armor racks in the area for your compatriots in the sewer.
_To recruit gladiators, you need to fight three named mobs in the area and kill them. They spawn throughout the above area:_
Akazz the Blood Goddess ( map)
Alassh the Cannibal ( map)
Death Fang Teraz ( map)
Iross the Sledge ( map)
Katazz the Twisted ( map)
Korizar the Neckbreaker ( map)
Nendor the Daunting ( map)
Nentassh the Blade Queen ( map)
The Steel Serpent ( map)
Ulga the Elfeater ( map)
Zurul the Bonecruncher ( map)
_These mobs are a little more difficult than your standard trash mobs. They hit for a max ~17,000 and tend to flurry, rampage, and/or AE rampage._
Nendor the Daunting falls to the ground, defeated for the first time in months. Other nearby gladiators look at you with respect and offer salutes. They will join your cause.
_While you are in this area, click on armor stands ( image) in the area until you have five updates. These spawn inside and around the buildings._
You grab a sturdy piece of roughly forged armor from the stand.
The gladiator armor hanging on this rack is nothing special. What you're already wearing is bigger, better, and way more expensive.

---

Deliver stolen goods to your contact at the base of Vyzh`dra's tower 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Everything is in place. Return to your contact who is lurking at the base of Vyzh'dra's tower to the north and inform them that you've accomplished everything.
_Speak with Calvin Tresc ( map) at the base of the giant tower (northwest side). He's findable via CTRL+F, at 1340, 885, 321._
You say, 'Hail, Calvin Tresc'
Calvin Tresc says 'Great work, \_\_\_\_\_. Kilithyr told me you'd be coming. I'll take these goods back to camp.'
You've set the stage for a large-scale invasion of Vyzh'dra's tower. You've weakened its defenses, stolen research notes, recruited fighters, and acquired better equipment for your troops. It's time to strike.
_Rewards:_
Experience (4 AAs + 2-3% regular exp in Level 100)
300 platinum

_This is a group mission that begins with Calvin Tresc in Chelsith Reborn (findable with CTRL+F). He is at the base of the giant tower (northwest side), at 1340, 885, 321 ( map)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completion of "Prove Your Worth, Slave"
\- Completion of "How Puzzling All These Changes Are"
\- Completion of "Hold Nothing Back"
\- Completion of "Ready the Killing Blow"
You say, 'Hail, Calvin Tresc'
Calvin Tresc says 'Ah \_\_\_\_\_, you've arrived, and not a moment too soon. Your name is on the forked tongue of every serpent in the city. Quite a grand place to be famous, or at least infamous, eh?' He surveys your expression and takes a more serious tone, 'Very well, I see you're as stoic as they say. The only way we're going to obtain victory here is to tear down the [veil] that blinds us from the truth.'
You say, 'What veil?'
Calvin Tresc says 'As you've seen in your struggles here, the city is not what it seems. Manifestations of mad dreams take form and live among us. It is time we [reveal] the city for what it truly is: the machinations of a backstabbing beast.'
You say, 'Let's reveal it'
Calvin Tresc says 'When you are [ready] I will open your eyes to the truth.'
You have been assigned the task 'Unveiling the Mystery'.
All of your heroic triumphs throughout the city have lead to this moment. Speak with Calvin Tresc and have him lead your charge into Vyzh`dra's seat of power.

---

Speak with Calvin Tresc in the unveiled city 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Speak with him and follow him._
You say, 'Hail, Calvin Tresc'
Calvin Tresc says 'Look now at the unveiled city and see it for the sick stage that it is. The self titled 'Godslayer' is losing control of the strings he pulls to make these puppets dance. It is 'this' moment that we [strike] at the heart of his empire and free ourselves of this nightmare. Of course if this is all too much for you to handle you can [escape] reality and return to the charade.'
You say, 'Let's strike'
Calvin Tresc says 'Vyzh`dra sits at the top of his [tower] waiting for our arrival. From what I can tell he's turned all of his attention to stopping our rebellion as he has forgone maintaining the charade of reality within the city. His puppets lie frozen and shattered in the streets. The only living creatures that seem to remain are his allies and ours.'
You say, 'What about his tower?'
Calvin Tresc says 'The entrance to the top of his tower is guarded by four empowered servants. You will have to defeat them so that I can break the seal on the portal. The information I've gathered suggests that each guardian is shielded against both a school of magic and melee combat. Should one of them fall in battle the shielding is imparted on each of the other guardians. Your best bet is to kill them all concurrently. Give the word when you are [ready] to fight.'
You say, 'Ready!'
Calvin Tresc charges as he shouts, 'Get rid of these guardians so that I may break the seal!'

---

Storm the Tower 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_When ready, just enter the tower._
The statuesque serpents spring to life and turn their attention toward you!

---

Eliminate the Portal Guards 0/4 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Four loyal guardians are sustaining a shield around the portal to the top of Vyzh`dra's tower. Eliminate them. Beware that each portal guardian has a resistance against a school of magic and type of melee weapon. When a guardian dies, its immunities are shared among its remaining allies.
_Each of the guards has a strength against a weapon type and spell type. When a guard is killed, they pass their strengths to the remaining guards:_
\- Portal Tender Kozath: slashing damage + disease/poison spells
\- Portal Tender Srezek: blunt damage + cold spells
\- Portal Tender Vozesh: piercing damage + fire spells
\- Portal Tender Zureshek: hand-to-hand damage + magic spells
_The guards are permanently rooted and do not summon; however, if a guard is 10% health (or lower) than any other guard, they gain the ability to summon and begin casting a pull spell on their target._
_As you kill them, you will see an emote:_
As the portal tender falls its strengths are shared with the remaining guardians.
_Upon the death of the last Portal Tender, you see:_
Calvin Tresc shouts excitedly, 'Yes, that's it! Your sick game is over 'Godslayer'!' He looks over and beckons you toward the portal, 'Speak to me when you are ready and we shall confront the snake directly.'

---

Speak with Calvin Tresc again 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
You say, 'Hail, Calvin Tresc'
Calvin Tresc steps into the portal with a smug look on his face.
Calvin Tresc turns back, a look of dire concern on his face, 'Impossible, the tower portal is inactive! That must mean...' His words trail off as his voice is but a whisper to the bellow that interrupts him.
The serpentine voice of the dominion's master hisses loudly throughout every corner of the city, 'Do you really expect to essscape this place, Tresc?'
Calvin Tresc shouts, 'Go now and gather our allies together! No doubt the Godslayer's minions have set out to squash the rebellion.'

---

Gather allies out where the World Ends 0/3 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Reconvene with Belissa the Barker to the north out where the world ends. The shissar have moved to suppress any resistance members in that area.
You say, 'Hail, Belissa the Barker'
Belissa the Barker says 'Just in time savior! These conjurors have been sent by Vyzh`dra to squash our little going away party. If you would be so kind as to kill them and their little crystal projections off I'm sure we'll all be one step closer to getting what we want.'
_In the very far northern part of the zone are three groups of slaves. Kill all the KOS NPCs around them. Note that the shissar sustainers summon time-based adds (two at a time), so you will want to focus on killing them first. You'll see this emote as they summon adds:_
The shissar sustainer raises its arms into the air and conjures two more allies to aid in the fight!
_Upon the death of the last mob:_
Belissa the Barker calls out to you gratefully, 'That's the last of 'em. I'll wait for you at the center square.'
Belissa the Barker roars at the remaining resistance members, 'Pack it up you lazy lot and get to the center. We've got a war to win!'

---

Gather allies from the Aqueducts 0/6 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Find Kilithyr in the aqueducts below the city and rescue any remaining resistance members that may still be alive.
You say, 'Hail, Kilithyr'
Kilithyr says 'You're just in time, savior. A gang of Vyzh`dra's brutes have started exterminating the survivors here. Flush them out so the resistance can put an end to this nightmare. Go now, quickly!'
_In the aqueducts, do the same thing for the six groups of slaves there. To get to the aqueducts, you can jump down the well in the far northeastern part of the zone (note that the well area is full of mobs, so you will probably get this task step update last)._
_Mobs in the aqueducts tend to hit for a max ~17,500. Upon the death of the last mob:_
Kilithyr calls out to you, 'That's the last of the brutes down here. I pray that the gods look favorably upon you as you enter the tower.' His voice grows quieter, '...I have a bad feeling about this.'

---

Gather allies from the Pit 0/4 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Meet up with Grulid near the great spires in the northeast. Several shissar reanimators are using the spires to amplify Vyzh`dra's powers over the city.
You say, 'Hail, Grulid'
Grulid speaks in a whisper, 'Good, you've arrived. These necrotic enchanters have trapped my battalion in some sort of stasis using the power of these pillars. I believe slaying them will lift the veil on the monuments and free our allies from their grasp.'
_Around the well in the far northeastern part of the zone are four groups of Shissar. Note that these appear to be aggro-linked in groups of three. Kill all of them to free the slaves in this area._
_As you kill mobs, you'll see emotes:_
The western spire shakes violently and breaks into pieces, revealing its true nature.
The great crystal shatters into pieces, weakening Vyzh`dra's illusion.
The southern spire shakes violently and breaks into pieces, revealing its true nature.
The mighty shard loses its power and falls to the ground, lifeless.
The eastern spire trembles and cracks slightly.
The eastern spire shakes violently and breaks into pieces, revealing its true nature.
The giant crystal explodes in a shower of deadly pieces.
The northern spire trembles and cracks slightly.
The northern spire shakes violently and breaks into pieces, revealing its true nature.
The enormous shard fractures into tiny pieces, loosening the shissar's hold on your allies.
As the final crystal spire shatters into pieces the frozen resistance members regain control of their bodies.
Grulid joyfully exclaims, 'I knew from the day we first met that you would be our savior. I shall rally these troops in the center of town and await your arrival there!'

---

Meet your allies at the center of the city 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_This updates in the city center (north of the arena, where the giant statue is)._
Vyzh`dra's voice fills every corner of the city, 'How is it you expect to defeat me in my own domain!? Does your power blind you from even the sssimplest truths in front of your eyes?'
Vyzh`dra continues, 'Look around you. You would lay down your lives for these soulless vessels? There is no victory for you here.'
The fear tainted sky parts, revealing Norrath in the distance.
Vyzh`dra speaks, 'A final obstacle for you to overcome if you truly wish to join me in my tower.' Your attention shifts toward the stone statue in the center of the pool.

---

Defeat Vhezush, the Stone Sentinel 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Vyzh`dra's power over the city has not yet been severed. He has animated the statue in the center of town to protect the portal to his seat of power. Destroy the final portal guardian!
_Note that Vhezush gains strength as he lowers in health:_
The stone sentinel crumbles, becoming more susceptible to damage but more dangerous in combat.
_At its worst (under 10% health), it hits for a max ~30,000 (possibly even higher). Kill it to update this step:_
Vhezush, the Stone Sentinel has been slain by \_\_\_\_\_!
The ground shakes as the stone sentinel falls dead. A portal has opened at the base of its pedestal.
Vyzh`dra's speaks slowly, you are unsure if he is furious or simply toying with you, 'Clearly I should have known I was not safe even in my own domain from such mighty conquerors. Please, join me at the top of my tower and I shall lay down my arms and shower you in the treasure you so clearly deserve.'

---

Step through the newly opened portal 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ With the stone sentinel defeated, the portal to Vyzh`dra's seat of power is open. Step through the portal north of the statue's pedestal.
_NOTE: Once the portal is activated, your group is ported into the tower. Once in the tower, you will not be able to return, so if you're going to engage either of the two optional nameds in the zone, don't port in yet._
_Enter the portal to Vyzh`dra's tower._
A flash of light blinds you as \_\_\_\_\_ activates the tower portal. You open your eyes to see the dominion's master standing over you.
Vyzh`dra looks down at your party with aloof contempt. He speaks with a mocking tone, 'Thisss is the army you've gathered to dethrone me?'
Grulid grips his weapon tightly as he glares at the empowered shissar.

---

Confront Vyzh`dra at the top of his tower 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
Vyzh`dra the Godslayer grips his blade tightly and swings it high over your head. You are confused by Vyzh`dra's hysterical laughter until you look around the room. A quick survey reveals that most of your party is either dead or lumps of lifeless crystal!
Vyzh`dra the Godslayer shouts 'As I said, there is no victory for you here. You fight for soulless projections of my imagination. Even when you hurt me most, you did it for me. There is no hope for you. No reward, no fanfare, no accolades to be won or noble creatures to save. You have willingly marched into the depths of misery and death to share in just a fraction of my personal torment. How does it feel to have those you care for, those you fought so hard to defend, suddenly fall dead with barely a whimper? It hurt me a hundred times more.'
Vyzh`dra the Godslayer looks you over carefully, 'You have changed greatly since our first meeting. Then again, so have I. That brittle broken body you put to rest time and time again is a distant memory of my power now. I bet you don't even know how I came to be the subject of your torture.'
Vyzh`dra the Godslayer continues, 'I aimed to usurp that false emperor, but was stopped by turncoats and backstabbers who had lost sight of our peoples' purpose. Those miserable snakes sit in solitude waiting for your kind to march in and pillage all they own. Not I, though. I am above such complacency. Look around you and see the fruits of my labor. Ssraeshza thought binding my body to the depths of the temple so that it could be slain by your kind time and time again was a fitting punishment. Yet now, now that my soul has escaped and claimed the power of that bastard that drove us from Norrath, I am stronger than he could ever dream to be!'
The portal in the center of the room begins radiating with power. Vyzh`dra has allowed you to exit.
Vyzh`dra the Godslayer looks to the fear shard suspended at the center of the temple, 'So cliche, to expound at length before doing away with you.' He pauses then smiles, 'Let us play a more fitting game. I shall let you live, to fester in your revelations, and I shall wait at the coliseum. When you are ready to end your lives, speak with Kilithyr. I will allow him to wake from this dream, conscious of the truth. But I'll send the rest of this lot back to their supposed lives with no memory of what happened here. Just so I can watch the baffled look on their faces when you try to explain all of this to them...'
With that, the mighty serpent vanishes and a chest of treasures is revealed as a mocking reward.

---

Claim your treasure 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ Claim the treasures that Vyzh`dra has left for you.
All of your endeavors to rescue the people of this city have proved to be a sick joke. Vyzh`dra has allowed you to live and return to the oblivious population of his illusionary city. He departed offering you a final challenge, seek Kilithyr if you wish to do battle with the Godslayer in his arena.

---

**Optional Encounters**
(Optional) Defeat Szalvinzir, the Arena Champion 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ One of Vyzh`dra's champions awaits anyone who would challenge him in the great coliseum.
_This is an optional fight in the arena. Killing it will gain you an extra item in the reward chest. The fight occurs in five phases:_
Phase 1: Szalvinzir, the Arena Champion (Lvl: 100)
Phase 2: Szalvinzir the Great (Lvl: 101)
Phase 3: Szalvinzir the Mighty (Lvl: 102)
Phase 4: Szalvinzir the Revealed (Lvl: 103)
Phase 5: Stone Memory of Szalvinzir (Lvl: 104)
**Details:**
Phase 1: Throughout the fight, spawns a large number of "a hissing serpent" (Lvl: 75) which are very weak with low HP. If you burn him down before any serpents spawn, you will get the I Love Snakes achievement.
Phase 2: Throughout the fight, spawns "a bladestorm" (Lvl: 98) one at a time. We ended up with 5 or 6. They hit for up to 8000.
Phase 3: Occasionally Szalvinzir will lock HP and a trap will spawn. Drag Szalvinzir over the trap to resume killing.
Phase 4: Crystal form. Nothing special.
Phase 5: During the fight, spawns "a shissarian nightmare" (Lvl: 98) one at a time. 4 total. They hit for up to 10000.
The event can be reset by moving outside the arena.
(Optional) Defeat Khozul, the Vanishing Serpent 0/1 (Chelsith Reborn)
_Task Window Says:_ An ancient spy of Vyzh`dra is one of his last living allies. You will find him on the southwestern shore of the beach, contemplating his return to Luclin.
_This is an optional fight in the beach area - far southwestern part of the zone. Killing it will gain you an extra item in the reward chest._
_Khozul AE rampages and flurries, and casts "Assassin's Repulse" (random single target):_
Assassin's Repulse: Single Target, Unresistable (0)
1: Stun (2.40 sec/999)
2: Decrease Hitpoints by 57693
_At 80%, 60%, 35%, 25%, 15%, and 5%, he turns invisible (he keeps attacking) and buffs himself with two 2-tick buffs:_
Khozul steps into the shadows and surrounds himself with a reflective aura.
Shadowy Reflection: Self 0', Unresistable (0)
1: Increase Chance to Reflect Spell by 100%
2: Increase Absorb Magic Damage by 100000000
Shadowy Spikes: Self 0', Unresistable (0)
1: Mitigate Melee Damage by 100%, 100000000 total
11: Increase Damage Shield by 10000
_Turn off attacks and wait for him to return to Shissar form before resuming._

_This is a solo task and is the first task in a series of three. It begins with Aten Ha Ra ( map), findable with CTRL+F, who is found just inside the palace entrance._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No task requirements
You say, 'Hail, Aten Ha Ra'
Aten Ha Ra doesn't even look at you as she speaks 'Lumanes \_\_\_\_\_ Something disastrous has occurred here. A strange [crystal shard] crashed into Vex Thal and pierced the veil to Vex Xi Va, the domain of my Goddess.' She turns her gaze fully upon you. 'The sanctity of this holy place has been defiled.'
You say, 'What about the crystal shard?'
Aten Ha Ra says 'This shard must have enormous power to force its way into the planes. Already its presence is changing Her domain in unexpected ways. I have tasked the Akhevans to find any [pieces] of this shard and remove it from the Plane of Shadow immediately. As Her holy servants, it is our duty to cleanse the home of our Goddess and seal the breach to Her domain.'
You say, 'What pieces?'
Aten Ha Ra says 'The crystal broke apart into many pieces upon entering Vex Xi Va. I have tasked my most trusted priest Diabo Va Xin Vellis to head our efforts to collect the shards and return them to me. However, it has been quite some time since he has reported back with shards and none of my priests have been able to [locate] him.'
You say, 'I will locate him'
Aten Ha Ra says 'You? You should not even be here! If it was not for this crisis, you would already be dead for defiling this place. Still, I must know how the cleanup is progressing and my people are spread thinly. I will allow you look for Diabo Va Xin Vellis. Should you find him, inform him he is to return immediately with the shards he has collected.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Goddess, the Shard, and the Diabo'.
You have been tasked by Aten Ha Ra to find Diabo Va Xin Vellis and instruct him to return with all the shards he has gathered.

---

Search for Diabo Va Xin Vellis in the ancient battlefield 0/1 (Plane of Shadow)
_This location update ( map) is findable via CTRL+F (this is the southwestern valley outside the palace)._
Ask akhevan vagabonds in the area about Diabo Va Xin Vellis 0/1 (Plane of Shadow)
_Akhevan vagabonds ( map) are found throughout the battlefield area. Say 'Diabo Va Xin Vellis' to one of them to update this step._
You say, 'What about Diabo Va Xin Vellis?'
an Akhevan vagabond eyes you warily but somehow knows you have been sent by Aten Ha Ra. 'Yes, he was here many hours ago. After collecting all the shards in this area, he headed toward the Darkfire Islands.'

---

Search for Diabo Va Xin Vellis at the darkfire islands 0/1 (Plane of Shadow)
_This is a large update area ( map) in the western part of the outside area._
Ask akhevan vagabonds in the area about Diabo Va Xin Vellis 0/1 (Plane of Shadow)
_Akhevan vagabonds ( map) are found throughout the islands. Say 'Diabo Va Xin Vellis' to one of them to update this step._

an Akhevan vagabond looks at you with distrust as they answer,'Diabo Va Xin Vellis already collected all the shards which could be found here some time ago. He departed to speak with mercenary leader Kela Lor Telaris inside the temple. He has set up his command post at the top of the eastern root passage.'

Enter Luclin's Palace via the eastern root passage 0/1 (Plane of Shadow)

Kela Lor Telaris says 'I do not have time to talk now, \_\_\_\_\_. My mercenaries are being pressed hard by maddened akhevans. They seem to be stronger than I would have thought possible. We are barely holding our position in the chamber behind me.'

Return the crystal shard to Aten Ha Ra 0/1 (Plane of Shadow)
Aten Ha Ra listens intently, her face betraying no emotion as you relay your findings. 'I did not expect something like this could happen. These shards are more dangerous than I thought. We must find what has happened to Diabo Va Xin Vellis and recover the shards he collected.'
You were unable to locate Diabo Va Xin Vellis, but you did find a clue as to what may have happened to him.

Experience (3 AAs + 2% regular exp at Level 100)
112 platinum, 5 gold

_This is a solo task and is the second task in a series of three. It begins with Aten Ha Ra ( map), findable with CTRL+F, who is found just inside the palace entrance._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completion of "The Goddess, the Shard, and the Diabo"
You say, 'Hail, Aten Ha Ra'
Aten Ha Ra is clearly displeased as she speaks, 'It seems these shards have a power that is able to corrupt the soul. Obviously they do not have this effect on everyone, so I must conclude this is a [weakness] inherent those who are affected.'
You say, 'What weakness?'
Aten Ha Ra raises her voice in anger, 'This weakness will not be tolerated! Those akhevans who fall to the power of these shards are not fit to live amongst our people. They must be purged and any shards they possess must be recovered!' Aten Ha Ra regains her composure. 'There is also the matter of Diabo Va Xin Vellis. We must know if he has been affected by the shards. The [mercenaries] may prove useful after all.'
You say, 'What mercenaries?'
Aten Ha Ra says 'Who better to conduct a purge than Kela Lor Telaris and his mercenaries? And since they have not yet succumbed to the power of the shards, they should be able to handle collecting them. \_\_\_\_\_, you may continue to avoid my wrath by [delivering] these [orders] and assisting him in whatever way he may require.'
You say, 'I will deliver these orders'
Aten Ha Ra says 'A wise decision, \_\_\_\_\_.' Aten Ha Ra fixes you with an icy stare 'I will not tolerate failure in this. Return with news of success or do not return at all.'
You have been assigned the task 'Aten's Wrath'.
You have been tasked by Aten Ha Ra to assist Kela Lor Telaris in eliminating the corrupt Akhevans and recovering any shards in their possession.

_This is a group mission that begins with Kela Lor Telaris (findable with CTRL+F) who is found in the far southeastern part of the palace (head up inside tree - she is in the first room)._
_For a visual of how to safely get to this area, see the image on this NPC entry [npc=43161]._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completion of Return of King Xorbb [quest=6115]
\- Completion of Champions of the People [quest=6822]
You say, 'Hail, Kela Lor Telaris'
Kela Lor Telaris says 'You tarried! Though braced by the strength of our Lady, the chamber doors will not hold against Diabo's ambition. You have faced his might. You know how tall it towers, built lofty by a scaffolding poisoned shards. Have you brought a [large] force to cut him down, or will you brave his wrath with a [small] band? If you have not done so, you should [inform] Aten Ha Ra of what is happening. You may also choose to [accompany] me on another important mission.'
You say, 'I have a small group'
Kela Lor Telaris says 'Though our task will be difficult with small numbers, we must [act] at once before Diabo again seals the antechamber doors.'
You have been assigned the task 'Dispelling the Shadows'.
Diabo Va Xin Vellis beats upon Luclin's chamber door. Soon he will breach the inner sanctum and claim for himself lordship over the Plane of Shadow. Where hs Luclin gone? Does she cower in fear while her realm falls to ruin?
You say, 'Let's act'
Kela Lor Telaris says 'We shall meet in the chamber.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Plane of Shadow.

---

**Task Steps**
Speak with Kela Lor Telaris 0/1 (Plane of Shadow)
_Task Window Says:_ Speak with Kela Lor Telaris and find out what is to be done about Diabo Va Xin Vellis.
Defeat Luclin 0/1 (Plane of Shadow)
_Task Window Says:_ Luclin has appeared. Meet her challenge
Claim your reward from the chest 0/1 (Plane of Shadow)

---

**Summary**
\- Speak with Kela Lor Telaris to spawn the event (can bypass intro by saying "attack now").
\- After lore plays out, Luclin attacks.
\- Luclin's spells...
\-\-\- From 100%-30%, casts "Dark Hemisphere" and "Light Hemisphere".
\-\-\-\-\-\- Every 35 seconds, these two spells are cast simultaneously. One will AE 180 degrees to her left; the other will AE 180 degrees to her right. The "Dark" AE is a nuke; the "Light" AE is a focus debuff that increases spell damage taken if you are hit with the "Dark" AE. Each time these are cast, these two AEs switch sides.
\-\-\- At 30%, buffs self with "Shield of Shade".
\-\-\-\-\-\- This renders her undamageable as part of the script.
\-\-\- From 30% to death, casts "Disease of Shade".
\-\-\-\-\-\- This is a single-target emote-based viral DOT for 30,000 hp/tick for 3 ticks (viral to anyone within 30' range of the inflicted target).
\-\-\- From 15% to death, casts "Shadow Annihilation" and "Shadow Explosion".
\-\-\-\-\-\- Every 30 seconds, glowing particles appear in a vertical column above the central platform, and Luclin AEs "Shadow Annihilation".
\-\-\-\-\-\- 15 seconds after this happens, the particles turn off and orbs appear, and shortly after this, Luclin AEs "Shadow Explosion".
\-\-\-\-\-\- Both these two "Shadow" spells are avoidable by hiding out of line of sight (use the pillars to hide).
\- The Doors...
\-\-\- Once Luclin reaches 70%, several vessels (orbs) spawn around the room. They are a mix of light (white) and dark (black). You'll need to go through three phases here; the order in which you do so is up to you.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Vessels can be turned the alternate type (light to dark, or dark to light) by DPS'ing them (low hps).
\-\-\-\-\-\- One Phase: Turn every orb dark to spawn "Bearer of Darkness".
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- Every 30 seconds, the Bearer of Darkness AEs "Dark Pulse" (150' range nuke for 16,500).
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- Luclin buffs herself with "Cloak of Darkness" (increase defense) and heals herself for 10%.
\-\-\-\-\-\- Another Phase: Turn every orb light to spawn "Bearer of Light".
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- Every 30 seconds, the Bearer of Darkness AEs "Light Pulse" (150' range nuke for 16,500).
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- Luclin buffs herself with "Lucent Rending" (increase attack) and heals herself for 10%.
\-\-\-\-\-\- A Third Phase: Turn the four southern orbs light, and the four northern orbs dark to spawn the essence of shadow adds.
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- Luclin heals herself for 20%.
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- At first, one add spawns. 60 seconds later, two adds spawn. 60 seconds after that, three adds spawn. These adds continue to spawn every 60 seconds (maximum per wave is three mobs) for the remainder of the event.
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- These adds have low hitpoints and don't hit too hard, and can be mezzed.
\- The Shadow...
\-\-\- Once Luclin reaches 30%, she becomes immune to DPS and walks to her throne. The Shadow of Luclin spawns and attacks.
\-\-\- The Shadow of Luclin casts "Shade Siphon" every 40 seconds.
\-\-\-\-\-\- If a player has this debuff on them at a time when they are hit with another nuke, the Shadow of Luclin heals itself.
\-\-\- Shadow of Luclin has emote-based attacks:
\-\-\-\-\-\- If she emotes that she "raises its sword" at someone, she is 10 seconds away from casting a frontal AE "Shadow Blade" in that players direction.
\-\-\-\-\-\- If she emotes that she "aims a straight cut" at someone, she is 10 seconds away from casting a beam nuke ("Shadow Blade Slash") at that person.
\-\-\-\-\-\- If she emotes that she "glances around itself", she is 10 seconds away from AEing the 175' range "Shadow Blade Whorl".
\-\-\- Kill the Shadow of Luclin to progress the event.
\- After the Shadow's Death: Luclin at 30%...
\-\-\- After the Shadow's death, Luclin attacks again.
\-\-\- She now has an emote-based viral DOT ("Disease of Shade"). She warns 15 seconds ahead of time that "Spreading Shadows will consume you, \_\_\_\_\_" (where the blank is a player).
\- Luclin at 15%...
\-\-\- Once Luclin reaches 15% health, she gains another ability.
\-\-\- An emote will go off indicating the appearance of a vertical column of particles at the center of the room. Luclin, at this time, AEs "Shadow Annihilation" (avoidable by being out of line of sight).
\-\-\- 15 seconds after this, the particles disappear and NPC orbs spawn, at which point Luclin casts "Shadow Explosion".
\- Kill Luclin to complete the event.

---

**Triggering the Event**
_Speak with Kela Lor Telaris to trigger the event. Note that you can bypass the introductory lore by saying "attack now"._
You say, 'Hail, Kela Lor Telaris'
Kela Lor Telaris shouts 'Do you feel it, your hair rising on its ends? The balance of light and darkness tilts back and forth, priming the energy in the air. We cannot wait. Any moment this chamber could [ignite].'
You say, 'Ignite?'
Kela Lor Telaris shouts 'Diabo carries the darkness within him. I can sense you bear the light. When the two meet, they shall annihilate each other, as it should be. I have seen enough to know there is no peace unless the light and the darkness come together as one and give themselves unto obliteration. Without such sacrifice, [strife] is eternal.'
You say, 'Strife?'
Kela Lor Telaris shouts 'You know the imbalance the shards brought to this realm. You see the looming destruction embodied in Diabo. Were he to ascend to the throne of Shadow and obtain the greatest shard secured within, this plane, Vex Thal, and perhaps the entire moon would be swallowed in darkness. If only [Luclin] had heard our pleas.'
You say, 'Where is Luclin?'
Kela Lor Telaris shouts 'She remains in the shadows. Where has she gone now that the spreading fear and ambition of her followers wrecks her home? Does she cower behind the door, shivering at the might of Diabo? Has she herself fallen to the madness of the shard she holds? Were you to [defeat] Diabo, perhaps Luclin would open her chamber that I might remove the shard from this plane and deliver it unto my employer, who will dispose of it. If you have no heart to confront Diabo, you should [leave] now.'
You say, 'We can defeat him'
Kela Lor Telaris glances around as the chamber begins to rumble and fill with shadows. 'Diabo must be breaching the chamber door! The time has come; light and darkness must collide!'
Kela Lor Telaris halts and quakes. 'Shadows betwixt the light and darkness...my Lady, could that be you? We plead only that you allow us to remove the defilement from your sight. My lady, hear my words and despise not my presence!
Luclin shouts 'Mortal beings who live within the shadows of guilt and secrets, what makes you think I hear not every whisper, curse, or plea you utter? Under the light of my moon you spill your secrets to a darkened room, you speak your blood oaths, you cry out in your fulfillment of base desires. I see into your hearts. I know the darkness that lies within, vying with light for supremacy. You stumble about, enshrouded by darkness or blinded by light. You know not which will next lead you, or which will become your master.'
Luclin shouts 'Diabo, darkness mastered you. Long ago light bled from your heart, pierced by the shards of fear and the blackened thorns of envy. You are but a darkened husk, a shriveled form of the creatures I created. For you there is no return to balance, only dissolution in the blackest reaches of my realm, beyond the edge of memory.'
Luclin shouts 'And you, adventurers...you stumble into my presence, led as though blindfolded to gallows built by your own hands. I see within you. Some bear light, others carry darkness, but together your shadow walks a fated path. Will you climb the scaffolding and stand beside your dark executioner? Will you lay your necks within the noose that tightens around Norrath? Know that I will not allow you what you seek. The final piece of Cazic Thule rests in my shade for eternity. If you continue your journey, to you I grant reprieve from the gallows through death.'
_Luclin becomes aggro (auto-aggro and summons from 100%, so be ready for a fight)._

---

**Luclin: 100% to 70%**
_Luclin hits for a max ~13,000 (does not flurry or rampage at all; nor does she through the entire event). She can be pulled to any location in the entire chamber._
_Every 35 seconds, she casts "Dark Hemisphere" and "Light Hemisphere". These two spells are cast simultaneously. One will AE 180 degrees to her left; the other will AE 180 degrees to her right. The "Dark" AE is a nuke; the "Light" AE is a focus debuff that increases spell damage taken if you are hit with the "Dark" AE. Each time these are cast, these two AEs switch sides._
Dark Hemisphere: Directional 400', (-150)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 25000
Light Hemisphere: Directional 400', Chromatic (-975)
1: Add effect: Light Hemisphere Effect
2: Add effect: Light Hemisphere Effect
_Once Luclin reaches 70%, you see these emotes:_
Vessels of light and darkness fill the chamber.
Kela Lor Telaris shouts 'Look at the vessels! Might all of them at once be changed to match the patterns on the doors? Perhaps they channel Luclins powers of Light and Darkness!'

---

**Luclin: 70% to 30%**
_During this phase, Luclin continues casting her "Hemisphere" directional AEs. She does not cast any additional spells, nor does she gain any other abilities._
_When she reaches 70% and the above emotes occur, eight orbs spawn around the center of the room. These are a mix of white and black ("a light vessel" and "a dark vessel")._
_You'll need to go through three phases here; the order in which you do so is up to you. The order in which they are presented here is the recommended order for the least amount of difficulty._
_Vessels can be turned the alternate type (light to dark, or dark to light) by DPS'ing them (low hps)._
The Dark Moon & Bearer of Darkness
_One phase is the "dark" phase: Turn every orb dark to spawn a named called "Bearer of Darkness". As soon as this happens, Luclin heals herself by 10% and buffs herself with "Cloak of Darkness", a two-minute mitigation to all damage:_
The constellation of orbs resonates, and the occluded moon rises in the North.
Luclin is revitalized by the activation of the dark-moon door, and she increases her defense.
Cloak of Darkness: Single Target, Unresistable (0)
1: Mitigate Spell Damage by 15%, 0 total
2: Mitigate Melee Damage by 15%, 0 total
_The Bearer of Darkness spawns at a doorway and slowly makes its way to wherever you're fighting Luclin. It hits for a max ~9,000. Every 30 seconds, the Bearer of Darkness AEs "Dark Pulse":_
Dark Pulse: PB AE 150', Corruption (-150)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 16500
The Full Moon & Bearer of Light
_A second phase is the "light" phase: Turn every orb light to spawn a named called "Bearer of Light". As soon as this happens, Luclin heals herself by 10% and buffs herself with "Lucent Rending", a two-minute increase to her attack:_
The constellation of orbs resonates, and the light of the full moon shines in the South.
Luclin is revitalized by the activation of the full-moon door, and her strength increases.
Lucent Rending: Single Target, Unresistable (0)
1: Increase 1H Blunt Damage Modifier by 110%
2: Increase Attack Speed by 20%
_The Bearer of Light spawns at a doorway and slowly makes its way to wherever you're fighting Luclin. It hits for a max ~9,000. Every 30 seconds, the Bearer of Light AEs "Light Pulse":_
Light Pulse: PB AE 150', Prismatic (-150)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 16500
The Half-Moon & Essences of Shadow
_The third phase is the "mixed" phase: Turn the four southern orbs light, and the four northern orbs dark:_
The constellation of orbs resonates, and the half moon shines in the East.
Luclin is revitalized by the activation of the half-moon door, and beings of shadow are drawn into the fray.
Kela Lor Telaris says 'With the three doors activated, Luclin's protective powers must be exhausted!'
_As soon as this happens, Luclin heals herself by 20%. 60 seconds later, 1x "an essence of shadow" spawns. 60 seconds after that, 2x "an essence of shadow" spawn. 60 seconds later, 3x "an essence of shadow". Every 60 seconds thereafter, you get another three "an essence of shadow". These adds have low hitpoints and hit for a max ~8,000. They are mezzable and stunnable._
Luclin at 30%
_WARNING: Do not take Luclin to 30% until you have spawned all three of these phases. If she reaches 30% before you have spawned them, she regenerates to 100% health._
_Once all three phases have been spawned and Luclin reaches 30%, she goes unaggro, buffs herself with "Shield of Shade" and puts the aura "Shadow Pushback" around her:_
Shadow Pushback: PB AE 250', Unresistable (0)
1: Slow Push (300)
Shield of Shade: Self 0', Unresistable (0)
1: Mitigate Spell Damage by 100%
2: Mitigate Melee Damage by 100%
_She makes her way back to the center of the chamber where she takes a seat on a shadowed throne. Soon after, the room rumbles and the "Shadow of Luclin" appears._
Luclin shouts 'You think your spirit shines in these dark hours, but I see the black cloud billowing about you, encroaching upon your horizon. You race into the moonless night, heedless of the coming destruction you hasten. That which you call light is only darkness. Can you even say where one ends and the other begins? Can you take a life that countless more might be saved? Though Cazic Thule was of my immortal kin, that which has been destroyed should never be repaired, lest he who stalks in shadows arises to claim both night and day. Those of you who cannot walk in the balance of light and darkness will be destroyed by shadow!'

---

**Shadow of Luclin**
_The Shadow of Luclin auto-aggros (summons from 100% health). It hits for a max ~13,000 and can be pulled to any location in the chamber. There are no adds during this phase._
_Every 40 seconds, it debuffs players with "Shade Siphon". This effect causes Luclin to be healed each time any player takes 10,000 damage (or more)._
_It has several emote-based attacks (note that in each case here, there is a double space after the word "Luclin"):_
Shadow of Luclin raises its sword at \_\_\_\_\_ for an arcing cut.
_\-\-\- 10-second warning for a frontal AE "Shadow Blade" in that player's direction._
Shadow Blade: Directional 300', Magic (-950)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 22000
Shadow of Luclin aims a straight cut at \_\_\_\_\_.
_\-\-\- 10-second warning for a beam nuke "Shadow Blade Slash" at that player._
Shadow Blade Slash: Unknown(44) 20', Magic (-950)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 25000
Shadow of Luclin glances around itself.
_\-\-\- 10-second warning to the 175' range AE "Shadow Blade Whorl"._
Shadow Blade Whorl: PB AE 175', Magic (-950)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 19000
_Kill the Shadow of Luclin to progress the event._

---

**Luclin: 30% to 15%**
_Luclin reactivates as soon as the Shadow of Luclin dies (again, auto-aggro and instant summon). She no longer does he "Hemisphere" directional AEs, but she gains an emote-based viral spell attack:_
Luclin says 'The spreading shadows will consume you, \_\_\_\_\_'
\-\-\- 15-second warning to "Disease of Shade" being cast on the targeted player.
Disease of Shade: Single Target, Disease (-975)
1: Decrease Hitpoints by 30000 per tick _(3 ticks)_
2: Increase Disease Counter by 30
\\* Viral to anyone within 40' range
_Note: No adds spawn during this phase, or for the remainder of the event._
_Once Luclin reaches 15%, you see this emote:_
Luclin says 'Those who reject equilibrium and seek to overthrow balance will find nothing but annihilation!'

---

**Luclin: 15% to Defeat**
_Luclin no longer casts the viral spell, but gains a debuff ("Shadow Annihilation", 1200' PBAE avoidable by being out of line of sight) + explosion AE ("Shadow Explosion", 1200' PBAE nuke for 12,000). The "Shadow Annihilation" effect is a focus that makes you take additional damage from the explosion AE._
_Kill Luclin (or rather, the Shadow of Luclin, as she tricked you into doing) to complete the event:_
Luclin's laughter echoes throughout the chamber, and her undefeated form rises from the shadows. 'You still do not understand? The hand of darkness guided you here, stretched you out like mindless digits to grasp for itself that which should never be taken. Kela Lor Telaris, stand before your goddess!'
_Kela Lor Telaris and Luclin have a stand-off in the center of the chamber..._
Luclin shouts 'You are the palm of your master, the black hand of many names. You reach for coin but grab hold of Norrath's destruction. Do you even know whom you serve? Long ago it ceased to be I.'
_Kela Lor Telaris is then destroyed..._
Luclin shouts 'Now your death will serve Norrath as a reminder of the cost of allegiance to Xaric!'
_Luclin makes her way to her throne..._
Luclin shouts 'Adventurers, your courage and strength may be useful to me. But no more will I trifle with you while you remain cloaked in ignorance. If you seek to lift the veil, I await you in my chambers.'
_A chest spawns next to the throne._
Luclin shouts 'In another age, before even your races crawled upon the surface of Norrath, I heard the Alarans praying in their strange tongues under the light of my moon. They cowered beneath this silver eye in the black sky, and they dreaded the glimpse of winged forms flitting across its face. In this strange land, fear lurked beneath every rock and within every shadow. Even as their gods lay dead and buried, the Alarans' fear lived, growing stronger just beyond their vision.'
Luclin shouts 'Though they could not speak its name, I knew it. Even in the darkest twilight recesses of thought I am there. I have seen where it lives, behind the brave countenance or facile smile. Lupex, the Unspoken -- it has been called many things, but its true name is Xaric, the Phantasm of unspeakable fear, the fear without name.'
Luclin shouts 'It waits in the heart of Cazic's crystal, drawing facets of fear unto itself, becoming a god more powerful than Cazic ever was. It ends here. This piece of Cazic Thule will never leave this chamber. If you trek further upon your dark path, I offer you no leniency. You forfeit your life as Kela Lor did when he made a pact with Xaric. But there is yet a chance to atone for your misdeeds.'
Luclin shouts 'In due time I shall open the way into the heart of fear. [Leave] here and return to your lands below. Concern yourself not with my realm, for my servants and I shall return it to equilibrium. Await the time to confront Xaric. Prepare your minds: Be not fooled by the path of light or darkness, for one is often the other. Instead, walk upon the path of shadows, and know that I hear your thoughts and am with you in the gray.'
_As you open the chest:_
Luclin has revealed that Xaric, the Phantasm of Fear, has been using you to gather the fallen shards of Cazic Thule. When the time is right, the way shall be opened for you to confront this unspoken evil that has been spreading its grasp over Norrath.
You say, 'Hail, Luclin'
Luclin says 'You should [leave] from here. If you [fight] on in your quest to bring about Xaric's darkness, you will die.'
_Say "leave" to zone out (or "fight" for a quick zone to your bind location)._
You say, 'Let me leave!'
Luclin says 'Be ready when I call upon you to walk the path of shadow!'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Plane of Shadow.

You say, 'Hail, Vex Derex Lux'
Vex Derex Lux billows threateningly, 'You are either [brave] or [foolish] to dare approach me. Tell me, which is it?'
You say, 'I am brave, of course!'
Vex Derex Lux lets loose a laugh like a maelstrom of angry steam, 'Hah! A fool will think themselves brave when they do not know the danger they face! Now I will teach you-' It stops, suddenly growing calm, then continues in a gentle, breezy tone, '-anything I can that may help you in your journey. Alas! For myself, I am [beyond help].'
You say, 'Beyond help?'
Vex Derex Lux sighs gustily, 'It's so lonesome here, that sometimes I wish I were just a mindless essence like the others who roam this hall. Though we are all formed of the same basic elements, only I can speak and think. Alone, it is a burden, but [shared], I feel it would be the greatest gift imaginable.'
You say, 'Shared?'
Vex Derex Lux says 'I have long pondered how to bestow intelligence upon my fellow essences, and believe I have found a means, however, it is beyond my skill to carry out myself. If you would aid me, however, my dream of building my own army may finally come to fruition!''
_You receive a "Fragment of Vex Derex Lux"._
You have been assigned the task 'Cannibalism for Fun and Profit'.

Modified: Tue Dec 5 05:21:04 2023 | | _This is a Rain of Fear "Collections" achievement._
A sampling of the strange things from the deepest dungeons of fear.
Strange Black Rock
Shifting Shard
Gestation Crystal Shard
Heart of Fear
Paragon of Fear
Hero of Chelsith Reborn
Hero of Plane of Shadow
Hero of Heart of Fear
_The "Strange Black Rock", "Shifting Shard", "Gestation Crystal Shard", and "Heart of Fear" are items to be collected. They are looted from chests that spawn at the end of the following missions:_
\- Unveiling the Mystery _(Chelsith Reborn mission #1 - drops "Strange Black Rock")_
\- Breaking the Seal _(Plane of Shadow mission #1 - drops "Shifting Shard")_
\- Menace, Doom, and Horror _(Heart of Fear mission #1 - drops "Gestation Crystal Shard")_
\- An End to Fear _(Heart of Fear mission #2 - drops "Heart of Fear")_
_"Paragon of Fear" involves the completion of all Tier 1 and Tier 2 missions, and the three "Hero of..." achievements involve the completion of all Tier 3 and both Tier 4 missions._
_Mission writeups along with pre-requisite outlines are documented in **this wiki article**._
_Reward:_
Bard - Dreadstone Minstrel's Rapier
Beastlord - Dreadstone Primal Claws
Berserker - Dreadstone Ravager's Scythe
Cleric - Dreadstone Templar's Scepter
Druid - Dreadstone Warden's Scimitar
Enchanter - Dreadstone Beguiler's Wand
Magician - Dreadstone Summoner's Orb
Monk - Dreadstone Master's Katar
Necromancer - Dreadstone Defiled Dagger
Paladin - Dreadstone Crusader's Hammer
Ranger - Dreadstone Huntsman's Axe
Rogue - Dreadstone Assassin's Knife
Shadow Knight - Dreadstone Life Reaver
Shaman - Dreadstone Mystic Spear
Warrior - Dreadstone Guardian's Blade
Wizard - Dreadstone Evoker's Staff
_Raid Upgrades:_
_All of the above class weapons are upgradeable to a raid version. To upgrade, loot an Eye of Fear from one of the three Heart of Fear Tier 4 raids and, inside a Rust-Tinged Box of Fear, combine it with your Dreadstone weapon. This combine results in a "Possessed Dreadstone" weapon, the raid version of your class weapon._

_This task is the first in a series of four. It begins with Harbinger Iska ( **click for map image**) in the Heart of Fear: The Threshold (first level) at location -85, -10, 75 (at the zone-in: the center of the zone)._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- No task requirements
You say, 'Hail, Harbinger Iska'
Harbinger Iska says 'Finally! Someone competent stumbles through here. You may not believe in our mission, \_\_\_\_\_, but you were a significant help up in Shard's Landing. I trust you're still willing to [fight] for us?'
You say, 'I'm always willing to fight'
Harbinger Iska says 'I'm glad to hear it. Things haven't been going as smoothly as we'd hoped down here. Some of my most-trusted Harbingers have gone missing. Will you help me [find] them?'
You say, 'I will find them'
Harbinger Iska says 'Search the caves to the north for them. That's where they were exploring last. Thank you, \_\_\_\_\_.'
You have been assigned the task 'Lost Harbingers'.

---

Search for the missing Harbingers 0/1 (Heart of Fear: The Threshold)
_This updates in the north-central part of the zone at about 2200, 1600, 3 ( **click for map image**)._
Speak to Risok, the party leader 0/1 (Heart of Fear: The Threshold)
You say, 'Hail, Harbinger Risok'
Harbinger Risok says, 'Are you real, or another apparition? Please, help us! Before they come ba--' The party leader is cut short by creatures materializing around the group and rushing in to attack!
Harbinger Risok calls out as the fear creatures rush toward his scouts, 'If you're really an ally of the Harbingers, help us kill these things!''
_Four mobs (regular trash mobs for the zone) spawn and make their way to the NPCs._
Defend the party against apparitions 0/4 (Heart of Fear: The Threshold)
_Note: While these mobs are not auto-aggro, they tend to be a mix of live and undead, so either invis and IVU quickly after the hail, or back away, or be ready to engage them all at once._
_These mobs will despawn if left idle for longer than two minutes. If this happens, you can re-hail to respawn them._
Speak to Risok once again 0/1 (Heart of Fear: The Threshold)
You say, 'Hail, Harbinger Risok'
Harbinger Risok nods his head in thanks to you, 'We're not the only Harbingers out here. Another group headed into the twisting mountain paths over there.' He points to the southwest.

---

Search for the second party of Harbingers 0/1 (Heart of Fear: The Threshold)
_This updates at -2185, 1650, 5 ( **click for map image** \-\- southwestern part of the zone, towards the southern boundary)._
Speak to one of the scouts 0/1 (Heart of Fear: The Threshold)
You say, 'Hail, a Harbinger scout'
a Harbinger scout says 'I can't risk moving the entire group at once, but if you show one of my scouts the way back to the main group, they can return and lead us all there one at a time.'
_This spawns another scout, which you should lead back to Harbinger Risok. This scout will act like a mercenary in that if you get too far away from it, it warps to your location._
_If you happen to die or zone and lose the scout, you can re-hail to spawn another._
Lead the Harbinger scout back to Risok 0/1 (Heart of Fear: The Threshold)
a Harbinger scout says 'Harbinger, we were ambushed while trying to collect fear shards. We hid for some time, waiting to be rescued. But Harbinger Clykk and a few others got impatient and left us to fight their way back to camp. It looks like they didn't make it. I'll return to the other survivors and carefully lead them back to this camp.'
Speak to Harbinger Risok 0/1 (Heart of Fear: The Threshold)
You say, 'Hail, Harbinger Risok'
Harbinger Risok says 'Thank you for finding them, \_\_\_\_\_. We secured this area while you were away, but if Harbinger Clykk didn't make it back here, I'm afraid I must send you out to find him. Kill any of those pathetic alaran you run into along the way.'

---

Recover the stolen shards 0/6 (Heart of Fear: The Threshold)
_Kill believers (any "believer") until you have six updates (there is no actual item here)._
Find a survivor from the slaughtered party 0/1 (Heart of Fear: The Threshold)
_Find a dying scout at location -1060, -2800, 15 ( **click for map image** \-\- very far southeastern corner of the zone -- the easternmost "room"), and hail it._
You say, 'Hail, a dying scout'
a dying scout spits out blood as he gasps for air between words, 'Harbinger Clykk is dead ... They came from the shadows ... to the west. Kill them ... before they kill ... everyone.' His body shudders as he struggles to take his last breath.

---

Find the source of the apparitions 0/1 (Heart of Fear: The Threshold)
_This updates at around -2100, -880, 3 ( **click for map image** \-\- this is a passage in the far southern part of the zone)._
As you approach a cluster of gestation crystals, the shards in your pack start vibrating violently. A loud musical note rings in the cavern as the fear apparitions trapped inside the crystals break free.
Kill the fear apparitions 0/3 (Heart of Fear: The Threshold)
_These spawn from the nearby crystal and are a mix of three regular trash mobs._

---

Tell Harbinger Iska what has transpired 0/1 (Heart of Fear: The Threshold)
You say, 'Hail, Harbinger Iska'
Harbinger Iska smiles slightly as she thinks, responding slowly, 'The Believers have moved lower into the crystal. This is good. Cazic-Thule's power will be stronger there. And look what it's already doing here! Those gestation crystals must be a manifestation of his power, working to come back to life.' Harbinger Iska laughs and raises her arms into the air, 'Oh, Cazic-Thule, you will be reborn soon!'
You helped Harbinger Iska locate the missing scouts.
_Rewards:_
187 platinum, 5 gold
Experience (2% in Level 100 OR 3 AAs)

_This solo task is the fourth in a series of four. It begins with a Harbinger spy ( **click for map image**) in the Heart of Fear: The Rebirth (middle level). The spy is found on the platform above the giant pit in the middle of the zone._
_Pre-Requisites:_
\- Level 85
\- Completed "Lost Harbingers"
\- Completed "Channeling Cazic"
\- Completed "Growing Fear"
You say, 'Hail, a Harbinger spy'
a Harbinger spy says 'I've been considering your dilemma. I believe the only chance you have to live is to enter the [heart of the crystal] and offer up the power inside you to Cazic-Thule. This is nearly as likely to end in your death as doing nothing, but it's either that or bow to the wishes of the Silent Herald.'
You say, 'What heart of the crystal?'
a Harbinger spy says 'If you wish to pursue that path, you will need to speak with the guard of the depths. You can find him guarding the passage exiting the room below us. Good luck.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Heart of Fear'.
Your time grows short. Your only chance for survival is to enter the heart of the crystal and offer the power to Cazic-Thule before it consumes you.

---

Speak with the guard of the depths 0/1 (Heart of Fear: The Rebirth)
_The guard of the depths is found at location 20, -435, -635 ( **click for map image** \-\- at the very bottom of the pit in the center of the zone; east side)._
You say, 'Hail, the guard of the depths'
the guard of the depths says 'So you are the one I have heard about. I can already feel the frightful power growing within you. However, you are not the only being to have obtained such power. Below us, near the heart of the crystal, are the most dangerous [phantasms].'
You say, 'Phantasms?'
the guard of the depths says 'They ventured below to grow stronger and offer their power to the Unspoken. After being consumed by him, they continue to wander without purpose. They remember only their need to consume the power of others. They will continue feed until they are [destroyed].'
